Use the selected case configuration. Numerical audit gates must pass before results are used downstream.

```{r bootstrap, include=FALSE}
source("R/workflow_config.R", local = TRUE)
.smart31_case <- smart31_load_case(params$case_file)
.smart31_years <- smart31_year_values(.smart31_case)
cfg <- smart31_stage_config(.smart31_case, "step2")
smart31_preflight(.smart31_case, "step2", cfg)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = .smart31_case$project_root)
```

## Scenario constructors

```{r step2-03-scenario-constructors}

`%||%` <- function(x, y) {
  if (is.null(x)) y else x
}

smart31_stop <- function(...) {
  stop(..., call. = FALSE)
}

normalise_code <- function(x) {
  toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
}

normalise_gsa <- function(x) {
  cleaned <- normalise_code(x)
  token <- sub("^GSA[[:space:]_-]*", "", cleaned)
  token <- gsub(",", ".", token, fixed = TRUE)
  token <- gsub("[[:space:]_-]+", "", token)

  output <- rep(NA_character_, length(token))
  integer_format <- !is.na(token) & grepl("^[0-9]+$", token)

  if (any(integer_format)) {
    integer_value <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(token[integer_format]))
    output[integer_format] <- ifelse(
      integer_value < 100L,
      sprintf("GSA%02d", integer_value),
      paste0("GSA", integer_value)
    )
  }

  decimal_format <- !is.na(token) &
    grepl("^[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+$", token)

  if (any(decimal_format)) {
    decimal_parts <- strsplit(token[decimal_format], "\\.")
    output[decimal_format] <- vapply(
      decimal_parts,
      function(parts) {
        paste0(
          "GSA",
          sprintf("%02d", as.integer(parts[[1L]])),
          paste0(parts[-1L], collapse = "")
        )
      },
      character(1)
    )
  }

  output
}

normalise_month <- function(x, label = "MONTH") {
  raw_month <- trimws(as.character(x))
  month_value <- rep(NA_integer_, length(raw_month))

  numeric_month <- !is.na(raw_month) &
    grepl("^(0?[1-9]|1[0-2])$", raw_month)

  month_value[numeric_month] <- as.integer(raw_month[numeric_month])

  month_token <- toupper(gsub("[[:space:]._-]+", "", raw_month))
  month_lookup <- c(
    stats::setNames(seq_len(12L), toupper(month.name)),
    stats::setNames(seq_len(12L), toupper(month.abb)),
    SEPT = 9L
  )

  named_month <- is.na(month_value) &
    !is.na(month_token) &
    month_token %in% names(month_lookup)

  month_value[named_month] <- unname(
    month_lookup[month_token[named_month]]
  )

  invalid_month <- is.na(month_value) | !month_value %in% 1:12

  if (any(invalid_month)) {
    invalid_examples <- unique(raw_month[invalid_month])
    invalid_examples[
      is.na(invalid_examples) | !nzchar(invalid_examples)
    ] <- "<missing_or_blank>"

    smart31_stop(
      label,
      " contains ",
      sum(invalid_month),
      " values that are not valid months. Accepted formats are 1-12, ",
      "01-12, January-December and Jan-Dec. Examples: ",
      paste(utils::head(invalid_examples, 12L), collapse = ", "),
      "."
    )
  }

  month_value
}

new_closure <- function(
  restriction_id,
  id_grid = NULL,
  months = NULL,
  gears = NULL,
  cfr = NULL,
  member_state = .smart31_case$domain$country,
  source_note = NA_character_
) {
  list(
    restriction_id = as.character(restriction_id),
    id_grid = if (is.null(id_grid)) NULL else as.character(id_grid),
    months = if (is.null(months)) NULL else normalise_month(
      months,
      "closure months"
    ),
    gears = if (is.null(gears)) NULL else normalise_code(gears),
    cfr = if (is.null(cfr)) NULL else as.character(cfr),
    member_state = normalise_code(member_state),
    source_note = as.character(source_note)
  )
}

new_cm_rule <- function(
  rule_id,
  associated_measure_id,
  extra_days = 0,
  extra_days_fraction = 0,
  eligible_cfr = NULL,
  eligible_gears = NULL,
  eligible_harbours = NULL,
  minimum_loa = -Inf,
  maximum_loa = Inf,
  member_state = .smart31_case$domain$country,
  rate_status = "configured_compensation"
) {
  list(
    rule_id = as.character(rule_id),
    associated_measure_id = as.character(associated_measure_id),
    extra_days = as.numeric(extra_days),
    extra_days_fraction = as.numeric(extra_days_fraction),
    eligible_cfr = if (is.null(eligible_cfr)) NULL else as.character(eligible_cfr),
    eligible_gears = if (is.null(eligible_gears)) NULL else normalise_code(eligible_gears),
    eligible_harbours = if (is.null(eligible_harbours)) NULL else normalise_code(eligible_harbours),
    minimum_loa = as.numeric(minimum_loa),
    maximum_loa = as.numeric(maximum_loa),
    member_state = normalise_code(member_state),
    rate_status = as.character(rate_status)
  )
}

new_selectivity_rule <- function(
  rule_id,
  multiplier,
  species = NULL,
  gears = NULL,
  months = NULL,
  id_grid = NULL
) {
  list(
    rule_id = as.character(rule_id),
    multiplier = as.numeric(multiplier),
    species = if (is.null(species)) NULL else normalise_code(species),
    gears = if (is.null(gears)) NULL else normalise_code(gears),
    months = if (is.null(months)) NULL else normalise_month(
      months,
      "selectivity-rule months"
    ),
    id_grid = if (is.null(id_grid)) NULL else as.character(id_grid)
  )
}

new_smart31_scenario <- function(
  scenario_id,
  scenario_year = .smart31_years$baseline,
  representative_period = c(.smart31_case$periods$baseline, .smart31_case$periods$future),
  cm_status = c("with_cm", "without_cm"),
  method = c("stochastic_optimizer", "bayesian_dirichlet", "both"),
  closures = list(),
  compensation_mechanisms = list(),
  permanent_cessation_cfr = character(),
  selectivity_rules = list(),
  parameters = list()
) {
  method <- match.arg(method)
  representative_period <- match.arg(representative_period)
  cm_status <- match.arg(cm_status)

  list(
    scenario_id = as.character(scenario_id),
    scenario_year = as.integer(scenario_year),
    representative_period = representative_period,
    member_state = management_member_state,
    cm_status = cm_status,
    method = method,
    closures = closures,
    compensation_mechanisms = compensation_mechanisms,
    permanent_cessation_cfr = as.character(permanent_cessation_cfr),
    selectivity_rules = selectivity_rules,
    parameters = utils::modifyList(
      default_simulation_parameters,
      parameters
    )
  )
}
```

## Core utilities

```{r step2-05-core-utilities}

one_value <- function(x, label, tolerance = sqrt(.Machine$double.eps)) {
  available <- unique(x[!is.na(x)])
  if (length(available) == 0L) {
    return(NA)
  }
  if (is.numeric(available)) {
    if (max(available) - min(available) > tolerance * max(1, abs(available))) {
      smart31_stop("Non-unique values encountered for ", label, ".")
    }
    return(available[[1L]])
  }
  if (length(available) != 1L) {
    smart31_stop("Non-unique values encountered for ", label, ".")
  }
  available[[1L]]
}

weighted_mean_safe <- function(x, w) {
  keep <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(w) & w > 0
  if (!any(keep)) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  stats::weighted.mean(x[keep], w[keep])
}

normalise_positive <- function(x) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  x[!is.finite(x) | x < 0] <- 0
  total <- sum(x)
  if (total <= 0) {
    rep(1 / length(x), length(x))
  } else {
    x / total
  }
}

rdirichlet_one <- function(alpha) {
  alpha <- pmax(as.numeric(alpha), .Machine$double.eps)
  draw <- stats::rgamma(length(alpha), shape = alpha, rate = 1)
  normalise_positive(draw)
}

gva_improvement_threshold <- function(
  current_gva,
  improvement_factor,
  absolute_tolerance
) {
  if (!is.finite(current_gva)) {
    return(Inf)
  }
  current_gva + max(
    absolute_tolerance,
    (improvement_factor - 1) * abs(current_gva)
  )
}

allocate_capped_proportional <- function(total_days, weights, cap) {
  weights <- normalise_positive(weights)
  cap <- rep(as.numeric(cap), length.out = length(weights))

  if (!is.finite(total_days) || total_days < 0 ||
      any(!is.finite(cap)) || any(cap < 0)) {
    smart31_stop("Invalid day-allocation inputs.")
  }

  allocation <- numeric(length(weights))
  remaining <- total_days
  available <- cap > 0 & weights > 0
  tolerance <- 1e-10

  while (remaining > tolerance && any(available)) {
    proposal <- remaining * weights[available] / sum(weights[available])
    room <- cap[available] - allocation[available]
    accepted <- pmin(proposal, room)
    allocation[available] <- allocation[available] + accepted
    remaining <- total_days - sum(allocation)
    available <- available & (allocation < cap - tolerance)
  }

  list(
    allocation = allocation,
    unallocated_days = max(0, remaining),
    feasible = remaining <= tolerance
  )
}

make_unit_id <- function(cfr, month) {
  paste(as.character(cfr), sprintf("%02d", as.integer(month)), sep = "::")
}

make_pattern_id <- function(cfr, month, gear, metier) {
  paste(
    as.character(cfr),
    sprintf("%02d", as.integer(month)),
    normalise_code(gear),
    normalise_code(metier),
    sep = "::"
  )
}

atomic_save_rds <- function(object, output_file) {
  temporary_file <- tempfile(
    pattern = paste0(basename(output_file), "_"),
    tmpdir = dirname(output_file),
    fileext = ".tmp"
  )

  on.exit(
    if (file.exists(temporary_file)) unlink(temporary_file),
    add = TRUE
  )

  saveRDS(
    object,
    temporary_file,
    compress = "gzip",
    version = 3
  )

  if (!file.exists(temporary_file) ||
      !is.finite(file.info(temporary_file)$size) ||
      file.info(temporary_file)$size <= 0) {
    smart31_stop("The temporary Step 2 result file is invalid.")
  }

  published <- file.rename(temporary_file, output_file)
  if (!published) {
    published <- file.copy(
      temporary_file,
      output_file,
      overwrite = FALSE
    )
  }

  if (!published || !file.exists(output_file)) {
    smart31_stop("Unable to publish the Step 2 result file: ", output_file)
  }

  invisible(output_file)
}

smart31_record_parallel_timing <- function(
  stage,
  tasks,
  workers,
  elapsed_seconds
) {
  timing_key <- paste(stage, workers, sep = "::")
  previous <- if (exists(
        timing_key,
        envir = .smart31_acceleration$timings,
        inherits = FALSE
      )) {
    get(
      timing_key,
      envir = .smart31_acceleration$timings,
      inherits = FALSE
    )
  } else {
    list(calls = 0L, tasks = 0L, total_elapsed_seconds = 0)
  }

  assign(
    timing_key,
    list(
      stage = as.character(stage),
      workers = as.integer(workers),
      calls = previous$calls + 1L,
      tasks = previous$tasks + as.integer(tasks),
      total_elapsed_seconds =
        previous$total_elapsed_seconds + as.numeric(elapsed_seconds)
    ),
    envir = .smart31_acceleration$timings
  )

  invisible(NULL)
}

smart31_parallel_lapply <- function(
  X,
  FUN,
  ...,
  use_parallel = TRUE,
  stage = "unspecified"
) {
  started_at <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
  rng_before <- if (exists(
        ".Random.seed",
        envir = .GlobalEnv,
        inherits = FALSE
      )) {
    get(".Random.seed", envir = .GlobalEnv, inherits = FALSE)
  } else {
    NULL
  }

  cluster_available <- isTRUE(use_parallel) &&
    parallel_active &&
    !is.null(.smart31_acceleration$cluster) &&
    length(X) > 1L

  workers_used <- if (cluster_available) {
    min(.smart31_acceleration$run_workers, length(X))
  } else {
    1L
  }

  result <- if (workers_used > 1L) {
    parallel::parLapply(
      .smart31_acceleration$cluster,
      X,
      FUN,
      ...
    )
  } else {
    lapply(X, FUN, ...)
  }

  rng_after <- if (exists(
        ".Random.seed",
        envir = .GlobalEnv,
        inherits = FALSE
      )) {
    get(".Random.seed", envir = .GlobalEnv, inherits = FALSE)
  } else {
    NULL
  }

  if (!identical(rng_before, rng_after)) {
    smart31_stop(
      "Deterministic parallel stage '", stage,
      "' modified the parent random-number stream."
    )
  }

  failed <- vapply(result, inherits, logical(1), what = "try-error")
  if (any(failed)) {
    smart31_stop(
      "Parallel task failure in '", stage, "' at task position(s): ",
      paste(which(failed), collapse = ", "), "."
    )
  }

  elapsed_seconds <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - started_at
  smart31_record_parallel_timing(
    stage = stage,
    tasks = length(X),
    workers = workers_used,
    elapsed_seconds = elapsed_seconds
  )

  result
}

smart31_worker_evaluate_task <- function(task) {
  if (!exists(
        ".smart31_worker_context",
        envir = .GlobalEnv,
        inherits = FALSE
      )) {
    stop("The Step 2 worker context is unavailable.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  evaluate_vessel_month_light(
    task$share,
    task$unit_id,
    get(
      ".smart31_worker_context",
      envir = .GlobalEnv,
      inherits = FALSE
    )
  )
}

smart31_start_parallel_run <- function(context) {
  smart31_stop_parallel_run()

  assign(
    ".smart31_worker_context",
    context,
    envir = .GlobalEnv
  )

  .smart31_acceleration$run_workers <- 1L

  if (!parallel_active) {
    .smart31_acceleration$sequential_fallback_runs <-
      .smart31_acceleration$sequential_fallback_runs + 1L
    return(invisible(1L))
  }

  cluster_attempt <- try(
    parallel::makeForkCluster(
      nnodes = parallel_workers,
      outfile = "/dev/null"
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )

  if (inherits(cluster_attempt, "try-error")) {
    .smart31_acceleration$sequential_fallback_runs <-
      .smart31_acceleration$sequential_fallback_runs + 1L
    cat(
      "SMART3.1 parallel cluster could not be started; ",
      "this run will use the exact sequential fallback.\n",
      sep = ""
    )
    return(invisible(1L))
  }

  .smart31_acceleration$cluster <- cluster_attempt
  .smart31_acceleration$run_workers <- length(cluster_attempt)
  .smart31_acceleration$clusters_started <-
    .smart31_acceleration$clusters_started + 1L
  invisible(.smart31_acceleration$run_workers)
}

smart31_stop_parallel_run <- function() {
  active_cluster <- .smart31_acceleration$cluster
  .smart31_acceleration$cluster <- NULL
  .smart31_acceleration$run_workers <- 1L

  if (!is.null(active_cluster)) {
    try(parallel::stopCluster(active_cluster), silent = TRUE)
  }

  if (exists(
        ".smart31_worker_context",
        envir = .GlobalEnv,
        inherits = FALSE
      )) {
    rm(".smart31_worker_context", envir = .GlobalEnv)
  }

  invisible(NULL)
}

smart31_objects_equivalent <- function(x, y, tolerance = 1e-10) {
  if (identical(x, y)) {
    return(TRUE)
  }

  isTRUE(all.equal(
    x,
    y,
    tolerance = tolerance,
    check.attributes = TRUE
  ))
}
```

```{r step2-06-live-monitoring, include=FALSE}
.smart31_monitor <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())

smart31_monitor_scalar <- function(x, default = NA) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0L) {
    return(default)
  }
  x[[1L]]
}

smart31_html_escape <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("<", "&lt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub(">", "&gt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("\"", "&quot;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  gsub("'", "&#39;", x, fixed = TRUE)
}

smart31_monitor_elapsed <- function(seconds) {
  if (!is.finite(seconds)) {
    return("--:--:--")
  }
  seconds <- max(0, as.integer(round(seconds)))
  sprintf(
    "%02d:%02d:%02d",
    seconds %/% 3600L,
    (seconds %% 3600L) %/% 60L,
    seconds %% 60L
  )
}

smart31_monitor_number <- function(x, digits = 2L) {
  if (length(x) == 0L || !is.finite(x[[1L]])) {
    return("—")
  }
  formatC(x[[1L]], format = "f", digits = digits, big.mark = ",")
}

smart31_monitor_percent <- function(x, digits = 2L) {
  if (length(x) == 0L || !is.finite(x[[1L]])) {
    return("—")
  }
  paste0(
    if (x[[1L]] > 0) "+" else "",
    formatC(x[[1L]], format = "f", digits = digits),
    "%"
  )
}

smart31_monitor_progress <- function(events) {
  empty_result <- list(
    fraction = NA_real_,
    percent = NA_real_,
    eta_seconds = NA_real_,
    completion_utc = "calibrating"
  )
  if (nrow(events) == 0L || nrow(.smart31_monitor$run_plan) == 0L) {
    return(empty_result)
  }

  latest_event <- utils::tail(events, 1L)
  elapsed <- smart31_monitor_scalar(latest_event$elapsed_seconds, NA_real_)
  if (latest_event$event[[1L]] %in% c("step2_completed", "numerical_outputs_completed", "report_assets_completed", "report_assets_failed")) {
    return(list(
      fraction = 1,
      percent = 100,
      eta_seconds = 0,
      completion_utc = smart31_monitor_scalar(
        latest_event$timestamp_utc,
        "complete"
      )
    ))
  }

  skipped_scenarios <- unique(events$scenario_id[
    events$event == "scenario_infeasible" & !is.na(events$scenario_id)
  ])
  effective_plan <- .smart31_monitor$run_plan %>%
    dplyr::filter(!.data$scenario_id %in% .env$skipped_scenarios)
  if (nrow(effective_plan) == 0L) {
    return(empty_result)
  }

  run_events <- events %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.finite(.data$run_index))
  if (nrow(run_events) == 0L) {
    return(empty_result)
  }
  current <- utils::tail(run_events, 1L)
  current_position <- which(
    effective_plan$scenario_id == current$scenario_id[[1L]] &
      effective_plan$method == current$method[[1L]] &
      effective_plan$replicate == current$replicate[[1L]]
  )
  if (length(current_position) != 1L) {
    return(empty_result)
  }

  current_run_events <- run_events %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$scenario_id == current$scenario_id[[1L]],
      .data$method == current$method[[1L]],
      .data$replicate == current$replicate[[1L]]
    )
  current <- utils::tail(current_run_events, 1L)
  event_name <- current$event[[1L]]
  phase_name <- current$phase[[1L]]
  unit_fraction <- if (
    is.finite(current$unit_index[[1L]]) &&
      is.finite(current$units_in_stage[[1L]]) &&
      current$units_in_stage[[1L]] > 0
  ) {
    min(1, max(0, current$unit_index[[1L]] / current$units_in_stage[[1L]]))
  } else {
    0
  }

  run_fraction <- if (event_name %in% c(
    "run_completed", "completed_run_reused", "run_infeasible", "run_output_selected"
  )) {
    1
  } else if (phase_name == "initialisation") {
    0.05 * unit_fraction
  } else if (phase_name == "feasibility_repair") {
    0.05 + 0.05 * unit_fraction
  } else if (event_name %in% c(
    "optimisation_converged", "optimisation_maximum_sweeps_reached"
  )) {
    0.95
  } else if (phase_name %in% c("optimisation", "checkpoint")) {
    maximum_sweeps <- current$maximum_sweeps[[1L]]
    sweep <- current$sweep[[1L]]
    if (!is.finite(maximum_sweeps) || maximum_sweeps <= 0) {
      maximum_sweeps <- utils::tail(
        current_run_events$maximum_sweeps[
          is.finite(current_run_events$maximum_sweeps)
        ],
        1L
      )
    }
    if (!is.finite(sweep)) {
      sweep <- utils::tail(
        current_run_events$sweep[is.finite(current_run_events$sweep)],
        1L
      )
    }
    if (length(maximum_sweeps) == 0L || length(sweep) == 0L ||
        !is.finite(maximum_sweeps) || !is.finite(sweep)) {
      0.10
    } else {
      completed_equivalent <- if (
        event_name == "optimisation_unit_progress"
      ) {
        max(0, sweep - 1) + unit_fraction
      } else {
        max(0, sweep)
      }
      0.10 + 0.85 * min(1, completed_equivalent / maximum_sweeps)
    }
  } else if (phase_name == "final_output_reconstruction") {
    0.95 + 0.05 * unit_fraction
  } else {
    0
  }

  run_fraction <- min(1, max(0, run_fraction))
  overall_fraction <- (
    current_position - 1 + run_fraction
  ) / nrow(effective_plan)
  overall_fraction <- min(1, max(0, overall_fraction))
  eta_seconds <- if (
    is.finite(elapsed) && elapsed >= 60 && overall_fraction >= 0.01
  ) {
    elapsed * (1 - overall_fraction) / overall_fraction
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }
  completion_utc <- if (is.finite(eta_seconds)) {
    format(
      .smart31_monitor$started_at + elapsed + eta_seconds,
      tz = "UTC",
      format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC"
    )
  } else {
    "calibrating"
  }

  list(
    fraction = overall_fraction,
    percent = 100 * overall_fraction,
    eta_seconds = eta_seconds,
    completion_utc = completion_utc
  )
}

smart31_monitor_publish_file <- function(temporary_file, output_file) {
  if (!file.exists(temporary_file)) {
    stop("Monitoring temporary file was not created.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  published <- file.rename(temporary_file, output_file)
  if (!published) {
    published <- file.copy(
      temporary_file,
      output_file,
      overwrite = TRUE
    )
    unlink(temporary_file)
  }

  if (!published || !file.exists(output_file)) {
    stop("Unable to publish monitoring file: ", output_file, call. = FALSE)
  }

  invisible(output_file)
}

smart31_archive_percent_change <- function(value, reference) {
  ans <- rep(NA_real_, length(value))
  reference <- rep(reference, length.out = length(value))
  ok <- is.finite(value) & is.finite(reference) & abs(reference) > 1e-8
  ans[ok] <- 100 * (value[ok] - reference[ok]) / abs(reference[ok])
  ans
}

smart31_monitor_curve_data <- function(events) {
  needed <- c("scenario_id", "method", "replicate", "sweep", "total_GVA", "event")
  if (!all(needed %in% names(events)) || !nrow(events)) return(data.frame())
  z <- events[is.finite(events$total_GVA) & !is.na(events$method) &
    is.finite(events$replicate), , drop = FALSE]
  if (!nrow(z)) return(data.frame())
  key <- paste(z$scenario_id, z$method, z$replicate, sep = "::")
  z <- z[key == tail(key, 1L), , drop = FALSE]
  z <- z[z$event %in% c("optimisation_started", "optimisation_sweep", "optimisation_resumed") &
    is.finite(z$sweep), , drop = FALSE]
  if (!nrow(z)) return(data.frame())
  z <- z[!duplicated(z$sweep, fromLast = TRUE), , drop = FALSE]
  z[order(z$sweep), , drop = FALSE]
}

smart31_archive_svg_chart <- function(x, series, title, y_title, x_end, colours, dashed = character()) {
  width <- 1040; height <- 305; left <- 92; right <- 30; top <- 32; bottom <- 70
  fmt <- function(z) formatC(z, digits = 3, format = "f", decimal.mark = ".")
  vals <- unlist(series, use.names = FALSE); vals <- vals[is.finite(vals)]
  if (!length(vals)) return("<p class='empty'>No comparable reference available.</p>")
  yr <- range(c(0, vals)); pad <- max(diff(yr) * .09, max(abs(yr)) * .015, 1e-5)
  yr <- yr + c(-pad, pad); xr <- c(0, max(1, x_end, x))
  xp <- function(z) left + (z - xr[1]) / diff(xr) * (width - left - right)
  yp <- function(z) top + (yr[2] - z) / diff(yr) * (height - top - bottom)
  yt <- pretty(yr, n = 5); yt <- yt[yt >= yr[1] & yt <= yr[2]]
  xt <- unique(c(0, pretty(xr, n = 10), xr[2])); xt <- xt[xt >= 0 & xt <= xr[2]]
  h <- paste0("<h3>", smart31_html_escape(title), "</h3><svg viewBox='0 0 ", width, " ", height,
    "' role='img' aria-label='", smart31_html_escape(title), "'><title>",
    smart31_html_escape(title), "</title>")
  for (v in yt) h <- paste0(h, "<line x1='", left, "' x2='", width-right,
    "' y1='", fmt(yp(v)), "' y2='", fmt(yp(v)), "' stroke='#e3e9ed'/><text x='", left-12,
    "' y='", fmt(yp(v)+4), "' text-anchor='end' class='tick'>",
    smart31_html_escape(format(signif(v, 4), trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE)), "</text>")
  for (v in xt) h <- paste0(h, "<text x='", fmt(xp(v)), "' y='", height-bottom+23,
    "' text-anchor='middle' class='tick'>", v, "</text>")
  for (nm in names(series)) {
    y <- series[[nm]]; ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
    if (!any(ok)) next
    xx <- x[ok]; yy <- y[ok]

    if (nm %in% dashed && length(unique(yy)) == 1L) { xx <- xr; yy <- rep(yy[1], 2L) }
    points <- paste(paste0(fmt(xp(xx)), ",", fmt(yp(yy))), collapse = " ")
    h <- paste0(h, "<polyline fill='none' stroke='", colours[[nm]], "' stroke-width='2.7' ",
      if (nm %in% dashed) "stroke-dasharray='7 5' " else "", "points='", points, "'/>")
    if (!nm %in% dashed) h <- paste0(h, "<circle cx='", fmt(xp(tail(xx,1))),
      "' cy='", fmt(yp(tail(yy,1))), "' r='4' fill='", colours[[nm]], "'/>")
  }
  h <- paste0(h, "<text x='", (left+width-right)/2, "' y='", height-24,
    "' text-anchor='middle' class='axis-label'>Optimiser sweep (not calendar time)</text>",
    "<text transform='translate(23 ", (top+height-bottom)/2,
    ") rotate(-90)' text-anchor='middle' class='axis-label'>", smart31_html_escape(y_title), "</text></svg>")
  legend <- vapply(names(series), function(nm) paste0("<span><i style='border-top:3px ",
    if (nm %in% dashed) "dashed" else "solid", " ", colours[[nm]], "'></i>",
    smart31_html_escape(nm), "</span>"), character(1))
  paste0(h, "<div class='legend'>", paste(legend, collapse = ""), "</div>")
}

smart31_monitor_convergence_svg <- function(events) {
  z <- smart31_monitor_curve_data(events)
  if (!nrow(z)) return("<div class='empty'>The curves appear at initialisation (sweep 0). Historical GVA is kept separate from the conditioned start.</div>")
  if (!"historical_GVA" %in% names(z)) z$historical_GVA <- NA_real_
  hist <- z$historical_GVA; initial <- z$reference_GVA
  end <- if (any(is.finite(z$maximum_sweeps))) max(z$maximum_sweeps, na.rm=TRUE) else max(z$sweep)
  absolute <- list("Current GVA" = z$total_GVA/1e6, "Step 1 historical reference" = hist/1e6,
    "Conditioned run start" = initial/1e6)
  relative <- list("Change vs history" = smart31_archive_percent_change(z$total_GVA, hist),
    "Change vs run start" = smart31_archive_percent_change(z$total_GVA, initial))
  paste0("<p class='plot-title'>", smart31_html_escape(paste(tail(z$scenario_id,1),
      tail(z$method,1), paste0("replicate ",tail(z$replicate,1)), sep=" · ")), "</p>",
    smart31_archive_svg_chart(z$sweep, absolute, "GVA in context: history, start and current state",
      "Million EUR / representative year", end,
      c("Current GVA"="#F28E2B", "Step 1 historical reference"="#17324D", "Conditioned run start"="#168A9B"),
      dashed=c("Step 1 historical reference", "Conditioned run start")),
    smart31_archive_svg_chart(z$sweep, relative, "Two different comparisons — two explicit denominators",
      "Change (%)", end, c("Change vs history"="#17324D", "Change vs run start"="#168A9B")),
    "<p class='hint'>Historical = unchanged Step 1 model reference for the complete original active cohort, including ceased vessels and closed months. The conditioned start includes Step 2 resets and constraints. A recovery from this start is not necessarily a gain over history. Percent change = 100 × (current − reference) / |reference|; undefined for a zero reference.</p>")
}

smart31_monitor_dashboard <- function() {
  events <- .smart31_monitor$events
  latest <- if (nrow(events)) events[nrow(events),,drop=FALSE] else data.frame()
  text <- function(nm, default="—") {
    x <- latest[[nm]]
    if (!length(x) || is.na(x[1])) default else as.character(x[1])
  }
  metric <- events[is.finite(events$total_GVA),,drop=FALSE]
  if (nrow(metric)) metric <- tail(metric,1)
  value <- function(nm) if(nrow(metric) && length(metric[[nm]])) metric[[nm]][1] else NA_real_
  eur <- function(z) if(is.finite(z)) paste0(formatC(z/1e6,format="f",digits=3)," M€") else "—"
  pct <- function(z) if(is.finite(z)) paste0(if(z>=0) "+" else "", formatC(z,format="f",digits=2),"%") else "—"
  progress <- smart31_monitor_progress(events)
  card <- function(label, number, hint="") paste0("<div class='card'><div class='label'>",
    smart31_html_escape(label),"</div><div class='value'>",smart31_html_escape(number),
    "</div><div class='hint'>",smart31_html_escape(hint),"</div></div>")
  hist <- value("historical_GVA"); initial <- value("reference_GVA"); current <- value("total_GVA")
  recent <- tail(events,16)
  rows <- if(nrow(recent)) paste(vapply(seq_len(nrow(recent)),function(i) {
    r <- recent[i,,drop=FALSE]
    paste0("<tr><td>",smart31_html_escape(r$timestamp_utc),"</td><td>",smart31_html_escape(r$event),
      "</td><td>",smart31_html_escape(r$scenario_id),"</td><td>",smart31_html_escape(r$method),
      "</td><td>",if(is.finite(r$sweep)) r$sweep else "—","</td><td>",smart31_html_escape(r$note),"</td></tr>")
  }, character(1)),collapse="") else "<tr><td>No events yet</td></tr>"
  refresh <- if (!identical(text("phase"), "report_assets_complete"))
    paste0("<meta http-equiv='refresh' content='",monitor_refresh_seconds,"'>") else ""
  paste0("<!doctype html><html lang='en'><head><meta charset='utf-8'>",refresh,
    "<meta name='viewport' content='width=device-width,initial-scale=1'><title>SMART3.1 · live GVA monitor</title>",
    "<style>body{font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;background:#f3f6f8;color:#17324D;margin:0}",
    ".wrap{max-width:1160px;margin:auto;padding:24px}h1{font-size:25px;margin-bottom:4px}h3{font-size:16px}",
    ".sub,.hint{font-size:12px;color:#627583;line-height:1.55}.cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:12px}",
    ".card,.panel{border:1px solid #dce5eb;border-radius:10px;background:white;padding:16px;margin-top:14px}",
    ".value{font-size:23px;font-weight:700;margin:6px 0}.label{font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em}",
    ".panel svg{width:100%;height:auto}.tick{font-size:12px;fill:#627583}.axis-label{font-size:13px;fill:#17324D}",
    ".legend{display:flex;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:20px;font-size:12px;margin-bottom:20px}",
    ".legend i{display:inline-block;width:28px;vertical-align:middle;margin-right:8px}.empty{padding:50px;text-align:center}",
    ".bar{background:#e4edf1;height:9px;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;margin:10px 0}.bar i{display:block;height:100%;background:#168A9B}",
    "table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font-size:11px}td,th{padding:7px;border-bottom:1px solid #e4edf1;text-align:left}",
    ".tablewrap{overflow-x:auto}@media(max-width:900px){.cards{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}",
    "</style></head><body><main class='wrap'><h1>SMART3.1 · live GVA monitor</h1><div class='sub'>",
    smart31_html_escape(paste(text("phase"),text("scenario_id"),text("method"),sep=" · ")),
    "<br>Last update: ",smart31_html_escape(text("timestamp_utc"))," UTC · elapsed ",
    smart31_monitor_elapsed(if(nrow(latest)) latest$elapsed_seconds else NA_real_),"</div><div class='cards'>",
    card("Historical GVA",eur(hist),"Step 1 reference — unchanged"),
    card("Run starting GVA",eur(initial),"After resets and scenario constraints"),
    card("Current / last evaluated GVA",eur(current),"Objective evaluated in EUR"),
    card("Change vs historical",pct(smart31_archive_percent_change(current,hist)),"Not the change from run start"),
    card("Recovery vs run start",pct(smart31_archive_percent_change(current,initial)),"Optimisation gain or loss"),
    "</div><div class='panel'><div class='label'>Run ",text("run_index")," / ",text("total_runs"),
    " · Sweep ",if(is.finite(value("sweep"))) value("sweep") else "—"," / ",
    if(is.finite(value("maximum_sweeps"))) value("maximum_sweeps") else "—",
    " · Overall progress ",smart31_monitor_number(progress$percent,1),"%</div><div class='bar'><i style='width:",
    max(0,min(100,if(is.finite(progress$percent)) progress$percent else 0)),"%'></i></div></div>",
    "<section class='panel'>",smart31_monitor_convergence_svg(events),"</section><section class='panel tablewrap'>",
    "<h3>Latest events</h3><table><thead><tr><th>UTC</th><th>Event</th><th>Scenario</th><th>Method</th><th>Sweep</th><th>Details</th></tr></thead><tbody>",
    rows,"</tbody></table></section></main></body></html>")
}

smart31_monitor_render <- function() {
  if (!isTRUE(.smart31_monitor$enabled)) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  smart31_monitor_write_csv(
    .smart31_monitor$events,
    .smart31_monitor$csv_file
  )

  latest <- utils::tail(.smart31_monitor$events, 1L)
  monitor_progress <- smart31_monitor_progress(.smart31_monitor$events)
  dashboard_eta <- smart31_monitor_detail_eta(.smart31_monitor$events)
  monitor_progress$eta_seconds <- dashboard_eta$total_seconds
  monitor_progress$completion_utc <- dashboard_eta$completion_utc
  status_lines <- c(
    "SMART3.1 Step 2 live status",
    paste0("updated_utc: ", latest$timestamp_utc),
    paste0("elapsed: ", smart31_monitor_elapsed(latest$elapsed_seconds)),
    paste0("event: ", latest$event),
    paste0("phase: ", latest$phase),
    paste0("scenario: ", latest$scenario_id),
    paste0("method: ", latest$method),
    paste0("replicate: ", latest$replicate),
    paste0("run: ", latest$run_index, "/", latest$total_runs),
    paste0("sweep: ", latest$sweep, "/", latest$maximum_sweeps),
    paste0("unit: ", latest$unit_index, "/", latest$units_in_stage),
    paste0("GVA_change_percent: ", latest$GVA_change_percent),
    paste0("GVA_reference_EUR: ", latest$reference_GVA),
    paste0("overall_progress_percent: ", monitor_progress$percent),
    paste0(
      "estimated_time_remaining: ",
      smart31_monitor_elapsed(monitor_progress$eta_seconds)
    ),
    paste0("estimated_completion_utc: ", monitor_progress$completion_utc),
    paste0("current_search_eta: ", smart31_monitor_elapsed(dashboard_eta$run_seconds)),
    paste0("eta_scope: ", dashboard_eta$label),
    paste0("accepted_updates: ", latest$accepted_updates),
    paste0("stable_units: ", latest$stable_units, "/", latest$total_units),
    paste0("maximum_crowding_ratio: ", latest$maximum_crowding_ratio),
    paste0("violation_score: ", latest$violation_score),
    paste0("note: ", latest$note)
  )

  smart31_monitor_write_lines(status_lines, .smart31_monitor$text_file)
  smart31_monitor_write_lines(
    smart31_monitor_dashboard(),
    .smart31_monitor$html_file
  )

  invisible(NULL)
}

smart31_monitor_heartbeat_due <- function() {
  if (!isTRUE(.smart31_monitor$enabled)) {
    return(FALSE)
  }

  last_heartbeat <- .smart31_monitor$last_heartbeat_at
  if (is.null(last_heartbeat) || length(last_heartbeat) == 0L) {
    return(TRUE)
  }

  as.numeric(difftime(
    Sys.time(),
    last_heartbeat,
    units = "secs"
  )) >= monitor_heartbeat_seconds
}

smart31_monitor_event <- function(
  event,
  phase,
  scenario_id = NA_character_,
  method = NA_character_,
  replicate = NA_integer_,
  sweep = NA_integer_,
  maximum_sweeps = NA_integer_,
  unit_index = NA_integer_,
  units_in_stage = NA_integer_,
  accepted_updates = NA_integer_,
  stable_units = NA_integer_,
  total_units = NA_integer_,
  total_GVA = NA_real_,
  reference_GVA = NA_real_,
  maximum_crowding_ratio = NA_real_,
  violation_score = NA_real_,
  note = ""
) {
  if (!isTRUE(.smart31_monitor$enabled)) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  scenario_id <- smart31_monitor_scalar(scenario_id, NA_character_)
  method <- smart31_monitor_scalar(method, NA_character_)
  replicate <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(
    smart31_monitor_scalar(replicate, NA_integer_)
  ))

  scenario_index <- match(
    scenario_id,
    .smart31_monitor$scenario_ids
  )

  run_index <- NA_integer_
  if (nrow(.smart31_monitor$run_plan) > 0L &&
      !is.na(scenario_id) && !is.na(method) && is.finite(replicate)) {
    run_match <- .smart31_monitor$run_plan %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        .data$scenario_id == .env$scenario_id,
        .data$method == .env$method,
        .data$replicate == .env$replicate
      )
    if (nrow(run_match) == 1L) {
      run_index <- run_match$run_index[[1L]]
    }
  }

  run_key <- if (
    !is.na(scenario_id) && !is.na(method) && is.finite(replicate)
  ) {
    paste(scenario_id, method, replicate, sep = "::")
  } else {
    NA_character_
  }
  if (!is.na(run_key) && identical(as.character(event), "run_started")) {
    .smart31_monitor$reference_gva_by_run[[run_key]] <- NULL
  }
  total_gva_value <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(smart31_monitor_scalar(
    total_GVA, NA_real_
  )))
  reference_gva_value <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(smart31_monitor_scalar(
    reference_GVA, NA_real_
  )))
  if (!is.na(run_key) && is.finite(reference_gva_value)) {
    .smart31_monitor$reference_gva_by_run[[run_key]] <- reference_gva_value
  } else if (!is.na(run_key) &&
      !is.null(.smart31_monitor$reference_gva_by_run[[run_key]])) {
    reference_gva_value <- .smart31_monitor$reference_gva_by_run[[run_key]]
  }
  gva_change_percent <- if (
    is.finite(total_gva_value) && is.finite(reference_gva_value) &&
      abs(reference_gva_value) > .Machine$double.eps
  ) {
    100 * (total_gva_value / reference_gva_value - 1)
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

  historical_gva_value <- if (!is.na(scenario_id) && nzchar(scenario_id))
    .smart31_monitor$historical_gva_by_scenario[[as.character(scenario_id)]] else NA_real_
  if (is.null(historical_gva_value) || length(historical_gva_value) != 1L ||
      !is.finite(historical_gva_value)) historical_gva_value <- NA_real_

  elapsed_seconds <- as.numeric(difftime(
    Sys.time(),
    .smart31_monitor$started_at,
    units = "secs"
  ))

  event_row <- tibble::tibble(
    timestamp_utc = format(Sys.time(), tz = "UTC", usetz = FALSE),
    elapsed_seconds = elapsed_seconds,
    event = as.character(event),
    phase = as.character(phase),
    scenario_id = as.character(scenario_id),
    scenario_index = as.integer(scenario_index),
    total_scenarios = as.integer(.smart31_monitor$total_scenarios),
    method = as.character(method),
    replicate = replicate,
    run_index = as.integer(run_index),
    total_runs = as.integer(.smart31_monitor$total_runs),
    sweep = suppressWarnings(as.integer(smart31_monitor_scalar(
      sweep, NA_integer_
    ))),
    maximum_sweeps = suppressWarnings(as.integer(smart31_monitor_scalar(
      maximum_sweeps, NA_integer_
    ))),
    unit_index = suppressWarnings(as.integer(smart31_monitor_scalar(
      unit_index, NA_integer_
    ))),
    units_in_stage = suppressWarnings(as.integer(smart31_monitor_scalar(
      units_in_stage, NA_integer_
    ))),
    accepted_updates = suppressWarnings(as.integer(smart31_monitor_scalar(
      accepted_updates, NA_integer_
    ))),
    stable_units = suppressWarnings(as.integer(smart31_monitor_scalar(
      stable_units, NA_integer_
    ))),
    total_units = suppressWarnings(as.integer(smart31_monitor_scalar(
      total_units, NA_integer_
    ))),
    total_GVA = total_gva_value,
    reference_GVA = reference_gva_value,
    historical_GVA = historical_gva_value,
    GVA_change_vs_history_percent = smart31_archive_percent_change(total_gva_value, historical_gva_value),
    GVA_change_percent = gva_change_percent,
    maximum_crowding_ratio = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(
      smart31_monitor_scalar(maximum_crowding_ratio, NA_real_)
    )),
    violation_score = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(smart31_monitor_scalar(
      violation_score, NA_real_
    ))),
    note = as.character(smart31_monitor_scalar(note, ""))
  )

  .smart31_monitor$events <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    .smart31_monitor$events,
    event_row
  )
  .smart31_monitor$last_heartbeat_at <- Sys.time()

  monitor_progress <- smart31_monitor_progress(.smart31_monitor$events)
  dashboard_eta <- smart31_monitor_detail_eta(.smart31_monitor$events)
  monitor_progress$eta_seconds <- dashboard_eta$total_seconds
  monitor_progress$completion_utc <- dashboard_eta$completion_utc

  if (isTRUE(.smart31_monitor$text)) {
    fields <- c(
      paste0("[SMART3.1 ", smart31_monitor_elapsed(elapsed_seconds), "]"),
      paste0("event=", event),
      paste0("phase=", phase)
    )
    if (!is.na(scenario_id)) fields <- c(fields, paste0("scenario=", scenario_id))
    if (!is.na(method)) fields <- c(fields, paste0("method=", method))
    if (is.finite(replicate)) fields <- c(fields, paste0("rep=", replicate))
    if (is.finite(event_row$sweep)) {
      fields <- c(fields, paste0(
        "sweep=", event_row$sweep, "/", event_row$maximum_sweeps
      ))
    }
    if (is.finite(event_row$unit_index)) {
      fields <- c(fields, paste0(
        "unit=", event_row$unit_index, "/", event_row$units_in_stage
      ))
    }
    if (is.finite(event_row$GVA_change_percent)) {
      fields <- c(fields, paste0(
        "GVA_change=",
        smart31_monitor_percent(event_row$GVA_change_percent, 2L)
      ))
    }
    if (is.finite(monitor_progress$eta_seconds)) {
      fields <- c(fields, paste0(
        "ETA=", smart31_monitor_elapsed(monitor_progress$eta_seconds)
      ))
    }
    if (is.finite(event_row$accepted_updates)) {
      fields <- c(fields, paste0("accepted=", event_row$accepted_updates))
    }
    if (nzchar(event_row$note)) fields <- c(fields, paste0("note=", event_row$note))

    cat(paste(fields, collapse = " | "), "\n", file = stderr())
    try(flush(stderr()), silent = TRUE)
    flush.console()
  }

  tryCatch(
    smart31_monitor_render(),
    error = function(condition) {
      if (!isTRUE(.smart31_monitor$io_warning_issued)) {
        cat(
          "SMART3.1 monitoring warning: ", conditionMessage(condition), "\n",
          file = stderr(), sep = ""
        )
        .smart31_monitor$io_warning_issued <- TRUE
      }
    }
  )

  invisible(event_row)
}

smart31_monitor_set_plan <- function(scenarios) {
  if (!isTRUE(.smart31_monitor$enabled)) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  .smart31_monitor$scenario_ids <- vapply(
    scenarios,
    function(scenario) scenario$scenario_id,
    character(1)
  )
  .smart31_monitor$total_scenarios <- length(scenarios)

  run_plan <- purrr::map_dfr(
    scenarios,
    function(scenario) {

      methods <- if (scenario$method == "both") {
        c("bayesian_dirichlet", "stochastic_optimizer")
      } else {
        scenario$method
      }
      tidyr::crossing(
        scenario_id = scenario$scenario_id,
        method = methods,
        replicate = seq_len(as.integer(
          scenario$parameters$n_replicates
        ))
      )
    }
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(run_index = dplyr::row_number())

  .smart31_monitor$run_plan <- run_plan
  .smart31_monitor$total_runs <- nrow(run_plan)
  .smart31_monitor$rich_plan_caps <- stats::setNames(lapply(scenarios,
    function(s) as.integer(s$parameters$maximum_sweeps)), .smart31_monitor$scenario_ids)

  smart31_monitor_event(
    event = "simulation_plan_ready",
    phase = "planning",
    note = paste0(
      .smart31_monitor$total_scenarios,
      " scenarios; ",
      .smart31_monitor$total_runs,
      " method-replicate runs"
    )
  )

  invisible(run_plan)
}

smart31_monitor_checkpoint_run <- function(scenario, run_result) {
  if (!isTRUE(.smart31_monitor$checkpoint_completed_runs)) stop("requires completed-run archives.")

  run_key <- paste(
    scenario$scenario_id,
    run_result$method,
    paste0("rep", sprintf("%03d", run_result$replicate)),
    sep = "__"
  )

  completed_run_file <- smart31_completed_run_file(
    scenario$scenario_id,
    run_result$method,
    run_result$replicate
  )
  if (isTRUE(.smart31_monitor$checkpoint_completed_runs)) {
    completed_archive <- list(
      metadata = list(
        format_version = "SMART31_step24_completed_run_v1",
        scientific_source_md5 = scientific_source_md5,
        created_utc = format(Sys.time(), tz = "UTC", usetz = TRUE),
        step1_bundle_md5 = configured_bundle_md5,
        catch_quota_file_md5 = catch_quota_file_md5,
        effort_quota_file_md5 = effort_quota_file_md5,
        scenario_contract = scenario,
        method = run_result$method,
        replicate = run_result$replicate,
        seed = run_result$seed
      ),
      run = run_result
    )
    smart31_monitor_write_rds(completed_archive, completed_run_file)
  }

  .smart31_monitor$completed_runs[[run_key]] <- list(
    scenario = list(
      scenario_id = scenario$scenario_id,
      scenario_year = scenario$scenario_year,
      representative_period = scenario$representative_period,
      member_state = scenario$member_state,
      cm_status = scenario$cm_status
    ),
    run_status = list(
      feasible = isTRUE(run_result$feasible),
      converged = isTRUE(run_result$outputs$converged),
      method = run_result$method,
      replicate = run_result$replicate,
      seed = run_result$seed,
      stage = run_result$stage %||% "completed",
      issue = run_result$issue %||% NA_character_
    ),
    run_file = if (isTRUE(.smart31_monitor$checkpoint_completed_runs)) {
      normalizePath(completed_run_file, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
    } else {
      NA_character_
    }
  )

  smart31_monitor_event(
    event = "run_completed",
    phase = "checkpoint",
    scenario_id = scenario$scenario_id,
    method = run_result$method,
    replicate = run_result$replicate,
    note = if (isTRUE(run_result$feasible)) {
      "feasible run completed"
    } else {
      paste0("infeasible at ", run_result$stage %||% "unknown stage")
    }
  )

  if (!isTRUE(.smart31_monitor$checkpoint_completed_runs)) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  checkpoint <- list(
    metadata = list(
      format_version = "SMART31_step24_completed_runs_checkpoint_v5",
      created_utc = format(Sys.time(), tz = "UTC", usetz = TRUE),
      source_document =
        "workflows/step2.Rmd",
      complete_workflow = FALSE,
      completed_run_count = length(.smart31_monitor$completed_runs),
      expected_run_count = .smart31_monitor$total_runs
    ),
    latest_status = utils::tail(.smart31_monitor$events, 1L),
    event_log = .smart31_monitor$events,
    completed_runs = .smart31_monitor$completed_runs
  )

  tryCatch(
    smart31_monitor_write_rds(
      checkpoint,
      .smart31_monitor$checkpoint_file
    ),
    error = function(condition) {
      cat(
        "SMART3.1 checkpoint warning: ", conditionMessage(condition), "\n",
        file = stderr(), sep = ""
      )
    }
  )

  invisible(.smart31_monitor$checkpoint_file)
}

smart31_monitor_complete_workflow <- function(
  simulation_export_file,
  feasible_runs,
  converged_runs
) {
  if (!isTRUE(.smart31_monitor$enabled)) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  smart31_monitor_event(
    event = "numerical_outputs_completed",
    phase = "numerical_outputs_complete",
    note = paste0(
      feasible_runs, " feasible runs; ",
      converged_runs, " converged runs; compact overview and per-run archives written; graphics tracked separately"
    )
  )

  if (isTRUE(.smart31_monitor$checkpoint_completed_runs)) {
    checkpoint <- list(
      metadata = list(
        format_version = "SMART31_step24_completed_runs_checkpoint_v5",
        created_utc = format(Sys.time(), tz = "UTC", usetz = TRUE),
        source_document =
          "workflows/step2.Rmd",
        complete_workflow = FALSE,
        numerical_outputs_complete = TRUE,
        native_HTML_completion_verified = FALSE,
        completed_run_count = length(.smart31_monitor$completed_runs),
        expected_run_count = .smart31_monitor$total_runs,
        final_simulation_export_file = normalizePath(
          simulation_export_file,
          winslash = "/",
          mustWork = FALSE
        )
      ),
      latest_status = utils::tail(.smart31_monitor$events, 1L),
      event_log = .smart31_monitor$events,
      completed_runs = .smart31_monitor$completed_runs
    )

    tryCatch(
      smart31_monitor_write_rds(
        checkpoint,
        .smart31_monitor$checkpoint_file
      ),
      error = function(condition) {
        cat(
          "SMART3.1 checkpoint warning: ", conditionMessage(condition), "\n",
          file = stderr(), sep = ""
        )
      }
    )
  }

  invisible(NULL)
}

smart31_monitor_initialise <- function() {
  .smart31_monitor$enabled <- monitor_enabled
  .smart31_monitor$text <- monitor_text
  .smart31_monitor$viewer <- monitor_rstudio_viewer
  .smart31_monitor$checkpoint_completed_runs <-
    monitor_checkpoint_completed_runs
  .smart31_monitor$started_at <- Sys.time()
  .smart31_monitor$last_heartbeat_at <- .smart31_monitor$started_at
  .smart31_monitor$events <- smart31_monitor_empty_events()
  .smart31_monitor$scenario_ids <- contract_scenario_matrix$scenario_id
  .smart31_monitor$total_scenarios <- nrow(contract_scenario_matrix)
  .smart31_monitor$run_plan <- tibble::tibble(
    scenario_id = character(),
    method = character(),
    replicate = integer(),
    run_index = integer()
  )
  .smart31_monitor$total_runs <- NA_integer_
  .smart31_monitor$completed_runs <- list()
  .smart31_monitor$reference_gva_by_run <- list()
  .smart31_monitor$historical_gva_by_scenario <- list()
  .smart31_monitor$io_warning_issued <- FALSE
  .smart31_monitor$rich_runs <- list()
  .smart31_monitor$rich_references <- list()
  .smart31_monitor$rich_historical_catch <- NULL
  .smart31_monitor$rich_warnings <- character()
  .smart31_monitor$rich_last_key <- NULL
  .smart31_monitor$rich_plan_caps <- list()
  .smart31_monitor$csv_file <- file.path(
    simulation_output_directory,
    "SMART31_step2_live_monitor.csv"
  )
  .smart31_monitor$text_file <- file.path(
    simulation_output_directory,
    "SMART31_step2_live_monitor.txt"
  )
  .smart31_monitor$html_file <- file.path(
    simulation_output_directory,
    "SMART31_step2_live_monitor.html"
  )
  .smart31_monitor$checkpoint_file <- file.path(
    simulation_output_directory,
    "SMART31_step24_completed_runs_checkpoint.rds"
  )

  if (!monitor_enabled) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  smart31_monitor_event(
    event = "step2_started",
    phase = "setup",
    note = "loading and validating Step 1 inputs"
  )

  viewer_opened <- FALSE
  if (monitor_rstudio_viewer &&
      requireNamespace("rstudioapi", quietly = TRUE) &&
      isTRUE(tryCatch(rstudioapi::isAvailable(), error = function(e) FALSE))) {
    viewer_opened <- isTRUE(tryCatch({
      rstudioapi::viewer(normalizePath(
        .smart31_monitor$html_file,
        winslash = "/",
        mustWork = TRUE
      ))
      TRUE
    }, error = function(e) FALSE))
  }

  if (monitor_text) {
    cat(
      "SMART3.1 live dashboard: ",
      normalizePath(
        .smart31_monitor$html_file,
        winslash = "/",
        mustWork = FALSE
      ),
      if (viewer_opened) " (opened in RStudio Viewer)" else
        " (open manually if the Viewer did not appear)",
      "\n",
      file = stderr(),
      sep = ""
    )
    flush.console()
  }

  invisible(NULL)
}

smart31_monitor_detail_guard <- function(expr) {
  if (!isTRUE(.smart31_monitor$enabled)) return(invisible(NULL))
  tryCatch(force(expr), error = function(e) {
    msg <- conditionMessage(e)
    previous <- .smart31_monitor$rich_warnings
    if (!msg %in% previous) {
      .smart31_monitor$rich_warnings <- unique(c(previous, msg))
      cat("SMART3.1 dashboard-only warning: ", msg, "\n", file = stderr(), sep = "")
    }
    invisible(NULL)
  })
}

smart31_monitor_detail_key <- function(scenario, method, replicate) {
  paste(as.character(scenario), as.character(method), as.integer(replicate), sep = "::")
}
smart31_monitor_detail_sum <- function(x) {
  if (!is.numeric(x) || any(!is.finite(x))) return(NA_real_)
  sum(x)
}
smart31_monitor_detail_group_sum <- function(value, key) {
  if (length(value) != length(key) || anyNA(key) || any(!is.finite(value)))
    stop("Incomplete reporting values or keys; no implicit NA-to-zero conversion.")
  if (!length(value)) return(stats::setNames(numeric(), character()))
  z <- rowsum(matrix(as.numeric(value), ncol = 1L), as.character(key), reorder = FALSE)
  stats::setNames(as.numeric(z[, 1L]), rownames(z))
}
smart31_monitor_detail_at <- function(x, keys, missing = 0) {
  ans <- as.numeric(x[match(keys, names(x))]); ans[!keys %in% names(x)] <- missing
  ans
}
smart31_monitor_detail_bind <- function(old, new) {
  if (is.null(old) || !nrow(old)) return(new)
  rbind(old, new)
}

smart31_monitor_detail_catch_limits <- function(q) {
  empty <- data.frame(Species = character(), quota_kg = numeric(),
    quota_years = character(), limiting_years = character(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  if (!is.data.frame(q) || !nrow(q)) return(empty)
  if (!all(c("Species", "YEAR", "quota_kg") %in% names(q)) ||
      anyNA(q[c("Species", "YEAR", "quota_kg")]) || any(!is.finite(q$quota_kg)))
    stop("Incomplete catch-quota reporting table.")
  do.call(rbind, lapply(split(q, as.character(q$Species)), function(z) {
    limit <- min(z$quota_kg)
    data.frame(Species = as.character(z$Species[1L]), quota_kg = limit,
      quota_years = paste(sort(unique(z$YEAR)), collapse = ", "),
      limiting_years = paste(sort(unique(z$YEAR[z$quota_kg == limit])), collapse = ", "),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
}

smart31_monitor_detail_effort_limits <- function(q, history) {
  empty <- data.frame(segment_id = character(), label = character(), Gear = character(),
    length_class = character(), min_loa_m = numeric(), max_loa_m = numeric(),
    upper_inclusive = logical(), quota_days = numeric(), quota_years = character(),
    limiting_years = character(), regulated = logical(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  out <- empty
  if (is.data.frame(q) && nrow(q)) {
    required <- c("Gear", "length_class", "min_loa_m", "max_loa_m", "YEAR", "effort_quota_days")
    if (!all(required %in% names(q)) || anyNA(q[required])) stop("Incomplete effort-quota scopes.")
    key <- paste(q$Gear, q$length_class, q$min_loa_m, q$max_loa_m, sep = "|")
    out <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(q, key), function(z) {
      limit <- min(z$effort_quota_days)
      data.frame(segment_id = paste(z$Gear[1L], z$length_class[1L], z$min_loa_m[1L], z$max_loa_m[1L], sep = "|"),
        label = paste(z$Gear[1L], z$length_class[1L]), Gear = as.character(z$Gear[1L]),
        length_class = as.character(z$length_class[1L]), min_loa_m = z$min_loa_m[1L],
        max_loa_m = z$max_loa_m[1L], upper_inclusive = TRUE, quota_days = limit,
        quota_years = paste(sort(unique(z$YEAR)), collapse = ", "),
        limiting_years = paste(sort(unique(z$YEAR[z$effort_quota_days == limit])), collapse = ", "),
        regulated = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    }))
  }
  covered <- rep(FALSE, nrow(history))
  if (nrow(out)) for (i in seq_len(nrow(out))) covered <- covered |
    (history$Gear == out$Gear[i] & history$loa >= out$min_loa_m[i] & history$loa <= out$max_loa_m[i])

  extra <- unique(as.character(history$Gear[!covered]))
  for (gear in extra) out <- rbind(out, data.frame(segment_id = paste0(gear, "|UNREGULATED"),
    label = paste(gear, "outside quota scopes"), Gear = gear, length_class = "UNREGULATED",
    min_loa_m = 0, max_loa_m = Inf, upper_inclusive = TRUE, quota_days = NA_real_,
    quota_years = "", limiting_years = "", regulated = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  if (nrow(out)) {
    duplicate_labels <- duplicated(out$label) | duplicated(out$label, fromLast = TRUE)
    out$label[duplicate_labels] <- paste0(out$label[duplicate_labels], " [",
      out$min_loa_m[duplicate_labels], "–", out$max_loa_m[duplicate_labels], " m]")
    out <- out[order(out$Gear, !out$regulated, out$min_loa_m, out$max_loa_m), , drop = FALSE]
    rownames(out) <- NULL
  }
  out
}
smart31_monitor_detail_segment_days <- function(d, definitions) {
  if (!all(c("Gear", "loa", "days") %in% names(d)) || anyNA(d[c("Gear", "loa", "days")]) ||
      any(!is.finite(d$days)) || any(!is.finite(d$loa))) stop("Incomplete segment-day reporting values.")
  regulated <- rep(FALSE, nrow(d))
  if (nrow(definitions)) for (i in which(definitions$regulated)) regulated <- regulated |
    (d$Gear == definitions$Gear[i] & d$loa >= definitions$min_loa_m[i] & d$loa <= definitions$max_loa_m[i])
  vapply(seq_len(nrow(definitions)), function(i) {
    use <- d$Gear == definitions$Gear[i] & d$loa >= definitions$min_loa_m[i] & d$loa <= definitions$max_loa_m[i]
    if (!definitions$regulated[i]) use <- use & !regulated
    sum(d$days[use])
  }, numeric(1))
}

smart31_monitor_detail_reference <- function(context) {
  sid <- as.character(context$scenario$scenario_id)
  old <- .smart31_monitor$rich_references[[sid]]
  if (!is.null(old)) return(old)
  history_economic <- dplyr::bind_rows(context$economic_reference, context$cessation_reference)
  initial_economic <- context$initial_economic_monthly
  economic <- data.frame(metric = c("GVA", "GVL", "EC", "GVL_6sp", "GVL_other_reference", "OC"),
    historical = NA_real_, initial = NA_real_)
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(economic))) {
    nm <- economic$metric[i]
    economic$historical[i] <- smart31_monitor_detail_sum(history_economic[[nm]])
    economic$initial[i] <- smart31_monitor_detail_sum(initial_economic[[nm]])
  }
  if (any(!is.finite(economic$historical)) || any(!is.finite(economic$initial)))
    stop("Historical/start economics are incomplete; rich dashboard reference not published.")
  if (is.null(.smart31_monitor$rich_historical_catch)) {
    surface <- .smart31_surface$surface
    supported <- smart31_monitor_detail_group_sum(surface$catch_reference, surface$Species)
    fixed <- prepare_non_vms_reference(non_vms_inputs, historical_years, active_fleet$active_cfr)
    fixed <- smart31_monitor_detail_group_sum(fixed$W, fixed$Species)
    species <- sort(unique(c(names(supported), names(fixed))))
    .smart31_monitor$rich_historical_catch <- data.frame(Species = species,
      historical_supported_kg = smart31_monitor_detail_at(supported, species),
      historical_fixed_non_vms_kg = smart31_monitor_detail_at(fixed, species), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }
  hc <- .smart31_monitor$rich_historical_catch
  hc$historical_kg <- hc$historical_supported_kg + hc$historical_fixed_non_vms_kg

  reporting_quota <- context$catch_quota_reporting_limits
  if (is.null(reporting_quota)) reporting_quota <- context$catch_quota_limits
  quota_catch <- smart31_monitor_detail_catch_limits(
    reporting_quota[!startsWith(reporting_quota$Species, "STOCK::"), , drop = FALSE])
  species <- sort(unique(c(hc$Species, names(context$fixed_non_vms_species_catch), quota_catch$Species)))
  catch <- merge(data.frame(Species = species), hc, by = "Species", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
  for (nm in c("historical_kg", "historical_supported_kg", "historical_fixed_non_vms_kg"))
    catch[[nm]][!catch$Species %in% hc$Species] <- 0
  catch <- merge(catch, quota_catch, by = "Species", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
  catch$fixed_scenario_non_vms_kg <- smart31_monitor_detail_at(context$fixed_non_vms_species_catch, catch$Species)
  catch <- catch[order(catch$Species), , drop = FALSE]
  original <- .smart31_initial$original_time
  profile <- active_fleet$vessel_profile
  historical_days <- data.frame(CFR = as.character(original$CFR), Gear = as.character(original$Gear),
    loa = profile$loa[match(as.character(original$CFR), as.character(profile$CFR))],
    days = original$days_reference, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  scopes <- smart31_monitor_detail_effort_limits(context$effort_quota_table, historical_days)
  scopes$historical_days <- smart31_monitor_detail_segment_days(historical_days, scopes)
  initial_days <- context$gear_time
  initial_days <- data.frame(Gear = as.character(initial_days$Gear),
    loa = profile$loa[match(as.character(initial_days$CFR), as.character(profile$CFR))],
    days = initial_days$days_scenario_gear, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  scopes$initial_days <- smart31_monitor_detail_segment_days(initial_days, scopes)
  ref <- list(scenario_id = sid, representative_period = context$scenario$representative_period,
    economic = economic, catches = catch, effort = scopes,
    maximum_sweeps = as.integer(context$scenario$parameters$maximum_sweeps))
  .smart31_monitor$rich_references[[sid]] <- ref
  ref
}

smart31_monitor_detail_days <- function(state, context) {
  profile <- context$retained_vessels
  pieces <- lapply(names(state$share_by_unit), function(uid) {
    g <- context$gear_search_by_unit[[uid]]
    base <- sum(g$days_scenario_gear)
    extra <- smart31_extra_days(state$share_by_unit[[uid]])
    if (base <= 0 && extra > 0) stop("Positive CM uptake without base activity in dashboard.")
    ratio <- if (base > 0) (base + extra) / base else 1
    data.frame(Gear = as.character(g$Gear),
      loa = profile$loa[match(as.character(g$CFR), as.character(profile$CFR))],
      days = as.numeric(g$days_scenario_gear) * ratio, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  })
  if (!length(pieces)) return(data.frame(Gear = character(), loa = numeric(), days = numeric()))
  do.call(rbind, pieces)
}

smart31_monitor_f_at_catch <- function(catch_kg, limit) {
  unpack <- function(x) as.numeric(strsplit(as.character(x), ";", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]])
  anchor <- unpack(limit$age_F_ITA_anchor); M <- unpack(limit$age_M_reference)
  external <- unpack(limit$age_F_external)
  ratio <- catch_kg / (1000 * limit$anchor_2025_t)
  g <- function(F, m, e) if (F == 0) 0 else F/(F+m+e) * (-expm1(-F-m-e))
  partial <- vapply(seq_along(anchor), function(i) {
    target <- ratio * g(anchor[[i]], M[[i]], external[[i]])
    if (target <= 0) return(0)
    if (target >= 1) return(Inf)
    upper <- 1
    while (g(upper, M[[i]], external[[i]]) < target && upper < 1e6) upper <- upper * 2
    if (g(upper, M[[i]], external[[i]]) < target) return(Inf)
    stats::uniroot(function(x) g(x, M[[i]], external[[i]]) - target,
      c(0, upper), tol = 1e-10)$root
  }, numeric(1))
  mean(external + partial)
}
smart31_monitor_f_rows <- function(ref, stamp, catch, diagnostic=NULL) {
  if (!isTRUE(cfg$enforce_fmsy) ||
      identical(ref$representative_period, .smart31_case$periods$baseline)) return(data.frame())
  limits <- fmsy_catch_limits[fmsy_catch_limits$YEAR == min(
    fmsy_catch_limits$YEAR), , drop = FALSE]
  out <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(limits)), function(i) {
    q <- limits[i, , drop = FALSE]
    kg <- diagnostic[[paste0("stock_catch_kg__", q$assessment_stock)]]
    if(length(kg)!=1L || !is.finite(kg)) stop("Missing stock catch snapshot: ",q$assessment_stock)
    F <- smart31_monitor_f_at_catch(kg, q)
    data.frame(stamp, assessment_stock = q$assessment_stock, Species = q$Species,
      catch_kg = kg, F_calibrated = F, Fmsy = q$Fmsy,
      F_over_Fmsy = F / q$Fmsy, year_basis = "future representative",
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  })
  do.call(rbind, out)
}
smart31_monitor_detail_store <- function(ref, method, replicate, sweep, diagnostic, days,
                                    record_type = "completed_sweep", trajectory = NULL) {
  key <- smart31_monitor_detail_key(ref$scenario_id, method, replicate)
  run <- .smart31_monitor$rich_runs[[key]]
  if (is.null(run)) {

    first <- NULL
    if (is.data.frame(trajectory) && nrow(trajectory) && "sweep" %in% names(trajectory)) {
      candidate <- trajectory[is.finite(trajectory$sweep) & trajectory$sweep == 0L, , drop = FALSE]
      if (nrow(candidate)) first <- candidate[1L, , drop = FALSE]
    }
    if (is.null(first) && is.finite(sweep) && sweep == 0L) first <- diagnostic
    if (!is.null(first)) for (nm in c("GVA", "GVL", "EC", "GVL_6sp", "GVL_other_reference", "OC")) {
      v <- first[[paste0("total_", nm)]]
      if (length(v) && is.finite(v[1L])) ref$economic$initial[ref$economic$metric == nm] <- v[1L]
    }
    run <- list(reference = ref, economics = data.frame(), catches = data.frame(), effort = data.frame(), f_monitor = data.frame())
  }
  ref <- run$reference
  elapsed <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), .smart31_monitor$started_at, units = "secs"))
  stamp <- data.frame(scenario_id = ref$scenario_id, method = method, replicate = as.integer(replicate),
    sweep = as.integer(sweep), record_type = record_type,
    timestamp_utc = format(Sys.time(), tz = "UTC", format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
    elapsed_seconds = elapsed, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  erow <- stamp
  for (nm in c("GVA", "GVL", "EC", "GVL_6sp", "GVL_other_reference", "OC")) {
    current <- as.numeric(diagnostic[[paste0("total_", nm)]][1L])
    if (length(current) != 1L || !is.finite(current)) stop("Incomplete economic snapshot: ", nm)
    r <- ref$economic[ref$economic$metric == nm, , drop = FALSE]
    erow[[paste0("historical_", nm)]] <- r$historical
    erow[[paste0("initial_", nm)]] <- r$initial
    erow[[paste0("current_", nm)]] <- current
    erow[[paste0(nm, "_change_vs_history_percent")]] <- smart31_archive_percent_change(current, r$historical)
    erow[[paste0(nm, "_change_vs_start_percent")]] <- smart31_archive_percent_change(current, r$initial)
  }
  erow$total_days_at_sea <- smart31_monitor_detail_sum(days$days)
  catch <- ref$catches
  current_catch <- vapply(catch$Species, function(sp) {
    val <- diagnostic[[smart31_species_metric_name(sp)]]
    if (!length(val)) return(NA_real_)
    as.numeric(val[1L])
  }, numeric(1))
  if (any(!is.finite(current_catch))) stop("Incomplete species snapshot; missing values are not zero catches.")
  catch$current_kg <- unname(current_catch)
  catch$change_vs_history_percent <- smart31_archive_percent_change(catch$current_kg, catch$historical_kg)
  catch$quota_use_percent <- ifelse(is.finite(catch$quota_kg) & catch$quota_kg > 0,
    100 * catch$current_kg / catch$quota_kg, NA_real_)
  catch$quota_exceeded <- is.finite(catch$quota_kg) &
    catch$current_kg > catch$quota_kg * (1 + quota_tolerance_fraction) + sqrt(.Machine$double.eps)
  effort <- ref$effort
  effort$current_days <- smart31_monitor_detail_segment_days(days, effort)
  effort$change_vs_history_percent <- smart31_archive_percent_change(effort$current_days, effort$historical_days)
  effort$quota_use_percent <- ifelse(is.finite(effort$quota_days) & effort$quota_days > 0,
    100 * effort$current_days / effort$quota_days, NA_real_)
  effort$quota_exceeded <- is.finite(effort$quota_days) &
    effort$current_days > effort$quota_days * (1 + quota_tolerance_fraction) + sqrt(.Machine$double.eps)
  add_stamp <- function(z) cbind(stamp[rep(1L, nrow(z)), , drop = FALSE], z, row.names = NULL)
  drop_snapshot <- function(z) {
    if (!nrow(z)) return(z)
    same <- if (is.na(sweep)) is.na(z$sweep) else !is.na(z$sweep) & z$sweep == sweep
    z[!(same & z$record_type == record_type), , drop = FALSE]
  }
  run$economics <- smart31_monitor_detail_bind(drop_snapshot(run$economics), erow)
  run$catches <- smart31_monitor_detail_bind(drop_snapshot(run$catches), add_stamp(catch))
  run$effort <- smart31_monitor_detail_bind(drop_snapshot(run$effort), add_stamp(effort))
  frows <- smart31_monitor_f_rows(ref, stamp, catch, diagnostic)
  if (nrow(frows)) run$f_monitor <- smart31_monitor_detail_bind(
    drop_snapshot(run$f_monitor), frows)

  if (is.data.frame(trajectory) && nrow(trajectory)) run$trajectory <- trajectory
  run$latest_economics <- erow; run$latest_catches <- catch; run$latest_effort <- effort
  run$latest_f <- frows
  index <- match(key, names(.smart31_monitor$rich_runs))
  if (is.na(index)) index <- length(.smart31_monitor$rich_runs) + 1L

  run$panel_html <- smart31_monitor_detail_run_panel(run, paste0("run-", index))
  .smart31_monitor$rich_runs[[key]] <- run
  .smart31_monitor$rich_last_key <- key
  root <- file.path(simulation_output_directory, "live_dashboard")
  dir.create(root, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  if (!dir.exists(root)) stop("Cannot create dashboard telemetry directory.")
  for (nm in c("economics", "catches", "effort", "f_monitor")) {
    all_runs <- lapply(.smart31_monitor$rich_runs, function(z) z[[nm]])
    smart31_monitor_write_csv(do.call(rbind, all_runs), file.path(root, paste0(nm, ".csv")))
  }
  invisible(NULL)
}
smart31_monitor_detail_capture <- function(state, context, method, replicate, sweep,
                                      diagnostic = NULL, trajectory = NULL) {
  smart31_monitor_detail_guard({
    if (!as.character(context$scenario$scenario_id) %in% .smart31_monitor$scenario_ids)
      return(invisible(NULL))
    ref <- smart31_monitor_detail_reference(context)
    if (is.null(diagnostic)) diagnostic <- smart31_state_diagnostics(state, context)

    for (sp in ref$catches$Species) if (is.null(diagnostic[[smart31_species_metric_name(sp)]])) {
      value <- if (sp %in% names(context$fixed_non_vms_species_catch))
        context$fixed_non_vms_species_catch[[sp]] else 0
      for (ev in state$evaluation_by_unit) {
        if (is.null(ev$catch_kg)) stop("Incomplete unit catch vector in dashboard.")
        if (sp %in% names(ev$catch_kg)) value <- value + ev$catch_kg[[sp]]
      }
      if (!is.finite(value)) stop("Nonfinite species catch in dashboard.")
      diagnostic[[smart31_species_metric_name(sp)]] <- value
    }
    sk <- state$catch_index[startsWith(names(state$catch_index),"STOCK::")]
    for(k in names(sk)) diagnostic[[paste0("stock_catch_kg__",sub("^STOCK::","",k))]] <- sk[[k]]
    days <- smart31_monitor_detail_days(state, context)
    smart31_monitor_detail_store(ref, method, replicate, sweep, diagnostic, days,
      if (sweep == 0L) "conditioned_start" else "completed_sweep", trajectory)
  })
}
smart31_monitor_detail_selected <- function(result, context) {
  smart31_monitor_detail_guard({
    if (!isTRUE(result$feasible) ||
        !as.character(context$scenario$scenario_id) %in% .smart31_monitor$scenario_ids)
      return(invisible(NULL))
    out <- result$outputs; ref <- smart31_monitor_detail_reference(context)
    diagnostic <- as.list(stats::setNames(vapply(c("GVA", "GVL", "EC"),
      function(nm) smart31_monitor_detail_sum(out$economic_monthly[[nm]]), numeric(1)),
      paste0("total_", c("GVA", "GVL", "EC"))))

    catches <- out[["catches", exact = TRUE]]
    if (!is.data.frame(catches)) stop("Selected output lacks the exact complete catches table.")
    totals <- smart31_monitor_detail_group_sum(catches$W, catches$Species)
    for (sp in ref$catches$Species)
      diagnostic[[smart31_species_metric_name(sp)]] <- smart31_monitor_detail_at(totals, sp)
    if(isTRUE(cfg$enforce_fmsy) && !identical(ref$representative_period,.smart31_case$periods$baseline)) {
      sk<-smart31_quota_catches(catches,paste0("STOCK::",unique(fmsy_catch_limits$assessment_stock)))
      for(k in names(sk)) diagnostic[[paste0("stock_catch_kg__",sub("^STOCK::","",k))]]<-sk[[k]]
    }
    trips <- out$trip_time_audit
    if (!is.data.frame(trips) || !all(c("CFR", "Gear", "days") %in% names(trips)))
      stop("Selected output lacks the compact trip-time audit.")
    days <- data.frame(Gear = as.character(trips$Gear), days = trips$days,
      loa = context$retained_vessels$loa[match(as.character(trips$CFR), as.character(context$retained_vessels$CFR))])
    trajectory <- out$search_trajectory
    if (!is.data.frame(trajectory)) trajectory <- out$convergence_log
    last_sweep <- if (is.data.frame(trajectory) && any(is.finite(trajectory$sweep)))
      max(trajectory$sweep[is.finite(trajectory$sweep)]) else NA_integer_
    smart31_monitor_detail_store(ref, result$method, result$replicate, last_sweep,
      diagnostic, days, "selected_output", trajectory)
  })
}

smart31_monitor_detail_eta <- function(events) {
  ans <- list(run_seconds = NA_real_, total_seconds = NA_real_, completion_utc = "Calibrating",
    label = "Waiting for at least three completed-sweep intervals.")
  if (!nrow(events)) return(ans)
  terminal <- c("numerical_outputs_completed", "step2_completed", "report_assets_completed", "report_assets_failed")
  if (tail(events$event, 1L) %in% terminal) {
    ans$run_seconds <- 0; ans$total_seconds <- 0; ans$completion_utc <- "Searches completed"
    ans$label <- "Optimisation is complete. Figure generation and filesystem work are separate."
    return(ans)
  }
  plan <- .smart31_monitor$run_plan
  known <- events[!is.na(events$scenario_id) & !is.na(events$method) & is.finite(events$replicate), , drop = FALSE]
  if (!nrow(known) || !is.data.frame(plan) || !nrow(plan)) return(ans)
  latest <- tail(known, 1L); sid <- latest$scenario_id[1L]
  key <- smart31_monitor_detail_key(sid, latest$method[1L], latest$replicate[1L])
  event_keys <- smart31_monitor_detail_key(events$scenario_id, events$method, events$replicate)
  e <- events[event_keys == key & !is.na(event_keys), , drop = FALSE]

  overall_latest <- tail(events, 1L)
  if (!is.na(overall_latest$scenario_id[1L]) && overall_latest$scenario_id[1L] != sid) {
    ans$label <- "Preparing the next scenario; solver duration is not yet known."
    return(ans)
  }
  rates <- data.frame(key = character(), method = character(), seconds = numeric())
  for (k in unique(smart31_monitor_detail_key(known$scenario_id, known$method, known$replicate))) {
    z <- events[event_keys == k & !is.na(event_keys), , drop = FALSE]

    reset <- which(z$event %in% c("optimisation_started", "optimisation_resumed"))
    if (length(reset)) z <- z[seq.int(tail(reset, 1L), nrow(z)), , drop = FALSE]
    z <- z[z$event %in% c("optimisation_started", "optimisation_sweep", "optimisation_resumed") &
      is.finite(z$sweep) & is.finite(z$elapsed_seconds), , drop = FALSE]
    z <- z[!duplicated(z$sweep, fromLast = TRUE), , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(z) < 4L) next
    ds <- diff(z$sweep); dt <- diff(z$elapsed_seconds)
    good <- ds > 0 & dt > 0 & is.finite(dt)
    intervals <- dt[good] / ds[good]
    if (length(intervals) >= 3L) rates <- rbind(rates, data.frame(key = k,
      method = as.character(tail(z$method, 1L)), seconds = median(tail(intervals, 10L))))
  }
  if (!nrow(rates)) return(ans)
  current_rate <- rates$seconds[match(key, rates$key)]
  if (!length(current_rate) || !is.finite(current_rate)) current_rate <- median(rates$seconds)
  maximum <- e$maximum_sweeps[is.finite(e$maximum_sweeps) & e$maximum_sweeps > 0]
  if (!length(maximum)) maximum <- .smart31_monitor$rich_references[[sid]]$maximum_sweeps
  if (!length(maximum) || !is.finite(tail(maximum, 1L))) return(ans)
  maximum <- tail(maximum, 1L)
  z <- e[e$event %in% c("optimisation_started", "optimisation_sweep", "optimisation_resumed") & is.finite(e$sweep), , drop = FALSE]
  position <- if (nrow(z)) tail(z$sweep, 1L) else 0
  heartbeat <- tail(e, 1L)
  if (identical(heartbeat$event[1L], "optimisation_unit_progress") &&
      is.finite(heartbeat$sweep[1L]) && is.finite(heartbeat$unit_index[1L]) &&
      is.finite(heartbeat$units_in_stage[1L]) && heartbeat$units_in_stage[1L] > 0)
    position <- max(position, heartbeat$sweep[1L] - 1 + min(1, heartbeat$unit_index[1L] / heartbeat$units_in_stage[1L]))
  finished <- c("run_completed", "completed_run_reused", "run_infeasible", "run_aborted", "run_output_selected")
  done <- unique(event_keys[events$event %in% finished])
  blocked <- unique(events$scenario_id[events$event %in% c("scenario_infeasible", "scenario_preparation_failed")])
  remaining_current <- if (key %in% done || identical(heartbeat$phase[1L], "final_output_reconstruction")) 0 else max(0, maximum - position)
  ans$run_seconds <- remaining_current * current_rate
  plan_keys <- smart31_monitor_detail_key(plan$scenario_id, plan$method, plan$replicate)
  future <- plan[!plan_keys %in% c(done, key) & !plan$scenario_id %in% blocked, , drop = FALSE]
  future_seconds <- 0
  if (nrow(future)) for (i in seq_len(nrow(future))) {
    rate <- rates$seconds[rates$method == future$method[i]]
    rate <- if (length(rate)) median(rate) else median(rates$seconds)
    cap <- .smart31_monitor$rich_plan_caps[[as.character(future$scenario_id[i])]]
    if (is.null(cap) || !is.finite(cap)) cap <- maximum
    future_seconds <- future_seconds + rate * cap
  }
  ans$total_seconds <- ans$run_seconds + future_seconds
  now <- .smart31_monitor$started_at + tail(events$elapsed_seconds, 1L)
  ans$completion_utc <- format(now + ans$total_seconds, tz = "UTC", format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC")
  ans$label <- "Search-budget estimate from recent complete sweeps; earlier convergence may shorten it. Future scenario-solver, archive and gallery time is not included."
  if (heartbeat$event[1L] %in% c("run_aborted", "run_infeasible")) ans$label <- paste("Current run stopped, not converged.", ans$label)
  ans
}

smart31_monitor_detail_economic_svg <- function(run, metric) {
  z <- run$economics

  if (is.data.frame(run$trajectory) && nrow(run$trajectory)) {
    tr <- run$trajectory
    if (all(c("sweep", paste0("total_", metric)) %in% names(tr))) {
      old <- data.frame(sweep = tr$sweep, value = tr[[paste0("total_", metric)]], record_type = "completed_sweep")
      fresh <- data.frame(sweep = z$sweep, value = z[[paste0("current_", metric)]], record_type = z$record_type)
      z <- rbind(old, fresh)
    } else z <- data.frame(sweep = z$sweep, value = z[[paste0("current_", metric)]], record_type = z$record_type)
  } else z <- data.frame(sweep = z$sweep, value = z[[paste0("current_", metric)]], record_type = z$record_type)
  z <- z[is.finite(z$sweep) & is.finite(z$value) & z$record_type != "selected_output", , drop = FALSE]
  z <- z[!duplicated(z$sweep, fromLast = TRUE), , drop = FALSE]; z <- z[order(z$sweep), , drop = FALSE]
  last <- run$latest_economics
  hist <- last[[paste0("historical_", metric)]] / 1e6
  initial <- last[[paste0("initial_", metric)]] / 1e6
  current <- last[[paste0("current_", metric)]] / 1e6
  values <- c(hist, initial, current, z$value / 1e6); values <- values[is.finite(values)]
  if (!length(values)) return("<p class='hint'>No complete comparable values yet.</p>")
  w <- 460; h <- 250; left <- 56; right <- 18; top <- 18; bottom <- 44
  yr <- range(c(0, values)); pad <- max(diff(yr) * .10, .001)
  yr <- yr + c(-pad * .15, pad)
  xmax <- max(1, run$reference$maximum_sweeps, if (nrow(z)) max(z$sweep) else 0)
  xp <- function(x) left + x / xmax * (w - left - right)
  yp <- function(y) top + (yr[2L] - y) / diff(yr) * (h - top - bottom)
  fmt <- function(x) formatC(x, digits = 3, format = "f", decimal.mark = ".")
  title <- paste(metric, "— historical, conditioned start and complete-sweep values")
  svg <- paste0("<svg viewBox='0 0 ", w, " ", h, "' role='img' aria-label='", smart31_html_escape(title), "'><title>", smart31_html_escape(title), "</title>")
  yt <- pretty(yr, n = 4); yt <- yt[yt >= yr[1L] & yt <= yr[2L]]
  for (y in yt) svg <- paste0(svg, "<line x1='", left, "' x2='", w-right, "' y1='", fmt(yp(y)), "' y2='", fmt(yp(y)),
    "' stroke='#e2eaf0'/><text x='", left-9, "' y='", fmt(yp(y)+4), "' text-anchor='end' class='tick'>", format(signif(y, 4), trim = TRUE), "</text>")
  for (x in unique(round(seq(0, xmax, length.out = 5)))) svg <- paste0(svg, "<text x='", fmt(xp(x)), "' y='", h-bottom+22, "' text-anchor='middle' class='tick'>", x, "</text>")
  for (kind in c("historical", "initial")) {
    val <- if (kind == "historical") hist else initial
    colour <- if (kind == "historical") "#17324D" else "#168A9B"
    if (is.finite(val)) svg <- paste0(svg, "<line x1='", left, "' x2='", w-right, "' y1='", fmt(yp(val)), "' y2='", fmt(yp(val)),
      "' stroke='", colour, "' stroke-width='2' stroke-dasharray='6 4'/>")
  }
  if (nrow(z)) {
    pts <- paste(paste0(fmt(xp(z$sweep)), ",", fmt(yp(z$value/1e6))), collapse = " ")
    svg <- paste0(svg, "<polyline points='", pts, "' fill='none' stroke='#E98522' stroke-width='2.6'/>")
  }
  xlast <- if (is.finite(last$sweep)) last$sweep else if(nrow(z)) max(z$sweep) else 0
  x <- xp(xlast); y <- yp(current)
  if (identical(as.character(last$record_type), "selected_output")) {
    svg <- paste0(svg, "<polygon points='", paste0(fmt(c(x,x+5,x,x-5)), ",", fmt(c(y-5,y,y+5,y)), collapse = " "),
      "' fill='#E98522'><title>Selected final output; not an additional sweep</title></polygon>")
  } else svg <- paste0(svg, "<circle cx='", fmt(x), "' cy='", fmt(y), "' r='4' fill='#E98522'/>")
  paste0(svg, "<text x='", left, "' y='12' class='axis-label'>Million EUR / representative year</text><text x='", w/2, "' y='", h-5,
    "' text-anchor='middle' class='axis-label'>Optimiser sweep (not a calendar year)</text></svg>")
}

smart31_monitor_detail_bars <- function(labels, historical, current, quota, title, unit) {
  n <- length(labels)
  if (!n) return("<p class='hint'>No segment/reference data available.</p>")
  if (any(!is.finite(historical)) || any(!is.finite(current))) return("<p class='warning'>Incomplete comparison: missing values are not plotted as zero.</p>")
  width <- 1100; left <- 220; right <- 60; top <- 34; row_h <- 62; height <- top + n*row_h + 55
  maximum <- max(c(0, historical, current, quota[is.finite(quota)])); if (maximum <= 0) maximum <- 1
  maximum <- maximum * 1.08
  xp <- function(x) left + x/maximum * (width-left-right)
  fmt <- function(x) formatC(x, digits = 3, format = "f", decimal.mark = ".")
  svg <- paste0("<svg viewBox='0 0 ", width, " ", height, "' role='img' aria-label='", smart31_html_escape(title), "'><title>", smart31_html_escape(title), "</title>")
  ticks <- pretty(c(0, maximum), n = 6); ticks <- ticks[ticks >= 0 & ticks <= maximum]
  for (v in ticks) svg <- paste0(svg, "<line x1='", fmt(xp(v)), "' x2='", fmt(xp(v)), "' y1='", top-12, "' y2='", height-44,
```
