```{r step2-06-live-monitoring, include=FALSE}
    "' stroke='#e6edf1'/><text x='", fmt(xp(v)), "' y='", height-25, "' text-anchor='middle' class='tick'>", smart31_monitor_number(v, if(maximum < 10) 1 else 0), "</text>")
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    y <- top + (i-1)*row_h
    svg <- paste0(svg, "<text x='", left-12, "' y='", y+21, "' text-anchor='end' class='bar-label'>", smart31_html_escape(labels[i]), "</text>")
    for (kind in c("Historical", "Current")) {
      v <- if(kind == "Historical") historical[i] else current[i]
      yy <- y + if(kind == "Historical") 0 else 21
      colour <- if(kind == "Historical") "#17324D" else "#E98522"
      svg <- paste0(svg, "<rect x='", left, "' y='", yy, "' width='", fmt(xp(v)-left), "' height='15' rx='2' fill='", colour, "'><title>",
        smart31_html_escape(paste(labels[i], kind, smart31_monitor_number(v, 3), unit)), "</title></rect>")
    }
    if(is.finite(quota[i])) svg <- paste0(svg, "<line x1='", fmt(xp(quota[i])), "' x2='", fmt(xp(quota[i])), "' y1='", y-5,
      "' y2='", y+40, "' stroke='#A94343' stroke-width='2.4' stroke-dasharray='4 3'><title>",
      smart31_html_escape(paste(labels[i], "applicable annual quota", smart31_monitor_number(quota[i],3), unit)), "</title></line>")
  }
  paste0(svg, "<text x='", (left+width-right)/2, "' y='", height-4, "' text-anchor='middle' class='axis-label'>", smart31_html_escape(unit), " / representative year</text></svg>")
}
smart31_monitor_detail_table <- function(z, kind) {
  catches <- identical(kind, "catches")
  labels <- if(catches) z$Species else z$label
  historical <- if(catches) z$historical_kg/1000 else z$historical_days
  current <- if(catches) z$current_kg/1000 else z$current_days
  quota <- if(catches) z$quota_kg/1000 else z$quota_days
  rows <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(z)), function(i) {
    limit <- if(is.finite(quota[i])) smart31_monitor_number(quota[i], 2) else "Not specified"
    use <- if(is.finite(quota[i]) && quota[i] == 0) {
      if(current[i] <= sqrt(.Machine$double.eps)) "Zero quota; no activity" else "ZERO QUOTA EXCEEDED"
    } else if(is.finite(quota[i])) paste0(smart31_monitor_number(z$quota_use_percent[i], 1), "%") else "—"
    yrs <- if(is.finite(quota[i])) paste0(z$quota_years[i], "; minimum in ", z$limiting_years[i]) else "—"
    paste0("<tr", if(isTRUE(z$quota_exceeded[i])) " class='exceeded'" else "", "><td>", smart31_html_escape(labels[i]),
      "</td><td>", smart31_monitor_number(historical[i],2), "</td><td>", smart31_monitor_number(current[i],2),
      "</td><td>", smart31_monitor_percent(z$change_vs_history_percent[i],2), "</td><td>", limit,
      "</td><td>", use, "</td><td>", smart31_html_escape(yrs), "</td></tr>")
  }, character(1))
  paste0("<div class='tablewrap'><table><thead><tr><th>", if(catches) "Species" else "Segment / constraint scope",
    "</th><th>Historical ", if(catches) "t" else "days", "</th><th>Current ", if(catches) "t" else "days",
    "</th><th>Change vs history</th><th>Annual quota</th><th>Quota used</th><th>Quota year(s)</th></tr></thead><tbody>",
    paste(rows,collapse=""), "</tbody></table></div>")
}

smart31_monitor_f_svg <- function(run) {
  z <- run$latest_f
  if (!is.data.frame(z) || !nrow(z)) return("<p class='hint'>F is monitored for the future representative scenario; the baseline has no FMSY cap.</p>")
  width <- 1050; left <- 220; right <- 75; top <- 35; step <- 62
  height <- top + step * nrow(z) + 52
  maximum <- max(1.15, z$F_over_Fmsy[is.finite(z$F_over_Fmsy)] * 1.05)
  xp <- function(x) left + x / maximum * (width-left-right)
  fmt <- function(x) formatC(x, digits = 2, format = "f", decimal.mark = ".")
  lines <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(z)), function(i) {
    y <- top + step*(i-1)
    val <- z$F_over_Fmsy[[i]]
    paste0("<text x='",left-12,"' y='",y+18,"' text-anchor='end' class='bar-label'>",
      smart31_html_escape(z$assessment_stock[[i]]),"</text>",
      "<rect x='",left,"' y='",y,"' width='",fmt(max(0,xp(min(val,maximum))-left)),
      "' height='25' rx='3' fill='",if(val>1) "#A94343" else "#168A9B",
      "'><title>F=",fmt(z$F_calibrated[[i]]),"; FMSY=",fmt(z$Fmsy[[i]]),"</title></rect>",
      "<text x='",min(width-right+5,xp(min(val,maximum))+7),"' y='",y+18,
      "' class='bar-label'>",fmt(val),"</text>")
  }, character(1))
  paste0("<svg viewBox='0 0 ",width," ",height,"' role='img' aria-label='Calibrated F over FMSY by stock'>",
    "<line x1='",fmt(xp(1)),"' x2='",fmt(xp(1)),"' y1='",top-16,"' y2='",
    height-35,"' stroke='#A94343' stroke-dasharray='5 4' stroke-width='2'/>",
    paste(lines,collapse=""),"<text x='",fmt(xp(1)),"' y='",height-12,
    "' text-anchor='middle' class='axis-label'>F/FMSY = 1</text></svg>")
}
smart31_monitor_detail_run_panel <- function(run, id) {
  last <- run$latest_economics; ref <- run$reference
  label <- paste(last$scenario_id, last$method, paste0("replicate ",last$replicate), sep=" · ")
  status <- if(identical(as.character(last$record_type), "selected_output")) "Selected final output (not a new sweep)" else
    paste("Latest complete snapshot: sweep", last$sweep)
  labels <- c(GVA = "GVA", GVL = "GVL", EC = "EC", GVL_6sp = "GVL · modelled species",
    GVL_other_reference = "GVL · non-modelled species", OC = "Operating cost")
  cards <- vapply(c("GVA","GVL","EC"), function(nm) {
    h <- last[[paste0("historical_",nm)]]; start <- last[[paste0("initial_",nm)]]; now <- last[[paste0("current_",nm)]]
    paste0("<article class='metric-panel'><h3>", labels[[nm]], "</h3><div class='metric-value'>", smart31_monitor_number(now/1e6,3), " M€</div>",
      "<div class='deltas'><span>vs history <b>",smart31_monitor_percent(smart31_archive_percent_change(now,h)),"</b></span>",
      "<span>vs run start <b>",smart31_monitor_percent(smart31_archive_percent_change(now,start)),"</b></span></div>",
      "<div class='mini-reference'><span>Historical <strong>",smart31_monitor_number(h/1e6,3)," M€</strong></span>",
      "<span>Run start <strong>",smart31_monitor_number(start/1e6,3)," M€</strong></span></div>",
      smart31_monitor_detail_economic_svg(run,nm), "</article>")
  },character(1))
  detail_cards <- vapply(c("GVL_6sp","GVL_other_reference","OC"), function(nm) {
    h <- last[[paste0("historical_",nm)]]; start <- last[[paste0("initial_",nm)]]; now <- last[[paste0("current_",nm)]]
    paste0("<article class='economic-detail-card'><div class='label'>", labels[[nm]], "</div>",
      "<strong>", smart31_monitor_number(now/1e6,3), " M€</strong>",
      "<div class='detail-deltas'><span>history ", smart31_monitor_number(h/1e6,3), "</span><span>start ",
      smart31_monitor_number(start/1e6,3), "</span><span>Δhist ",
      smart31_monitor_percent(smart31_archive_percent_change(now,h),1), "</span></div></article>")
  }, character(1))
  c <- run$latest_catches; d <- run$latest_effort
  paste0("<section class='run-view' id='",id,"'><h2>",smart31_html_escape(label),"</h2><p class='snapshot'>",smart31_html_escape(status),
    " · ",smart31_html_escape(last$timestamp_utc)," UTC. All economic, catch and effort panes refer to this same state.</p>",
    "<div class='legend'><span><i class='history-line'></i>Step 1 historical reference</span><span><i class='start-line'></i>Conditioned run start</span>",
    "<span><i class='current-line'></i>Current / selected</span></div><div class='economic-grid'>",paste(cards,collapse=""),"</div>",
    "<div class='economic-detail-grid'>", paste(detail_cards, collapse=""), "</div>",
    "<p class='hint'>Historical economics retain the original active cohort, ceased vessels and closed months. Each metric has its own vertical scale. ",
    "Change = 100 × (current − reference) / |reference|; undefined for a zero reference. An EC decrease is a cost saving, not an automatic gain in GVA. ",
    "The non-modelled-species panel makes the residual explicit; it is not a separately observed GVA component. Residual rule: <b>",
    smart31_html_escape(cfg$other_gvl_mode), "</b>",
    if (identical(cfg$other_gvl_mode, "activity_elastic")) paste0(" · β=", smart31_monitor_number(cfg$other_gvl_beta,2),
      if (isTRUE(cfg$other_gvl_cap_at_reference)) " · capped at Step 1 annual reference" else "") else "", ". ",
    "The solver/optimiser and the historical reference are unchanged by this dashboard.</p>",
    "<section class='panel'><h2>Catches by species — history, current state and non-binding reference</h2>",
    "<div class='legend'><span><i class='history-block'></i>Historical</span><span><i class='current-block'></i>Current / selected</span><span><i class='quota-line'></i>Catch quota reference</span></div>",
    smart31_monitor_detail_bars(c$Species,c$historical_kg/1000,c$current_kg/1000,c$quota_kg/1000,"Model catches by species","tonnes"),
    smart31_monitor_detail_table(c,"catches"),
    "<p class='hint'>Catches are the model's W, not catch-at-age or F. Both sides include the explicit non-VMS ledger for their respective vessel cohort; it is counted once and carries no invented effort. ",
    "Historical supported catches use original Step 1 mass targets, not the conditioned start. No quota is shown as ‘Not specified’, never as zero. ",
    "Catch-quota enforcement is selected in the case configuration. The red mark shows the minimum annual reference for the representative period. Selected effort and FMSY bounds enter feasibility checks.</p></section>",
    "<section class='panel'><h2>Calibrated fishing mortality — F/FMSY by assessment stock</h2>",
    smart31_monitor_f_svg(run),
    smart31_report_label("<p class='hint'>Age-specific calibrated total F, using the same 2025 reference, natural mortality and non-Italian F as Step 3. Values refer to the representative 2027–2030 annual catches; each sweep is an optimiser state, not a future calendar year. A value above 1 exceeds FMSY.</p></section>"),
    "<section class='panel'><h2>Fishing days by segment — history, current state and quota</h2>",
    "<div class='legend'><span><i class='history-block'></i>Historical</span><span><i class='current-block'></i>Current / selected</span><span><i class='quota-line'></i>Catch quota reference</span></div>",
    smart31_monitor_detail_bars(d$label,d$historical_days,d$current_days,d$quota_days,"Fishing days by fleet segment","days at sea"),
    smart31_monitor_detail_table(d,"effort"),
    "<p class='hint'>Days follow the original vessel–gear/month accounting, including REALISED optional CM days. They are not LOA × fishing hours and do not sum repeated vessel annual totals. ",
    "Historical days are pre-reset/pre-cessation. Segment bounds exactly follow the quota table; activity outside those scopes is shown separately. ",
    "If annual segment definitions overlap or change, rows are distinct constraint scopes and must not be added together. Current total across unique vessel–gear activity: ",
    smart31_monitor_number(last$total_days_at_sea,2)," days.</p></section></section>")
}

smart31_monitor_progress_search_field <- function(events) {
  empty_panel <- function(message) paste0(
    "<section class='search-field-panel'><div class='search-field-head'><div>",
    "<span class='search-field-kicker'>LIVE OPTIMISATION</span><h2>Generative search field</h2>",
    "<p>Complexity accumulates only when optimisation progresses.</p></div>",
    "<div class='search-field-badge'>complexity 0%</div></div>",
    "<div class='search-field-empty'><div class='search-field-empty-core'></div><span>",
    smart31_html_escape(message), "</span></div></section>")
  if (!nrow(events)) return(empty_panel("Waiting for the first optimisation run"))
  eligible <- events[is.finite(events$run_index) & !is.na(events$scenario_id) &
    !is.na(events$method) & is.finite(events$replicate), , drop = FALSE]
  if (!nrow(eligible)) return(empty_panel("Preparing the first run · complexity starts at zero"))

  latest <- utils::tail(eligible, 1L)
  same <- eligible$scenario_id == latest$scenario_id[[1L]] &
    eligible$method == latest$method[[1L]] & eligible$replicate == latest$replicate[[1L]]
  run <- eligible[same, , drop = FALSE]
  sweeps <- run$sweep[is.finite(run$sweep)]
  sweep_seen <- if (length(sweeps)) max(0, max(sweeps)) else 0
  maxs <- run$maximum_sweeps[is.finite(run$maximum_sweeps) & run$maximum_sweeps > 0]
  maximum <- if (length(maxs)) max(maxs) else NA_real_
  finished <- any(run$event %in% c("run_completed", "completed_run_reused", "run_infeasible", "run_output_selected"))
  fraction <- if (finished) 1 else if (is.finite(maximum) && maximum > 0)
    min(1, max(0, sweep_seen / maximum)) else 0

  key <- paste(latest$scenario_id[[1L]], latest$method[[1L]], latest$replicate[[1L]], sep = "::")
  code <- utf8ToInt(key)
  signature <- if (length(code)) sum(code * (seq_along(code) + 7L)) %% 4093 else 0
  phase <- 2 * pi * signature / 4093
  tt <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 680L)
  x <- 1.12 * cos(tt) + 0.035 * cos(2 * tt + phase)
  y <- 0.67 * sin(tt) + 0.025 * sin(3 * tt - phase / 2)
  n_layers <- 16L
  for (h in seq_len(n_layers)) {
    raw <- min(1, max(0, n_layers * fraction - (h - 1)))
    gate <- raw * raw * (3 - 2 * raw)
    if (gate <= 0) next
    fx <- h + 2L + ((signature + 5L * h) %% 5L)
    fy <- h + 3L + ((signature + 7L * h) %% 6L)
    amp <- gate * 0.235 / (1 + 0.16 * h)
    x <- x + amp * cos(fx * tt + phase * (0.22 + h / 31))
    y <- y + amp * sin(fy * tt - phase * (0.17 + h / 37))
  }
  radial <- 1 + fraction * 0.052 * sin((4 + signature %% 3) * tt + phase)
  x <- x * radial
  y <- y * (2 - radial)
  xr <- range(x); yr <- range(y)
  scale <- min(760 / max(diff(xr), 1e-9), 244 / max(diff(yr), 1e-9))
  xx <- 450 + (x - mean(xr)) * scale
  yy <- 164 + (y - mean(yr)) * scale
  fmt <- function(z) formatC(z, format = "f", digits = 2)
  make_path <- function(px, py) paste0("M ", fmt(px[[1L]]), " ", fmt(py[[1L]]), " L ",
    paste(paste(fmt(px[-1L]), fmt(py[-1L])), collapse = " L "))
  path <- make_path(xx, yy)

  node_count <- as.integer(5 + floor(45 * fraction))
  idx <- if (node_count > 0L) unique(1L + ((seq_len(node_count) * 37L + signature) %% (length(xx) - 1L))) else integer()
  nodes <- if (length(idx)) paste(vapply(seq_along(idx), function(i) {
    j <- idx[[i]]
    r <- 0.8 + ((signature + 11L * i) %% 7L) / 8
    opacity <- 0.18 + 0.48 * fraction * (0.55 + ((i * 17L + signature) %% 11L) / 20)
    delay <- -((i * 0.41 + (signature %% 13L) / 10) %% 6)
    paste0("<circle cx='", fmt(xx[[j]]), "' cy='", fmt(yy[[j]]), "' r='", fmt(r),
      "' class='search-node' style='opacity:", fmt(min(.85, opacity)), ";animation-delay:", fmt(delay), "s'/>")
  }, character(1)), collapse = "") else ""

  bg_n <- 30L
  stars <- paste(vapply(seq_len(bg_n), function(i) {
    bx <- 28 + ((signature * 13L + i * 83L) %% 844L)
    by <- 24 + ((signature * 19L + i * 47L) %% 276L)
    br <- 0.45 + ((signature + i * 7L) %% 5L) / 6
    op <- 0.12 + ((signature + i * 23L) %% 9L) / 28
    delay <- -((i * .37) %% 5)
    paste0("<circle cx='", bx, "' cy='", by, "' r='", fmt(br),
      "' class='search-star' style='opacity:", fmt(op), ";animation-delay:", fmt(delay), "s'/>")
  }, character(1)), collapse = "")

  pct <- as.integer(round(100 * fraction))
  level <- min(n_layers, floor(n_layers * fraction + 1e-10))
  state <- if (finished) "run complete" else if (sweep_seen <= 0) "initialising" else "optimising"
  run_label <- paste(latest$scenario_id[[1L]], latest$method[[1L]],
    paste0("replicate ", latest$replicate[[1L]]), sep = " · ")
  sweep_label <- if (is.finite(maximum)) paste0("sweep ", sweep_seen, " / ", maximum) else paste0("sweep ", sweep_seen)
  paste0(
    "<section class='search-field-panel'><div class='search-field-head'><div><span class='search-field-kicker'>LIVE OPTIMISATION · ",
    smart31_html_escape(toupper(state)), "</span><h2>Generative search field</h2><p>", smart31_html_escape(run_label),
    " · ", smart31_html_escape(sweep_label), "</p></div><div class='search-field-badge'><span>", pct,
    "%</span><small>complexity · ", level, "/", n_layers, " layers</small></div></div>",
    "<div class='search-field-stage'><svg viewBox='0 0 900 328' role='img' aria-label='Progressive generative optimisation activity field'>",
    "<defs>",
    "<linearGradient id='searchTraceGradient' x1='0%' y1='0%' x2='100%' y2='100%'><stop offset='0%' stop-color='#50e6d1'/><stop offset='48%' stop-color='#74b9ff'/><stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffb15a'/></linearGradient>",
    "<radialGradient id='searchFieldGradient' cx='50%' cy='48%' r='68%'><stop offset='0%' stop-color='#173e52' stop-opacity='.72'/><stop offset='52%' stop-color='#0c2736' stop-opacity='.40'/><stop offset='100%' stop-color='#06131c' stop-opacity='0'/></radialGradient>",
    "<filter id='searchSoftGlow' x='-60%' y='-60%' width='220%' height='220%'><feGaussianBlur stdDeviation='7' result='blur'/><feMerge><feMergeNode in='blur'/><feMergeNode in='SourceGraphic'/></feMerge></filter>",
    "<filter id='searchWideGlow' x='-80%' y='-80%' width='260%' height='260%'><feGaussianBlur stdDeviation='16'/></filter>",
    "</defs>",
    "<rect x='0' y='0' width='900' height='328' rx='24' fill='#06131c'/>",
    "<ellipse cx='450' cy='164' rx='410' ry='142' fill='url(#searchFieldGradient)'/>",
    "<g class='search-stars'>", stars, "</g>",
    "<ellipse class='search-orbit orbit-a' cx='450' cy='164' rx='360' ry='118'/><ellipse class='search-orbit orbit-b' cx='450' cy='164' rx='286' ry='92'/>",
    "<path d='", path, "' class='search-trace-bloom'/><path d='", path, "' class='search-trace-halo'/><path id='smart31-search-trace' d='", path, "' class='search-trace-main'/>",
    "<g class='search-nodes'>", nodes, "</g>",
    "<circle r='13' class='search-runner-glow' filter='url(#searchWideGlow)'><animateMotion dur='7.4s' repeatCount='indefinite' rotate='auto' path='", path, "'/></circle>",
    "<circle r='5.4' class='search-runner' filter='url(#searchSoftGlow)'><animateMotion dur='7.4s' repeatCount='indefinite' rotate='auto' path='", path, "'/></circle>",
    "<circle r='2.1' class='search-runner-core'><animateMotion dur='7.4s' repeatCount='indefinite' rotate='auto' path='", path, "'/></circle>",
    "<circle r='2.6' class='search-runner-tail tail-one'><animateMotion dur='7.4s' begin='-1.15s' repeatCount='indefinite' rotate='auto' path='", path, "'/></circle>",
    "<circle r='1.8' class='search-runner-tail tail-two'><animateMotion dur='7.4s' begin='-2.25s' repeatCount='indefinite' rotate='auto' path='", path, "'/></circle>",
    "</svg><div class='search-field-meter'><i style='width:", pct, "%'></i></div></div>",
    "<div class='search-field-foot'><span><b>0%</b> simple orbit</span><span>detail is cumulative within this run</span><span><b>100%</b> full search field</span></div>",
    "<p class='search-field-note'>Visual activity indicator only · not a vessel track, fishing-ground map or model state · deterministic geometry, no random-number calls · resets only when the next run begins.</p></section>"
  )
}

smart31_monitor_dashboard <- function() {
  events <- .smart31_monitor$events
  latest <- if(nrow(events)) tail(events,1L) else data.frame()
  val <- function(nm,default="—") {
    x <- latest[[nm]]; if(!length(x)||is.na(x[1L])) default else as.character(x[1L])
  }
  progress <- smart31_monitor_progress(events); eta <- smart31_monitor_detail_eta(events)
  elapsed <- if(nrow(latest)) latest$elapsed_seconds[1L] else NA_real_
  runs <- .smart31_monitor$rich_runs
  keys <- names(runs); default_key <- .smart31_monitor$rich_last_key

  pending <- ""
  if(length(keys)) {
    last_known <- events[!is.na(events$scenario_id)&!is.na(events$method)&is.finite(events$replicate),,drop=FALSE]
    if(nrow(last_known)) {
      lk <- tail(last_known,1L); requested <- smart31_monitor_detail_key(lk$scenario_id,lk$method,lk$replicate)
      if(requested %in% keys) default_key <- requested else
        pending <- "The current run is being prepared. Panels below explicitly retain the last available complete run, not the new run."
      if(!is.na(latest$scenario_id[1L]) && latest$scenario_id[1L] != lk$scenario_id[1L])
        pending <- "The next scenario is being prepared. Displayed panels remain labelled with their original run until its new snapshot is available."
    }
  }
  default_index <- match(default_key,keys); if(!length(default_index)||is.na(default_index)) default_index <- 1L
  options <- if(length(keys)) paste(vapply(seq_along(keys),function(i) paste0("<option value='run-",i,"'>",
    smart31_html_escape(paste(runs[[i]]$latest_economics$scenario_id,runs[[i]]$latest_economics$method,sep=" · ")),"</option>"),character(1)),collapse="") else ""
  panels <- if(length(keys)) paste(vapply(seq_along(keys),function(i) {
    cached <- runs[[i]]$panel_html
    if (is.character(cached) && length(cached) == 1L) cached else
      smart31_monitor_detail_run_panel(runs[[i]],paste0("run-",i))
  },character(1)),collapse="") else
    "<section class='panel empty'><h2>Preparing the first complete snapshot</h2><p>GVA, GVL, EC, species catches and segment days appear together at sweep 0, after scenario preparation. Missing data are not zero.</p></section>"
  recent <- tail(events,14)
  rows <- if(nrow(recent)) paste(vapply(seq_len(nrow(recent)),function(i) {
    r <- recent[i,,drop=FALSE]
    paste0("<tr><td>",smart31_html_escape(r$timestamp_utc),"</td><td>",smart31_html_escape(r$event),"</td><td>",smart31_html_escape(r$scenario_id),
      "</td><td>",smart31_html_escape(r$method),"</td><td>",if(is.finite(r$sweep)) r$sweep else "—","</td><td>",smart31_html_escape(r$note),"</td></tr>")
  },character(1)),collapse="") else ""
  ended <- val("event") %in% c("report_assets_completed","report_assets_failed")
  refresh <- if(ended) "" else paste0("<meta http-equiv='refresh' content='",monitor_refresh_seconds,"'>")
  card <- function(label,value,hint="") paste0("<div class='time-card'><div class='label'>",smart31_html_escape(label),"</div><strong>",smart31_html_escape(value),
    "</strong><div class='hint'>",smart31_html_escape(hint),"</div></div>")
  warnings <- .smart31_monitor$rich_warnings
  warning_html <- if(length(warnings)) paste0("<div class='warning'><b>Dashboard-only diagnostics:</b> ",smart31_html_escape(paste(tail(warnings,3),collapse=" | ")),"</div>") else ""
  paste0("<!doctype html><html lang='en'><head><meta charset='utf-8'>",refresh,"<meta name='viewport' content='width=device-width,initial-scale=1'>",
    "<title>SMART3.1 · live scenario dashboard · </title><style>",
    "*{box-sizing:border-box}body{font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;background:#f3f6f8;color:#17324D;margin:0}.wrap{max-width:1580px;margin:auto;padding:24px 32px}h1{font-size:28px;margin:0 0 5px}h2{font-size:19px;margin:0 0 10px}h3{font-size:18px;margin:0 0 5px}.sub,.hint,.snapshot{font-size:12px;color:#617887;line-height:1.6}.snapshot{margin:8px 0 12px}",
    ".time-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;margin-top:18px}.time-card,.panel,.metric-panel{background:white;border:1px solid #dbe5ec;border-radius:11px;padding:18px}.time-card strong{display:block;font-size:23px;margin:8px 0}.time-card:last-child strong{font-size:18px}.label{text-transform:uppercase;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.07em}.panel{margin:16px 0}.economic-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px}.economic-detail-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;margin:10px 0 4px}.economic-detail-card{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fbfdfe,#f4f8fa);border:1px solid #dbe5ec;border-radius:9px;padding:13px 15px}.economic-detail-card strong{display:block;font-size:20px;margin:5px 0;color:#17324D}.detail-deltas{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:11px;color:#617887}.detail-deltas span{white-space:nowrap}.metric-value{font-size:30px;font-weight:750;letter-spacing:-.02em}.deltas{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:10px 0}.deltas span{font-size:12px;background:#eef4f7;border-radius:5px;padding:6px 8px}.deltas b{margin-left:5px}.mini-reference{font-size:12px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin:12px 0}.mini-reference span{display:flex;flex-direction:column;color:#617887}.mini-reference strong{color:#17324D;font-weight:600;margin-top:3px}",

    "@media(max-width:1000px){.time-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.economic-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.economic-detail-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.metric-panel{max-width:100%}.metric-panel svg{max-height:320px}.wrap{padding:18px}}@media(max-width:550px){.time-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}.time-card{padding:12px}.time-card strong{font-size:19px}h1{font-size:23px}.panel{padding:12px}.mini-reference{flex-wrap:wrap}}</style></head><body><main class='wrap'>",

    "<br>Last event: ",smart31_html_escape(val("timestamp_utc"))," UTC</div><div class='time-grid'>",
    card("Elapsed",smart31_monitor_elapsed(elapsed),"Current R session"),
    card("ETA current search",smart31_monitor_elapsed(eta$run_seconds),"At the configured sweep budget"),
    card("ETA all remaining searches",smart31_monitor_elapsed(eta$total_seconds),"Estimate, not a convergence promise"),
    card("Estimated search finish",eta$completion_utc,"UTC; solver/export/gallery caveat below"),"</div><p class='hint'>",smart31_html_escape(eta$label),"</p>",
    "<div class='panel'><div class='label'>Run ",smart31_html_escape(val("run_index"))," / ",smart31_html_escape(val("total_runs"))," · Current sweep ",smart31_html_escape(val("sweep"))," / ",smart31_html_escape(val("maximum_sweeps")),
    " · Overall progress ",smart31_monitor_number(progress$percent,1),"%</div><div class='bar'><i style='width:",if(is.finite(progress$percent)) max(0,min(100,progress$percent)) else 0,"%'></i></div>",
    "<div class='hint'>Progress updates within a sweep; comparison panels update together at each completed sweep and after final output selection.</div></div>",
    smart31_monitor_progress_search_field(events),
    warning_html,if(nzchar(pending)) paste0("<div class='warning'>",smart31_html_escape(pending),"</div>") else "",
    if(length(keys)) paste0("<div class='controls'><label for='run-picker'>Displayed run</label><select id='run-picker'><option value='follow'>Follow latest run</option>",options,"</select></div>") else "",panels,
    "<details class='panel events'><summary>Latest events</summary><div class='tablewrap'><table><thead><tr><th>UTC</th><th>Event</th><th>Scenario</th><th>Method</th><th>Sweep</th><th>Details</th></tr></thead><tbody>",rows,"</tbody></table></div></details>",
    "<p class='hint'>All plots are generated locally from small reporting summaries. No network chart service, cell-table reload or additional simulation is used.</p></main>",
    "<script>(function(){var p=document.getElementById('run-picker');if(!p)return;var k='smart31.run',d='run-",default_index,"';",
    "function show(){var v=p.value==='follow'?d:p.value;document.querySelectorAll('.run-view').forEach(function(e){e.hidden=e.id!==v;});try{sessionStorage.setItem(k,p.value);}catch(e){}}",
    "try{var v=sessionStorage.getItem(k);if(v&&Array.from(p.options).some(function(o){return o.value===v;}))p.value=v;}catch(e){}p.addEventListener('change',show);show();",
    "try{var y=sessionStorage.getItem('smart31.scroll');if(y)window.scrollTo(0,Number(y));window.addEventListener('scroll',function(){sessionStorage.setItem('smart31.scroll',String(window.scrollY));},{passive:true});}catch(e){}",
    "})();</script></body></html>")
}

smart31_monitor_detail_regression_tests <- function() {
  e <- new.env(parent = environment(smart31_monitor_detail_regression_tests))
  wanted <- c(grep("^smart31_monitor_detail_", ls(parent.env(e), all.names = TRUE), value = TRUE),
    "smart31_monitor_progress_search_field",
    "smart31_monitor_f_rows", "smart31_monitor_f_at_catch", "smart31_monitor_f_svg",
    "smart31_monitor_dashboard", "smart31_monitor_progress", "smart31_monitor_number",
    "smart31_monitor_percent", "smart31_monitor_elapsed", "smart31_monitor_scalar",
    "smart31_archive_percent_change", "smart31_html_escape", "smart31_monitor_empty_events")
  wanted <- setdiff(unique(wanted), "smart31_monitor_detail_regression_tests")
  for(nm in wanted) { f <- get(nm, envir = parent.env(e)); environment(f) <- e; assign(nm, f, envir = e) }
  e$.smart31_monitor <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
  e$.smart31_monitor$enabled <- TRUE
  e$.smart31_monitor$rich_runs <- list(); e$.smart31_monitor$rich_references <- list()
  e$.smart31_monitor$rich_historical_catch <- NULL; e$.smart31_monitor$rich_warnings <- character()
  e$.smart31_monitor$rich_last_key <- NULL; e$.smart31_monitor$rich_plan_caps <- list(S = 100L)
  e$.smart31_monitor$started_at <- as.POSIXct("2026-01-01 00:00:00", tz="UTC")
  e$.smart31_monitor$events <- e$smart31_monitor_empty_events()
  e$.smart31_monitor$run_plan <- data.frame(scenario_id="S",method="engine",replicate=1L,run_index=1L)
  e$monitor_refresh_seconds <- 2; e$quota_tolerance_fraction <- 1e-8
  e$cfg <- list(enforce_fmsy = FALSE,
    other_gvl_mode = "activity_elastic", other_gvl_beta = 0.5,
    other_gvl_cap_at_reference = TRUE)
  e$smart31_monitor_write_csv <- function(...) invisible(NULL)
  e$smart31_species_metric_name <- function(sp) paste0("catch_kg__",gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+","_",as.character(sp)))

  stopifnot(e$.smart31_monitor$rich_runs[["S::engine::1"]]$reference$economic$initial[1L]==50,

  pass("method_specific_run_start_no_reference_leakage")

  ev<-e$smart31_monitor_empty_events()
  for(i in 0:4) {
    row<-as.data.frame(lapply(ev,function(x) {if(is.character(x))"" else if(is.integer(x))NA_integer_ else NA_real_}))
    row$timestamp_utc<-format(e$.smart31_monitor$started_at+i*60,tz="UTC",format="%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
    row$elapsed_seconds<-i*60;row$event<-if(i==0)"optimisation_started" else "optimisation_sweep"
    row$phase<-"optimisation";row$scenario_id<-"S";row$method<-"engine";row$replicate<-1L
    row$run_index<-1L;row$total_runs<-1L;row$sweep<-as.integer(i);row$maximum_sweeps<-100L
    ev<-rbind(ev,row)
  }
  e$.smart31_monitor$events<-ev
  eta<-e$smart31_monitor_detail_eta(ev)
  stopifnot(eta$run_seconds==5760,eta$total_seconds==5760)
  short<-ev[1:3,];stopifnot(is.na(e$smart31_monitor_detail_eta(short)$run_seconds))
  stopifnot(!any(grepl("NaN|Inf",c(eta$completion_utc,eta$label))))
  pass("ETA_recent_sweeps_and_explicit_calibration_phase")

  reset<-ev[5,];reset$event<-"optimisation_resumed";reset$sweep<-60L;reset$elapsed_seconds<-500
  resumed<-rbind(ev,reset)
  stopifnot(is.na(e$smart31_monitor_detail_eta(resumed)$run_seconds))
  pass("ETA_does_not_use_pre_resume_sweep_intervals")

  html<-e$smart31_monitor_dashboard()

    grepl("Fishing days by segment",html,fixed=TRUE),grepl("Not specified",html,fixed=TRUE),
    grepl("<h3>EC</h3>",html,fixed=TRUE),!grepl("https://",html,fixed=TRUE),!grepl("NaN",html,fixed=TRUE))
  pass("complete_offline_HTML_economic_decomposition_generative_field_catches_and_effort")
  escaped<-e$smart31_monitor_detail_bars("HKE<script>",1,2,NA,"Synthetic <test>","tonnes")
  stopifnot(grepl("&lt;script&gt;",escaped,fixed=TRUE),!grepl("HKE<script>",escaped,fixed=TRUE))
  stopifnot(is.na(e$smart31_archive_percent_change(1,0)),e$smart31_archive_percent_change(-5,-10)==50)
  pass("HTML_escaping_and_zero_negative_reference_handling")

  stopifnot(identical(seed_before,seed_after))
  pass("no_consumption_of_the_simulation_RNG")
  result<-data.frame(test=tests,status="PASS",scope="synthetic dashboard only; not fleet validation")
  print(result,row.names=FALSE);invisible(result)
```

## Load step 1 bundle

```{r step2-07-load-step-1-bundle}

find_latest_step1_bundle <- function(directory) {
  latest_pointer <- file.path(
    directory,
    "SMART31_step1_simulation_inputs_LATEST.rds"
  )

  if (file.exists(latest_pointer)) {
    return(latest_pointer)
  }

  candidate_files <- list.files(
    directory,
    pattern = "^SMART31_step1_simulation_inputs_.*\\.rds$",
    full.names = TRUE
  )

  candidate_files <- candidate_files[
    basename(candidate_files) !=
      "SMART31_step1_simulation_inputs_LATEST.rds"
  ]

  if (length(candidate_files) == 0L) {
    smart31_stop(
      "No principal Step 1 simulation bundle was found in: ",
      normalizePath(directory, mustWork = FALSE),
      ". Supply params$step1_bundle_file or SMART31_STEP1_BUNDLE."
    )
  }

  candidate_information <- file.info(candidate_files)
  candidate_files[which.max(candidate_information$mtime)]
}

resolve_step1_bundle_file <- function(path) {
  if (basename(path) != "SMART31_step1_simulation_inputs_LATEST.rds") {
    return(list(file = path, expected_md5 = NA_character_))
  }

  pointer <- readRDS(path)
  required_pointer_fields <- c(
    "simulation_bundle_file",
    "simulation_bundle_md5"
  )

  if (!is.list(pointer) ||
      !all(required_pointer_fields %in% names(pointer))) {
    smart31_stop("The Step 1 LATEST file is not a valid bundle pointer.")
  }

  resolved <- file.path(
    dirname(path),
    basename(pointer$simulation_bundle_file)
  )

  list(
    file = resolved,
    expected_md5 = as.character(pointer$simulation_bundle_md5)
  )
}

configured_bundle_file <- cfg$step1_bundle_file

if (is.null(configured_bundle_file) ||
    !nzchar(as.character(configured_bundle_file))) {
  configured_bundle_file <- Sys.getenv(
    "SMART31_STEP1_BUNDLE",
    unset = ""
  )
}

if (!nzchar(as.character(configured_bundle_file))) {
  configured_bundle_file <- find_latest_step1_bundle(
    step1_bundle_directory
  )
}

resolved_bundle <- resolve_step1_bundle_file(configured_bundle_file)
configured_bundle_file <- resolved_bundle$file

if (!file.exists(configured_bundle_file)) {
  smart31_stop(
    "The configured Step 1 bundle does not exist: ",
    configured_bundle_file
  )
}

configured_bundle_md5 <- unname(tools::md5sum(configured_bundle_file))

if (!is.na(resolved_bundle$expected_md5) &&
    !identical(
      tolower(configured_bundle_md5),
      tolower(resolved_bundle$expected_md5)
    )) {
  smart31_stop(
    "The principal Step 1 bundle does not match the MD5 stored in LATEST."
  )
}

step1_bundle <- readRDS(configured_bundle_file)

if (!is.list(step1_bundle) ||
    !all(c("metadata", "inputs", "manifest") %in% names(step1_bundle))) {
  smart31_stop(
    "The selected RDS is not a valid SMART3.1 principal simulation bundle."
  )
}

step1_inputs <- step1_bundle$inputs

required_step1_inputs <- c(
  "years_to_submit",
```

## Validate step 1 structures

```{r step2-08-validate-step-1-structures}

assert_columns <- function(object, object_name, required_columns) {
  if (!is.data.frame(object)) {
    smart31_stop("'", object_name, "' is not a data frame.")
  }
  missing_columns <- setdiff(required_columns, names(object))
  if (length(missing_columns) > 0L) {
    smart31_stop(
      "'", object_name, "' is missing: ",
      paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
  invisible(TRUE)
}

assert_columns(
  step1_inputs$IBM_effort,
  "IBM_effort",
  c(
    "CFR", "YEAR", "MONTH", "Gear", "Metier", "id_grid",
    "loa", "fishing_time", "harbour",
    "GSA_code"
  )
)

assert_columns(

)

    "CFR", "YEAR", "MONTH", "observed_fishing_days",
    "calendar_days_in_month"
  )
)

assert_columns(
  step1_inputs$economic_activity_baseline,
  "economic_activity_baseline",
  c(
    "CFR", "YEAR", "MONTH", "Gear", "days_at_sea",
    "observed_fishing_days", "days_at_sea_source",
    "trips_per_sea_day", "fishing_time", "steaming_time",
    "fishing_time_elasticity", "fishing_fuel_l_per_h",
    "steaming_fuel_l_per_h"

)

expected_day_source <-
  "observed_unique_UTC_fishing_dates_allocated_by_activity_hours"

unexpected_day_source <- step1_inputs$economic_activity_baseline %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    is.na(.data$days_at_sea_source) |
      .data$days_at_sea_source != expected_day_source

if (nrow(unexpected_day_source) > 0L) {
  smart31_stop(
    "Step 2 requires a Step 1 bundle whose baseline days are ",
    "derived from unique UTC fishing dates. The selected bundle contains ",
    nrow(unexpected_day_source),
    " incompatible economic-activity rows."
  )
}

observed_day_structure <- step1_inputs$observed_fishing_days %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    CFR = as.character(.data$CFR),
    YEAR = as.integer(.data$YEAR),
    MONTH = normalise_month(
      .data$MONTH,
      "observed_fishing_days$MONTH"
    ),
    observed_fishing_days = as.numeric(.data$observed_fishing_days),
    calendar_days_in_month = as.numeric(.data$calendar_days_in_month)
  )

if (anyDuplicated(observed_day_structure[c("CFR", "YEAR", "MONTH")]) ||
    anyNA(observed_day_structure) ||
    any(!is.finite(observed_day_structure$observed_fishing_days)) ||
    any(!is.finite(observed_day_structure$calendar_days_in_month)) ||
    any(observed_day_structure$observed_fishing_days <= 0) ||
    any(
      observed_day_structure$observed_fishing_days >
        observed_day_structure$calendar_days_in_month
    )) {
  smart31_stop(
    "The Step 1 UTC fishing-day table is invalid or duplicated by ",
    "CFR, YEAR and MONTH."
  )
}

baseline_day_reconciliation <- step1_inputs$economic_activity_baseline %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    CFR = as.character(.data$CFR),
    YEAR = as.integer(.data$YEAR),
    MONTH = normalise_month(
      .data$MONTH,
      "economic_activity_baseline$MONTH"
    ),
    days_at_sea = as.numeric(.data$days_at_sea),
    observed_fishing_days = as.numeric(.data$observed_fishing_days)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$CFR, .data$YEAR, .data$MONTH) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    allocated_days = sum(.data$days_at_sea),
    observed_days = one_value(
      .data$observed_fishing_days,
      "vessel-month observed fishing days"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    tolerance = sqrt(.Machine$double.eps) *
      pmax(1, abs(.data$observed_days)),
    reconciled =
      abs(.data$allocated_days - .data$observed_days) <= .data$tolerance
  )

if (anyNA(baseline_day_reconciliation) ||
    any(!is.finite(baseline_day_reconciliation$allocated_days)) ||
    any(!baseline_day_reconciliation$reconciled)) {
  smart31_stop(
    "The Step 1 economic baseline does not reconcile to its unique UTC ",
    "vessel-month fishing-day counts."
  )
}

    as.numeric(step1_inputs$thr_depth) <= 800) {
  smart31_stop(
    "The Step 1 analytical grid must extend deeper than 800 m to evaluate ",
    "the Italian deep-water closure."
  )
}

if (anyDuplicated(step1_inputs$grid_gsa_lookup$id_grid)) {
  smart31_stop("grid_gsa_lookup is not unique by id_grid.")
}

if (is.data.frame(step1_inputs$fuel_cost)) {
  assert_columns(
    step1_inputs$fuel_cost,
    "fuel_cost",
    c("YEAR", "fuel_cost")
  )
} else if (length(step1_inputs$fuel_cost) != 1L ||
           !is.finite(as.numeric(step1_inputs$fuel_cost)) ||
           as.numeric(step1_inputs$fuel_cost) < 0) {
  smart31_stop(
    "fuel_cost must be an annual YEAR/fuel_cost table or one finite ",
    "non-negative value."
  )
}

if (length(step1_inputs$steaming_speed) != 1L ||
    !is.finite(as.numeric(step1_inputs$steaming_speed)) ||
    as.numeric(step1_inputs$steaming_speed) <= 0) {
  smart31_stop("steaming_speed must be one finite positive value.")
}
```

## Baseline helpers

```{r step2-09-baseline-helpers}

prepare_active_fleet <- function(inputs, years) {
  trip_data <- inputs$annual_trips %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      CFR = as.character(.data$CFR),
      YEAR = as.integer(.data$YEAR),
      MONTH = normalise_month(.data$MONTH, "annual_trips$MONTH"),
      Gear = normalise_code(.data$Gear),
      ntrip = as.numeric(.data$ntrip)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$YEAR %in% years)

  latest_year <- max(years)

  active_cfr <- trip_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$YEAR == latest_year,
      is.finite(.data$ntrip),
      .data$ntrip > 0
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(.data$CFR) %>%
    dplyr::pull(.data$CFR)

  if (length(active_cfr) == 0L) {
    smart31_stop("No vessel is active in the latest historical year.")
  }

  vessel_year_support <- trip_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$CFR %in% active_cfr) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$CFR) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      entry_year = min(.data$YEAR),
      latest_year = latest_year,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::rowwise() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      n_baseline_years = sum(
        years >= .data$entry_year & years <= .data$latest_year
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  vessel_loa_profile <- inputs$IBM_effort %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$CFR %in% active_cfr) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      CFR = as.character(.data$CFR),
      loa = as.numeric(.data$loa)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$CFR) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      loa = one_value(.data$loa, "vessel LOA"),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  latest_harbour_profile <- inputs$IBM_effort %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$CFR %in% active_cfr,
      as.integer(.data$YEAR) == latest_year
    ) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      CFR = as.character(.data$CFR),
      harbour = normalise_code(.data$harbour),
      fishing_time = as.numeric(.data$fishing_time)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(.data$harbour),
      nzchar(.data$harbour),
      is.finite(.data$fishing_time),
      .data$fishing_time >= 0
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$CFR, .data$harbour) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      latest_year_fishing_hours = sum(.data$fishing_time),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      .data$CFR,
      dplyr::desc(.data$latest_year_fishing_hours),
      .data$harbour
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$CFR) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 1L) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  missing_latest_harbour <- setdiff(
    active_cfr,
    latest_harbour_profile$CFR
  )

  if (length(missing_latest_harbour) > 0L) {
    smart31_stop(
      length(missing_latest_harbour),
      " active vessels have no valid harbour in the latest historical year."
    )
  }

  vessel_profile <- vessel_loa_profile %>%
    dplyr::left_join(latest_harbour_profile, by = "CFR") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(vessel_year_support, by = "CFR")

  if (anyNA(vessel_profile) ||
      any(vessel_profile$n_baseline_years <= 0L) ||
      any(vessel_profile$loa <= 0)) {
    smart31_stop("Invalid active-fleet profile produced from Step 1.")
  }

  list(
    active_cfr = active_cfr,
    trip_data = trip_data,
    vessel_profile = vessel_profile
  )
}

aggregate_activity_reference <- function(inputs, fleet) {
  inputs$IBM_effort %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$CFR %in% fleet$active_cfr,
      .data$YEAR %in% historical_years
    ) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      CFR = as.character(.data$CFR),
      YEAR = as.integer(.data$YEAR),
      MONTH = normalise_month(.data$MONTH, "IBM_effort$MONTH"),
      Gear = normalise_code(.data$Gear),
      Metier = normalise_code(.data$Metier),
      id_grid = as.character(.data$id_grid),
      harbour = normalise_code(.data$harbour),
      loa = as.numeric(.data$loa),
      fishing_time = as.numeric(.data$fishing_time)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      .data$CFR, .data$MONTH, .data$Gear,
      .data$Metier, .data$id_grid
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      historical_fishing_time = sum(.data$fishing_time),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      fleet$vessel_profile %>%
        dplyr::select(
          .data$CFR, .data$harbour, .data$loa,
          .data$n_baseline_years
        ),
      by = "CFR",
      relationship = "many-to-one"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      fishing_time_reference =
        .data$historical_fishing_time / .data$n_baseline_years,
      effort_reference = .data$fishing_time_reference * .data$loa,
      pattern_id = make_pattern_id(
        .data$CFR, .data$MONTH, .data$Gear, .data$Metier
      ),
      unit_id = make_unit_id(.data$CFR, .data$MONTH)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$fishing_time_reference > 0)
}

aggregate_time_reference <- function(inputs, fleet) {
  inputs$economic_activity_baseline %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$CFR %in% fleet$active_cfr,
      .data$YEAR %in% historical_years
    ) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      CFR = as.character(.data$CFR),
      YEAR = as.integer(.data$YEAR),
      MONTH = normalise_month(
        .data$MONTH,
        "economic_activity_baseline$MONTH"
      ),
      Gear = normalise_code(.data$Gear),
      days_at_sea = as.numeric(.data$days_at_sea),
      trips = as.numeric(.data$days_at_sea) *
        as.numeric(.data$trips_per_sea_day),
      fishing_time = as.numeric(.data$fishing_time),
      steaming_time = as.numeric(.data$steaming_time),
      fishing_time_elasticity =
        as.numeric(.data$fishing_time_elasticity),
      fishing_fuel_l_per_h =
        as.numeric(.data$fishing_fuel_l_per_h),
      steaming_fuel_l_per_h =
        as.numeric(.data$steaming_fuel_l_per_h)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      .data$CFR, .data$YEAR, .data$MONTH, .data$Gear
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      fishing_time_elasticity = weighted_mean_safe(
        .data$fishing_time_elasticity,
        pmax(.data$days_at_sea, .Machine$double.eps)
      ),
      fishing_fuel_l_per_h = weighted_mean_safe(
        .data$fishing_fuel_l_per_h,
        pmax(.data$days_at_sea, .Machine$double.eps)
      ),
      steaming_fuel_l_per_h = weighted_mean_safe(
        .data$steaming_fuel_l_per_h,
        pmax(.data$days_at_sea, .Machine$double.eps)
      ),
      days_at_sea = sum(.data$days_at_sea),
      trips = sum(.data$trips),
      fishing_time = sum(.data$fishing_time),
      steaming_time = sum(.data$steaming_time),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$CFR, .data$MONTH, .data$Gear) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      historical_days = sum(.data$days_at_sea),
      historical_trips = sum(.data$trips),
      historical_fishing_time = sum(.data$fishing_time),
      historical_steaming_time = sum(.data$steaming_time),
      fishing_time_elasticity = weighted_mean_safe(
        .data$fishing_time_elasticity,
        .data$days_at_sea
      ),
      fishing_fuel_l_per_h = weighted_mean_safe(
        .data$fishing_fuel_l_per_h,
        pmax(.data$days_at_sea, .Machine$double.eps)
      ),
      steaming_fuel_l_per_h = weighted_mean_safe(
        .data$steaming_fuel_l_per_h,
        pmax(.data$days_at_sea, .Machine$double.eps)
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      fleet$vessel_profile %>%
        dplyr::select(.data$CFR, .data$n_baseline_years),
      by = "CFR",
      relationship = "many-to-one"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      days_reference = .data$historical_days / .data$n_baseline_years,
      trips_reference = .data$historical_trips / .data$n_baseline_years,
      fishing_time_reference =
        .data$historical_fishing_time / .data$n_baseline_years,
      steaming_time_reference =
        .data$historical_steaming_time / .data$n_baseline_years,
      trips_per_sea_day = dplyr::if_else(
        .data$historical_days > 0,
        .data$historical_trips / .data$historical_days,
        0
      )
    )
}
```

## Simulation surface helpers

```{r step2-10-simulation-surface-helpers}

smart31_build_simulation_lpue <- function(inputs, years) {
  keys <- c("YEAR", "MONTH", "GSA_code", "Gear", "id_grid")
  rates <- inputs$df_lpue_rates_mass_conserving %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$YEAR %in% years,
      .data$effort_basis != "historical_spatial_non_vms_proxy") %>%
    dplyr::transmute(YEAR = as.integer(.data$YEAR),
      MONTH = normalise_month(.data$MONTH, "LPUE month"),
      GSA_code = normalise_gsa(.data$GSA_code), Gear = normalise_code(.data$Gear),
      id_grid = as.character(.data$id_grid), Species = normalise_code(.data$Species),
      lpue = as.numeric(.data$lpue))
  if (anyDuplicated(rates[c(keys, "Species")]) ||
      any(!is.finite(rates$lpue)) || any(rates$lpue < 0)) {
    smart31_stop("Step 1 LPUE rates must be non-negative and unique by cell-stratum.")
  }
  effort <- inputs$IBM_effort %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$YEAR %in% years) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(CFR = as.character(.data$CFR), YEAR = as.integer(.data$YEAR),
      MONTH = normalise_month(.data$MONTH, "effort month"),
      GSA_code = normalise_gsa(.data$GSA_code), Gear = normalise_code(.data$Gear),
      id_grid = as.character(.data$id_grid),
      effort = as.numeric(.data$loa) * as.numeric(.data$fishing_time)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(c("CFR", keys)))) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(effort = sum(.data$effort), .groups = "drop")
  if (anyNA(effort) || any(!is.finite(effort$effort)) || any(effort$effort < 0)) {
    smart31_stop("Invalid historical effort while constructing simulation support.")
  }

  local_peak <- effort %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$YEAR, .data$MONTH, .data$Gear, .data$id_grid) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(effort = sum(.data$effort), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$MONTH, .data$Gear, .data$id_grid) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(historical_peak_effort = max(.data$effort), .groups = "drop")
  active <- effort %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(active_fleet$vessel_profile %>%
      dplyr::select(.data$CFR, .data$n_baseline_years), by = "CFR",
      relationship = "many-to-one")
  catch_rows <- active %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(rates, by = keys, relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(W = .data$effort * .data$lpue,
      representative_W = .data$W / .data$n_baseline_years)
  historic_vessel_catch <- catch_rows %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$CFR, .data$YEAR, .data$MONTH, .data$Gear, .data$Species) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(W = sum(.data$W), .groups = "drop")
  reference_catch <- catch_rows %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$MONTH, .data$GSA_code, .data$Gear, .data$id_grid, .data$Species) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(catch_reference = sum(.data$representative_W), .groups = "drop")
  reference_effort <- active %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$MONTH, .data$GSA_code, .data$Gear, .data$id_grid) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(effort_reference = sum(.data$effort / .data$n_baseline_years),
      .groups = "drop") %>% dplyr::filter(.data$effort_reference > 0)
  grid <- inputs$grid_sf$grid_sf
  if (!inherits(grid, "sf") || is.na(sf::st_crs(grid))) {
    smart31_stop("The Step 1 analytical grid must be sf with a defined CRS.")
  }
  xy <- sf::st_coordinates(sf::st_point_on_surface(sf::st_transform(grid, 3035)))
  grid_support <- tibble::tibble(id_grid = as.character(grid$id_grid),
    pool_x = floor(xy[, 1L] / (1000 * cfg$lpue_pool_km)),
    pool_y = floor(xy[, 2L] / (1000 * cfg$lpue_pool_km)),
    depth_band = floor(abs(as.numeric(grid$depth)) / cfg$lpue_depth_band_m))
  if (anyNA(grid_support) || anyDuplicated(grid_support$id_grid)) {
    smart31_stop("Invalid spatial support for regularised simulation LPUE.")
  }
  habitat_keys <- c("MONTH", "GSA_code", "Gear", "pool_x", "pool_y", "depth_band")
  supported_effort <- reference_effort %>%
    dplyr::left_join(grid_support, by = "id_grid", relationship = "many-to-one")
  if (anyNA(supported_effort)) smart31_stop("Historical effort has unmapped grid cells.")
  pool_effort <- supported_effort %>%
    dplyr::group_by(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(habitat_keys))) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(pool_effort = sum(.data$effort_reference), .groups = "drop")
  pool_catch <- reference_catch %>%
    dplyr::left_join(grid_support, by = "id_grid", relationship = "many-to-one") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(c(habitat_keys, "Species")))) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(pool_catch = sum(.data$catch_reference), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$pool_catch > 0) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(pool_effort, by = habitat_keys, relationship = "many-to-one")
  legacy <- rates %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$MONTH, .data$GSA_code, .data$Gear, .data$Species, .data$id_grid) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(lpue_legacy = sum(.data$lpue) / length(years),
      n_positive_years = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$YEAR[.data$lpue > 0]), .groups = "drop")

  surface <- supported_effort %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(pool_catch, by = habitat_keys, relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(reference_catch,
      by = c("MONTH", "GSA_code", "Gear", "id_grid", "Species"),
      relationship = "one-to-one") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(catch_reference = dplyr::coalesce(.data$catch_reference, 0),
      lpue_exposure = .data$catch_reference / .data$effort_reference,
      lpue_pool = .data$pool_catch / .data$pool_effort,
      lpue_reference = cfg$lpue_cell_weight * .data$lpue_exposure +
        (1 - cfg$lpue_cell_weight) * .data$lpue_pool) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(legacy,
      by = c("MONTH", "GSA_code", "Gear", "id_grid", "Species"),
      relationship = "one-to-one") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(n_positive_years = dplyr::coalesce(.data$n_positive_years, 0L),
      lpue_legacy = dplyr::coalesce(.data$lpue_legacy, 0))
  audit <- surface %>%
    dplyr::group_by(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(c(habitat_keys, "Species")))) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(historical_catch_kg = sum(.data$catch_reference),
      reconstructed_catch_kg = sum(.data$effort_reference * .data$lpue_reference),
      .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(residual_kg = .data$reconstructed_catch_kg - .data$historical_catch_kg,
      compatible = abs(.data$residual_kg) <= 1e-8 * pmax(1, .data$historical_catch_kg))
  if (!all(audit$compatible)) smart31_stop("Pooled simulation LPUE failed mass reconciliation.")
  .smart31_surface$local_peak <- local_peak
  .smart31_surface$historical_vessel_catch <- historic_vessel_catch
  .smart31_surface$surface_audit <- audit
  .smart31_surface$surface <- surface
  .smart31_surface$historical_reference_effort <- reference_effort
  .smart31_surface$legacy_surface <- legacy
  selected <- if (identical(cfg$simulation_lpue_mode, "regularised_pool")) {
    surface %>% dplyr::select(.data$MONTH, .data$GSA_code, .data$Gear,
      .data$Species, .data$id_grid, .data$lpue_reference, .data$n_positive_years)
  } else {
    legacy %>% dplyr::rename(lpue_reference = .data$lpue_legacy)
  }
  selected %>% dplyr::filter(.data$lpue_reference > 0)
}

smart31_align_nontrawl_energy <- function(time, inputs) {
  target <- inputs$IBM.eco %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$YEAR %in% historical_years,
      .data$CFR %in% active_fleet$active_cfr) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(CFR = as.character(.data$CFR), Gear = normalise_code(.data$Gear)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$CFR, .data$Gear) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(EC_history = sum(.data$EC), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(active_fleet$vessel_profile %>%
      dplyr::select(.data$CFR, .data$n_baseline_years), by = "CFR") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(EC_history = .data$EC_history / .data$n_baseline_years)
  model <- time %>% dplyr::group_by(.data$CFR, .data$Gear) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(EC_physical_reference = fuel_price_reference * sum(
      .data$fishing_fuel_l_per_h * .data$fishing_time_reference +
      .data$steaming_fuel_l_per_h * .data$steaming_time_reference), .groups = "drop")
  calibration <- model %>% dplyr::left_join(target, by = c("CFR", "Gear")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(fuel_rate_scale = dplyr::if_else(.data$Gear == "OTB", 1,
      .data$EC_history / .data$EC_physical_reference),
      energy_basis = dplyr::if_else(.data$Gear == "OTB", "Step1_physical_rates",
        "physical_shape_anchored_to_historical_EC"))
  if (any(!is.finite(calibration$fuel_rate_scale)) || any(calibration$fuel_rate_scale <= 0)) {
    smart31_stop("Non-trawl historical energy cannot calibrate a positive physical proxy.")
  }
  .smart31_surface$energy_calibration <- calibration
  time %>% dplyr::left_join(calibration %>%
    dplyr::select(.data$CFR, .data$Gear, .data$fuel_rate_scale), by = c("CFR", "Gear")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(fishing_fuel_l_per_h = .data$fishing_fuel_l_per_h * .data$fuel_rate_scale,
      steaming_fuel_l_per_h = .data$steaming_fuel_l_per_h * .data$fuel_rate_scale) %>%
    dplyr::select(-.data$fuel_rate_scale)
}
```

## Build representative baseline

```{r step2-11-build-representative-baseline}

prepare_lpue_reference <- function(inputs, years) {
  smart31_build_simulation_lpue(inputs, years)
}

prepare_price_reference <- function(inputs, years) {
  inputs$price_annual %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$YEAR %in% years) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      YEAR = as.integer(.data$YEAR),
      Species = normalise_code(.data$Species),
      GSA = normalise_gsa(.data$GSA),
      Price = as.numeric(.data$Price)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.finite(.data$Price), .data$Price >= 0) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$Species, .data$GSA) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      price_reference = mean(.data$Price),
      n_price_years = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$YEAR),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

prepare_fuel_price_reference <- function(inputs, years) {
  if (!is.data.frame(inputs$fuel_cost)) {
    value <- as.numeric(inputs$fuel_cost)
    if (length(value) != 1L || !is.finite(value) || value < 0) {
      smart31_stop("Invalid scalar fuel-cost reference.")
    }
    return(value)
  }

  fuel_history <- inputs$fuel_cost %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      YEAR = as.integer(as.character(.data$YEAR)),
      fuel_price_eur_per_l = as.numeric(.data$fuel_cost)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$YEAR %in% years)

  if (nrow(fuel_history) != length(years) ||
      anyDuplicated(fuel_history$YEAR) ||
      any(!is.finite(fuel_history$fuel_price_eur_per_l)) ||
      any(fuel_history$fuel_price_eur_per_l < 0)) {
    smart31_stop(
      "The annual fuel-cost table must contain one finite non-negative ",
      "value for every historical baseline year."
    )
  }

  mean(fuel_history$fuel_price_eur_per_l)
}

prepare_economic_rates <- function(inputs, active_cfr) {
  required_rate_columns <- c(
    "CFR", "Gear", "EC_share", "OC_share", "LC_share"
  )

  if (all(required_rate_columns %in% names(inputs$IBM.eco))) {
    return(
      inputs$IBM.eco %>%
        dplyr::filter(.data$CFR %in% active_cfr) %>%
        dplyr::transmute(
          CFR = as.character(.data$CFR),
          Gear = normalise_code(.data$Gear),
          EC_share = as.numeric(.data$EC_share),
          OC_share = as.numeric(.data$OC_share),
          LC_share = as.numeric(.data$LC_share)
        ) %>%
        dplyr::group_by(.data$CFR, .data$Gear) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(
          EC_share = one_value(.data$EC_share, "EC_share"),
          OC_share = one_value(.data$OC_share, "OC_share"),
          LC_share = one_value(.data$LC_share, "LC_share"),
          .groups = "drop"
        )
    )
  }

  smart31_stop(
    "IBM.eco does not expose CFR-specific EC, OC and LC shares. ",
    "Regenerate the Step 1 bundle with the current economic export."
  )
}

prepare_economic_reference <- function(inputs, fleet) {
  inputs$IBM.eco %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$CFR %in% fleet$active_cfr,
      .data$YEAR %in% historical_years
    ) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      CFR = as.character(.data$CFR),
      YEAR = as.integer(.data$YEAR),
      MONTH = normalise_month(.data$MONTH, "IBM.eco$MONTH"),
      Gear = normalise_code(.data$Gear),
      GVL_6sp = as.numeric(.data$GVL_6sp),
      GVL_other_reference = as.numeric(.data$GVL_other_reference),
      GVL = as.numeric(.data$GVL),
      EC = as.numeric(.data$EC),
      OC = as.numeric(.data$OC),
      LC = as.numeric(.data$LC),
      GVA = as.numeric(.data$GVA),
      GP = as.numeric(.data$GP)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$CFR, .data$YEAR, .data$MONTH) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      dplyr::across(
        dplyr::all_of(c(
          "GVL_6sp", "GVL_other_reference", "GVL",
          "EC", "OC", "LC", "GVA", "GP"
        )),
        sum
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$CFR, .data$MONTH) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      dplyr::across(
        dplyr::all_of(c(
          "GVL_6sp", "GVL_other_reference", "GVL",
          "EC", "OC", "LC", "GVA", "GP"
        )),
        sum
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      fleet$vessel_profile %>%
        dplyr::select(.data$CFR, .data$n_baseline_years),
      by = "CFR",
      relationship = "many-to-one"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      dplyr::across(
        dplyr::all_of(c(
          "GVL_6sp", "GVL_other_reference", "GVL",
          "EC", "OC", "LC", "GVA", "GP"
        )),
        ~ .x / .data$n_baseline_years
      ),
      unit_id = make_unit_id(.data$CFR, .data$MONTH)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-.data$n_baseline_years)
}

prepare_trip_evidence <- function(inputs, active_cfr) {
  activity_by_year <- inputs$IBM_effort %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$CFR %in% active_cfr,
      .data$YEAR %in% historical_years
    ) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      CFR = as.character(.data$CFR),
      YEAR = as.integer(.data$YEAR),
      MONTH = normalise_month(.data$MONTH, "IBM_effort$MONTH"),
      Gear = normalise_code(.data$Gear),
      Metier = normalise_code(.data$Metier),
      id_grid = as.character(.data$id_grid),
      fishing_time = as.numeric(.data$fishing_time)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      .data$CFR, .data$YEAR, .data$MONTH,
      .data$Gear, .data$Metier, .data$id_grid
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      fishing_time = sum(.data$fishing_time),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      .data$CFR, .data$YEAR, .data$MONTH, .data$Gear, .data$Metier
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      metier_fishing_time = sum(.data$fishing_time),
      cell_share = normalise_positive(.data$fishing_time)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$CFR, .data$YEAR, .data$MONTH, .data$Gear) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      gear_fishing_time = sum(.data$fishing_time),
      metier_share = dplyr::if_else(
        .data$gear_fishing_time > 0,
        .data$metier_fishing_time / .data$gear_fishing_time,
        0
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  trip_lookup <- inputs$annual_trips %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$CFR %in% active_cfr,
      .data$YEAR %in% historical_years
    ) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      CFR = as.character(.data$CFR),
      YEAR = as.integer(.data$YEAR),
      MONTH = normalise_month(.data$MONTH, "annual_trips$MONTH"),
      Gear = normalise_code(.data$Gear),
      ntrip = as.numeric(.data$ntrip)
    )

  activity_by_year %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      trip_lookup,
      by = c("CFR", "YEAR", "MONTH", "Gear"),
      relationship = "many-to-one"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      effective_trip_count = dplyr::coalesce(.data$ntrip, 0) *
        .data$metier_share * .data$cell_share,
      pattern_id = make_pattern_id(
        .data$CFR, .data$MONTH, .data$Gear, .data$Metier
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$pattern_id, .data$id_grid) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      effective_trip_count = sum(.data$effective_trip_count),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}
```

```{r step2-12-materialise-fleet-scenarios}
read_italian_cessation_cfr <- function(file, inline_cfr) {
  inline_cfr <- unique(trimws(as.character(inline_cfr)))
  inline_cfr <- inline_cfr[nzchar(inline_cfr)]

  file_cfr <- character()
  if (!is.null(file) && nzchar(as.character(file))) {
    if (!file.exists(file)) {
      smart31_stop("Italian cessation file does not exist: ", file)
    }

    cessation_table <- utils::read.csv(
      file,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
      colClasses = "character",
      check.names = FALSE
    )

    cfr_column <- names(cessation_table)[
      normalise_code(names(cessation_table)) == "CFR"
    ]

    if (length(cfr_column) != 1L) {
      smart31_stop(
        "The Italian cessation file must contain exactly one CFR column."
      )
    }

    file_cfr <- unique(trimws(as.character(
      cessation_table[[cfr_column]]
    )))
    file_cfr <- file_cfr[nzchar(file_cfr)]
  }

  unique(c(inline_cfr, file_cfr))
}

canonical_quota_names <- function(x) {
  x <- toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
  x <- gsub("[^A-Z0-9]+", "_", x)
  gsub("^_|_$", "", x)
}

smart31_clean_quota_headers <- function(table, input_name, source_file) {
  if (!is.data.frame(table) || ncol(table) == 0L) {
    smart31_stop(input_name, " has no readable columns: ", source_file)
  }
  raw_names <- names(table)
  if (length(raw_names) != ncol(table)) {
    smart31_stop(input_name, " has an invalid header structure: ", source_file)
  }

  is_empty_cell <- function(x) {
    text <- as.character(x)
    text <- gsub("\u00a0", " ", text, fixed = TRUE)
    is.na(x) | (!is.na(text) & !nzchar(trimws(text)))
  }
  canonical_names <- canonical_quota_names(raw_names)
  bad_header <- is.na(raw_names) | is.na(canonical_names) |
    !nzchar(canonical_names)
  empty_column <- vapply(table, function(x) all(is_empty_cell(x)), logical(1))

  unsafe <- which(bad_header & !empty_column)
  if (length(unsafe) > 0L) {
    details <- vapply(unsafe, function(j) {
      rows <- which(!is_empty_cell(table[[j]]))
      paste0("column ", j, " (non-empty data rows: ",
        paste(utils::head(rows, 5L), collapse = ", "), ")")
    }, character(1))
    smart31_stop(
      input_name, " contains data in column(s) without a usable header: ",
      paste(details, collapse = "; "), ". File: ", source_file,
      ". Name these columns explicitly in the CSV; no values were discarded."
    )
  }

  dropped <- which(bad_header & empty_column)
  kept <- setdiff(seq_len(ncol(table)), dropped)
  if (length(kept) == 0L) {
    smart31_stop(input_name, " has no named columns after removing empty padding: ",
      source_file)
  }
  names_kept <- canonical_names[kept]
  duplicate_names <- unique(names_kept[duplicated(names_kept)])
  if (length(duplicate_names) > 0L) {
    smart31_stop(
      input_name, " has duplicate column names after header normalisation: ",
      paste(duplicate_names, collapse = ", "), ". File: ", source_file,
      ". Correct the ambiguous headers; no column was selected arbitrarily."
    )
  }

  header_audit <- data.frame(
    original_column = seq_along(raw_names),
    original_header = raw_names,
    canonical_header = canonical_names,
    action = ifelse(seq_along(raw_names) %in% dropped,
      "removed_unnamed_empty_column", "retained"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  table <- table[, kept, drop = FALSE]
  names(table) <- names_kept

  empty_row <- rep(TRUE, nrow(table))
  for (j in seq_len(ncol(table))) {
    empty_row <- empty_row & is_empty_cell(table[[j]])
  }
  dropped_rows <- which(empty_row)
  if (length(dropped_rows) > 0L) {
    table <- table[!empty_row, , drop = FALSE]
  }
  if (nrow(table) == 0L) {
    smart31_stop(input_name, " has no non-empty data rows: ", source_file)
  }

  attr(table, "smart31_header_audit") <- header_audit
  attr(table, "smart31_empty_data_rows_removed") <- dropped_rows
  if (length(dropped) > 0L || length(dropped_rows) > 0L) {
    message(
      "SMART3.1 quota import [", basename(source_file), "]: removed ",
      length(dropped), " unnamed empty column(s)",
      if (length(dropped)) paste0(" at position(s) ", paste(dropped, collapse = ", ")) else "",
      " and ", length(dropped_rows), " completely empty data row(s). ",
      "All populated values were retained unchanged."
    )
  }
  table
}

smart31_read_delimited_table <- function(file, input_name) {
  file_size <- file.info(file)$size
  if (length(file_size) != 1L || !is.finite(file_size) || file_size <= 0) {
    smart31_stop(input_name, " is empty or unreadable: ", file)
  }

  connection <- base::file(file, open = "rb")
  on.exit(close(connection), add = TRUE)
  raw_content <- readBin(connection, what = "raw", n = file_size)
  if (length(raw_content) >= 3L && identical(
        as.integer(raw_content[seq_len(3L)]),
        c(239L, 187L, 191L)
      )) {
    raw_content <- raw_content[-seq_len(3L)]
  }
  text_content <- rawToChar(raw_content)
  text_content <- gsub("\r\n", "\n", text_content, fixed = TRUE)
  text_content <- gsub("\r", "\n", text_content, fixed = TRUE)

  lines <- strsplit(text_content, "\n", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]]
  lines <- lines[nzchar(trimws(lines))]
  if (length(lines) < 2L) {
    smart31_stop(input_name, " must contain a header and at least one row.")
  }

  delimiter_count <- function(delimiter, header) {
    positions <- gregexpr(delimiter, header, fixed = TRUE)[[1L]]
    if (length(positions) == 1L && positions[[1L]] == -1L) {
      0L
    } else {
      length(positions)
    }
  }
  delimiters <- c(comma = ",", semicolon = ";", tab = "\t")
  delimiter_counts <- vapply(
    delimiters,
    delimiter_count,
    integer(1),
    header = lines[[1L]]
  )
  if (max(delimiter_counts) == 0L) {
    smart31_stop(
      input_name,
      " header contains no recognised delimiter (comma, semicolon or tab)."
    )
  }
  delimiter <- unname(delimiters[[which.max(delimiter_counts)]])

  table <- tryCatch(
    utils::read.table(
      text = paste(lines, collapse = "\n"),
      header = TRUE,
      sep = delimiter,
      quote = "\"",
      dec = ".",
      comment.char = "",
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
      colClasses = "character",
      check.names = FALSE,
      strip.white = TRUE,
      fill = FALSE,
      blank.lines.skip = TRUE,
      na.strings = c("", "NA", "NaN")
    ),
    error = function(condition) {
      smart31_stop(
        "Unable to parse ", input_name, " using detected delimiter '",
        delimiter, "': ", conditionMessage(condition)
      )
    }
  )
  table <- smart31_clean_quota_headers(table, input_name, file)
  attr(table, "smart31_delimiter") <- delimiter
  table
}

write_quota_input_templates <- function() {
  catch_template_file <- file.path(
    simulation_output_directory,
    "TEMPLATE_italian_annual_catch_quotas.csv"
  )
  effort_template_file <- file.path(
    simulation_output_directory,
    "TEMPLATE_italian_annual_effort_quotas.csv"
  )

  if (!file.exists(catch_template_file)) {
    utils::write.csv(
      data.frame(
        Species = rep(.smart31_case$domain$species_to_submit[[1L]], 1L + length(.smart31_years$future)),
        YEAR = c(.smart31_years$baseline, .smart31_years$future),
        quota_kg = rep(NA_real_, 1L + length(.smart31_years$future))
      ),
      catch_template_file,
      row.names = FALSE,
      na = ""
    )
  }

  if (!file.exists(effort_template_file)) {
    utils::write.csv(
      data.frame(
        YEAR = c(.smart31_years$baseline, .smart31_years$future_start, .smart31_years$future_start),
        SCENARIO_ID = c(.smart31_case$scenario_ids$baseline,
          .smart31_case$scenario_ids$A, .smart31_case$scenario_ids$B),
        GEAR = rep("OTB", 3L),
        LENGTH_CLASS = rep("VL1218", 3L),
        MIN_LOA_M = rep(12, 3L),
        MAX_LOA_M = rep(17.99, 3L),
        EFF1_MED2_DAYS = rep(NA_real_, 3L),
        EFF2_MED2_DAYS = rep(NA_real_, 3L),
        EFFORT_QUOTA_DAYS = rep(NA_real_, 3L),
        SOURCE_STATUS = rep("complete_from_official_or_documented_assumption", 3L)
      ),
      effort_template_file,
      row.names = FALSE,
      na = ""
    )
  }

  invisible(c(catch_template_file, effort_template_file))
}

read_italian_catch_quotas <- function(file, strict = TRUE) {
  if (is.null(file) || !nzchar(trimws(as.character(file))) ||
      !file.exists(file)) {
    if (strict) {
      templates <- write_quota_input_templates()
      smart31_stop(
        "The Italian annual catch-quota table is required: ", file,
        ". A template was written to ", templates[[1L]], "."
      )
    }
    return(tibble::tibble(
      Species = character(), YEAR = integer(), quota_kg = numeric()
    ))
  }

  quota <- smart31_read_delimited_table(
    file,
    "Italian annual catch-quota table"
  )
  names(quota) <- canonical_quota_names(names(quota))
  required <- c("SPECIES", "YEAR", "QUOTA_KG")
  missing <- setdiff(required, names(quota))
  if (length(missing) > 0L) {
    smart31_stop(
      "Catch-quota table is missing column(s): ",
      paste(missing, collapse = ", "), "."
    )
  }

  quota <- quota %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Species = normalise_code(.data$SPECIES),
      YEAR = suppressWarnings(as.integer(.data$YEAR)),
      quota_kg = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data$QUOTA_KG))
    )

  if (nrow(quota) == 0L || anyNA(quota) ||
      any(!is.finite(quota$quota_kg)) || any(quota$quota_kg < 0) ||
      any(!quota$YEAR %in% c(.smart31_years$baseline, .smart31_years$future)) ||
      anyDuplicated(quota[c("Species", "YEAR")])) {
    smart31_stop(
      "Catch quotas must be unique by Species and YEAR and contain finite ",
      "non-negative quota_kg values for the configured calendar."
    )
  }

  quota %>% dplyr::arrange(.data$Species, .data$YEAR)
}

read_italian_effort_quotas <- function(file, strict = TRUE) {
  if (is.null(file) || !nzchar(trimws(as.character(file))) ||
      !file.exists(file)) {
    if (strict) {
      templates <- write_quota_input_templates()
      smart31_stop(
        "The Italian annual effort-quota table is required: ", file,
        ". A template was written to ", templates[[2L]], "."
      )
    }
    return(tibble::tibble(
      YEAR = integer(), scenario_id = character(), Gear = character(),
      length_class = character(),
      min_loa_m = numeric(), max_loa_m = numeric(),
      eff1_med2_days = numeric(), eff2_med2_days = numeric(),
      effort_quota_days = numeric(), source_status = character(),
      effort_quota_id = character()
    ))
  }

  quota <- smart31_read_delimited_table(
    file,
    "Italian annual effort-quota table"
  )
  names(quota) <- canonical_quota_names(names(quota))
  required <- c(
    "YEAR", "SCENARIO_ID", "GEAR", "LENGTH_CLASS", "MIN_LOA_M",
    "MAX_LOA_M", "EFF1_MED2_DAYS", "EFF2_MED2_DAYS",
    "EFFORT_QUOTA_DAYS", "SOURCE_STATUS"
  )
  missing <- setdiff(required, names(quota))
  if (length(missing) > 0L) {
    smart31_stop(
      "Effort-quota table is missing column(s): ",
      paste(missing, collapse = ", "), "."
    )
  }

  quota <- quota %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      YEAR = suppressWarnings(as.integer(.data$YEAR)),
      scenario_id = trimws(as.character(.data$SCENARIO_ID)),
      Gear = normalise_code(.data$GEAR),
      length_class = trimws(as.character(.data$LENGTH_CLASS)),
      min_loa_m = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data$MIN_LOA_M)),
      max_loa_m = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data$MAX_LOA_M)),
      eff1_med2_days = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data$EFF1_MED2_DAYS)),
      eff2_med2_days = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data$EFF2_MED2_DAYS)),
      effort_quota_days = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(
        .data$EFFORT_QUOTA_DAYS
      )),
      source_status = trimws(as.character(.data$SOURCE_STATUS))
    )

  if (nrow(quota) == 0L || anyNA(quota) ||
      any(!is.finite(quota$min_loa_m)) ||
      any(!is.finite(quota$max_loa_m) & quota$max_loa_m != Inf) ||
      any(!is.finite(quota$eff1_med2_days)) ||
      any(!is.finite(quota$eff2_med2_days)) ||
      any(!is.finite(quota$effort_quota_days)) ||
      any(quota$min_loa_m < 0) ||
      any(quota$max_loa_m <= quota$min_loa_m) ||
      any(quota$eff1_med2_days < 0) ||
      any(quota$eff2_med2_days < 0) ||
      any(quota$effort_quota_days < 0) ||
      any(!quota$YEAR %in% c(.smart31_years$baseline, .smart31_years$future)) ||
      any(!nzchar(quota$scenario_id)) ||
      any(!nzchar(quota$length_class)) ||
      any(!nzchar(quota$source_status)) ||
      any(abs(quota$eff1_med2_days + quota$eff2_med2_days -
                quota$effort_quota_days) > 1e-7) ||
      anyDuplicated(quota[c("YEAR", "scenario_id", "Gear", "length_class")])) {
    smart31_stop(
      "Effort quotas must be unique by YEAR, SCENARIO_ID, GEAR and ",
      "LENGTH_CLASS; non-negative EFF1 and EFF2 days must add to ",
      "EFFORT_QUOTA_DAYS; length bounds must be valid."
    )
  }

  overlapping <- quota %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(
      quota,
      by = c("YEAR", "scenario_id", "Gear"),
      suffix = c("_x", "_y"),
      relationship = "many-to-many"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$length_class_x < .data$length_class_y,
      .data$min_loa_m_x <= .data$max_loa_m_y,
      .data$min_loa_m_y <= .data$max_loa_m_x
    )
  if (nrow(overlapping) > 0L) {
    smart31_stop(
      "Effort-quota length intervals overlap within the same YEAR, SCENARIO_ID and GEAR."
    )
  }

  quota %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      effort_quota_id = paste(
        .data$scenario_id, .data$YEAR, .data$Gear,
        .data$length_class, sep = "::"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(.data$scenario_id, .data$YEAR, .data$Gear,
                   .data$min_loa_m)
}

italian_catch_quotas <- read_italian_catch_quotas(
  cfg$italian_catch_quota_file,
  strict = isTRUE(.smart31_case$management$enforce_catch_quotas)
)

fmsy_catch_limits <- tibble::tibble(Species = character(), YEAR = integer(),
  quota_kg = numeric(), assessment_stock = character(), Fmsy = numeric(),
  F_external_floor = numeric(), anchor_2025_t = numeric(),
  maximum_future_to_anchor_ratio = numeric(), calibration = character(),
  source = character())
if (nzchar(cfg$fmsy_limits_file)) {
  path <- path.expand(cfg$fmsy_limits_file)
  if (!file.exists(path)) smart31_stop(
    "Missing Step 3 calibrated FMSY input: ", path,
    ". First run the Step 3 FMSY export on the previous Step 2 result.")
  fmsy_catch_limits <- smart31_read_delimited_table(path, "Step 3 FMSY limits")
  required <- c("Species", "YEAR", "quota_kg", "assessment_stock",
    "Fmsy", "F_external_floor", "anchor_2025_t",
    "maximum_future_to_anchor_ratio", "age_F_ITA_anchor", "age_M_reference",
    "age_F_external", "calibration", "source")

  header_match <- match(names(fmsy_catch_limits), canonical_quota_names(required))
  mapped <- !is.na(header_match)
  names(fmsy_catch_limits)[mapped] <- required[header_match[mapped]]
  if (!all(required %in% names(fmsy_catch_limits))) smart31_stop(
    "FMSY limits missing: ", paste(setdiff(required, names(fmsy_catch_limits)), collapse = ", "))
  fmsy_catch_limits <- fmsy_catch_limits %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Species = normalise_code(.data$Species),
      YEAR = as.integer(.data$YEAR), quota_kg = as.numeric(.data$quota_kg),
      Fmsy = as.numeric(.data$Fmsy),
      F_external_floor = as.numeric(.data$F_external_floor),
      anchor_2025_t = as.numeric(.data$anchor_2025_t),
      maximum_future_to_anchor_ratio = as.numeric(.data$maximum_future_to_anchor_ratio))
  if (nrow(fmsy_catch_limits) != length(unique(fmsy_catch_limits$assessment_stock)) * length(.smart31_years$future) ||
      !setequal(fmsy_catch_limits$YEAR, .smart31_years$future) ||

      anyDuplicated(fmsy_catch_limits[c("assessment_stock", "YEAR")]) ||
      anyNA(fmsy_catch_limits[required]) ||
      any(!is.finite(as.matrix(fmsy_catch_limits[c("quota_kg", "Fmsy",
        "F_external_floor", "anchor_2025_t", "maximum_future_to_anchor_ratio")]))) ||
      any(fmsy_catch_limits$quota_kg < 0) ||
      any(fmsy_catch_limits$F_external_floor >= fmsy_catch_limits$Fmsy) ||
      !all(fmsy_catch_limits$calibration == .smart31_case$calibration_id)) {
    smart31_stop("FMSY constraint input incomplete, duplicated or invalid.")
  }
  parse_age <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(strsplit(as.character(x), ";", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]]))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(fmsy_catch_limits))) {
    age <- lapply(fmsy_catch_limits[i, c("age_F_ITA_anchor", "age_M_reference", "age_F_external")], parse_age)
    if (length(unique(lengths(age))) != 1L || !length(age[[1L]]) ||
        any(!is.finite(unlist(age))) || any(unlist(age) < 0) ||
        any(age[[1L]] <= 0)) smart31_stop("Incomplete F-at-age calibration for ",
          fmsy_catch_limits$assessment_stock[[i]], " in FMSY input.")
  }
  fmsy_catch_limits <- fmsy_catch_limits %>% dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(required))
}

stock_constraint_scope <- if (nzchar(cfg$fmsy_assessment_crosswalk_file)) {

} else data.frame(Species=character(), GSA_code=character(), assessment_stock=character())
smart31_validate_stock_inputs(fmsy_catch_limits, stock_constraint_scope)

fmsy_reference_limits <- fmsy_catch_limits
```
