## Working baseline conditioning

```{r step2-13-working-baseline-conditioning}

smart31_working_controls <- function() {
  nms <- c("trip_limit_hours", "trip_reserved_hours", "min_fishing_hours_per_trip",
    "max_fishing_hours_per_trip", "max_navigation_fraction", "initial_quota_utilisation",
    "harbour_reset_min_support", "allow_simulation_harbour_reset", "continue_after_run_error")
  p <- cfg[nms]
  numeric_names <- nms[seq_len(7L)]
  for (nm in numeric_names) {
    if (length(p[[nm]]) != 1L || !is.finite(p[[nm]])) stop("Invalid working-baseline control: ", nm)
  }
  if (p$trip_limit_hours <= 0 || p$trip_limit_hours >= 24 ||
      p$trip_reserved_hours < 0 || p$min_fishing_hours_per_trip <= 0 ||
      p$max_fishing_hours_per_trip < p$min_fishing_hours_per_trip ||
      p$max_fishing_hours_per_trip + p$trip_reserved_hours > p$trip_limit_hours ||
      p$max_navigation_fraction <= 0 || p$max_navigation_fraction >= 1 ||
      p$initial_quota_utilisation <= 0 || p$initial_quota_utilisation > 1 ||
      p$harbour_reset_min_support < 0 || p$harbour_reset_min_support > 1)
    stop("Inconsistent daily-trip or initial quota controls.")
  p
}
smart31_working_tag <- function(x, scenario, stage) {
  if (!is.data.frame(x)) x <- tibble::tibble()
  x$scenario_id <- rep(scenario$scenario_id, nrow(x))
  x$representative_period <- rep(scenario$representative_period, nrow(x))
  x$cm_status <- rep(scenario$cm_status, nrow(x))
  x$audit_stage <- rep(stage, nrow(x))
  x
}
smart31_working_write <- function(x, name, scenario_id = NULL) {
  dir <- .smart31_initial$audit_directory
  if (!dir.exists(dir)) dir.create(dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  suffix <- if (is.null(scenario_id)) "" else paste0("_", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_-]", "_", scenario_id))
  utils::write.csv(x, file.path(dir, paste0(name, suffix, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE, na = "")
  invisible(x)
}
smart31_daily_route <- function(distance, budget, speed, controls) {
  nav <- 2 * distance / speed
  fish <- pmin(controls$max_fishing_hours_per_trip, pmax(0, budget - nav))
  active <- fish + nav
  duration <- active + controls$trip_reserved_hours
  nav_fraction <- ifelse(active > 0, nav / active, 0)
  valid <- is.finite(distance) & distance >= 0 & is.finite(budget) &
    budget > 0 & is.finite(speed) & speed > 0 & is.finite(duration) &
    fish >= controls$min_fishing_hours_per_trip - 1e-10 &
    nav_fraction <= controls$max_navigation_fraction + 1e-10 &
    duration <= controls$trip_limit_hours + 1e-10 & duration < 24
  list(fishing = fish, navigation = nav, duration = duration,
    navigation_fraction = nav_fraction, valid = valid)
}

smart31_condition_working_reference <- function(activity, time, fleet, distances, grid, speed) {
  p <- .smart31_initial$controls
  .smart31_initial$original_time <- time
  .smart31_initial$historical_occupancy <- activity %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$MONTH, .data$id_grid) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(effort = sum(.data$effort_reference), .groups = "drop")
  .smart31_initial$historical_effort_map <- activity %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$Gear, .data$MONTH, .data$id_grid) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(effort_historical = sum(.data$effort_reference), .groups = "drop")

  .smart31_initial$pattern_gsa <- activity %>%
    dplyr::select(.data$pattern_id, .data$id_grid) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(grid %>% dplyr::select(.data$id_grid, .data$GSA_code),
      by = "id_grid", relationship = "many-to-one") %>%
    dplyr::distinct(.data$pattern_id, .data$GSA_code)
  if (anyNA(.smart31_initial$pattern_gsa$GSA_code)) stop("Unmapped historical GSA in working baseline.")
  grounds <- activity %>% dplyr::group_by(.data$CFR, .data$id_grid) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(weight = sum(.data$fishing_time_reference), .groups = "drop")
  ports <- sort(unique(distances$harbour))
  route_index <- split(seq_len(nrow(distances)), distances$id_grid)
  all_scores <- list(); choices <- vector("list", nrow(fleet$vessel_profile))
  maximum_active <- p$trip_limit_hours - p$trip_reserved_hours
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(fleet$vessel_profile))) {
    cfr <- as.character(fleet$vessel_profile$CFR[i])
    old_port <- as.character(fleet$vessel_profile$harbour[i])
    g <- grounds[grounds$CFR == cfr, , drop = FALSE]
    ids <- unique(unlist(route_index[g$id_grid], use.names = FALSE))
    d <- distances[ids, , drop = FALSE]
    d$weight <- g$weight[match(d$id_grid, g$id_grid)]
    route <- smart31_daily_route(d$distance_km, maximum_active, speed, p)
    d$supported_weight <- ifelse(route$valid, d$weight, 0)
    d$weighted_navigation <- ifelse(route$valid, d$weight * route$navigation, 0)
    scores <- d %>% dplyr::group_by(.data$harbour) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(supported_weight = sum(.data$supported_weight),
        weighted_navigation = sum(.data$weighted_navigation), .groups = "drop") %>%
      dplyr::mutate(supported_share = .data$supported_weight / sum(g$weight),
        supported_mean_navigation = ifelse(.data$supported_weight > 0,
          .data$weighted_navigation / .data$supported_weight, Inf)) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(.data$supported_share), .data$supported_mean_navigation, .data$harbour)
    old_pos <- match(old_port, scores$harbour)
    old_support <- if (is.na(old_pos)) 0 else scores$supported_share[old_pos]
    chosen <- old_port; reason <- "original_anchor_retained"
    if (isTRUE(p$allow_simulation_harbour_reset) && nrow(scores) &&
        old_support < p$harbour_reset_min_support && scores$supported_share[1] > old_support + 1e-8) {
      chosen <- scores$harbour[1]; reason <- "hypothetical_anchor_maximising_historical_ground_support"
    }
    new_pos <- match(chosen, scores$harbour)
    new_support <- if (is.na(new_pos)) 0 else scores$supported_share[new_pos]
    choices[[i]] <- tibble::tibble(CFR = cfr, original_harbour = old_port,
      simulation_harbour = chosen, harbour_reset = chosen != old_port,
      original_supported_share = old_support, simulation_supported_share = new_support,
      reason = reason, observed_port_correction = FALSE)
    scores$CFR <- rep(cfr, nrow(scores)); all_scores[[i]] <- scores
  }
  port_audit <- dplyr::bind_rows(choices)

  activity$harbour <- port_audit$simulation_harbour[match(activity$CFR, port_audit$CFR)]
  fleet$vessel_profile$harbour <- port_audit$simulation_harbour[
    match(fleet$vessel_profile$CFR, port_audit$CFR)]
  t <- time
  t$original_days <- t$days_reference
  t$original_trips <- t$trips_reference
  t$original_fishing_hours <- t$fishing_time_reference
  t$original_steaming_hours <- t$steaming_time_reference
  daily_fishing <- ifelse(t$original_days > 0, t$original_fishing_hours / t$original_days, 0)
  target_fishing <- pmin(p$max_fishing_hours_per_trip,
    pmax(p$min_fishing_hours_per_trip, daily_fishing))

  t$days_reference <- pmin(t$original_days,
    ifelse(target_fishing > 0, t$original_fishing_hours / target_fishing, 0))
  t <- t %>% dplyr::group_by(.data$CFR, .data$MONTH) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(month_cap_factor = min(1, default_simulation_parameters$max_days_per_month /
      max(sum(.data$days_reference), 1e-12)),
      days_reference = .data$days_reference * .data$month_cap_factor) %>% dplyr::ungroup()

  t$target_fishing_per_trip <- target_fishing
  reachable <- activity %>% dplyr::left_join(distances, by = c("harbour", "id_grid"),
    relationship = "many-to-one")
  route <- smart31_daily_route(reachable$distance_km, maximum_active, speed, p)
  reachable$nav_h <- route$navigation
  reachable <- reachable[which(route$valid), , drop = FALSE]
  nav <- reachable %>% dplyr::group_by(.data$CFR, .data$MONTH, .data$Gear) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(mean_nav_h = stats::weighted.mean(.data$nav_h, .data$fishing_time_reference),
      minimum_nav_h = min(.data$nav_h), .groups = "drop")
  t <- t %>% dplyr::left_join(nav, by = c("CFR", "MONTH", "Gear"), relationship = "one-to-one")
  t$mean_nav_h[!is.finite(t$mean_nav_h)] <- 0
  t$minimum_nav_h[!is.finite(t$minimum_nav_h)] <- 0

  t$daily_activity_budget_h <- pmin(maximum_active, pmax(
    t$target_fishing_per_trip + t$mean_nav_h,
    t$minimum_nav_h + p$min_fishing_hours_per_trip,
    t$minimum_nav_h / p$max_navigation_fraction))
  t$trips_reference <- t$days_reference
  t$trips_per_sea_day <- ifelse(t$days_reference > 0, 1, 0)
  t$fishing_time_reference <- t$days_reference * t$target_fishing_per_trip
  t$steaming_time_reference <- t$days_reference * t$mean_nav_h
  t$trip_reference_kind <- "synthetic_daily_trip_equivalents_not_TRACK_counts"
  t$time_reset <- abs(t$original_trips - t$trips_reference) > 1e-8 |
    abs(t$original_fishing_hours - t$fishing_time_reference) > 1e-8 |
    abs(t$original_steaming_hours - t$steaming_time_reference) > 1e-8
  t$days_reduced <- t$days_reference < t$original_days - 1e-8

  .smart31_initial$time_audit <- t
  .smart31_initial$harbour_audit <- port_audit
  .smart31_initial$harbour_scores <- dplyr::bind_rows(all_scores)
  smart31_working_write(t, "working_time_reference")
  smart31_working_write(port_audit, "simulation_harbour_audit")
  smart31_working_write(.smart31_initial$harbour_scores, "simulation_harbour_candidate_scores")
  list(activity = activity, time = t, fleet = fleet)
}

smart31_rescale_effort_segments <- function(gear, vessels, scenario) {
  before <- evaluate_effort_quota_compatibility(gear, vessels, scenario)
  if (!isTRUE(before$feasible) && !identical(before$issue, "annual_effort_quota_exceeded"))
    return(list(feasible = FALSE, issue = before$issue, diagnostic = before$audit))
  gear$days_before_segment_scaling <- gear$days_scenario_gear
  factors <- tibble::tibble(CFR = character(), Gear = character(), segment_factor = numeric())
  audit <- before$audit
  if (nrow(audit)) {
    audit$initial_target_days <- audit$effort_quota_days * .smart31_initial$controls$initial_quota_utilisation
    audit$scaling_factor <- ifelse(audit$simulated_effort_days > 0 &
      is.finite(audit$initial_target_days),
      pmin(1, audit$initial_target_days / pmax(audit$simulated_effort_days, 1e-12)), 1)
    a <- before$assignments %>% dplyr::left_join(audit %>%
      dplyr::select(.data$effort_quota_id, .data$scaling_factor),
      by = "effort_quota_id", relationship = "many-to-one")
    factors <- a %>% dplyr::group_by(.data$CFR, .data$Gear) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(segment_factor = min(.data$scaling_factor), .groups = "drop")

  }
  gear <- gear %>% dplyr::left_join(factors, by = c("CFR", "Gear"), relationship = "many-to-one")
  gear$segment_factor <- dplyr::coalesce(gear$segment_factor, 1)
  gear$days_scenario_gear <- gear$days_scenario_gear * gear$segment_factor
  after <- evaluate_effort_quota_compatibility(gear, vessels, scenario)
  if (!isTRUE(after$feasible)) stop("Initial segment rescaling failed its quota invariant.")
  .smart31_initial$segment_audits[[scenario$scenario_id]] <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    smart31_working_tag(audit, scenario, "before_segment_rescaling"),
    smart31_working_tag(after$audit, scenario, "after_segment_rescaling"))
  smart31_working_write(.smart31_initial$segment_audits[[scenario$scenario_id]],
    "initial_segment_quota_audit", scenario$scenario_id)
  list(feasible = TRUE, gear = gear, quota_check = after)
}

smart31_refresh_working_days <- function(day, gear, scenario) {
  totals <- gear %>% dplyr::group_by(.data$CFR, .data$MONTH) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(working_days = sum(.data$days_scenario_gear), .groups = "drop")
  day <- day %>% dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of("working_days")) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(totals, by = c("CFR", "MONTH"), relationship = "one-to-one")
  day$days_scenario <- dplyr::coalesce(day$working_days, 0)
  day$working_days <- NULL
  day$cm_capacity_month <- rep(0, nrow(day))
  for (nm in c("conditioned_baseline_annual_days", "scenario_annual_days", "eligible_months", "total_day_capacity"))
    day[[nm]] <- rep(0, nrow(day))
  day$eligible_for_day_allocation <- rep(FALSE, nrow(day))
  for (cfr in unique(day$CFR)) {
    ii <- which(day$CFR == cfr)
    eligible <- day$days_scenario[ii] > 1e-10
    room <- ifelse(eligible, pmax(0, scenario$parameters$max_days_per_month - day$days_scenario[ii]), 0)
    award <- unique(day$available_cm_days[ii])
    if (length(award) != 1L || !is.finite(award) || award < 0) stop("Invalid CM authorisation during conditioning.")
    capacity <- allocate_capped_proportional(min(award, sum(room)),
      ifelse(eligible, day$days_scenario[ii], 0), room)$allocation
    day$cm_capacity_month[ii] <- capacity
    day$conditioned_baseline_annual_days[ii] <- sum(day$days_scenario[ii])
    day$scenario_annual_days[ii] <- sum(day$days_scenario[ii])
    day$eligible_months[ii] <- sum(eligible)
    day$total_day_capacity[ii] <- sum(eligible) * scenario$parameters$max_days_per_month
    day$eligible_for_day_allocation[ii] <- eligible
  }
  day$unallocated_baseline_days <- pmax(0, day$baseline_annual_days - day$conditioned_baseline_annual_days)
  day$unallocated_annual_days <- day$unallocated_baseline_days
  day$used_cm_days <- 0; day$unused_cm_days <- day$available_cm_days
  day$feasible_baseline_day_allocation <- TRUE; day$feasible_day_allocation <- TRUE
  day
}

smart31_prepare_working_allocation <- function(scenario, vessels, allowed_keys) {
  original <- .smart31_initial$original_time %>% dplyr::filter(.data$CFR %in% vessels$CFR)
  source <- time_reference %>% dplyr::filter(.data$CFR %in% vessels$CFR)
  gear <- source %>% dplyr::semi_join(allowed_keys, by = c("CFR", "MONTH", "Gear")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(days_scenario_gear = .data$days_reference)
  scaled <- smart31_rescale_effort_segments(gear, vessels, scenario)
  if (!isTRUE(scaled$feasible)) return(scaled)
  gear_audit <- scaled$gear
  gear <- gear_audit %>% dplyr::filter(.data$days_scenario_gear > 1e-10) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$CFR, .data$MONTH) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(days_scenario = sum(.data$days_scenario_gear),
      gear_day_share = .data$days_scenario_gear / .data$days_scenario) %>% dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(day_scale = .data$days_scenario_gear / .data$days_reference,
      fishing_time_reference_scenario = .data$fishing_time_reference * .data$day_scale,
      steaming_time_reference_scenario = .data$steaming_time_reference * .data$day_scale,
      scenario_trips = .data$days_scenario_gear, unit_id = make_unit_id(.data$CFR, .data$MONTH))
  day <- original %>% dplyr::group_by(.data$CFR, .data$MONTH) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(days_reference = sum(.data$days_reference), .groups = "drop") %>%
    tidyr::complete(CFR = vessels$CFR, MONTH = 1:12, fill = list(days_reference = 0)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$CFR) %>% dplyr::mutate(baseline_annual_days = sum(.data$days_reference)) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()
  day$available_cm_days <- 0
  cm_parts <- list()
  for (cfr in unique(day$CFR)) {
    ii <- which(day$CFR == cfr)
    vessel <- vessels[vessels$CFR == cfr, , drop = FALSE]
    gears <- sort(unique(original$Gear[original$CFR == cfr]))
    base <- day$baseline_annual_days[ii[1L]]
    award <- calculate_vessel_cm_days(vessel, gears, base, scenario$compensation_mechanisms)
    day$available_cm_days[ii] <- award
    comp <- calculate_vessel_cm_components(vessel, gears, base, scenario$compensation_mechanisms)
    if (nrow(comp)) {
      comp$CFR <- cfr; comp$historical_cm_award_basis_days <- base
      comp$selected_cm_days <- award
      comp$selected_for_vessel <- comp$component_days > 0
      comp$cm_rule <- "optional_sum_of_eligible_components_on_historical_days"
      if (abs(sum(comp$component_days) - award) > 1e-8)
        stop("CM component-sum invariant failed.")
      cm_parts[[cfr]] <- smart31_working_tag(comp, scenario, "authorisation")
    }
  }
  day <- smart31_refresh_working_days(day, gear, scenario)
  if (!nrow(gear)) return(list(feasible = FALSE, issue = "no_active_working_baseline",
    diagnostic = day, day_allocations = day, effort_quota_audit = scaled$quota_check$audit))

  audit <- source %>% dplyr::select(.data$CFR, .data$MONTH, .data$Gear,
      historical_days = .data$original_days, physical_working_days = .data$days_reference,
      .data$daily_activity_budget_h) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(gear_audit %>% dplyr::select(.data$CFR, .data$MONTH, .data$Gear,
      .data$days_before_segment_scaling, .data$segment_factor, .data$days_scenario_gear),
      by = c("CFR", "MONTH", "Gear"), relationship = "one-to-one") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(unavailable_after_closures_or_routes = is.na(.data$segment_factor),
      initial_days = dplyr::coalesce(.data$days_scenario_gear, 0))
  .smart31_initial$day_audits[[scenario$scenario_id]] <- smart31_working_tag(audit, scenario, "before_joint_projection")
  smart31_working_write(.smart31_initial$day_audits[[scenario$scenario_id]], "initial_days_audit", scenario$scenario_id)
  list(feasible = TRUE, gear = gear, days = day, cm = dplyr::bind_rows(cm_parts), quota_check = scaled$quota_check)
}

smart31_working_clock <- function(data, gear_time, combined_share, context) {
  p <- context$working_baseline_controls
  pos <- match(data$Gear, gear_time$Gear)
  if (anyNA(pos) || length(combined_share) != nrow(data) ||
      any(!is.finite(combined_share)) || any(combined_share < 0))
    return(list(valid = FALSE, issue = "invalid_daily_clock_keys_or_shares"))
  route <- smart31_daily_route(data$distance_km,
    gear_time$daily_activity_budget_h[pos], context$steaming_speed_kmh, p)
  row_trips <- gear_time$scenario_trips[pos] * combined_share
  active <- row_trips > 1e-12
  if (any(active & !route$valid)) return(list(valid = FALSE, issue = "destination_exceeds_daily_trip_or_navigation_bound"))

  row_fishing <- ifelse(active, row_trips * route$fishing, 0)
  row_steaming <- ifelse(active, row_trips * route$navigation, 0)
  sum_by_gear <- function(x) {
    z <- rowsum(matrix(x, ncol = 1L), as.character(data$Gear), reorder = FALSE)
    as.numeric(z[match(gear_time$Gear, rownames(z)), 1L])
  }
  fishing <- sum_by_gear(row_fishing); steaming <- sum_by_gear(row_steaming)
  trips <- gear_time$scenario_trips
  mean_distance <- ifelse(trips > 0, steaming * context$steaming_speed_kmh / (2 * trips), 0)
  day_hours <- fishing + steaming + trips * p$trip_reserved_hours
  if (any(abs(trips - gear_time$days_scenario_gear) > 1e-8) ||
      any(day_hours > p$trip_limit_hours * gear_time$days_scenario_gear + 1e-8))
    return(list(valid = FALSE, issue = "daily_trip_calendar_invariant_failed"))
  list(valid = TRUE, fishing = fishing, steaming = steaming, mean_distance = mean_distance,
    row_fishing = row_fishing, row_steaming = row_steaming, row_trips = row_trips,
    trip_duration = ifelse(active, route$duration, 0),
    fishing_h_per_trip = ifelse(active, route$fishing, 0),
    navigation_h_per_trip = ifelse(active, route$navigation, 0),
    navigation_fraction = ifelse(active, route$navigation_fraction, 0))
}

smart31_working_state <- function(context) {
  ids <- names(context$unit_kernels)
  shares <- lapply(context$unit_kernels, function(k) k$initial_share)
  ev <- vector("list", length(ids)); names(ev) <- ids
  for (i in seq_along(ids)) {
    ev[[i]] <- evaluate_vessel_month_light(shares[[i]], ids[[i]], context)
    if (!isTRUE(ev[[i]]$valid)) stop("Working baseline evaluation failed at ", ids[[i]], ": ", ev[[i]]$issue)
    if (i %% monitor_update_every_units == 0L || i == length(ids)) {
      smart31_monitor_event(event = "working_baseline_progress", phase = "scenario_preparation",
        scenario_id = context$scenario$scenario_id, unit_index = i, units_in_stage = length(ids),
        note = "deterministic physical evaluation before stochastic search")
    }
  }
  occ <- combine_occupancy(ev)
  catches <- context$fixed_non_vms_quota_catch
  for (e in ev) if (length(catches)) catches <- catches + e$quota_catch_kg[names(catches)]
  state <- list(feasible = TRUE, share_by_unit = shares, evaluation_by_unit = ev,
    occupancy = occ, occupancy_index = build_occupancy_index(occ), catch_index = catches)
  smart31_auxiliary_state(state, context)
}

smart31_condition_joint_context <- function(context) {
  if (!isTRUE(context$feasible)) return(context)
  if (isTRUE(context$working_baseline_conditioned)) return(context)
  p <- context$working_baseline_controls
  state <- smart31_working_state(context)
  before <- smart31_constraint_scores(state, context)
  ratios <- function(value, limit, utilisation = 1) {
    out <- rep(1, length(value))
    k <- is.finite(limit) & value > 0
    out[k] <- pmin(1, pmax(0, limit[k]) * utilisation / value[k])
    out
  }
  global_factor <- stats::setNames(ratios(state$occupancy$effort,
    rep(context$crowding_limit, nrow(state$occupancy)), p$initial_quota_utilisation),
    paste(state$occupancy$MONTH, state$occupancy$id_grid, sep = "::"))
  local_factor <- stats::setNames(if (isTRUE(cfg$enforce_local_effort_envelope)) {
    ratios(as.numeric(state$local_index), as.numeric(context$local_limits), p$initial_quota_utilisation)
  } else rep(1, length(state$local_index)), names(context$local_limits))
  effort_factor <- stats::setNames(ratios(as.numeric(state$effort_index),
    as.numeric(context$effort_limits), p$initial_quota_utilisation), names(context$effort_limits))
  catch_factor <- stats::setNames(rep(1, length(context$quota_species)), context$quota_species)
  for (sp in context$quota_species) {
    limit <- min(context$catch_quota_limits$quota_kg[context$catch_quota_limits$Species == sp])
    fixed <- context$fixed_non_vms_quota_catch[[sp]]
    active <- state$catch_index[[sp]] - fixed
    if (fixed > limit + 1e-8) stop("Fixed removals alone exceed quota; activity conditioning cannot solve this.")
    if (active > 0 && is.finite(limit)) catch_factor[[sp]] <-
      min(1, max(0, limit - fixed) * p$initial_quota_utilisation / active)
  }
  audit <- purrr::imap_dfr(state$evaluation_by_unit, function(e, uid) {
    keys <- paste(e$occupancy$MONTH, e$occupancy$id_grid, sep = "::")
    fg <- min(c(1, global_factor[keys[e$occupancy$effort > 0]]))
    fl <- min(c(1, local_factor[names(e$local_occupancy)[e$local_occupancy > 0]]))
    fe <- min(c(1, effort_factor[names(e$effort_quota_days)[e$effort_quota_days > 0]]))
    fc <- min(c(1, catch_factor[names(e$quota_catch_kg)[e$quota_catch_kg > 0]]))
    g <- context$gear_search_by_unit[[uid]]
    observed_cap <- stats::setNames(g$fishing_time_reference_scenario, g$Gear)
    actual_fishing <- e$gear_fishing_hours
    ft <- min(c(1, observed_cap[names(actual_fishing)[actual_fishing > 0]] /
      actual_fishing[actual_fishing > 0]))
    factor <- min(fg, fl, fe, fc, ft)
    tibble::tibble(unit_id = uid, CFR = e$economic$CFR, MONTH = e$economic$MONTH,
      days_before_joint = e$economic$days_at_sea, GVA_before_joint = e$economic$GVA,
      global_crowding_factor = fg, local_effort_factor = fl,
      effort_quota_factor = fe, catch_quota_factor = fc, initial_fishing_exposure_factor = ft, joint_factor = factor,
      days_after_joint = e$economic$days_at_sea * factor,
      initial_GVA_after_joint_expected = e$economic$GVA * factor)
  })
  if (any(!is.finite(audit$joint_factor)) || any(audit$joint_factor < 0) || any(audit$joint_factor > 1))
    stop("Invalid deterministic joint-conditioning multiplier.")

  volumes <- c("days_scenario_gear", "scenario_trips", "fishing_time_reference_scenario",
    "steaming_time_reference_scenario", "GVL_other_reference_month")
  multiplier <- stats::setNames(audit$joint_factor, audit$unit_id)
  scale_table <- function(x) {
    ids <- make_unit_id(x$CFR, x$MONTH)
    f <- unname(multiplier[ids]); if (anyNA(f)) stop("Missing conditioning factor.")
    for (nm in intersect(volumes, names(x))) x[[nm]] <- x[[nm]] * f
    x
  }
  context$gear_time <- scale_table(context$gear_time)
  context$other_gvl_monthly <- scale_table(context$other_gvl_monthly)
  context$gear_search_by_unit <- lapply(context$gear_search_by_unit, scale_table)

  context$gear_time <- context$gear_time %>% dplyr::group_by(.data$CFR, .data$MONTH) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(days_scenario = sum(.data$days_scenario_gear),
      gear_day_share = ifelse(.data$days_scenario > 0, .data$days_scenario_gear / .data$days_scenario, 0)) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()
  inactive <- names(multiplier)[multiplier <= 1e-12]
  if (length(inactive)) {
    context$unit_kernels <- context$unit_kernels[setdiff(names(context$unit_kernels), inactive)]
    context$gear_search_by_unit <- context$gear_search_by_unit[setdiff(names(context$gear_search_by_unit), inactive)]
    context$gear_time <- context$gear_time[!context$gear_time$unit_id %in% inactive, , drop = FALSE]
    other_ids <- make_unit_id(context$other_gvl_monthly$CFR, context$other_gvl_monthly$MONTH)
    context$other_gvl_monthly <- context$other_gvl_monthly[!other_ids %in% inactive, , drop = FALSE]
  }
  context$day_allocations <- smart31_refresh_working_days(context$day_allocations, context$gear_time, context$scenario)
  context$cm_capacity <- stats::setNames(context$day_allocations$cm_capacity_month,
    make_unit_id(context$day_allocations$CFR, context$day_allocations$MONTH))
  for (uid in names(context$unit_kernels)) {
    k <- context$unit_kernels[[uid]]; g <- context$gear_search_by_unit[[uid]]
    g$days_scenario <- sum(g$days_scenario_gear)
    g$gear_day_share <- g$days_scenario_gear / g$days_scenario
    context$gear_search_by_unit[[uid]] <- g
    j <- g$scenario_trips[match(k$data$Gear, g$Gear)]
    k$data$allocation_units <- pmax(1L, as.integer(round(j * k$data$metier_share)))
    context$unit_kernels[[uid]] <- k
  }
  tagged <- smart31_working_tag(audit, context$scenario, "joint_constraint_projection")
  .smart31_initial$joint_audits[[context$scenario$scenario_id]] <- tagged
  smart31_working_write(tagged, "joint_initialisation_audit", context$scenario$scenario_id)
  smart31_working_write(smart31_working_tag(context$day_allocations, context$scenario, "ready_for_search"),
    "conditioned_day_allocation", context$scenario$scenario_id)
  if (!length(context$unit_kernels)) {
    context$feasible <- FALSE; context$issue <- "conditioning_left_no_positive_activity"
    context$diagnostic <- tagged
    return(context)
  }
  final_state <- smart31_working_state(context)
  if (!smart31_state_feasible(final_state, context))
    stop("Joint conditioning failed an upper-bound invariant; no stochastic run was started.")
  after <- smart31_constraint_scores(final_state, context)
  constraint_audit <- tibble::tibble(constraint = names(before), before = as.numeric(before), after = as.numeric(after))
  smart31_working_write(smart31_working_tag(constraint_audit, context$scenario, "ready_for_search"),
    "initial_constraint_scores", context$scenario$scenario_id)
  final_effort <- evaluate_effort_quota_compatibility(context$gear_time, context$retained_vessels, context$scenario)
  context$effort_quota_audit <- smart31_working_tag(final_effort$audit, context$scenario, "conditioned_initial")
  context$effort_quota_assignments <- final_effort$assignments
  e <- purrr::map_dfr(final_state$evaluation_by_unit, "economic")
  e$initial_W <- vapply(final_state$evaluation_by_unit, function(z) sum(z$catch_kg), numeric(1))
  actual_gva <- stats::setNames(e$GVA, e$unit_id)
  tagged$actual_initial_GVA <- unname(actual_gva[tagged$unit_id])
  tagged$actual_initial_GVA[is.na(tagged$actual_initial_GVA)] <- 0
  tagged$homogeneity_residual <- tagged$actual_initial_GVA - tagged$initial_GVA_after_joint_expected
  if (any(abs(tagged$homogeneity_residual) > 1e-7 * pmax(1, abs(tagged$GVA_before_joint))))
    stop("Initial volume rescaling failed the independently recomputed economic identity.")
  .smart31_initial$joint_audits[[context$scenario$scenario_id]] <- tagged
  smart31_working_write(tagged, "joint_initialisation_audit", context$scenario$scenario_id)
  fields <- c("GVL_6sp", "GVL_other_reference", "GVL", "EC", "OC", "LC", "GVA", "GP")
  original_ref <- dplyr::bind_rows(context$economic_reference, context$cessation_reference)
  initial <- original_ref %>% dplyr::select(.data$unit_id, .data$CFR, .data$MONTH, dplyr::all_of(fields)) %>%
    dplyr::rename_with(~ paste0("historical_", .x), dplyr::all_of(fields)) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(e %>% dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of(c("CFR", "MONTH"))),
      by = "unit_id", relationship = "one-to-one") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(c(fields, "days_at_sea", "trips", "fishing_time", "steaming_time")),
      ~ dplyr::coalesce(.x, 0)),
      initial_baseline_type = "Step2_conditioned_daily_trip_model_not_revised_history")
  context$initial_economic_monthly <- smart31_working_tag(initial, context$scenario, "ready_for_search")
  .smart31_initial$initial_economics[[context$scenario$scenario_id]] <- context$initial_economic_monthly
  smart31_working_write(context$initial_economic_monthly, "initial_economic_monthly", context$scenario$scenario_id)
  context$working_baseline_conditioned <- TRUE
  context$baseline_initialisation_audit <- tagged
  smart31_monitor_event(event = "working_baseline_ready", phase = "scenario_preparation",
    scenario_id = context$scenario$scenario_id, total_units = length(context$unit_kernels),
    total_GVA = sum(e$GVA), note = paste0("joint constraints passed; ", length(inactive),
      " zero-activity units; days ", signif(sum(e$days_at_sea), 7),
      "; daily trip limit ", p$trip_limit_hours, " h"))
  context
}
```

## Candidate cells and priors

```{r step2-14-candidate-cells-and-priors}

attach_candidate_support <- function(candidate_table) {
  out <- candidate_table %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      distance_reference,
      by = c("harbour", "id_grid"),
      relationship = "many-to-one"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      grid_lookup,
      by = "id_grid",
      relationship = "many-to-one"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      trip_evidence,
      by = c("pattern_id", "id_grid"),
      relationship = "many-to-one"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      effective_trip_count = dplyr::coalesce(
        .data$effective_trip_count,
        0
      ),
      candidate_reachable = is.finite(.data$distance_km) &
        .data$distance_km >= 0 &
        !is.na(.data$GSA_code)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(time_reference %>% dplyr::select(.data$CFR, .data$MONTH, .data$Gear,
      .data$daily_activity_budget_h, .data$days_reference),
      by = c("CFR", "MONTH", "Gear"), relationship = "many-to-one") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(.smart31_initial$pattern_gsa %>% dplyr::mutate(gsa_supported = TRUE),
      by = c("pattern_id", "GSA_code"), relationship = "many-to-one") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(.smart31_initial$rate_support,
      by = c("MONTH", "GSA_code", "Gear", "id_grid"), relationship = "many-to-one")
  clock <- smart31_daily_route(out$distance_km, out$daily_activity_budget_h,
    .smart31_initial$speed, .smart31_initial$controls)
  out$candidate_reachable <- dplyr::coalesce(out$candidate_reachable & clock$valid &
    out$days_reference > 0 & out$gsa_supported & out$rate_supported, FALSE)
  out
}
```
