## Scenario validation and restrictions

```{r step2-15-scenario-validation-and-restrictions}

validate_scenario <- function(scenario) {
  if (!is.list(scenario) ||
      is.null(scenario$scenario_id) ||
      !nzchar(scenario$scenario_id)) {
    smart31_stop("Every scenario must have a non-empty scenario_id.")
  }

  if (!scenario$method %in%
      c("stochastic_optimizer", "bayesian_dirichlet", "both")) {
    smart31_stop("Unsupported simulation method in ", scenario$scenario_id)
  }

  if (!identical(scenario$member_state, management_member_state)) {
    smart31_stop(
      "Only Italian scenarios are allowed; invalid member_state in ",
      scenario$scenario_id,
      "."
    )
  }

  if (!scenario$representative_period %in% representative_periods) {
    smart31_stop(
      "Unsupported representative period in ", scenario$scenario_id, "."
    )
  }

  p <- scenario$parameters

  scalar_positive <- c(
    "max_days_per_month",
    "maximum_clock_hours_per_sea_day",
    "min_GVA_improve_fact",
    "crowding_factor",
    "candidates_per_update",
    "maximum_sweeps",
    "max_consecutive_non_improvements",
    "bayesian_prior_strength",
    "stochastic_concentration",
    "n_replicates"
  )

  invalid_positive <- scalar_positive[
    !vapply(
      scalar_positive,
      function(name) {
        value <- p[[name]]
        length(value) == 1L && is.finite(value) && value > 0
      },
      logical(1)
    )
  ]

  if (length(invalid_positive) > 0L) {
    smart31_stop(
      "Invalid positive scenario parameters: ",
      paste(invalid_positive, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  if (p$min_GVA_improve_fact < 1) {
    smart31_stop("min_GVA_improve_fact must be at least one.")
  }

  if (p$stochastic_exploration < 0 ||
      p$stochastic_exploration > 1) {
    smart31_stop("stochastic_exploration must lie in [0, 1].")
  }

  if (!is.finite(p$min_GVA_improve_abs_eur) ||
      p$min_GVA_improve_abs_eur < 0) {
    smart31_stop("min_GVA_improve_abs_eur must be non-negative.")
  }

  if (p$maximum_clock_hours_per_sea_day > 24) {
    smart31_stop(
      "maximum_clock_hours_per_sea_day cannot exceed 24."
    )
  }

  if (is.finite(p$fishing_time_elasticity_override) &&
      (p$fishing_time_elasticity_override < 0 ||
       p$fishing_time_elasticity_override > 1)) {
    smart31_stop("The fishing-time elasticity must lie in [0, 1].")
  }

  if (p$max_days_per_month > 31) {
    smart31_stop("max_days_per_month cannot exceed 31.")
  }

  if (!identical(p$cm_combination_method, "sum_capped")) {
    smart31_stop(
      "Italian CM awards must use the scenario-specific capped sum in ",
      scenario$scenario_id,
      "; cm_combination_method must be 'sum_capped'."
    )
  }

  for (rule in scenario$compensation_mechanisms) {
    if (!is.finite(rule$extra_days) || rule$extra_days < 0 ||
        !is.finite(rule$extra_days_fraction) ||
        rule$extra_days_fraction < 0) {
      smart31_stop("CM days and fractions must be finite and non-negative.")
    }
    available_measure_ids <- c(
      vapply(
        scenario$closures,
        function(x) x$restriction_id,
        character(1)
      ),
      vapply(
        scenario$selectivity_rules,
        function(x) x$rule_id,
        character(1)
      ),
      "PERMANENT_CESSATION"
    )

    if (!rule$associated_measure_id %in% available_measure_ids) {
      smart31_stop(
        "CM rule '", rule$rule_id,
        "' is not associated with a management measure in the same scenario."
      )
    }
  }

  for (rule in scenario$selectivity_rules) {
    if (!is.finite(rule$multiplier) || rule$multiplier < 0) {
      smart31_stop(
        "Selectivity multipliers must be finite and non-negative."
      )
    }
  }

  invisible(scenario)
}

closure_matches_pattern <- function(closure, cfr, month, gear) {
  (is.null(closure$cfr) || cfr %in% closure$cfr) &&
    (is.null(closure$months) || month %in% closure$months) &&
    (is.null(closure$gears) || gear %in% closure$gears)
}

filter_closed_cells <- function(candidate_table, closures) {
  if (length(closures) == 0L || nrow(candidate_table) == 0L) {
    return(candidate_table)
  }

  keep <- rep(TRUE, nrow(candidate_table))

  for (closure in closures) {
    cfr_match <- if (is.null(closure$cfr)) {
      rep(TRUE, nrow(candidate_table))
    } else {
      candidate_table$CFR %in% closure$cfr
    }

    month_match <- if (is.null(closure$months)) {
      rep(TRUE, nrow(candidate_table))
    } else {
      candidate_table$MONTH %in% closure$months
    }

    gear_match <- if (is.null(closure$gears)) {
      rep(TRUE, nrow(candidate_table))
    } else {
      candidate_table$Gear %in% closure$gears
    }

    pattern_match <- cfr_match & month_match & gear_match

    cell_match <- if (is.null(closure$id_grid)) {
      rep(TRUE, nrow(candidate_table))
    } else {
      candidate_table$id_grid %in% closure$id_grid
    }

    keep <- keep & !(pattern_match & cell_match)
  }

  candidate_table[keep, , drop = FALSE]
}

cm_rule_matches_vessel <- function(rule, vessel, vessel_gears) {
  (is.null(rule$eligible_cfr) || vessel$CFR %in% rule$eligible_cfr) &&
    (is.null(rule$eligible_gears) ||
       any(vessel_gears %in% rule$eligible_gears)) &&
    (is.null(rule$eligible_harbours) ||
       vessel$harbour %in% rule$eligible_harbours) &&
    vessel$loa >= rule$minimum_loa &&
    vessel$loa <= rule$maximum_loa
}

calculate_vessel_cm_components <- function(
  vessel,
  vessel_gears,
  baseline_annual_days,
  cm_rules
) {
  if (length(cm_rules) == 0L) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      rule_id = character(),
      associated_measure_id = character(),
      rate_status = character(),
      eligible = logical(),
      extra_days = numeric(),
      extra_days_fraction = numeric(),
      component_days = numeric()
    ))
  }

  purrr::map_dfr(
    cm_rules,
    function(rule) {
      eligible <- cm_rule_matches_vessel(rule, vessel, vessel_gears)
      tibble::tibble(
        rule_id = rule$rule_id,
        associated_measure_id = rule$associated_measure_id,
        rate_status = rule$rate_status,
        eligible = eligible,
        extra_days = rule$extra_days,
        extra_days_fraction = rule$extra_days_fraction,
        component_days = if (eligible) {
          rule$extra_days +
            rule$extra_days_fraction * baseline_annual_days
        } else {
          0
        }
      )
    }
  )
}

calculate_vessel_cm_days <- function(
  vessel,
  vessel_gears,
  baseline_annual_days,
  cm_rules
) {
  if (length(cm_rules) == 0L) {
    return(0)
  }

  contributions <- calculate_vessel_cm_components(
    vessel,
    vessel_gears,
    baseline_annual_days,
    cm_rules
  )$component_days

  matched <- contributions > 0
  if (!any(matched)) {
    return(0)
  }

  sum(contributions)
}

apply_selectivity_rules <- function(catch_table, rules) {
  if (nrow(catch_table) == 0L) {
    catch_table$selectivity_multiplier <- numeric()
    return(catch_table)
  }

  multiplier <- rep(1, nrow(catch_table))

  for (rule in rules) {
    species_match <- if (is.null(rule$species)) {
      rep(TRUE, nrow(catch_table))
    } else {
      catch_table$Species %in% rule$species
    }

    gear_match <- if (is.null(rule$gears)) {
      rep(TRUE, nrow(catch_table))
    } else {
      catch_table$Gear %in% rule$gears
    }

    month_match <- if (is.null(rule$months)) {
      rep(TRUE, nrow(catch_table))
    } else {
      catch_table$MONTH %in% rule$months
    }

    cell_match <- if (is.null(rule$id_grid)) {
      rep(TRUE, nrow(catch_table))
    } else {
      catch_table$id_grid %in% rule$id_grid
    }

    matched <- species_match & gear_match & month_match & cell_match

    multiplier[matched] <- multiplier[matched] * rule$multiplier
  }

  catch_table$selectivity_multiplier <- multiplier
  catch_table
}

prepare_non_vms_reference <- function(inputs, years, retained_cfr) {
  ledger <- inputs$non_vms_landings_ledger %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$YEAR %in% years) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      CFR = as.character(.data$CFR),
      YEAR = as.integer(.data$YEAR),
      MONTH = normalise_month(
        .data$MONTH,
        "non_vms_landings_ledger$MONTH"
      ),
      GSA_code = normalise_gsa(.data$GSA_code),
      Species = normalise_code(.data$Species),
      Gear = normalise_code(.data$Gear),
      calibrated_kg = as.numeric(.data$calibrated_kg)
    )

  retention_by_stratum <- ledger %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      .data$YEAR, .data$MONTH, .data$GSA_code,
      .data$Species, .data$Gear
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      declared_kg = sum(.data$calibrated_kg),
      retained_kg = sum(
        .data$calibrated_kg[.data$CFR %in% retained_cfr]
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      retained_fraction = dplyr::if_else(
        .data$declared_kg > 0,
        .data$retained_kg / .data$declared_kg,
        1
      )
    )

  spatial_reference <- inputs$non_vms_spatial_allocation %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$YEAR %in% years) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      YEAR = as.integer(.data$YEAR),
      MONTH = normalise_month(
        .data$MONTH,
        "non_vms_spatial_allocation$MONTH"
      ),
      GSA_code = normalise_gsa(.data$GSA_code),
      Species = normalise_code(.data$Species),
      Gear = normalise_code(.data$Gear),
      id_grid = as.character(.data$id_grid),
      allocated_kg = as.numeric(.data$landings)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      retention_by_stratum,
      by = c("YEAR", "MONTH", "GSA_code", "Species", "Gear"),
      relationship = "many-to-one"
    )

  missing_retention_strata <- spatial_reference %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.na(.data$retained_fraction)) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(
      .data$YEAR, .data$MONTH, .data$GSA_code,
      .data$Species, .data$Gear
    )

  if (nrow(missing_retention_strata) > 0L) {
    smart31_stop(
      nrow(missing_retention_strata),
      " non-VMS spatial strata have no matching vessel ledger."
    )
  }

  spatial_reference <- spatial_reference %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      retained_kg = .data$allocated_kg * .data$retained_fraction
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      .data$MONTH, .data$GSA_code, .data$Species,
      .data$Gear, .data$id_grid
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      W = sum(.data$retained_kg) / length(years),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$W > 0) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      CFR = NA_character_,
      Metier = "NON_VMS_LEDGER",
      fishing_time = 0,
      effort = 0,
      lpue_reference = NA_real_,
      selectivity_multiplier = 1,
      lpue_scenario = NA_real_,
      price_reference = NA_real_,
      n_price_years = NA_integer_,
      price_scenario = NA_real_,
      GVL = NA_real_,
      simulation_treatment =
        "fixed_non_vms_catch_no_synthetic_effort_or_economics"
    )

  expected_reference_kg <- sum(
    ledger$calibrated_kg[ledger$CFR %in% retained_cfr]
  ) / length(years)

  represented_reference_kg <- sum(spatial_reference$W)
  reconciliation_tolerance <- sqrt(.Machine$double.eps) *
    max(1, abs(expected_reference_kg))

  if (!is.finite(expected_reference_kg) ||
      !is.finite(represented_reference_kg) ||
      abs(represented_reference_kg - expected_reference_kg) >
        reconciliation_tolerance) {
    smart31_stop(
      "The future non-VMS biological ledger does not reconcile with ",
      "its spatial allocation."
    )
  }

  spatial_reference
}

scenario_target_years <- function(scenario) {
  if (identical(scenario$representative_period, .smart31_case$periods$baseline)) {
    return(.smart31_years$baseline)
  }
  if (identical(scenario$representative_period, .smart31_case$periods$future)) {
    return(.smart31_years$future)
  }
  smart31_stop(
    "Unknown representative period: ", scenario$representative_period
  )
}

evaluate_effort_quota_compatibility <- function(
  gear_days,
  retained_vessels,
  scenario
) {
  target_years <- scenario_target_years(scenario)
  quota <- italian_effort_quotas %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$YEAR %in% target_years)

  if ("scenario_id" %in% names(quota)) {
    quota <- quota %>% dplyr::filter(
      .data$scenario_id == scenario$scenario_id)
  }

  if (nrow(quota) == 0L) {
    return(list(
      feasible = TRUE,
      issue = NA_character_,
      audit = tibble::tibble(),
      assignments = tibble::tibble()
    ))
  }

  annual_vessel_gear_days <- gear_days %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$CFR, .data$Gear) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      scenario_effort_days = sum(.data$days_scenario_gear),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      retained_vessels %>% dplyr::select(.data$CFR, .data$loa),
      by = "CFR",
      relationship = "many-to-one"
    ) %>%
    tidyr::crossing(YEAR = target_years) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      effort_record_id = dplyr::row_number()
    )

  regulated_records <- annual_vessel_gear_days %>%
    dplyr::semi_join(
      quota %>% dplyr::distinct(.data$YEAR, .data$Gear),
      by = c("YEAR", "Gear")
    )

  assignments <- regulated_records %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(
      quota,
      by = c("YEAR", "Gear"),
      relationship = "many-to-many"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$loa >= .data$min_loa_m,
      .data$loa <= .data$max_loa_m
    )

  match_count <- regulated_records %>%
    dplyr::select(.data$effort_record_id, .data$YEAR, .data$CFR,
                  .data$Gear, .data$loa) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      assignments %>%
        dplyr::count(.data$effort_record_id, name = "quota_matches"),
      by = "effort_record_id",
      relationship = "one-to-one"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(quota_matches = dplyr::coalesce(.data$quota_matches, 0L))

  invalid_assignment <- match_count %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$quota_matches != 1L)
  if (nrow(invalid_assignment) > 0L) {
    return(list(
      feasible = FALSE,
      issue = "regulated_effort_records_without_unique_length_class",
      audit = invalid_assignment,
      assignments = assignments
    ))
  }

  usage <- assignments %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      .data$effort_quota_id, .data$YEAR, .data$Gear,
      .data$length_class, .data$min_loa_m, .data$max_loa_m,
      .data$effort_quota_days
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      simulated_effort_days = sum(.data$scenario_effort_days),
      contributing_vessels = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$CFR),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  audit <- quota %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      usage,
      by = c(
        "effort_quota_id", "YEAR", "Gear", "length_class",
        "min_loa_m", "max_loa_m", "effort_quota_days"
      ),
      relationship = "one-to-one"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      simulated_effort_days = dplyr::coalesce(
        .data$simulated_effort_days, 0
      ),
      contributing_vessels = dplyr::coalesce(
        .data$contributing_vessels, 0L
      ),
      remaining_effort_days =
        .data$effort_quota_days - .data$simulated_effort_days,
      quota_use_fraction = dplyr::if_else(
        .data$effort_quota_days > 0,
        .data$simulated_effort_days / .data$effort_quota_days,
        dplyr::if_else(.data$simulated_effort_days == 0, 0, Inf)
      ),
      compatible = .data$simulated_effort_days <=
        .data$effort_quota_days * (1 + quota_tolerance_fraction) +
        sqrt(.Machine$double.eps)
    )

  list(
    feasible = all(audit$compatible),
    issue = if (all(audit$compatible)) NA_character_ else
      "annual_effort_quota_exceeded",
    audit = audit,
    assignments = assignments
  )
}

build_scenario_cell_rates <- function(candidates, scenario, quota_species) {
  candidate_keys <- candidates %>%
    dplyr::distinct(
      .data$MONTH, .data$GSA_code, .data$Gear, .data$id_grid
    )

  rate_long <- lpue_reference %>%
    dplyr::semi_join(
      candidate_keys,
      by = c("MONTH", "GSA_code", "Gear", "id_grid")
    ) %>%
    apply_selectivity_rules(scenario$selectivity_rules) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      lpue_scenario = .data$lpue_reference *
        .data$selectivity_multiplier
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      price_reference,
      by = c("Species", "GSA_code" = "GSA"),
      relationship = "many-to-one"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      price_scenario = .data$price_reference *
        scenario$parameters$landing_price_multiplier,
      revenue_per_effort = .data$lpue_scenario * .data$price_scenario
    )

  if (nrow(rate_long) > 0L &&
      (any(!is.finite(rate_long$lpue_scenario)) ||
       any(rate_long$lpue_scenario < 0) ||
       any(!is.finite(rate_long$revenue_per_effort)) ||
       any(rate_long$revenue_per_effort < 0))) {
    smart31_stop(
      "Scenario LPUE or landing-price rates are incomplete or invalid."
    )
  }

  rate_table <- rate_long %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      .data$MONTH, .data$GSA_code, .data$Gear, .data$id_grid
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      revenue_per_effort = sum(.data$revenue_per_effort),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      .data$MONTH, .data$GSA_code, .data$Gear, .data$id_grid
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(cell_rate_id = dplyr::row_number() + 1L)

  candidates <- candidates %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      rate_table %>%
        dplyr::select(
          .data$MONTH, .data$GSA_code, .data$Gear, .data$id_grid,
          .data$cell_rate_id
        ),
      by = c("MONTH", "GSA_code", "Gear", "id_grid"),
      relationship = "many-to-one"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      cell_rate_id = dplyr::coalesce(.data$cell_rate_id, 1L)
    )

  revenue_rate <- c(0, rate_table$revenue_per_effort)
  catch_species <- sort(unique(as.character(rate_long$Species)))
  catch_rate <- matrix(
    0,
    nrow = length(revenue_rate),
    ncol = length(catch_species),
    dimnames = list(NULL, catch_species)
  )

  if (length(catch_species) > 0L) {
    species_rates <- rate_long %>%
      dplyr::group_by(
        .data$MONTH, .data$GSA_code, .data$Gear,
        .data$id_grid, .data$Species
      ) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        lpue_scenario = sum(.data$lpue_scenario),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(
        rate_table %>%
          dplyr::select(
            .data$MONTH, .data$GSA_code, .data$Gear, .data$id_grid,
            .data$cell_rate_id
          ),
        by = c("MONTH", "GSA_code", "Gear", "id_grid"),
        relationship = "many-to-one"
      )

    matrix_index <- cbind(
      species_rates$cell_rate_id,
      match(species_rates$Species, catch_species)
    )
    catch_rate[matrix_index] <- species_rates$lpue_scenario
  }

  quota_species <- sort(unique(as.character(quota_species)))

  list(
    candidates = candidates,
    revenue_rate = revenue_rate,
    catch_rate = catch_rate,
    quota_rate = smart31_build_quota_rate(catch_rate, c(NA_character_, rate_table$GSA_code), quota_species),
    catch_species = catch_species,
    quota_species = quota_species
  )
}

build_unit_kernel <- function(candidate_table) {
  row_id <- seq_len(nrow(candidate_table))

  list(
    data = candidate_table,
    pattern_rows = split(row_id, candidate_table$pattern_id),
    gear_rows = split(row_id, candidate_table$Gear),
    initial_share = as.numeric(candidate_table$initial_share),
    baseline_combined_share =
      as.numeric(candidate_table$metier_share) *
      as.numeric(candidate_table$initial_share)
  )
}

build_catch_quota_limits <- function(scenario, non_vms_reference) {
  target_years <- scenario_target_years(scenario)

  reporting_limits <- italian_catch_quotas %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$YEAR %in% target_years)
  limits <- fmsy_catch_limits %>%
    dplyr::transmute(Species = paste0("STOCK::", .data$assessment_stock),
      YEAR = .data$YEAR, quota_kg = .data$quota_kg,
      assessment_stock = .data$assessment_stock, source = .data$source) %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$YEAR %in% target_years)
  if (isTRUE(.smart31_case$management$enforce_catch_quotas)) {
    limits <- dplyr::bind_rows(limits, reporting_limits %>%
      dplyr::mutate(assessment_stock = NA_character_, source = "Ordinary catch quota"))
  }

  fixed_non_vms <- smart31_quota_catches(non_vms_reference, sort(unique(limits$Species)))

  fixed_audit <- limits %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      fixed_non_vms_catch_kg = unname(fixed_non_vms[.data$Species]),
      compatible = .data$fixed_non_vms_catch_kg <=
        .data$quota_kg * (1 + quota_tolerance_fraction) +
        sqrt(.Machine$double.eps)
    )

  fixed_compatible <- nrow(fixed_audit) == 0L ||
    all(fixed_audit$compatible)

  list(
    feasible = fixed_compatible,
    issue = if (nrow(fixed_audit) > 0L && !all(fixed_audit$compatible)) {
      "fixed_non_vms_catch_exceeds_annual_quota"
    } else {
      NA_character_
    },
    limits = limits,
    reporting_limits = reporting_limits,
    fixed_non_vms = fixed_non_vms,
    fixed_audit = fixed_audit
  )
}
```

## Prepare scenario context

```{r step2-16-prepare-scenario-context}

smart31_other_gvl_other_gvl_target <- function(reference_eur, active_days, historical_days) {
  reference_eur <- as.numeric(reference_eur)
  active_days <- as.numeric(active_days)
  historical_days <- as.numeric(historical_days)
  n <- max(length(reference_eur), length(active_days), length(historical_days))
  reference_eur <- rep(reference_eur, length.out = n)
  active_days <- rep(active_days, length.out = n)
  historical_days <- rep(historical_days, length.out = n)
  if (any(!is.finite(reference_eur)) || any(reference_eur < 0) ||
      any(!is.finite(active_days)) || any(active_days < 0) ||
      any(!is.finite(historical_days)) || any(historical_days < 0))
    stop("Invalid inputs to activity-elastic non-modelled-species GVL.")
  ratio <- ifelse(historical_days > 0, pmax(0, active_days / historical_days), 0)
  target <- switch(cfg$other_gvl_mode,
    fixed_annual_reference = ifelse(active_days > 0, reference_eur, 0),
    per_day_reference = reference_eur * ratio,
    activity_elastic = reference_eur * ratio^cfg$other_gvl_beta,
    stop("Unknown other_gvl_mode: ", cfg$other_gvl_mode))
  if (isTRUE(cfg$other_gvl_cap_at_reference)) target <- pmin(target, reference_eur)
  target[active_days <= 0] <- 0
  if (any(!is.finite(target)) || any(target < -1e-8))
    stop("Non-finite non-modelled-species GVL target.")
  pmax(0, target)
}

prepare_scenario_context <- function(scenario) {
  validate_scenario(scenario)

  removed_cfr <- intersect(
    active_fleet$active_cfr,
    scenario$permanent_cessation_cfr
  )

  retained_vessels <- active_fleet$vessel_profile %>%
    dplyr::filter(!.data$CFR %in% removed_cfr)

  if (nrow(retained_vessels) == 0L) {
    return(list(
      feasible = FALSE,
      scenario = scenario,
      issue = "permanent_cessation_removed_the_entire_fleet"
    ))
  }

  non_vms_reference <- prepare_non_vms_reference(
    non_vms_inputs,
    historical_years,
    retained_vessels$CFR
  )

  catch_quota_context <- build_catch_quota_limits(
    scenario,
    non_vms_reference
  )
  if (!isTRUE(catch_quota_context$feasible) ||
      (!is.na(catch_quota_context$issue) &&
       nzchar(catch_quota_context$issue))) {
    return(list(
      feasible = FALSE,
      scenario = scenario,
      issue = catch_quota_context$issue,
      diagnostic = catch_quota_context$fixed_audit,
      catch_quota_audit = catch_quota_context$fixed_audit
    ))
  }

  quota_species_coverage <- tibble::tibble(
    Species = sort(unique(catch_quota_context$limits$Species))
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      activity_supported = smart31_quota_species_code(.data$Species) %in% unique(lpue_reference$Species),
      fixed_non_vms_supported =
        smart31_quota_species_code(.data$Species) %in% unique(non_vms_reference$Species),
      represented = .data$activity_supported |
        .data$fixed_non_vms_supported
    )
  missing_quota_species <- quota_species_coverage %>%
    dplyr::filter(!.data$represented)
  if (nrow(missing_quota_species) > 0L) {
    return(list(
      feasible = FALSE,
      scenario = scenario,
      issue = "catch_quota_species_not_represented_in_catch_model",
      diagnostic = missing_quota_species,
      catch_quota_audit = missing_quota_species
    ))
  }

  retained_patterns <- pattern_keys %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$CFR %in% retained_vessels$CFR)

  allowed_candidates <- candidate_cells_reference %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$CFR %in% retained_vessels$CFR) %>%
    filter_closed_cells(scenario$closures)

  allowed_pattern_ids <- unique(allowed_candidates$pattern_id)

  allowed_gear_keys <- allowed_candidates %>%
    dplyr::distinct(.data$CFR, .data$MONTH, .data$Gear)

  allocation <- smart31_prepare_working_allocation(scenario, retained_vessels, allowed_gear_keys)
  if (!isTRUE(allocation$feasible)) {
    return(list(feasible = FALSE, scenario = scenario, issue = allocation$issue,
      diagnostic = allocation$diagnostic, day_allocations = allocation$day_allocations %||% NULL,
      effort_quota_audit = allocation$effort_quota_audit %||% NULL))
  }
  gear_day_reference <- allocation$gear
  day_allocations <- allocation$days
  cm_allocation_audit <- allocation$cm
  effort_quota_check <- allocation$quota_check

  allowed_candidates <- allowed_candidates %>% dplyr::semi_join(gear_day_reference %>%
    dplyr::select(.data$CFR, .data$MONTH, .data$Gear), by = c("CFR", "MONTH", "Gear"))
  allowed_pattern_ids <- unique(allowed_candidates$pattern_id)

  metier_shares <- activity_reference %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$CFR %in% retained_vessels$CFR,
      .data$pattern_id %in% allowed_pattern_ids
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$CFR, .data$MONTH, .data$Gear, .data$Metier) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      metier_fishing_time = sum(.data$fishing_time_reference),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$CFR, .data$MONTH, .data$Gear) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      metier_share = normalise_positive(.data$metier_fishing_time),
      pattern_id = make_pattern_id(
        .data$CFR, .data$MONTH, .data$Gear, .data$Metier
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  metier_share_check <- metier_shares %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$CFR, .data$MONTH, .data$Gear) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      share_sum = sum(.data$metier_share),
      invalid_share = any(
        !is.finite(.data$metier_share) |
          .data$metier_share < 0 |
          .data$metier_share > 1
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$invalid_share |
        !is.finite(.data$share_sum) |
        abs(.data$share_sum - 1) > 1e-10
    )

  if (nrow(metier_share_check) > 0L) {
    smart31_stop(
      nrow(metier_share_check),
      " vessel-month-Gear groups have invalid Metier shares."
    )
  }

  original_gear_days <- .smart31_initial$original_time %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$CFR, .data$Gear) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(original_annual_days = sum(.data$days_reference), .groups = "drop")
  scenario_gear_days <- gear_day_reference %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$CFR, .data$Gear) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(scenario_active_days = sum(.data$days_scenario_gear), .groups = "drop")
  other_gvl_monthly <- gear_day_reference %>%
    dplyr::select(.data$CFR, .data$MONTH, .data$Gear, .data$days_scenario_gear) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(vessel_other_gvl_reference, by = c("CFR", "Gear"), relationship = "many-to-one") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(original_gear_days, by = c("CFR", "Gear"), relationship = "many-to-one") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(scenario_gear_days, by = c("CFR", "Gear"), relationship = "many-to-one") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      other_gvl_activity_ratio = dplyr::if_else(.data$original_annual_days > 0,
        .data$scenario_active_days / .data$original_annual_days, 0),
      GVL_other_target_annual = smart31_other_gvl_other_gvl_target(
        .data$GVL_other_reference_annual, .data$scenario_active_days, .data$original_annual_days),
      other_GVL_eur_per_day = dplyr::if_else(.data$scenario_active_days > 0,
        .data$GVL_other_target_annual / .data$scenario_active_days, 0),
      GVL_other_reference_month = .data$other_GVL_eur_per_day * .data$days_scenario_gear,
      other_gvl_mode = cfg$other_gvl_mode,
      other_gvl_beta = cfg$other_gvl_beta
    )
  if (any(!is.finite(other_gvl_monthly$GVL_other_reference_month)) ||
      any(!is.finite(other_gvl_monthly$GVL_other_target_annual)))
    stop("Scenario non-modelled-species GVL contains non-finite values.")

  scenario_candidates <- allowed_candidates %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$pattern_id %in% metier_shares$pattern_id
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      metier_shares %>%
        dplyr::select(.data$pattern_id, .data$metier_share),
      by = "pattern_id",
      relationship = "many-to-one"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      gear_day_reference %>%
        dplyr::select(
          .data$CFR, .data$MONTH, .data$Gear,
          .data$scenario_trips
        ),
      by = c("CFR", "MONTH", "Gear"),
      relationship = "many-to-one"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$pattern_id) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      initial_share = if (sum(.data$own_share) > 0) {
        .data$own_share / sum(.data$own_share)
      } else {
        normalise_positive(.data$peer_share)
      },
      peer_share = normalise_positive(.data$peer_share),
      posterior_alpha = .data$effective_trip_count +
        scenario$parameters$bayesian_prior_strength * .data$peer_share +
        scenario$parameters$minimum_dirichlet_alpha,
      allocation_units = pmax(
        1L,
        as.integer(round(.data$scenario_trips * .data$metier_share))
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%

    dplyr::select(-dplyr::all_of("scenario_trips")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      unit_id = make_unit_id(.data$CFR, .data$MONTH)
    )

  scenario_rate_build <- build_scenario_cell_rates(
    scenario_candidates,
    scenario,
    unique(catch_quota_context$limits$Species)
  )
  if (isTRUE(cfg$enforce_fmsy) &&
      identical(scenario$representative_period, .smart31_case$periods$future) &&
      !all(unique(fmsy_catch_limits$Species) %in% scenario_rate_build$catch_species)) {
    smart31_stop("FMSY constraint species absent from the Step 2 catch surface.")
  }
  scenario_candidates <- scenario_rate_build$candidates
  scenario_revenue_rate <- scenario_rate_build$revenue_rate
  scenario_catch_rate <- scenario_rate_build$catch_rate
  scenario_quota_rate <- scenario_rate_build$quota_rate
  scenario_catch_species <- scenario_rate_build$catch_species
  scenario_quota_species <- scenario_rate_build$quota_species
  scenario_rate_build <- NULL

  diagnostic_species <- sort(unique(c(
    scenario_catch_species,
    as.character(non_vms_reference$Species)
  )))
  fixed_non_vms_species_catch <- stats::setNames(
    numeric(length(diagnostic_species)),
    diagnostic_species
  )
  if (length(diagnostic_species) > 0L && nrow(non_vms_reference) > 0L) {
    fixed_species_table <- non_vms_reference %>%
      dplyr::group_by(.data$Species) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(catch_kg = sum(.data$W), .groups = "drop")
    fixed_non_vms_species_catch[fixed_species_table$Species] <-
      fixed_species_table$catch_kg
  }

  kernel_columns <- c(
    "unit_id", "pattern_id", "CFR", "MONTH", "Gear", "Metier",
    "harbour", "loa", "id_grid", "GSA_code", "depth_m",
    "distance_km", "metier_share", "initial_share", "peer_share",
    "posterior_alpha", "allocation_units", "cell_rate_id"
  )
  missing_kernel_columns <- setdiff(
    kernel_columns,
    names(scenario_candidates)
  )
  if (length(missing_kernel_columns) > 0L) {
    smart31_stop(
      "The search kernel is missing column(s): ",
      paste(missing_kernel_columns, collapse = ", "), "."
    )
  }
  scenario_candidates <- scenario_candidates %>%
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(kernel_columns)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      .data$unit_id, .data$pattern_id,
      .data$Gear, .data$Metier, .data$id_grid
    )

  candidate_by_unit <- split(
    scenario_candidates,
    scenario_candidates$unit_id
  )
  scenario_candidates <- NULL
  unit_kernels <- lapply(candidate_by_unit, build_unit_kernel)
  candidate_by_unit <- NULL
  invisible(gc(verbose = FALSE))

  gear_search_static <- gear_day_reference %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      other_gvl_monthly %>%
        dplyr::select(
          .data$CFR, .data$MONTH, .data$Gear,
          .data$GVL_other_reference_month
        ),
      by = c("CFR", "MONTH", "Gear"),
      relationship = "one-to-one"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      economic_rates_reference,
      by = c("CFR", "Gear"),
      relationship = "many-to-one"
    )

  required_search_values <- c(
    "days_scenario_gear", "scenario_trips",
    "fishing_time_reference_scenario",
    "steaming_time_reference_scenario",
    "fishing_time_elasticity", "fishing_fuel_l_per_h",
    "steaming_fuel_l_per_h", "GVL_other_reference_month",
    "EC_share", "OC_share", "LC_share"
  )
  if (any(!is.finite(as.matrix(
        gear_search_static[required_search_values]
      )))) {
    smart31_stop(
      "The memory-safe search kernel has incomplete Gear-level inputs."
    )
  }

  gear_search_by_unit <- split(
    gear_search_static,
    gear_search_static$unit_id
  )

  reference_occupancy <- .smart31_initial$historical_occupancy

  observed_effort <- reference_occupancy$effort
  if (!length(observed_effort) || any(!is.finite(observed_effort)) || any(observed_effort < 0))
    smart31_stop("Invalid historical crowding distribution.")
  crowding_statistic_value <- if (cfg$crowding_statistic == "quantile") {
    stats::quantile(observed_effort, probs = cfg$crowding_probability,
                    names = FALSE, type = 7, na.rm = FALSE)
  } else max(observed_effort)
  crowding_limit <- scenario$parameters$crowding_factor * crowding_statistic_value

  if (!is.finite(crowding_limit) || crowding_limit <= 0) {
    smart31_stop("Unable to calculate a positive global crowding limit.")
  }

  list(
    feasible = TRUE,
    scenario = scenario,
    retained_vessels = retained_vessels,
    removed_cfr = removed_cfr,
    day_allocations = day_allocations,
    cm_allocation_audit = cm_allocation_audit,
    effort_quota_audit = effort_quota_check$audit,
    effort_quota_assignments = effort_quota_check$assignments,
    gear_time = gear_day_reference,
    metier_shares = metier_shares,
    unit_kernels = unit_kernels,
    gear_search_by_unit = gear_search_by_unit,
    revenue_rate = scenario_revenue_rate,
    catch_rate = scenario_catch_rate,
    quota_rate = scenario_quota_rate,
    catch_species = scenario_catch_species,
    diagnostic_species = diagnostic_species,
    fixed_non_vms_species_catch = fixed_non_vms_species_catch,
    quota_species = scenario_quota_species,
    catch_quota_limits = catch_quota_context$limits,
    catch_quota_reporting_limits = catch_quota_context$reporting_limits,
    ordinary_catch_quotas_enforced = .smart31_case$management$enforce_catch_quotas,
    fixed_non_vms_quota_catch = catch_quota_context$fixed_non_vms,
    catch_quota_fixed_audit = catch_quota_context$fixed_audit,
    catch_quota_species_coverage = quota_species_coverage,
    other_gvl_monthly = other_gvl_monthly,
    crowding_limit = crowding_limit,
    reference_occupancy = reference_occupancy,
    economic_reference = economic_reference %>%
      dplyr::filter(.data$CFR %in% retained_vessels$CFR),
    cessation_reference = economic_reference %>%
      dplyr::filter(.data$CFR %in% removed_cfr),
    non_vms_reference = non_vms_reference,
    fuel_price = fuel_price_reference *
      scenario$parameters$fuel_price_multiplier,
    steaming_speed_kmh = steaming_speed_reference,
    working_baseline_controls = .smart31_initial$controls
  )
}
```

## Physical and economic evaluator

```{r step2-17-physical-and-economic-evaluator}

evaluate_vessel_month_full <- function(state_unit, unit_id, context) {
  scenario <- context$scenario
  parameter <- scenario$parameters

  unit_time <- context$gear_time %>%

    dplyr::filter(.data$unit_id == .env$unit_id)

  extra_days <- smart31_extra_days(state_unit$share)
  cap <- context$cm_capacity[[unit_id]]
  if (is.null(cap) || extra_days > cap + 1e-8) return(list(valid = FALSE, issue = "CM_capacity_exceeded"))
  unit_time <- smart31_scale_unit_time(unit_time, extra_days)

  if (nrow(unit_time) == 0L ||
      sum(unit_time$days_scenario_gear) <= 0) {
    return(list(
      valid = TRUE,
      unit_id = unit_id,
      activity = tibble::tibble(),
      catches = tibble::tibble(),
      economic = tibble::tibble(
        unit_id = unit_id,
        CFR = sub("::.*$", "", unit_id),
        MONTH = as.integer(sub("^.*::", "", unit_id)),
        days_at_sea = 0,
        trips = 0,
        fishing_time = 0,
        steaming_time = 0,
        steaming_distance_km = 0,
        mean_distance_km = 0,
        W = 0,
        GVL_6sp = 0,
        GVL_other_reference = 0,
        GVL = 0,
        EC = 0,
        fuel_fishing_l = 0, fuel_steaming_l = 0,
        EC_fishing = 0, EC_steaming = 0,
        OC = 0,
        LC = 0,
        GVA = 0,
        GP = 0
      ),
      occupancy = tibble::tibble(),
      catch_kg = stats::setNames(
        numeric(length(context$catch_species)),
        context$catch_species
      ),
      quota_catch_kg = stats::setNames(
        numeric(length(context$quota_species)),
        context$quota_species
      )
    ))
  }

  required_state_columns <- c(
    "pattern_id", "CFR", "MONTH", "Gear", "Metier",
    "id_grid", "loa", "distance_km", "metier_share",
    "initial_share", "share"
  )
  missing_state_columns <- setdiff(required_state_columns, names(state_unit))

  if (length(missing_state_columns) > 0L) {
    return(list(
      valid = FALSE,
      issue = paste0(
        "spatial_state_missing_columns:",
        paste(missing_state_columns, collapse = ",")
      )
    ))
  }

  state_checked <- state_unit %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$pattern_id) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(share = normalise_positive(.data$share)) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  activity_weights <- state_checked %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      combined_share = .data$metier_share * .data$share,
      baseline_combined_share =
        .data$metier_share * .data$initial_share
    )

  invalid_weights <- activity_weights %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.finite(.data$combined_share) |
        .data$combined_share < 0 |
        !is.finite(.data$baseline_combined_share) |
        .data$baseline_combined_share < 0 |
        !is.finite(.data$distance_km) |
        .data$distance_km < 0
    )

  if (nrow(invalid_weights) > 0L) {
    return(list(valid = FALSE, issue = "invalid_activity_weights"))
  }

  clock <- smart31_working_clock(activity_weights, unit_time, activity_weights$combined_share, context)
  if (!isTRUE(clock$valid)) return(clock)
  gear_time <- unit_time
  gear_time$mean_distance_km <- clock$mean_distance
  gear_time$fishing_time_scenario <- clock$fishing
  gear_time$steaming_time_scenario <- clock$steaming
  activity <- activity_weights %>%
    dplyr::left_join(gear_time %>% dplyr::select(.data$CFR, .data$MONTH, .data$Gear,
      .data$days_scenario_gear, .data$scenario_trips, .data$fishing_time_scenario,
      .data$steaming_time_scenario, .data$mean_distance_km),
      by = c("CFR", "MONTH", "Gear"), relationship = "many-to-one")
  activity$days_at_sea <- activity$days_scenario_gear * activity$combined_share
  activity$trips <- clock$row_trips
  activity$fishing_time <- clock$row_fishing
  activity$steaming_time <- clock$row_steaming
  activity$effort <- activity$loa * activity$fishing_time
  activity$trip_duration_h <- clock$trip_duration
  activity$fishing_h_per_trip <- clock$fishing_h_per_trip
  activity$navigation_h_per_trip <- clock$navigation_h_per_trip
  activity$navigation_fraction <- clock$navigation_fraction
  activity$trip_reserved_h <- ifelse(activity$trips > 1e-12, context$working_baseline_controls$trip_reserved_hours, 0)

  activity_reconciliation <- activity %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$CFR, .data$MONTH, .data$Gear) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      days_from_cells = sum(.data$days_at_sea),
      trips_from_cells = sum(.data$trips),
      fishing_from_cells = sum(.data$fishing_time),
      steaming_from_cells = sum(.data$steaming_time),
      expected_days = one_value(
        .data$days_scenario_gear,
        "gear scenario days"
      ),
      expected_trips = one_value(.data$scenario_trips, "gear trips"),
      expected_fishing = one_value(
        .data$fishing_time_scenario,
        "gear fishing time"
      ),
      expected_steaming = one_value(
        .data$steaming_time_scenario,
        "gear steaming time"
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  activity_reconciliation_ok <- with(
    activity_reconciliation,
    abs(days_from_cells - expected_days) <=
      1e-8 * pmax(1, abs(expected_days)) &
      abs(trips_from_cells - expected_trips) <=
      1e-8 * pmax(1, abs(expected_trips)) &
      abs(fishing_from_cells - expected_fishing) <=
      1e-8 * pmax(1, abs(expected_fishing)) &
      abs(steaming_from_cells - expected_steaming) <=
      1e-8 * pmax(1, abs(expected_steaming))
  )

  if (anyNA(activity_reconciliation_ok) ||
      !all(activity_reconciliation_ok)) {
    return(list(
      valid = FALSE,
      issue = "spatial_activity_does_not_reconcile_to_gear_totals"
    ))
  }

  catches <- activity %>%
    dplyr::select(
      .data$CFR, .data$MONTH, .data$Gear, .data$Metier,
      .data$id_grid, .data$GSA_code, .data$fishing_time, .data$effort
    ) %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(
      lpue_reference,
      by = c("MONTH", "GSA_code", "Gear", "id_grid"),
      relationship = "many-to-many"
    ) %>%
    apply_selectivity_rules(scenario$selectivity_rules) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      lpue_scenario = .data$lpue_reference *
        .data$selectivity_multiplier,
      W = .data$effort * .data$lpue_scenario
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      price_reference,
      by = c("Species", "GSA_code" = "GSA"),
      relationship = "many-to-one"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      price_scenario = .data$price_reference *
        parameter$landing_price_multiplier,
      GVL = .data$W * .data$price_scenario
    )

  if (nrow(catches) > 0L &&
      (any(!is.finite(catches$W)) ||
       any(catches$W < 0) ||
       any(!is.finite(catches$GVL)) ||
       any(catches$GVL < 0))) {
    return(list(valid = FALSE, issue = "invalid_catches_or_prices"))
  }

  gvl_by_gear <- catches %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$CFR, .data$MONTH, .data$Gear) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      W = sum(.data$W),
      GVL_6sp = sum(.data$GVL),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  full_base_days <- sum(context$gear_time$days_scenario_gear[
    context$gear_time$unit_id == unit_id])
  if (!is.finite(full_base_days) || full_base_days <= 0)
    return(list(valid = FALSE, issue = "invalid_other_revenue_day_basis"))
  full_day_ratio <- sum(unit_time$days_scenario_gear) / full_base_days
  full_other_monthly <- context$other_gvl_monthly %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$CFR == .env$unit_time$CFR[[1L]],
                  .data$MONTH == .env$unit_time$MONTH[[1L]])
  if (identical(cfg$other_gvl_mode, "per_day_reference"))
    full_other_monthly <- full_other_monthly %>%
      dplyr::mutate(GVL_other_reference_month = .data$GVL_other_reference_month * .env$full_day_ratio)

  gear_economic <- gear_time %>%
    dplyr::select(
      .data$CFR, .data$MONTH, .data$Gear,
      .data$days_scenario_gear,
      trips = .data$scenario_trips,
      mean_distance_km = .data$mean_distance_km,
      fishing_time = .data$fishing_time_scenario,
      steaming_time = .data$steaming_time_scenario,
      .data$fishing_fuel_l_per_h,
      .data$steaming_fuel_l_per_h
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      gvl_by_gear,
      by = c("CFR", "MONTH", "Gear"),
      relationship = "one-to-one"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      full_other_monthly %>%
        dplyr::select(
          .data$CFR, .data$MONTH, .data$Gear,
          .data$GVL_other_reference_month
        ),
      by = c("CFR", "MONTH", "Gear"),
      relationship = "one-to-one"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      economic_rates_reference,
      by = c("CFR", "Gear"),
      relationship = "many-to-one"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      W = dplyr::coalesce(.data$W, 0),
      GVL_6sp = dplyr::coalesce(.data$GVL_6sp, 0),
      GVL_other_reference = dplyr::coalesce(
        .data$GVL_other_reference_month,
        0
      ),
      GVL = .data$GVL_6sp + .data$GVL_other_reference,
      physical_fuel_model_available =
        is.finite(.data$fishing_fuel_l_per_h) &
        .data$fishing_fuel_l_per_h > 0 &
        is.finite(.data$steaming_fuel_l_per_h) &
        .data$steaming_fuel_l_per_h > 0,
      fuel_fishing_l = .data$fishing_fuel_l_per_h * .data$fishing_time,
      fuel_steaming_l = .data$steaming_fuel_l_per_h * .data$steaming_time,
      EC_fishing = .data$fuel_fishing_l * context$fuel_price,
      EC_steaming = .data$fuel_steaming_l * context$fuel_price,
      FC = dplyr::if_else(
        .data$physical_fuel_model_available,
        .data$fishing_fuel_l_per_h * .data$fishing_time +
          .data$steaming_fuel_l_per_h * .data$steaming_time,
        NA_real_
      ),
      steaming_distance_km = 2 * .data$trips * .data$mean_distance_km,
      EC = dplyr::if_else(
        .data$physical_fuel_model_available,
        .data$FC * context$fuel_price,
        .data$GVL * .data$EC_share
      ),
      OC = .data$GVL * .data$OC_share,
      LC = .data$GVL * .data$LC_share,
      GVA = .data$GVL - .data$EC - .data$OC,
      GP = .data$GVA - .data$LC
    )

  if (!all(gear_economic$physical_fuel_model_available)) {
    return(list(valid = FALSE, issue = "missing_physical_fuel_rates"))
  }
  required_economic_values <- c(
    "days_scenario_gear", "trips", "mean_distance_km",
    "fishing_time", "steaming_time", "steaming_distance_km",
    "GVL_6sp", "GVL_other_reference", "GVL",
    "EC", "OC", "LC", "GVA", "GP"
  )

  if (any(!is.finite(as.matrix(
    gear_economic[required_economic_values]
  )))) {
    return(list(valid = FALSE, issue = "incomplete_economic_evaluation"))
  }

  unit_economic <- gear_economic %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      CFR = one_value(.data$CFR, "CFR"),
      MONTH = one_value(.data$MONTH, "MONTH"),
      days_at_sea = sum(.data$days_scenario_gear),
      trips = sum(.data$trips),
      fishing_time = sum(.data$fishing_time),
      steaming_time = sum(.data$steaming_time),
      steaming_distance_km = sum(.data$steaming_distance_km),
      mean_distance_km = dplyr::if_else(
        sum(.data$trips) > 0,
        sum(.data$steaming_distance_km) / (2 * sum(.data$trips)),
        0
      ),
      W = sum(.data$W),
      GVL_6sp = sum(.data$GVL_6sp),
      GVL_other_reference = sum(.data$GVL_other_reference),
      GVL = sum(.data$GVL),
      EC = sum(.data$EC),
      fuel_fishing_l = sum(.data$fuel_fishing_l),
      fuel_steaming_l = sum(.data$fuel_steaming_l),
      EC_fishing = sum(.data$EC_fishing),
      EC_steaming = sum(.data$EC_steaming),
      OC = sum(.data$OC),
      LC = sum(.data$LC),
      GVA = sum(.data$GVA),
      GP = sum(.data$GP)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(unit_id = .env$unit_id, .before = 1)

  unit_catch_kg <- stats::setNames(
    numeric(length(context$catch_species)),
    context$catch_species
  )
  if (length(unit_catch_kg) > 0L && nrow(catches) > 0L) {
    catch_table <- catches %>%
      dplyr::group_by(.data$Species) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(catch_kg = sum(.data$W), .groups = "drop")
    represented <- intersect(catch_table$Species, names(unit_catch_kg))
    unit_catch_kg[represented] <- catch_table$catch_kg[
      match(represented, catch_table$Species)
    ]
  }
  unit_quota_catch_kg <- smart31_quota_catches(catches, context$quota_species)

  occupancy <- activity %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$MONTH, .data$id_grid) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      effort = sum(.data$effort),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  list(
    valid = TRUE,
    unit_id = unit_id,
    activity = activity %>%
      dplyr::filter(.data$effort > 1e-12 | .data$days_at_sea > 1e-12),
    catches = catches %>%
      dplyr::filter(.data$W > 1e-12),
    gear_economic = gear_economic,
    economic = unit_economic,
    occupancy = occupancy,
    catch_kg = unit_catch_kg,
    quota_catch_kg = unit_quota_catch_kg
  )
}

evaluate_vessel_month_light <- function(share, unit_id, context) {
  kernel <- context$unit_kernels[[unit_id]]
  gear_time <- context$gear_search_by_unit[[unit_id]]

  if (is.null(kernel) || is.null(gear_time) ||
      length(share) != nrow(kernel$data)) {
    return(list(valid = FALSE, issue = "invalid_lightweight_unit_state"))
  }

  extra_days <- smart31_extra_days(share)
  cap <- context$cm_capacity[[unit_id]]
  if (is.null(cap) || extra_days > cap + 1e-8) return(list(valid = FALSE, issue = "CM_capacity_exceeded"))
  gear_time <- smart31_scale_unit_time(gear_time, extra_days)
  data <- kernel$data
  normalised_share <- numeric(length(share))
  for (rows in kernel$pattern_rows) {
    normalised_share[rows] <- normalise_positive(share[rows])
  }

  combined_share <- as.numeric(data$metier_share) * normalised_share
  if (any(!is.finite(combined_share)) || any(combined_share < 0)) {
    return(list(valid = FALSE, issue = "invalid_lightweight_activity_share"))
  }

  clock <- smart31_working_clock(data, gear_time, combined_share, context)
  if (!isTRUE(clock$valid)) return(clock)
  fishing_time <- clock$fishing
  steaming_time <- clock$steaming
  gear_distance <- clock$mean_distance
  row_fishing_time <- clock$row_fishing
  row_effort <- as.numeric(data$loa) * row_fishing_time
  if (any(!is.finite(row_effort)) || any(row_effort < 0)) {
    return(list(valid = FALSE, issue = "invalid_lightweight_effort"))
  }

  occupancy_values <- rowsum(
    matrix(row_effort, ncol = 1L),
    group = as.character(data$id_grid),
    reorder = FALSE
  )[, 1L]
  occupancy <- tibble::tibble(
    MONTH = as.integer(data$MONTH[[1L]]),
    id_grid = names(occupancy_values),
    effort = as.numeric(occupancy_values)
  ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$effort > 1e-12)

  revenue_rate <- context$revenue_rate[data$cell_rate_id]
  row_gvl <- row_effort * revenue_rate
  gvl_6sp <- rowsum(
    matrix(row_gvl, ncol = 1L),
    group = as.character(data$Gear),
    reorder = FALSE
  )[, 1L]
  gvl_6sp <- unname(gvl_6sp[gear_time$Gear])
  gvl_6sp[is.na(gvl_6sp)] <- 0

  species_catch_kg <- stats::setNames(
    numeric(length(context$catch_species)),
    context$catch_species
  )
  if (length(species_catch_kg) > 0L) {
    catch_rate <- context$catch_rate[
      data$cell_rate_id,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
    species_catch_kg <- stats::setNames(
      colSums(catch_rate * row_effort),
      context$catch_species
    )
  }

  quota_catch <- smart31_quota_exposure(context, data$cell_rate_id, row_effort)

  gvl <- gvl_6sp + gear_time$GVL_other_reference_month
  physical_fuel <- is.finite(gear_time$fishing_fuel_l_per_h) &
    gear_time$fishing_fuel_l_per_h > 0 & is.finite(gear_time$steaming_fuel_l_per_h) &
    gear_time$steaming_fuel_l_per_h > 0
  if (!all(physical_fuel)) return(list(valid = FALSE, issue = "missing_physical_fuel_rates"))
  fuel_l <- ifelse(
    physical_fuel,
    gear_time$fishing_fuel_l_per_h * fishing_time +
      gear_time$steaming_fuel_l_per_h * steaming_time,
    NA_real_
  )
  energy_cost <- ifelse(
    physical_fuel,
    fuel_l * context$fuel_price,
    gvl * gear_time$EC_share
  )
  operating_cost <- gvl * gear_time$OC_share
  labour_cost <- gvl * gear_time$LC_share
  gva <- gvl - energy_cost - operating_cost
  gross_profit <- gva - labour_cost
  steaming_distance_km <- sum(
    2 * gear_time$scenario_trips * gear_distance
  )
  total_trips <- sum(gear_time$scenario_trips)
  mean_distance_km <- if (total_trips > 0) {
    steaming_distance_km / (2 * total_trips)
  } else {
    0
  }

  if (any(!is.finite(c(
        gvl, energy_cost, operating_cost, labour_cost, gva, gross_profit
      )))) {
    return(list(valid = FALSE, issue = "invalid_lightweight_economics"))
  }

  fuel_fishing_by_gear <- gear_time$fishing_fuel_l_per_h * fishing_time
  fuel_steaming_by_gear <- gear_time$steaming_fuel_l_per_h * steaming_time

  list(
    valid = TRUE,
    unit_id = unit_id,
    economic = tibble::tibble(
      unit_id = unit_id,
      CFR = as.character(data$CFR[[1L]]),
      MONTH = as.integer(data$MONTH[[1L]]),
      days_at_sea = sum(gear_time$days_scenario_gear),
      maximum_trip_duration_h = max(c(0, clock$trip_duration)),
      maximum_navigation_fraction = max(c(0, clock$navigation_fraction)),
      trips = total_trips,
      fishing_time = sum(fishing_time),
      steaming_time = sum(steaming_time),
      steaming_distance_km = steaming_distance_km,
      mean_distance_km = mean_distance_km,
      GVL_6sp = sum(gvl_6sp),
      GVL_other_reference = sum(gear_time$GVL_other_reference_month),
      GVL = sum(gvl),
      EC = sum(energy_cost),
      fuel_fishing_l = sum(fuel_fishing_by_gear),
      fuel_steaming_l = sum(fuel_steaming_by_gear),
      EC_fishing = sum(fuel_fishing_by_gear * context$fuel_price),
      EC_steaming = sum(fuel_steaming_by_gear * context$fuel_price),
      OC = sum(operating_cost),
      LC = sum(labour_cost),
      GVA = sum(gva),
      GP = sum(gross_profit)
    ),
    occupancy = occupancy,
    catch_kg = species_catch_kg,
    quota_catch_kg = quota_catch,

    coupled_row_effort = if (isTRUE(context$v52$enabled)) row_effort else NULL,
    local_occupancy = smart31_sum_named(row_effort, kernel$local_key),
    gear_fishing_hours = stats::setNames(fishing_time, gear_time$Gear),
    effort_quota_days = smart31_effort_quota_vector(gear_time, context)
  )
}

catch_quota_audit <- function(catch_index, limits) {
  if (nrow(limits) == 0L) {
    return(tibble::tibble())
  }
  limits %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      simulated_catch_kg = unname(catch_index[.data$Species]),
      simulated_catch_kg = dplyr::coalesce(.data$simulated_catch_kg, 0),
      remaining_quota_kg = .data$quota_kg - .data$simulated_catch_kg,
      quota_use_fraction = dplyr::if_else(
        .data$quota_kg > 0,
        .data$simulated_catch_kg / .data$quota_kg,
        dplyr::if_else(.data$simulated_catch_kg == 0, 0, Inf)
      ),
      compatible = .data$simulated_catch_kg <=
        .data$quota_kg * (1 + quota_tolerance_fraction) +
        sqrt(.Machine$double.eps)
    )
}

catch_quota_is_feasible <- function(catch_index, limits) {
  audit <- catch_quota_audit(catch_index, limits)
  nrow(audit) == 0L || all(audit$compatible)
}

catch_quota_violation_score <- function(catch_index, limits) {
  audit <- catch_quota_audit(catch_index, limits)
  if (nrow(audit) == 0L) return(0)
  sum((pmax(audit$simulated_catch_kg - audit$quota_kg * (1 + quota_tolerance_fraction) - 1e-8, 0) /
    pmax(1, audit$quota_kg))^2)
}

replace_unit_quota_catch <- function(
  total_catch,
  old_unit_catch,
  new_unit_catch
) {
  output <- total_catch
  species <- union(names(old_unit_catch), names(new_unit_catch))
  if (length(species) == 0L) return(output)
  old <- old_unit_catch[species]
  new <- new_unit_catch[species]
  old[is.na(old)] <- 0
  new[is.na(new)] <- 0
  output[species] <- output[species] - old + new
  output[abs(output) <= 1e-10] <- 0
  if (any(!is.finite(output)) || any(output < -1e-8)) {
    smart31_stop("Incremental catch-quota accounting became invalid.")
  }
  output
}

validate_light_evaluator_once <- function(share, unit_id, context, light) {
  if (!validate_acceleration_first_batch ||
      isTRUE(.smart31_acceleration$light_evaluator_validated) ||
      !isTRUE(light$valid)) {
    return(invisible(TRUE))
  }

  full_state <- context$unit_kernels[[unit_id]]$data
  full_state$share <- share
  full <- evaluate_vessel_month_full(full_state, unit_id, context)

  full_quota_catch <- full$quota_catch_kg %||% stats::setNames(
    numeric(length(context$quota_species)),
    context$quota_species
  )

  diagnostic_economic_fields <- c(
    "days_at_sea", "trips", "fishing_time", "steaming_time",
    "steaming_distance_km", "mean_distance_km",
    "GVL_6sp", "GVL_other_reference", "GVL",
    "EC", "OC", "LC", "GVA", "GP"
  )
  economic_equivalent <- isTRUE(full$valid) && isTRUE(all.equal(
    unlist(full$economic[diagnostic_economic_fields], use.names = TRUE),
    unlist(light$economic[diagnostic_economic_fields], use.names = TRUE),
    tolerance = 1e-8
  ))
  catch_equivalent <- isTRUE(all.equal(
    full_quota_catch,
    light$quota_catch_kg,
    tolerance = 1e-8,
    check.attributes = TRUE
  ))
  species_catch_equivalent <- isTRUE(full$valid) && isTRUE(all.equal(
    full$catch_kg,
    light$catch_kg,
    tolerance = 1e-8,
    check.attributes = TRUE
  ))
  occupancy_equivalent <- isTRUE(full$valid) &&
    occupancy_tables_equivalent(full$occupancy, light$occupancy)

  if (!economic_equivalent || !catch_equivalent ||
      !species_catch_equivalent || !occupancy_equivalent) {
    smart31_stop(
      "The lightweight search evaluator failed equivalence against the ",
      "complete scientific evaluator."
    )
  }

  .smart31_acceleration$light_evaluator_validated <- TRUE
  invisible(TRUE)
}

combine_occupancy <- function(evaluations) {
  purrr::map_dfr(evaluations, "occupancy") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$MONTH, .data$id_grid) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(effort = sum(.data$effort), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(.data$MONTH, .data$id_grid)
}

occupancy_violation_score <- function(occupancy, crowding_limit) {
  if (nrow(occupancy) == 0L) {
    return(0)
  }
  sum(pmax(occupancy$effort - crowding_limit, 0)^2)
}

occupancy_relative_violation_score <- function(
  occupancy,
  crowding_limit
) {
  if (nrow(occupancy) == 0L) return(0)
  sum(pmax(occupancy$effort / crowding_limit - 1, 0)^2)
}

replace_unit_occupancy_legacy <- function(
  total_occupancy,
  old_unit_occupancy,
  new_unit_occupancy
) {
  dplyr::bind_rows(
    total_occupancy %>%
      dplyr::mutate(component = "total"),
    old_unit_occupancy %>%
      dplyr::mutate(component = "old"),
    new_unit_occupancy %>%
      dplyr::mutate(component = "new")
  ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$MONTH, .data$id_grid) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      effort = sum(dplyr::case_when(
        .data$component == "total" ~ .data$effort,
        .data$component == "old" ~ -.data$effort,
        .data$component == "new" ~ .data$effort,
        TRUE ~ 0
      )),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$effort > 1e-12)
}

occupancy_key <- function(month, id_grid) {
  paste(as.integer(month), as.character(id_grid), sep = "\u001f")
}

build_occupancy_index <- function(occupancy) {
  if (nrow(occupancy) == 0L) {
    return(stats::setNames(numeric(), character()))
  }

  key <- occupancy_key(occupancy$MONTH, occupancy$id_grid)
  if (anyDuplicated(key)) {
    smart31_stop("Fleet occupancy is not unique by MONTH and id_grid.")
  }

  stats::setNames(as.numeric(occupancy$effort), key)
}

prepare_incremental_occupancy_update <- function(
  occupancy_index,
  old_unit_occupancy,
  new_unit_occupancy
) {
  old_component <- old_unit_occupancy %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      MONTH = as.integer(.data$MONTH),
      id_grid = as.character(.data$id_grid),
      old_effort = as.numeric(.data$effort)
    )

  new_component <- new_unit_occupancy %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      MONTH = as.integer(.data$MONTH),
      id_grid = as.character(.data$id_grid),
      new_effort = as.numeric(.data$effort)
    )

  if (anyDuplicated(occupancy_key(
        old_component$MONTH,
        old_component$id_grid
      )) ||
      anyDuplicated(occupancy_key(
        new_component$MONTH,
        new_component$id_grid
      ))) {
    smart31_stop(
      "A vessel-month occupancy component is not unique by MONTH and id_grid."
    )
  }

  changed <- dplyr::full_join(
    old_component,
    new_component,
    by = c("MONTH", "id_grid"),
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      old_effort = dplyr::coalesce(.data$old_effort, 0),
      new_effort = dplyr::coalesce(.data$new_effort, 0),
      occupancy_key = .env$occupancy_key(.data$MONTH, .data$id_grid)
    )

  if (nrow(changed) == 0L) {
    return(changed %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        current_effort = numeric(),
        replacement_effort = numeric()
      ))
  }

  current_effort <- unname(occupancy_index[changed$occupancy_key])
  current_effort[is.na(current_effort)] <- 0

  changed <- changed %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      current_effort = .env$current_effort,
      replacement_effort =
        .data$current_effort - .data$old_effort + .data$new_effort
    )

  if (any(!is.finite(changed$replacement_effort)) ||
      any(changed$replacement_effort < -1e-8)) {
    smart31_stop(
      "Incremental occupancy produced an invalid negative or non-finite effort."
    )
  }

  changed %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      replacement_effort = dplyr::if_else(
        abs(.data$replacement_effort) <= 1e-12,
        0,
        .data$replacement_effort
      )
    )
}

incremental_occupancy_is_feasible <- function(
  occupancy_update,
  crowding_limit
) {
  nrow(occupancy_update) == 0L ||
    all(
      occupancy_update$replacement_effort <= crowding_limit + 1e-10
    )
}

incremental_occupancy_score <- function(
  current_score,
  occupancy_update,
  crowding_limit
) {
  if (nrow(occupancy_update) == 0L) {
    return(current_score)
  }

  old_contribution <- sum(pmax(
    occupancy_update$current_effort - crowding_limit,
    0
  )^2)
  new_contribution <- sum(pmax(
    occupancy_update$replacement_effort - crowding_limit,
    0
  )^2)

  updated_score <- current_score - old_contribution + new_contribution
  if (abs(updated_score) <= 1e-10) 0 else updated_score
}

apply_incremental_occupancy_update <- function(
  state,
  occupancy_update
) {
  if (nrow(occupancy_update) == 0L) {
    return(state)
  }

  state$occupancy_index[occupancy_update$occupancy_key] <-
    occupancy_update$replacement_effort

  replacement_rows <- occupancy_update %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$replacement_effort > 1e-12) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      MONTH = .data$MONTH,
      id_grid = .data$id_grid,
      effort = .data$replacement_effort
    )

  state$occupancy <- state$occupancy %>%
    dplyr::anti_join(
      occupancy_update %>%
        dplyr::select(.data$MONTH, .data$id_grid),
      by = c("MONTH", "id_grid")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(replacement_rows) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(.data$MONTH, .data$id_grid)

  state
}

occupancy_tables_equivalent <- function(x, y, tolerance = 1e-8) {
  comparison <- dplyr::full_join(
    x %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        MONTH = as.integer(.data$MONTH),
        id_grid = as.character(.data$id_grid),
        effort_x = as.numeric(.data$effort)
      ),
    y %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        MONTH = as.integer(.data$MONTH),
        id_grid = as.character(.data$id_grid),
        effort_y = as.numeric(.data$effort)
      ),
    by = c("MONTH", "id_grid"),
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      effort_x = dplyr::coalesce(.data$effort_x, 0),
      effort_y = dplyr::coalesce(.data$effort_y, 0)
    )

  nrow(comparison) == 0L ||
    all(abs(comparison$effort_x - comparison$effort_y) <= tolerance)
}

validate_incremental_occupancy_once <- function(
  state,
  old_unit_occupancy,
  new_unit_occupancy,
  occupancy_update
) {
  if (!validate_acceleration_first_batch ||
      isTRUE(.smart31_acceleration$occupancy_increment_validated)) {
    return(invisible(TRUE))
  }

  legacy <- replace_unit_occupancy_legacy(
    state$occupancy,
    old_unit_occupancy,
    new_unit_occupancy
  )
  accelerated_state <- apply_incremental_occupancy_update(
    state,
    occupancy_update
  )

  if (!occupancy_tables_equivalent(
        legacy,
        accelerated_state$occupancy
      )) {
    smart31_stop(
      "The incremental crowding update failed its first-proposal equivalence check."
    )
  }

  .smart31_acceleration$occupancy_increment_validated <- TRUE
  invisible(TRUE)
}
```

## Proposal generators

```{r step2-18-proposal-generators}

propose_unit_share <- function(current_share, unit_kernel, method, parameter) {
  proposed_share <- numeric(length(current_share))

  for (rows in unit_kernel$pattern_rows) {
      pattern <- list(
        posterior_alpha = unit_kernel$data$posterior_alpha[rows],
        peer_share = unit_kernel$data$peer_share[rows],
        allocation_units = unit_kernel$data$allocation_units[rows])
      if (method == "bayesian_dirichlet") {
        alpha <- pattern$posterior_alpha
      } else if (method == "stochastic_optimizer") {
        centre <-
          (1 - parameter$stochastic_exploration) * current_share[rows] +
          parameter$stochastic_exploration * pattern$peer_share

        alpha <- parameter$stochastic_concentration *
          normalise_positive(centre) +
          parameter$minimum_dirichlet_alpha
      } else {
        smart31_stop("Unknown proposal method: ", method)
      }

      cell_probability <- rdirichlet_one(alpha)
      allocation_units <- one_value(
        pattern$allocation_units,
        "pattern allocation units"
      )
      allocated_counts <- as.numeric(stats::rmultinom(
        n = 1L,
        size = as.integer(allocation_units),
        prob = cell_probability
      ))
      proposed_share[rows] <- normalise_positive(allocated_counts)
  }

  proposed_share
}

evaluate_candidate_states <- function(
  candidate_shares,
  unit_id,
  context,
  method,
  replicate_id
) {
  candidate_indices <- seq_along(candidate_shares)
  candidate_tasks <- lapply(
    candidate_shares,
    function(candidate_share) {
      list(share = candidate_share, unit_id = unit_id)
    }
  )

  rng_before_evaluation <- if (exists(
        ".Random.seed",
        envir = .GlobalEnv,
        inherits = FALSE
      )) {
    get(".Random.seed", envir = .GlobalEnv, inherits = FALSE)
  } else {
    NULL
  }

  evaluations <- smart31_parallel_lapply(
    candidate_tasks,
    smart31_worker_evaluate_task,
    use_parallel = parallelise_candidate_evaluations,
    stage = "candidate_evaluation"
  )

  rng_after_evaluation <- if (exists(
        ".Random.seed",
        envir = .GlobalEnv,
        inherits = FALSE
      )) {
    get(".Random.seed", envir = .GlobalEnv, inherits = FALSE)
  } else {
    NULL
  }

  if (!identical(rng_before_evaluation, rng_after_evaluation)) {
    smart31_stop(
      "Candidate evaluation modified the parent random-number stream."
    )
  }

  if (validate_acceleration_first_batch &&
      parallelise_candidate_evaluations &&
      .smart31_acceleration$run_workers > 1L &&
      length(candidate_tasks) > 1L &&
      !isTRUE(.smart31_acceleration$candidate_parallel_validated)) {
    sequential_evaluations <- lapply(
      candidate_tasks,
      smart31_worker_evaluate_task
    )
    equivalent <- vapply(
      candidate_indices,
      function(index) {
        smart31_objects_equivalent(
          evaluations[[index]],
          sequential_evaluations[[index]]
        )
      },
      logical(1)
    )

    if (!all(equivalent)) {
      smart31_stop(
        "Parallel candidate evaluation failed its first-batch equivalence ",
        "check at candidate position(s): ",
        paste(which(!equivalent), collapse = ", "), "."
      )
    }

    .smart31_acceleration$candidate_parallel_validated <- TRUE
    smart31_monitor_event(
      event = "parallel_equivalence_validated",
      phase = "optimisation",
      scenario_id = context$scenario$scenario_id,
      method = method,
      replicate = replicate_id,
      note = paste0(
        length(candidate_indices),
        " candidate evaluations matched sequential results"
      )
    )
  }

  evaluations
}

initialise_scenario_state <- function(
  context,
  method = NA_character_,
  replicate_id = NA_integer_
) {
  active_units <- context$gear_time %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$unit_id, .data$CFR, .data$MONTH) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      days_at_sea = sum(.data$days_scenario_gear),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$days_at_sea > 0) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(.data$CFR, .data$MONTH)

  missing_states <- setdiff(
    active_units$unit_id,
    names(context$unit_kernels)
  )
  if (length(missing_states) > 0L) {
    return(list(
      feasible = FALSE,
      issue = "active_units_without_spatial_candidates",
      diagnostic = tibble::tibble(unit_id = missing_states)
    ))
  }

  share_by_unit <- lapply(
    context$unit_kernels[active_units$unit_id],
    function(kernel) kernel$initial_share
  )

  smart31_monitor_event(
    event = "initialisation_started",
    phase = "initialisation",
    scenario_id = context$scenario$scenario_id,
    method = method,
    replicate = replicate_id,
    unit_index = 0L,
    units_in_stage = nrow(active_units),
    note = "evaluating the representative vessel-month baseline"
  )

  evaluation_by_unit <- vector("list", length(active_units$unit_id))
  unit_indices <- seq_along(active_units$unit_id)
  initialisation_chunks <- split(
    unit_indices,
    ceiling(unit_indices / monitor_update_every_units)
  )

  for (chunk_indices in initialisation_chunks) {
    chunk_tasks <- lapply(
      chunk_indices,
      function(unit_index) {
        unit_id <- active_units$unit_id[[unit_index]]
        list(
          share = share_by_unit[[unit_id]],
          unit_id = unit_id
        )
      }
    )

    chunk_evaluations <- smart31_parallel_lapply(
      chunk_tasks,
      smart31_worker_evaluate_task,
      use_parallel = parallelise_initialisation,
      stage = "initialisation_chunk"
    )

    if (validate_acceleration_first_batch &&
        parallelise_initialisation &&
        .smart31_acceleration$run_workers > 1L &&
        !isTRUE(
          .smart31_acceleration$initialisation_parallel_validated
        )) {
      sequential_evaluations <- lapply(
        chunk_tasks,
        smart31_worker_evaluate_task
      )
      equivalent <- vapply(
        seq_along(chunk_evaluations),
        function(index) {
          smart31_objects_equivalent(
            chunk_evaluations[[index]],
            sequential_evaluations[[index]]
          )
        },
        logical(1)
      )

      if (!all(equivalent)) {
        smart31_stop(
          "Parallel initialisation failed its first-batch equivalence ",
          "check at task position(s): ",
          paste(which(!equivalent), collapse = ", "), "."
        )
      }

      .smart31_acceleration$initialisation_parallel_validated <- TRUE
      smart31_monitor_event(
        event = "parallel_equivalence_validated",
        phase = "initialisation",
        scenario_id = context$scenario$scenario_id,
        method = method,
        replicate = replicate_id,
        note = paste0(
          length(chunk_tasks),
          " initial evaluations matched sequential results"
        )
      )
    }

    evaluation_by_unit[chunk_indices] <- chunk_evaluations

    if (!isTRUE(.smart31_acceleration$light_evaluator_validated)) {
      first_index <- chunk_indices[[1L]]
      first_unit <- active_units$unit_id[[first_index]]
      validate_light_evaluator_once(
        share_by_unit[[first_unit]],
        first_unit,
        context,
        chunk_evaluations[[1L]]
      )
    }

    last_unit_index <- utils::tail(chunk_indices, 1L)
    last_unit_id <- active_units$unit_id[[last_unit_index]]

    smart31_monitor_event(
      event = "initialisation_progress",
      phase = "initialisation",
      scenario_id = context$scenario$scenario_id,
      method = method,
      replicate = replicate_id,
      unit_index = last_unit_index,
      units_in_stage = length(active_units$unit_id),
      note = paste0(
        "last unit ", last_unit_id,
        "; workers ",
        if (parallelise_initialisation) {
          .smart31_acceleration$run_workers
        } else {
          1L
        }
      )
    )
  }
  names(evaluation_by_unit) <- active_units$unit_id

  invalid_units <- names(evaluation_by_unit)[
    !vapply(evaluation_by_unit, function(x) isTRUE(x$valid), logical(1))
  ]

  if (length(invalid_units) > 0L) {
    return(list(
      feasible = FALSE,
      issue = "initial_state_is_physically_or_economically_invalid",
      diagnostic = tibble::tibble(
        unit_id = invalid_units,
        issue = vapply(
          evaluation_by_unit[invalid_units],
          function(x) x$issue %||% "unknown",
          character(1)
        )
      )
    ))
  }

  occupancy <- combine_occupancy(evaluation_by_unit)

  catch_index <- context$fixed_non_vms_quota_catch
  if (length(catch_index) > 0L) {
    for (evaluation in evaluation_by_unit) {
      catch_index <- catch_index + evaluation$quota_catch_kg[names(
        catch_index
      )]
    }
  }

  list(
    feasible = TRUE,
    units = active_units,
    share_by_unit = share_by_unit,
    evaluation_by_unit = evaluation_by_unit,
    occupancy = occupancy,
    occupancy_index = build_occupancy_index(occupancy),
    catch_index = catch_index,
    catch_quota_audit = catch_quota_audit(
      catch_index,
      context$catch_quota_limits
    )
  )
}
```
