## Compact constraints and directed repair

```{r step2-19-compact-constraints-and-directed-repair}

smart31_extra_days <- function(share) {
  x <- attr(share, "cm_extra_days", exact = TRUE)
  if (is.null(x)) return(0)
  if (length(x) != 1L || !is.finite(x) || x < 0) smart31_stop("Invalid CM uptake state.")
  as.numeric(x)
}
smart31_set_extra <- function(share, days) {
  attr(share, "cm_extra_days") <- as.numeric(days)
  share
}
smart31_key <- function(month, gear, cell) paste(month, gear, cell, sep = "::")
smart31_sum_named <- function(values, keys) {
  if (!length(values)) return(stats::setNames(numeric(), character()))
  out <- rowsum(matrix(as.numeric(values), ncol = 1L), as.character(keys), reorder = FALSE)
  stats::setNames(as.numeric(out[, 1L]), rownames(out))
}
smart31_named_add <- function(total, values, multiplier = 1) {
  if (length(values)) {
    if (anyNA(match(names(values), names(total)))) smart31_stop("Unindexed constraint key.")
    total[names(values)] <- total[names(values)] + multiplier * values
  }
  total[abs(total) < 1e-10] <- 0
  total
}
smart31_complete_context <- function(context) {
  if (!isTRUE(context$feasible)) return(context)
  context$cm_capacity <- stats::setNames(context$day_allocations$cm_capacity_month,
    make_unit_id(context$day_allocations$CFR, context$day_allocations$MONTH))
  peak <- .smart31_surface$local_peak
  context$local_limits <- stats::setNames(
    peak$historical_peak_effort * cfg$local_effort_peak_factor,
    smart31_key(peak$MONTH, peak$Gear, peak$id_grid))
  q <- italian_effort_quotas %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$YEAR %in% scenario_target_years(context$scenario))
  if ("scenario_id" %in% names(q)) {
    q <- q %>% dplyr::filter(
      .data$scenario_id == context$scenario$scenario_id)
  }
  context$effort_limits <- stats::setNames(q$effort_quota_days, as.character(q$effort_quota_id))
  context$effort_quota_table <- q
  for (uid in names(context$unit_kernels)) {
    k <- context$unit_kernels[[uid]]
    k$local_key <- smart31_key(k$data$MONTH, k$data$Gear, k$data$id_grid)
    unknown <- setdiff(k$local_key, names(context$local_limits))
    if (length(unknown)) context$local_limits[unknown] <- 0
    context$unit_kernels[[uid]] <- k
  }
  context
}

smart31_scale_unit_time <- function(gear_time, extra_days) {
  base_days <- sum(gear_time$days_scenario_gear)
  if (!is.finite(base_days) || base_days <= 0) {
    if (extra_days > 0) smart31_stop("CM uptake cannot create a historically inactive month.")
    return(gear_time)
  }
  ratio <- (base_days + extra_days) / base_days
  scale_fields <- c("days_scenario", "days_scenario_gear", "scenario_trips",
    "fishing_time_reference_scenario", "steaming_time_reference_scenario")
  if (identical(cfg$other_gvl_mode, "per_day_reference"))
    scale_fields <- c(scale_fields, "GVL_other_reference_month")
  for (field in intersect(scale_fields, names(gear_time))) {
    gear_time[[field]] <- gear_time[[field]] * ratio
  }
  gear_time
}
smart31_effort_quota_vector <- function(gear_time, context) {
  q <- context$effort_quota_table
  if (!nrow(q)) return(stats::setNames(numeric(), character()))
  cfr <- as.character(gear_time$CFR[[1L]])
  loa <- context$retained_vessels$loa[match(cfr, context$retained_vessels$CFR)]
  out <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(q)), function(i) {
    if (loa < q$min_loa_m[i] || loa > q$max_loa_m[i]) return(0)
    sum(gear_time$days_scenario_gear[gear_time$Gear == q$Gear[i]])
  }, numeric(1))
  stats::setNames(out, as.character(q$effort_quota_id))
}
smart31_auxiliary_state <- function(state, context) {
  state$local_index <- stats::setNames(numeric(length(context$local_limits)), names(context$local_limits))
  state$effort_index <- stats::setNames(numeric(length(context$effort_limits)), names(context$effort_limits))
  for (ev in state$evaluation_by_unit) {
    state$local_index <- smart31_named_add(state$local_index, ev$local_occupancy)
    state$effort_index <- smart31_named_add(state$effort_index, ev$effort_quota_days)
  }
  state
}
smart31_bound_score <- function(values, limits, tolerance = 1e-8) {
  if (!length(limits)) return(0)
  use <- values[names(limits)]
  if (anyNA(use)) smart31_stop("Constraint state has missing keys.")
  finite <- is.finite(limits)
  sum((pmax(use[finite] - limits[finite] * (1 + tolerance) - 1e-8, 0) /
    pmax(1, limits[finite]))^2)
}
smart31_constraint_scores <- function(state, context) {
  qa <- catch_quota_audit(state$catch_index, context$catch_quota_limits)
  catch_score <- if (nrow(qa)) sum((pmax(qa$simulated_catch_kg -
    qa$quota_kg * (1 + quota_tolerance_fraction) - 1e-8, 0) / pmax(1, qa$quota_kg))^2) else 0
  c(crowding = occupancy_relative_violation_score(state$occupancy, context$crowding_limit),
    local_effort = if (isTRUE(cfg$enforce_local_effort_envelope))
      smart31_bound_score(state$local_index, context$local_limits) else 0,
    catch_quota = catch_score,
    effort_quota = smart31_bound_score(state$effort_index, context$effort_limits,
      quota_tolerance_fraction))
}
smart31_state_feasible <- function(state, context) {
  local_ok <- !isTRUE(cfg$enforce_local_effort_envelope) ||
    all(state$local_index <= context$local_limits * (1 + 1e-8) + 1e-8)
  effort_ok <- all(state$effort_index <= context$effort_limits *
    (1 + quota_tolerance_fraction) + 1e-8)
  local_ok && effort_ok && catch_quota_is_feasible(state$catch_index, context$catch_quota_limits) &&
    all(state$occupancy$effort <= context$crowding_limit * (1 + 1e-8) + 1e-8)
}

smart31_aux_replacement <- function(state, uid, evaluation, context) {
  old <- state$evaluation_by_unit[[uid]]
  keys <- union(names(old$local_occupancy), names(evaluation$local_occupancy))
  old_value <- old$local_occupancy[keys]; old_value[is.na(old_value)] <- 0
  new_value <- evaluation$local_occupancy[keys]; new_value[is.na(new_value)] <- 0
  replacement <- state$local_index[keys] - old_value + new_value
  local_ok <- !isTRUE(cfg$enforce_local_effort_envelope) ||
    all(replacement <= context$local_limits[keys] * (1 + 1e-8) + 1e-8)
  effort <- smart31_named_add(smart31_named_add(state$effort_index,
    old$effort_quota_days, -1), evaluation$effort_quota_days)
  effort_ok <- all(effort <= context$effort_limits * (1 + quota_tolerance_fraction) + 1e-8)
  if (any(!is.finite(replacement)) || any(replacement < -1e-8) ||
      any(!is.finite(effort)) || any(effort < -1e-8)) {
    smart31_stop("Invalid incremental local/effort-quota accounting.")
  }
  list(compatible = local_ok && effort_ok, keys = keys,
    replacement = replacement, effort = effort)
}

smart31_trial_state <- function(state, uid, share, evaluation, context) {
  old <- state$evaluation_by_unit[[uid]]
  update <- prepare_incremental_occupancy_update(state$occupancy_index,
    old$occupancy, evaluation$occupancy)
  trial <- apply_incremental_occupancy_update(state, update)
  trial$catch_index <- replace_unit_quota_catch(state$catch_index,
    old$quota_catch_kg, evaluation$quota_catch_kg)
  trial$local_index <- smart31_named_add(
    smart31_named_add(state$local_index, old$local_occupancy, -1), evaluation$local_occupancy)
  trial$effort_index <- smart31_named_add(
    smart31_named_add(state$effort_index, old$effort_quota_days, -1), evaluation$effort_quota_days)
  trial$share_by_unit[uid] <- list(share)
  trial$evaluation_by_unit[uid] <- list(evaluation)
  trial
}
smart31_failure_details <- function(state, context) {
  local <- tibble::tibble(local_key = names(context$local_limits),
    effort = as.numeric(state$local_index), limit = as.numeric(context$local_limits)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(excess = pmax(0, .data$effort - .data$limit)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$excess > 1e-8)
  global <- state$occupancy %>% dplyr::mutate(limit = context$crowding_limit,
    excess = pmax(0, .data$effort - .data$limit)) %>% dplyr::filter(.data$excess > 1e-8)
  list(local_effort = local, global_crowding = global,
    catch_quota = catch_quota_audit(state$catch_index, context$catch_quota_limits),
    effort_quota = tibble::tibble(effort_quota_id = names(context$effort_limits),
      used_days = as.numeric(state$effort_index), quota_days = as.numeric(context$effort_limits)))
}

smart31_directed_share <- function(state, uid, context) {
  kernel <- context$unit_kernels[[uid]]
  data <- kernel$data
  current <- state$share_by_unit[[uid]]
  old <- state$evaluation_by_unit[[uid]]
  local_other <- smart31_named_add(state$local_index, old$local_occupancy, -1)
  local_spare <- pmax(context$local_limits[kernel$local_key] - local_other[kernel$local_key], 0)
  occ_key <- paste(state$occupancy$MONTH, state$occupancy$id_grid, sep = "::")
  old_key <- paste(old$occupancy$MONTH, old$occupancy$id_grid, sep = "::")
  used <- stats::setNames(state$occupancy$effort, occ_key)
  used[old_key] <- used[old_key] - old$occupancy$effort
  key <- paste(data$MONTH, data$id_grid, sep = "::")
  other <- used[key]; other[is.na(other)] <- 0
  spare <- pmax(0, context$crowding_limit - other)
  if (isTRUE(cfg$enforce_local_effort_envelope)) spare <- pmin(spare, local_spare)
  qa <- catch_quota_audit(state$catch_index, context$catch_quota_limits)
  over <- if (nrow(qa)) unique(qa$Species[!qa$compatible]) else character()
  burden <- numeric(nrow(data))
  for (sp in intersect(over, context$quota_species)) {
    q <- min(qa$quota_kg[qa$Species == sp])
    burden <- burden + smart31_context_quota_rate(context)[data$cell_rate_id, sp] / max(q, 1)
  }
  out <- numeric(length(current))
  for (rows in kernel$pattern_rows) {
    b <- burden[rows]
    scale <- if (any(b > 0)) stats::median(b[b > 0]) else 1

    target <- (data$peer_share[rows] + data$initial_share[rows] + 1e-12) *
      spare[rows] * exp(-pmin(30, b / scale))
    out[rows] <- if (sum(target) > 0) normalise_positive(target) else current[rows]
  }
  smart31_set_extra(out, 0)
}

repair_crowding <- function(initial_state, context, method, replicate_id = NA_integer_) {
  state <- smart31_auxiliary_state(initial_state, context)
  scores <- smart31_constraint_scores(state, context)
  trace <- list(tibble::tibble(iteration = 0L, repair_pass = 0L,
    crowding_violation_score = scores[["crowding"]],
    local_effort_violation_score = scores[["local_effort"]],
    catch_quota_violation_score = scores[["catch_quota"]],
    effort_quota_violation_score = scores[["effort_quota"]], violation_score = sum(scores)))
  iteration <- 0L
  smart31_monitor_event(event = "feasibility_repair_started", phase = "feasibility_repair",
    scenario_id = context$scenario$scenario_id, method = method, replicate = replicate_id,
    violation_score = sum(scores), note = "baseline days; optional CM starts at zero; directed repair")
  for (pass in seq_len(cfg$maximum_repair_passes)) {
    if (smart31_state_feasible(state, context)) break

    qa <- catch_quota_audit(state$catch_index, context$catch_quota_limits)
    over <- if (nrow(qa)) unique(qa$Species[!qa$compatible]) else character()
    priority <- vapply(state$evaluation_by_unit, function(ev) {
      ks <- names(ev$local_occupancy)
      local_pressure <- if (length(ks)) sum(ev$local_occupancy *
        pmax(state$local_index[ks] / pmax(1, context$local_limits[ks]) - 1, 0)) else 0
      global_idx <- match(paste(ev$occupancy$MONTH, ev$occupancy$id_grid),
        paste(state$occupancy$MONTH, state$occupancy$id_grid))
      global_pressure <- sum(ev$occupancy$effort * pmax(
        state$occupancy$effort[global_idx] / context$crowding_limit - 1, 0), na.rm = TRUE)
      quota_pressure <- sum(ev$quota_catch_kg[intersect(over, names(ev$quota_catch_kg))])
      local_pressure + global_pressure + quota_pressure
    }, numeric(1))
    order_ids <- names(sort(priority, decreasing = TRUE))
    accepted_pass <- 0L
    for (uid in order_ids) {
      if (smart31_state_feasible(state, context)) break
      if (priority[[uid]] <= 0) next
      iteration <- iteration + 1L
      current <- state$share_by_unit[[uid]]
      directed <- smart31_directed_share(state, uid, context)
      proposals <- lapply(c(0.1, 0.35, 1), function(w)
        smart31_set_extra((1 - w) * as.numeric(current) + w * as.numeric(directed), 0))
      proposals[[4L]] <- smart31_set_extra(propose_unit_share(current,
        context$unit_kernels[[uid]], method, context$scenario$parameters), 0)
      best <- NULL; best_score <- sum(scores)
      for (share in proposals) {
        ev <- evaluate_vessel_month_light(share, uid, context)
        if (!isTRUE(ev$valid)) next
        trial <- smart31_trial_state(state, uid, share, ev, context)
        score <- sum(smart31_constraint_scores(trial, context))
        if (smart31_state_feasible(trial, context) || score < best_score - 1e-14) {
          best <- trial; best_score <- score
          if (smart31_state_feasible(trial, context)) break
        }
      }
      if (!is.null(best)) { state <- best; accepted_pass <- accepted_pass + 1L }
      scores <- smart31_constraint_scores(state, context)
      trace[[length(trace) + 1L]] <- tibble::tibble(iteration = iteration, repair_pass = pass,
        crowding_violation_score = scores[["crowding"]], local_effort_violation_score = scores[["local_effort"]],
        catch_quota_violation_score = scores[["catch_quota"]], effort_quota_violation_score = scores[["effort_quota"]],
        violation_score = sum(scores))
      if (iteration %% monitor_update_every_repair_iterations == 0L || smart31_monitor_heartbeat_due()) {
        smart31_monitor_event(event = "feasibility_repair_progress", phase = "feasibility_repair",
          scenario_id = context$scenario$scenario_id, method = method, replicate = replicate_id,
          unit_index = iteration, units_in_stage = length(order_ids) * cfg$maximum_repair_passes,
          violation_score = sum(scores), note = paste0("pass ", pass, "; local=", signif(scores[["local_effort"]], 4),
            "; catch=", signif(scores[["catch_quota"]], 4)))
      }
    }
    if (accepted_pass == 0L) break
  }
  feasible <- smart31_state_feasible(state, context)
  detail <- smart31_failure_details(state, context)
  smart31_monitor_event(event = if (feasible) "feasibility_repair_completed" else "feasibility_repair_failed",
    phase = "feasibility_repair", scenario_id = context$scenario$scenario_id, method = method,
    replicate = replicate_id, violation_score = sum(scores),
    note = if (feasible) "joint constraints satisfied" else "search budget exhausted; not a proof of infeasibility")
  list(feasible = feasible, state = state, repair_log = dplyr::bind_rows(trace),
    remaining_violation_score = sum(scores), catch_quota_audit = detail$catch_quota,
    constraint_diagnostics = detail)
}

smart31_search_proposals <- function(current, uid, context, method) {
  p <- context$scenario$parameters
  q <- smart31_extra_days(current)
  cap <- context$cm_capacity[[uid]]
  n <- as.integer(p$candidates_per_update)
  lapply(seq_len(n), function(i) {
    if (i == 1L) return(smart31_set_extra(as.numeric(current), min(cap, q + cfg$cm_step_days)))
    raw <- propose_unit_share(current, context$unit_kernels[[uid]], method, p)
    w <- c(0.10, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00)[1L + (i - 2L) %% 5L]
    extra <- switch(as.character(i), "2" = q, "3" = min(cap, q + cfg$cm_step_days),
      "4" = max(0, q - cfg$cm_step_days), "5" = q,
      if (cap > 0) stats::runif(1L, 0, cap) else 0)
    smart31_set_extra((1 - w) * as.numeric(current) + w * raw, extra)
  })
}
```

## Optimisation engine

```{r step2-20-optimisation-engine}

smart31_search_checkpoint_file <- function(
  context,
  method,
  replicate_id
) {
  safe_id <- gsub(
    "[^A-Za-z0-9_-]+",
    "_",
    paste(
      context$scenario$scenario_id,
      method,
      sprintf("rep%03d", as.integer(replicate_id)),
      sep = "__"
    )
  )
  file.path(
    simulation_output_directory,
    paste0("SMART31_step2_other_gvl_incomplete_", safe_id, ".rds")
  )
}

smart31_save_search_checkpoint <- function(
  state,
  stability,
  convergence_log,
  accepted_updates,
  completed_sweep,
  context,
  method,
  replicate_id,
  seed,
  reference_GVA
) {
  checkpoint_file <- smart31_search_checkpoint_file(
    context,
    method,
    replicate_id
  )
  payload <- list(
    metadata = list(
      format_version = "SMART31_step2_search_checkpoint_v52",
      scientific_source_md5 = scientific_source_md5,
      source_document =
        "workflows/step2.Rmd",
      created_utc = format(Sys.time(), tz = "UTC", usetz = TRUE),
      step1_bundle_md5 = configured_bundle_md5,
      catch_quota_file_md5 = catch_quota_file_md5,
      effort_quota_file_md5 = effort_quota_file_md5,
      scenario_contract = context$scenario,
      scenario_id = context$scenario$scenario_id,
      method = method,
      replicate = as.integer(replicate_id),
      seed = as.integer(seed),
      completed_sweep = as.integer(completed_sweep),
      reference_GVA = as.numeric(reference_GVA)
    ),
    random_seed = if (exists(
      ".Random.seed",
      envir = .GlobalEnv,
      inherits = FALSE
    )) get(".Random.seed", envir = .GlobalEnv, inherits = FALSE) else NULL,
    state = state,
    stability = stability,
    convergence_log = convergence_log,
    accepted_updates = as.integer(accepted_updates),
    reference_GVA = as.numeric(reference_GVA)
  )
  temporary_file <- tempfile(
    pattern = paste0(basename(checkpoint_file), "_"),
    tmpdir = dirname(checkpoint_file),
    fileext = ".tmp"
  )
  on.exit(unlink(temporary_file), add = TRUE)

  saveRDS(payload, temporary_file, compress = FALSE, version = 3)
  smart31_monitor_publish_file(temporary_file, checkpoint_file)
  smart31_monitor_event(
    event = "optimisation_checkpoint_saved",
    phase = "checkpoint",
    scenario_id = context$scenario$scenario_id,
    method = method,
    replicate = replicate_id,
    sweep = completed_sweep,
    maximum_sweeps = as.integer(
      context$scenario$parameters$maximum_sweeps
    ),
    note = basename(checkpoint_file)
  )
  invisible(checkpoint_file)
}

smart31_load_search_checkpoint <- function(
  context,
  method,
  replicate_id,
  seed
) {
  if (!resume_incomplete_run) return(NULL)
  checkpoint_file <- smart31_search_checkpoint_file(
    context,
    method,
    replicate_id
  )
  if (!file.exists(checkpoint_file)) return(NULL)

  payload <- tryCatch(readRDS(checkpoint_file), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(payload) || is.null(payload$metadata)) return(NULL)
  metadata <- payload$metadata
  valid <- identical(
    metadata$format_version,
    "SMART31_step2_search_checkpoint_v52"
  ) && identical(metadata$scientific_source_md5, scientific_source_md5) && identical(
    as.character(metadata$step1_bundle_md5),
    as.character(configured_bundle_md5)
  ) && identical(
    as.character(metadata$scenario_id),
    as.character(context$scenario$scenario_id)
  ) && identical(metadata$scenario_contract, context$scenario) && identical(
    names(payload$state$share_by_unit),
    names(context$unit_kernels)
  ) && identical(
    as.character(metadata$catch_quota_file_md5),
    as.character(catch_quota_file_md5)
  ) && identical(
    as.character(metadata$effort_quota_file_md5),
    as.character(effort_quota_file_md5)
  ) && identical(as.character(metadata$method), as.character(method)) &&
    identical(as.integer(metadata$replicate), as.integer(replicate_id)) &&
    identical(as.integer(metadata$seed), as.integer(seed)) &&
    !is.null(payload$state$share_by_unit) &&
    !is.null(payload$state$evaluation_by_unit) &&
    !is.null(payload$stability)
  if (!valid) return(NULL)

  share_lengths_valid <- all(vapply(
    names(context$unit_kernels),
    function(unit_id) {
      length(payload$state$share_by_unit[[unit_id]]) ==
        nrow(context$unit_kernels[[unit_id]]$data)
    },
    logical(1)
  ))
  state_valid <- share_lengths_valid &&
    !is.null(payload$state$local_index) && !is.null(payload$state$effort_index) &&
    smart31_state_feasible(payload$state, context) &&
    identical(
      names(payload$state$evaluation_by_unit),
      names(context$unit_kernels)
    ) &&
    catch_quota_is_feasible(
      payload$state$catch_index,
      context$catch_quota_limits
    ) &&
    occupancy_relative_violation_score(
      payload$state$occupancy,
      context$crowding_limit
    ) <= 1e-12
  if (!state_valid) {
    smart31_stop(
      "The matching incomplete-run checkpoint contains an invalid or ",
      "infeasible search state: ", checkpoint_file
    )
  }
  payload$checkpoint_file <- checkpoint_file
  payload
}

maximum_catch_quota_ratio <- function(state, context) {
  audit <- catch_quota_audit(
    state$catch_index,
    context$catch_quota_limits
  )
  if (nrow(audit) == 0L) return(0)
  max(audit$quota_use_fraction)
}

smart31_relative_change_percent <- function(current, reference) {
  if (!is.finite(current) || !is.finite(reference) ||
      abs(reference) <= .Machine$double.eps) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  100 * (current / reference - 1)
}

smart31_species_metric_name <- function(species) {
  paste0(
    "catch_kg__",
    gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", as.character(species))
  )
}

smart31_state_species_catch <- function(state, context) {
  total <- context$fixed_non_vms_species_catch
  if (length(total) == 0L) return(total)

  for (evaluation in state$evaluation_by_unit) {
    unit_catch <- evaluation$catch_kg %||% numeric()
    represented <- intersect(names(total), names(unit_catch))
    if (length(represented) > 0L) {
      total[represented] <- total[represented] + unit_catch[represented]
    }
  }
  total
}

smart31_state_diagnostics <- function(state, context) {
  economic_fields <- c(
    "days_at_sea", "trips", "fishing_time", "steaming_time",
    "steaming_distance_km", "GVL_6sp", "GVL_other_reference",
    "GVL", "EC", "OC", "LC", "GVA", "GP",
    "fuel_fishing_l", "fuel_steaming_l", "EC_fishing", "EC_steaming"
  )
  economic_totals <- stats::setNames(
    vapply(
      economic_fields,
      function(field) {
        sum(vapply(
          state$evaluation_by_unit,
          function(evaluation) evaluation$economic[[field]][[1L]],
          numeric(1)
        ))
      },
      numeric(1)
    ),
    economic_fields
  )

  mean_distance_km <- if (economic_totals[["trips"]] > 0) {
    economic_totals[["steaming_distance_km"]] /
      (2 * economic_totals[["trips"]])
  } else {
    0
  }

  cell_effort <- if (nrow(state$occupancy) > 0L) {
    rowsum(
      matrix(state$occupancy$effort, ncol = 1L),
      group = as.character(state$occupancy$id_grid),
      reorder = FALSE
    )[, 1L]
  } else {
    numeric()
  }
  cell_effort <- cell_effort[is.finite(cell_effort) & cell_effort > 1e-12]
  effort_total <- sum(cell_effort)
  spatial_hhi <- if (effort_total > 0) {
    sum((cell_effort / effort_total)^2)
  } else {
    0
  }
  effective_cells <- if (spatial_hhi > 0) 1 / spatial_hhi else 0

  species_catch <- smart31_state_species_catch(state, context)
  names(species_catch) <- smart31_species_metric_name(names(species_catch))

  diagnostic_values <- c(
    total_days_at_sea = economic_totals[["days_at_sea"]],
    total_trips = economic_totals[["trips"]],
    total_fishing_time_hours = economic_totals[["fishing_time"]],
    total_steaming_time_hours = economic_totals[["steaming_time"]],
    total_steaming_distance_km =
      economic_totals[["steaming_distance_km"]],
    mean_distance_km = mean_distance_km,
    total_GVL_6sp = economic_totals[["GVL_6sp"]],
    total_GVL_other_reference =
      economic_totals[["GVL_other_reference"]],
    total_GVL = economic_totals[["GVL"]],
    total_EC = economic_totals[["EC"]],
    total_EC_fishing = economic_totals[["EC_fishing"]],
    total_EC_steaming = economic_totals[["EC_steaming"]],
    total_fuel_fishing_l = economic_totals[["fuel_fishing_l"]],
    total_fuel_steaming_l = economic_totals[["fuel_steaming_l"]],
    total_used_cm_days = sum(vapply(state$share_by_unit, smart31_extra_days, numeric(1))),
    maximum_local_effort_ratio = if (length(state$local_index))
      max(state$local_index / pmax(1e-12, context$local_limits)) else 0,
    total_OC = economic_totals[["OC"]],
    total_LC = economic_totals[["LC"]],
    total_GVA = economic_totals[["GVA"]],
    total_GP = economic_totals[["GP"]],
    total_catch_kg = sum(species_catch),
    occupied_cells = length(cell_effort),
    spatial_HHI = spatial_hhi,
    effective_occupied_cells = effective_cells,
    species_catch
  )
  sk <- state$catch_index[startsWith(names(state$catch_index),"STOCK::")]

  if (length(sk) > 0L) {
    names(sk) <- paste0("stock_catch_kg__",sub("^STOCK::","",names(sk)))
  }
  tibble::as_tibble_row(c(diagnostic_values,sk))
}

smart31_sweep_diagnostic_row <- function(
  state,
  context,
  sweep,
  accepted_updates,
  stability,
  reference_diagnostics,
  memory_used_mb = NA_real_
) {
  current <- smart31_state_diagnostics(state, context)
  change_fields <- c(
    GVA = "total_GVA",
    GVL = "total_GVL",
    GVL_6sp = "total_GVL_6sp",
    EC = "total_EC",
    OC = "total_OC",
    catch = "total_catch_kg",
    mean_distance = "mean_distance_km",
    spatial_HHI = "spatial_HHI"
  )

  changes <- stats::setNames(
    vapply(
      change_fields,
      function(field) smart31_relative_change_percent(
        current[[field]][[1L]],
        reference_diagnostics[[field]][[1L]]
      ),
      numeric(1)
    ),
    paste0(names(change_fields), "_change_percent")
  )

  dplyr::bind_cols(
    tibble::tibble(
      sweep = as.integer(sweep),
      reference_GVA = reference_diagnostics$total_GVA[[1L]],
      accepted_updates = as.integer(accepted_updates),
      units_still_searching = sum(
        stability <
          context$scenario$parameters$max_consecutive_non_improvements
      ),
      maximum_crowding_ratio = if (nrow(state$occupancy) > 0L) {
        max(state$occupancy$effort / context$crowding_limit)
      } else {
        0
      },
      maximum_catch_quota_ratio = maximum_catch_quota_ratio(
        state,
        context
      ),
      memory_used_mb = as.numeric(memory_used_mb)
    ),
    current,
    tibble::as_tibble_row(changes)
  )
}

smart31_write_live_sweep_diagnostics <- function(
  convergence_log,
  context,
  method,
  replicate_id
) {
  diagnostics <- dplyr::bind_rows(convergence_log) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      scenario_id = context$scenario$scenario_id,
      scenario_year = context$scenario$scenario_year,
      representative_period = context$scenario$representative_period,
      member_state = context$scenario$member_state,
      cm_status = context$scenario$cm_status,
      method = method,
      replicate = as.integer(replicate_id),
      .before = 1
    )
  safe_run_id <- gsub(
    "[^A-Za-z0-9_-]+",
    "_",
    paste(
      context$scenario$scenario_id,
      method,
      sprintf("rep%03d", as.integer(replicate_id)),
      sep = "__"
    )
  )
  diagnostic_file <- file.path(
    simulation_output_directory,
    paste0("SMART31_step2_other_gvl_live_sweep_diagnostics_", safe_run_id, ".csv")
  )
  smart31_monitor_write_csv(diagnostics, diagnostic_file)

  catch_columns <- grep("^catch_kg__", names(diagnostics), value = TRUE)
  if (length(catch_columns) > 0L) {
    catches <- diagnostics %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$scenario_id, .data$scenario_year,
        .data$representative_period, .data$member_state, .data$cm_status,
        .data$method, .data$replicate, .data$sweep,
        dplyr::all_of(catch_columns)
      ) %>%
      tidyr::pivot_longer(
        cols = dplyr::all_of(catch_columns),
        names_to = "Species",
        values_to = "catch_kg"
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        Species = sub("^catch_kg__", "", .data$Species),
        catch_kg = dplyr::coalesce(.data$catch_kg, 0)
      )
    catch_file <- file.path(
      simulation_output_directory,
      paste0("SMART31_step2_other_gvl_live_sweep_catches_", safe_run_id, ".csv")
    )
    smart31_monitor_write_csv(catches, catch_file)
  }
  invisible(diagnostic_file)
}

optimise_scenario_state <- function(
  feasible_state,
  context,
  method,
  replicate_id = NA_integer_,
  seed,
  resume_payload = NULL
) {
  parameter <- context$scenario$parameters
  if (is.null(resume_payload)) {
    state <- feasible_state
    stability <- stats::setNames(
      integer(nrow(state$units)),
      state$units$unit_id
    )
    convergence_log <- list()
    accepted_updates <- 0L
    first_sweep <- 1L
  } else {
    state <- resume_payload$state
    stability <- resume_payload$stability
    convergence_log <- resume_payload$convergence_log %||% list()
    accepted_updates <- as.integer(
      resume_payload$accepted_updates %||% 0L
    )
    first_sweep <- as.integer(
      resume_payload$metadata$completed_sweep
    ) + 1L
    if (!is.null(resume_payload$random_seed)) {
      assign(
        ".Random.seed",
        resume_payload$random_seed,
        envir = .GlobalEnv
      )
    }
    smart31_monitor_event(
      event = "optimisation_resumed",
      phase = "optimisation",
      scenario_id = context$scenario$scenario_id,
      method = method,
      replicate = replicate_id,
      sweep = first_sweep - 1L,
      maximum_sweeps = as.integer(parameter$maximum_sweeps),
      note = paste0(
        "resumed from ", basename(resume_payload$checkpoint_file)
      )
    )
  }

  current_diagnostics <- smart31_state_diagnostics(state, context)
  if (is.null(resume_payload)) {
    reference_diagnostics <- current_diagnostics
    convergence_log[[1L]] <- smart31_sweep_diagnostic_row(
      state = state,
      context = context,
      sweep = 0L,
      accepted_updates = 0L,
      stability = stability,
      reference_diagnostics = reference_diagnostics
    )
  } else {
    historical_convergence <- dplyr::bind_rows(convergence_log)
    reference_row <- historical_convergence %>%
      dplyr::filter(.data$sweep == 0L) %>%
      dplyr::slice_head(n = 1L)
    if (nrow(reference_row) != 1L ||
        !all(names(current_diagnostics) %in% names(reference_row))) {
      smart31_stop(
        "The matching checkpoint lacks the baseline diagnostics."
      )
    }
    reference_diagnostics <- reference_row %>%
      dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(names(current_diagnostics)))
  }
  smart31_monitor_detail_capture(state, context, method, replicate_id, first_sweep - 1L,
    current_diagnostics, dplyr::bind_rows(convergence_log))
  initial_total_gva <- current_diagnostics$total_GVA[[1L]]
  reference_total_gva <- reference_diagnostics$total_GVA[[1L]]
  smart31_write_live_sweep_diagnostics(
    convergence_log,
    context,
    method,
    replicate_id
  )
  smart31_monitor_event(
    event = "optimisation_started",
    phase = "optimisation",
    scenario_id = context$scenario$scenario_id,
    method = method,
    replicate = replicate_id,
    sweep = first_sweep - 1L,
    maximum_sweeps = as.integer(parameter$maximum_sweeps),
    unit_index = 0L,
    units_in_stage = nrow(state$units),
    stable_units = sum(
      stability >= parameter$max_consecutive_non_improvements
    ),
    total_units = nrow(state$units),
    total_GVA = initial_total_gva,
    reference_GVA = reference_total_gva,
    maximum_crowding_ratio = if (nrow(state$occupancy) > 0L) {
      max(state$occupancy$effort / context$crowding_limit)
    } else 0,
    note = paste0(
      if (is.null(resume_payload)) "GVA search started" else "GVA search resumed",
      "; maximum catch-quota use ",
      format(maximum_catch_quota_ratio(state, context), digits = 4)
    )
  )

  sweep_sequence <- if (first_sweep <= as.integer(parameter$maximum_sweeps)) {
    seq.int(first_sweep, as.integer(parameter$maximum_sweeps))
  } else integer()

  for (sweep in sweep_sequence) {
    unit_order <- sample(state$units$unit_id)
    accepted_this_sweep <- 0L

    for (unit_position in seq_along(unit_order)) {
      unit_id <- unit_order[[unit_position]]
      if (stability[[unit_id]] >=
          parameter$max_consecutive_non_improvements) next

      current_evaluation <- state$evaluation_by_unit[[unit_id]]
      current_gva <- current_evaluation$economic$GVA[[1L]]
      required_gva <- gva_improvement_threshold(
        current_gva,
        parameter$min_GVA_improve_fact,
        parameter$min_GVA_improve_abs_eur
      )

      best_share <- NULL
      best_evaluation <- NULL
      best_occupancy_update <- NULL
      best_catch_index <- NULL
      best_gva <- -Inf
      candidate_indices <- seq_len(as.integer(
        parameter$candidates_per_update
      ))
      proposed_shares <- smart31_search_proposals(
        state$share_by_unit[[unit_id]], unit_id, context, method)
      proposed_evaluations <- evaluate_candidate_states(
        proposed_shares,
        unit_id,
        context,
        method,
        replicate_id
      )

      for (candidate_index in candidate_indices) {
        proposed_evaluation <- proposed_evaluations[[candidate_index]]
        if (!isTRUE(proposed_evaluation$valid)) next

        occupancy_update <- prepare_incremental_occupancy_update(
          state$occupancy_index,
          current_evaluation$occupancy,
          proposed_evaluation$occupancy
        )
        validate_incremental_occupancy_once(
          state,
          current_evaluation$occupancy,
          proposed_evaluation$occupancy,
          occupancy_update
        )
        if (!incremental_occupancy_is_feasible(
              occupancy_update,
              context$crowding_limit
            )) next

        proposed_catch_index <- replace_unit_quota_catch(
          state$catch_index,
          current_evaluation$quota_catch_kg,
          proposed_evaluation$quota_catch_kg
        )
        if (!catch_quota_is_feasible(
              proposed_catch_index,
              context$catch_quota_limits
            )) next

        auxiliary <- smart31_aux_replacement(state, unit_id, proposed_evaluation, context)
        if (!isTRUE(auxiliary$compatible)) next
        proposed_gva <- proposed_evaluation$economic$GVA[[1L]]
        if (is.finite(proposed_gva) && proposed_gva > best_gva) {
          best_share <- proposed_shares[[candidate_index]]
          best_evaluation <- proposed_evaluation
          best_occupancy_update <- occupancy_update
          best_catch_index <- proposed_catch_index
          best_gva <- proposed_gva
          best_auxiliary <- auxiliary
        }
      }

      if (!is.null(best_share) && best_gva > required_gva) {
        state <- apply_incremental_occupancy_update(state, best_occupancy_update)
        state$catch_index <- best_catch_index
        state$local_index[best_auxiliary$keys] <- best_auxiliary$replacement
        state$effort_index <- best_auxiliary$effort
        state$share_by_unit[unit_id] <- list(best_share)
        state$evaluation_by_unit[unit_id] <- list(best_evaluation)
        stability[[unit_id]] <- 0L
        accepted_updates <- accepted_updates + 1L
        accepted_this_sweep <- accepted_this_sweep + 1L
      } else {
        stability[[unit_id]] <- stability[[unit_id]] + 1L
      }

      if (smart31_monitor_heartbeat_due() ||
          unit_position %% monitor_update_every_units == 0L ||
          unit_position == length(unit_order)) {
        smart31_monitor_event(
          event = "optimisation_unit_progress",
          phase = "optimisation",
          scenario_id = context$scenario$scenario_id,
          method = method,
          replicate = replicate_id,
          sweep = sweep,
          maximum_sweeps = as.integer(parameter$maximum_sweeps),
          unit_index = unit_position,
          units_in_stage = length(unit_order),
          accepted_updates = accepted_this_sweep,
          stable_units = sum(
            stability >= parameter$max_consecutive_non_improvements
          ),
          total_units = length(stability),
          note = paste0("last evaluated unit ", unit_id)
        )
      }
    }

    memory_used_mb <- if (
      sweep %% memory_cleanup_every_sweeps == 0L
    ) {
      sum(gc(verbose = FALSE)[, 2L])
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }
    if (!smart31_state_feasible(state, context)) smart31_stop("An accepted v5 sweep violates constraints.")
    current_sweep_log <- smart31_sweep_diagnostic_row(
      state = state,
      context = context,
      sweep = sweep,
      accepted_updates = accepted_this_sweep,
      stability = stability,
      reference_diagnostics = reference_diagnostics,
      memory_used_mb = memory_used_mb
    )
    convergence_log[[length(convergence_log) + 1L]] <- current_sweep_log
    smart31_monitor_detail_capture(state, context, method, replicate_id, sweep, current_sweep_log)
    smart31_write_live_sweep_diagnostics(
      convergence_log,
      context,
      method,
      replicate_id
    )
    total_gva <- current_sweep_log$total_GVA[[1L]]
    converged_now <- all(
      stability >= parameter$max_consecutive_non_improvements
    )

    smart31_monitor_event(
      event = "optimisation_sweep",
      phase = "optimisation",
      scenario_id = context$scenario$scenario_id,
      method = method,
      replicate = replicate_id,
      sweep = sweep,
      maximum_sweeps = as.integer(parameter$maximum_sweeps),
      accepted_updates = accepted_this_sweep,
      stable_units = sum(
        stability >= parameter$max_consecutive_non_improvements
      ),
      total_units = length(stability),
      total_GVA = total_gva,
      reference_GVA = reference_total_gva,
      maximum_crowding_ratio =
        current_sweep_log$maximum_crowding_ratio[[1L]],
      note = paste0(
        "cumulative accepted updates: ", accepted_updates,
        "; maximum catch-quota use ",
        format(
          current_sweep_log$maximum_catch_quota_ratio[[1L]],
          digits = 4
        ),
        "; mean distance ",
        format(current_sweep_log$mean_distance_km[[1L]], digits = 4),
        " km; effective cells ",
        format(
          current_sweep_log$effective_occupied_cells[[1L]],
          digits = 5
        ),
        if (is.finite(memory_used_mb)) {
          paste0("; R memory ", round(memory_used_mb), " MB")
        } else {
          ""
        }
      )
    )

    if (sweep %% checkpoint_every_sweeps == 0L || converged_now ||
        sweep == as.integer(parameter$maximum_sweeps)) {
      smart31_save_search_checkpoint(
        state,
        stability,
        convergence_log,
        accepted_updates,
        sweep,
        context,
        method,
        replicate_id,
        seed,
        reference_GVA = reference_total_gva
      )
    }
    if (converged_now) break
  }

  if (length(convergence_log) == 0L) {
    smart31_stop("The optimisation produced no completed sweep.")
  }
  state$catch_quota_audit <- catch_quota_audit(state$catch_index, context$catch_quota_limits)
  final_log <- convergence_log[[length(convergence_log)]]
  converged <- all(
    stability >= parameter$max_consecutive_non_improvements
  )
  smart31_monitor_event(
    event = if (converged) {
      "optimisation_converged"
    } else {
      "optimisation_maximum_sweeps_reached"
    },
    phase = "optimisation",
    scenario_id = context$scenario$scenario_id,
    method = method,
    replicate = replicate_id,
    sweep = final_log$sweep[[1L]],
    maximum_sweeps = as.integer(parameter$maximum_sweeps),
    accepted_updates = final_log$accepted_updates[[1L]],
    stable_units = length(stability) - final_log$units_still_searching[[1L]],
    total_units = length(stability),
    total_GVA = final_log$total_GVA[[1L]],
    reference_GVA = reference_total_gva,
    maximum_crowding_ratio = final_log$maximum_crowding_ratio[[1L]],
    note = paste0(
      "cumulative accepted updates: ", accepted_updates,
      "; maximum catch-quota use ",
      format(final_log$maximum_catch_quota_ratio[[1L]], digits = 4)
    )
  )

  list(
    state = state,
    stability = stability,
    convergence_log = dplyr::bind_rows(convergence_log),
    accepted_updates = accepted_updates,
    converged = converged
  )
}
```

## Economic reconciliation helpers

```{r step2-21-economic-reconciliation-helpers}

smart31_final_economics <- function(evaluations, context, method, replicate_id) {
  calculated <- purrr::map_dfr(evaluations, "economic")
  fields <- c("GVL_6sp", "GVL_other_reference", "GVL", "EC", "OC", "LC", "GVA", "GP")

  reference <- dplyr::bind_rows(context$economic_reference, context$cessation_reference) %>%
    dplyr::select(.data$unit_id, .data$CFR, .data$MONTH, dplyr::all_of(fields)) %>%
    dplyr::rename_with(~ paste0("reference_", .x), dplyr::all_of(fields))
  if (anyDuplicated(reference$unit_id) || anyDuplicated(calculated$unit_id)) {
    smart31_stop("Economic reference and simulated months must have unique unit IDs.")
  }
  if (length(setdiff(calculated$unit_id, reference$unit_id))) {
    smart31_stop("Simulated vessel-month lacks a historical economic reference.")
  }
  physical <- c("days_at_sea", "trips", "fishing_time", "steaming_time", "steaming_distance_km",
    "mean_distance_km", "fuel_fishing_l", "fuel_steaming_l", "EC_fishing", "EC_steaming", "W")
  missing_fields <- setdiff(c(physical, fields), names(calculated))
  if (length(missing_fields)) smart31_stop("Full evaluation lacks economic/physical fields: ",
    paste(missing_fields, collapse = ", "))
  if (any(!is.finite(as.matrix(calculated[c(physical, fields)])))) {
    smart31_stop("Computed monthly economic/physical values contain NA or Inf.")
  }
  monthly <- reference %>% dplyr::left_join(calculated %>%
      dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of(c("CFR", "MONTH"))), by = "unit_id", relationship = "one-to-one") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(c(physical, fields)), ~ dplyr::coalesce(.x, 0)),
      vessel_ceased = .data$CFR %in% context$removed_cfr,
      simulation_active = .data$days_at_sea > 0,
      delta_GVL = .data$GVL - .data$reference_GVL,
      delta_EC = .data$EC - .data$reference_EC,
      delta_GVA = .data$GVA - .data$reference_GVA,
      reference_GVA_retained = dplyr::if_else(.data$vessel_ceased, 0, .data$reference_GVA),
      scenario_id = context$scenario$scenario_id, scenario_year = context$scenario$scenario_year,
      representative_period = context$scenario$representative_period,
      member_state = context$scenario$member_state, cm_status = context$scenario$cm_status,
      method = method, replicate = replicate_id, .before = 1)

  required <- names(context$unit_kernels)[vapply(context$gear_search_by_unit,
    function(z) sum(z$days_scenario_gear) > 0, logical(1))]
  if (length(setdiff(required, calculated$unit_id))) smart31_stop("Active monthly economics are incomplete.")
  if (any(abs(monthly$GVA - (monthly$GVL - monthly$EC - monthly$OC)) >
      1e-7 * pmax(1, abs(monthly$GVL)))) smart31_stop("Final GVA identity failed.")
  group <- c("scenario_id", "scenario_year", "representative_period", "member_state",
    "cm_status", "method", "replicate", "CFR")
  sum_fields <- c(setdiff(physical, "mean_distance_km"), fields, paste0("reference_", fields),
    "delta_GVL", "delta_EC", "delta_GVA", "reference_GVA_retained")
  annual <- monthly %>% dplyr::group_by(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(group))) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(sum_fields), sum), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(mean_distance_km = dplyr::if_else(.data$trips > 0,
      .data$steaming_distance_km / (2 * .data$trips), 0))
  list(monthly = monthly, annual = annual)
}

smart31_realised_day_audit <- function(context, state, method, replicate_id) {
  extras <- vapply(state$share_by_unit, smart31_extra_days, numeric(1))
  out <- context$day_allocations
  uid <- make_unit_id(out$CFR, out$MONTH)
  out$used_cm_days_month <- unname(extras[uid])
  out$used_cm_days_month[is.na(out$used_cm_days_month)] <- 0
  out$days_scenario <- out$days_scenario + out$used_cm_days_month
  out <- out %>% dplyr::group_by(.data$CFR) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(used_cm_days = sum(.data$used_cm_days_month),
      unused_cm_days = pmax(0, .data$available_cm_days - .data$used_cm_days),
      scenario_annual_days = sum(.data$days_scenario)) %>% dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(scenario_id = context$scenario$scenario_id,
      scenario_year = context$scenario$scenario_year,
      representative_period = context$scenario$representative_period,
      member_state = context$scenario$member_state, cm_status = context$scenario$cm_status,
      method = method, replicate = replicate_id, .before = 1)
  if (any(out$used_cm_days > out$available_cm_days + 1e-7) ||
      any(out$days_scenario > context$scenario$parameters$max_days_per_month + 1e-7) ||
      any(out$scenario_annual_days < out$conditioned_baseline_annual_days - 1e-7)) {
    smart31_stop("Realised CM uptake violates conditioned baseline, authorisation or monthly capacity.")
  }
  out
}

smart31_realised_cm_audit <- function(context, days) {
  if (!nrow(context$cm_allocation_audit)) return(tibble::tibble())
  use <- days %>% dplyr::distinct(.data$CFR, .data$baseline_annual_days,
    .data$available_cm_days, .data$used_cm_days, .data$unused_cm_days, .data$scenario_annual_days,
    .data$method, .data$replicate)
  old <- context$cm_allocation_audit

  old <- old %>% dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of(setdiff(names(use), "CFR")))
  dplyr::left_join(old, use, by = "CFR", relationship = "many-to-one")
}
```

```{r step2-22-run-one-simulation}

rehydrate_final_evaluations <- function(
  optimised,
  context,
  method,
  replicate_id
) {
  unit_ids <- names(optimised$state$share_by_unit)
  evaluations <- vector("list", length(unit_ids))
  names(evaluations) <- unit_ids

  smart31_monitor_event(
    event = "final_output_reconstruction_started",
    phase = "final_output_reconstruction",
    scenario_id = context$scenario$scenario_id,
    method = method,
    replicate = replicate_id,
    unit_index = 0L,
    units_in_stage = length(unit_ids),
    note = "reconstructing full activity and catch tables once"
  )

  for (unit_position in seq_along(unit_ids)) {
    unit_id <- unit_ids[[unit_position]]
    state_unit <- context$unit_kernels[[unit_id]]$data
    state_unit$share <- smart31_set_extra(
      optimised$state$share_by_unit[[unit_id]],
      smart31_extra_days(optimised$state$share_by_unit[[unit_id]]))
    evaluations[[unit_position]] <- evaluate_vessel_month_full(
      state_unit,
      unit_id,
      context
    )
    if (!isTRUE(evaluations[[unit_position]]$valid)) {
      smart31_stop(
        "The final full evaluation failed for ", unit_id, ": ",
        evaluations[[unit_position]]$issue %||% "unknown issue"
      )
    }

    light_gva <- optimised$state$evaluation_by_unit[[unit_id]]$
      economic$GVA[[1L]]
    full_gva <- evaluations[[unit_position]]$economic$GVA[[1L]]
    if (!isTRUE(all.equal(light_gva, full_gva, tolerance = 1e-8))) {
      smart31_stop(
        "Lightweight and full final GVA differ for vessel-month ",
        unit_id, "."
      )
    }

    if (unit_position %% monitor_update_every_units == 0L ||
        unit_position == length(unit_ids)) {
      smart31_monitor_event(
        event = "final_output_reconstruction_progress",
        phase = "final_output_reconstruction",
        scenario_id = context$scenario$scenario_id,
        method = method,
        replicate = replicate_id,
        unit_index = unit_position,
        units_in_stage = length(unit_ids),
        note = paste0("last reconstructed unit ", unit_id)
      )
    }
  }
  evaluations
}

assemble_final_outputs <- function(optimised, context, method, replicate_id) {
  evaluations <- rehydrate_final_evaluations(
    optimised,
    context,
    method,
    replicate_id
  )

  accounting <- smart31_final_economics(evaluations, context, method, replicate_id)
  economic_monthly <- accounting$monthly
  economic_annual <- accounting$annual

  initial_values <- context$initial_economic_monthly %>%
    dplyr::select(.data$unit_id, initial_GVA = .data$GVA, initial_GVL = .data$GVL,
      initial_EC = .data$EC, initial_days = .data$days_at_sea)
  economic_monthly <- economic_monthly %>% dplyr::left_join(initial_values,
    by = "unit_id", relationship = "one-to-one") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(delta_GVA_vs_conditioned_initial = .data$GVA - .data$initial_GVA,
      historical_GVA_is_unchanged_Step1_model_reference = TRUE)
  initial_annual <- context$initial_economic_monthly %>% dplyr::group_by(.data$CFR) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(initial_GVA = sum(.data$GVA), initial_GVL = sum(.data$GVL),
      initial_EC = sum(.data$EC), initial_days = sum(.data$days_at_sea), .groups = "drop")
  economic_annual <- economic_annual %>% dplyr::left_join(initial_annual,
    by = "CFR", relationship = "one-to-one") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(delta_GVA_vs_conditioned_initial = .data$GVA - .data$initial_GVA)

  activity <- purrr::map_dfr(
    evaluations,
    ~ .x$activity %>%
      dplyr::filter(.data$effort > 1e-12 | .data$days_at_sea > 1e-12)
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      scenario_id = context$scenario$scenario_id,
      scenario_year = context$scenario$scenario_year,
      representative_period = context$scenario$representative_period,
      member_state = context$scenario$member_state,
      cm_status = context$scenario$cm_status,
      method = method,
      replicate = replicate_id,
      .before = 1
    )

  trip_time_audit <- activity %>% dplyr::group_by(.data$CFR, .data$MONTH, .data$Gear) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(days = sum(.data$days_at_sea), trips = sum(.data$trips),
      fishing_hours = sum(.data$fishing_time), steaming_hours = sum(.data$steaming_time),
      maximum_trip_duration_h = max(.data$trip_duration_h),
      minimum_fishing_h_per_trip = min(.data$fishing_h_per_trip),
      maximum_navigation_fraction = max(.data$navigation_fraction), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(compatible = .data$maximum_trip_duration_h < 24 &
      .data$maximum_trip_duration_h <= context$working_baseline_controls$trip_limit_hours + 1e-8 &
      .data$maximum_navigation_fraction <= context$working_baseline_controls$max_navigation_fraction + 1e-8)
  if (!all(trip_time_audit$compatible)) stop("Final destination-level trip audit failed.")
  trip_time_audit <- smart31_working_tag(trip_time_audit, context$scenario, "final")
  trip_time_audit$method <- method; trip_time_audit$replicate <- replicate_id
  smart31_working_write(trip_time_audit, paste0("final_trip_time_audit_", method, "_rep", replicate_id),
    context$scenario$scenario_id)

  spatial_pattern <- activity %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      .data$scenario_id,
      .data$scenario_year,
      .data$representative_period,
      representative_year_start = dplyr::if_else(
        .data$representative_period == .smart31_case$periods$baseline,
        .smart31_years$baseline,
        .smart31_years$future_start
      ),
      representative_year_end = dplyr::if_else(
        .data$representative_period == .smart31_case$periods$baseline,
        .smart31_years$baseline,
        .smart31_years$future_end
      ),
      .data$member_state,
      .data$cm_status,
      .data$method,
      .data$replicate,
      .data$CFR,
      .data$MONTH,
      .data$Gear,
      .data$Metier,
      .data$harbour,
      .data$loa,
      .data$id_grid,
      .data$GSA_code,
      .data$depth_m,
      spatial_share = .data$combined_share,
      spatial_share_definition = "daily_trip_allocation_share_within_gear",
      days_at_sea = .data$days_at_sea,
      trips = .data$trips,
      fishing_hours = .data$fishing_time,
      steaming_hours = .data$steaming_time,
      trip_duration_h = .data$trip_duration_h,
      fishing_h_per_trip = .data$fishing_h_per_trip,
      navigation_h_per_trip = .data$navigation_h_per_trip,
      navigation_fraction = .data$navigation_fraction,
      trip_reserved_h = .data$trip_reserved_h,
      trip_definition = "synthetic_daily_trip_equivalent",
      effort = .data$effort,
      effort_definition = "vessel_LOA_m_x_fishing_hour",
      pattern_scope = "representative_optimised_activity_supported_effort"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      .data$scenario_id,
      .data$method,
      .data$replicate,
      .data$CFR,
      .data$MONTH,
      .data$Gear,
      .data$Metier,
      .data$id_grid
    )

  catches_activity_supported <- purrr::map_dfr(
    evaluations,
    ~ .x$catches %>%
      dplyr::filter(.data$W > 1e-12)
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      scenario_id = context$scenario$scenario_id,
      scenario_year = context$scenario$scenario_year,
      representative_period = context$scenario$representative_period,
      member_state = context$scenario$member_state,
      cm_status = context$scenario$cm_status,
      method = method,
      replicate = replicate_id,
      .before = 1
    )

  catches_non_vms <- context$non_vms_reference %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      scenario_id = context$scenario$scenario_id,
      scenario_year = context$scenario$scenario_year,
      representative_period = context$scenario$representative_period,
      member_state = context$scenario$member_state,
      cm_status = context$scenario$cm_status,
      method = method,
      replicate = replicate_id,
      .before = 1
    )

  catches <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    catches_activity_supported %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        simulation_treatment =
          "activity_supported_spatial_lpue_production"
      ),
    catches_non_vms
  )

  final_species_catch <- stats::setNames(
    numeric(length(context$diagnostic_species)),
    context$diagnostic_species
  )
  if (length(final_species_catch) > 0L && nrow(catches) > 0L) {
    final_species_table <- catches %>%
      dplyr::filter(.data$Species %in% names(final_species_catch)) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(.data$Species) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(catch_kg = sum(.data$W), .groups = "drop")
    final_species_catch[final_species_table$Species] <-
      final_species_table$catch_kg
  }
  final_convergence_row <- optimised$convergence_log %>%
    dplyr::slice_tail(n = 1L)
  logged_species_catch <- stats::setNames(
    vapply(
      names(final_species_catch),
      function(species) {
        final_convergence_row[[
          smart31_species_metric_name(species)
        ]][[1L]]
      },
      numeric(1)
    ),
    names(final_species_catch)
  )
  if (!isTRUE(all.equal(
        final_species_catch,
        logged_species_catch,
        tolerance = 1e-8,
        check.attributes = TRUE
      ))) {
    smart31_stop(
      "Final full catches do not reconcile with sweep diagnostics."
    )
  }

  final_effort_check <- evaluate_effort_quota_compatibility(
    activity %>% dplyr::group_by(.data$CFR, .data$MONTH, .data$Gear) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(days_scenario_gear = sum(.data$days_at_sea), .groups = "drop"),
    context$retained_vessels, context$scenario)
  if (!isTRUE(final_effort_check$feasible)) smart31_stop("Realised final effort quota exceeded.")
  if (!smart31_state_feasible(optimised$state, context)) smart31_stop("Final state violates a joint constraint.")
  realised_days <- smart31_realised_day_audit(context, optimised$state, method, replicate_id)

  final_quota_catch <- smart31_quota_catches(catches, context$quota_species)

  if (!isTRUE(all.equal(
        final_quota_catch,
        optimised$state$catch_index,
        tolerance = 1e-8,
        check.attributes = TRUE
      ))) {
    smart31_stop(
      "Final full catches do not reconcile with incremental quota accounting."
    )
  }
  final_catch_quota_audit <- catch_quota_audit(
    final_quota_catch,
    context$catch_quota_limits
  )
  if (nrow(final_catch_quota_audit) > 0L &&
      !all(final_catch_quota_audit$compatible)) {
    smart31_stop("A final catch-quota limit was exceeded.")
  }

  list(
    economic_monthly = economic_monthly,
    economic_annual = economic_annual,
    initial_economic_monthly = context$initial_economic_monthly,
    baseline_initialisation_audit = context$baseline_initialisation_audit,
    trip_time_audit = trip_time_audit,
    spatial_pattern = spatial_pattern,
    catches = catches,
    occupancy = combine_occupancy(evaluations),
    catch_quota_audit = final_catch_quota_audit %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        scenario_id = context$scenario$scenario_id,
        scenario_year = context$scenario$scenario_year,
        representative_period = context$scenario$representative_period,
        method = method,
        replicate = replicate_id,
        .before = 1
      ),
    day_allocations = realised_days,
    cm_allocation_audit = smart31_realised_cm_audit(context, realised_days),
    constraint_diagnostics = smart31_failure_details(optimised$state, context),
    effort_quota_audit = final_effort_check$audit %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        scenario_id = context$scenario$scenario_id,
        scenario_year = context$scenario$scenario_year,
        representative_period = context$scenario$representative_period,
        method = method,
        replicate = replicate_id,
        .before = 1
      ),
    convergence = optimised$convergence_log,
    stability = tibble::tibble(
      unit_id = names(optimised$stability),
      consecutive_non_improvements = as.integer(optimised$stability)
    ),
    accepted_updates = optimised$accepted_updates,
    converged = optimised$converged
  )
}

smart31_completed_run_file <- function(
  scenario_id,
  method,
  replicate_id
) {
  run_key <- gsub(
    "[^A-Za-z0-9_-]+",
    "_",
    paste(
      scenario_id,
      method,
      paste0("rep", sprintf("%03d", as.integer(replicate_id))),
      sep = "__"
    )
  )
  file.path(
    simulation_output_directory,
    paste0("SMART31_step24_completed_", run_key, ".rds")
  )
}

smart31_run_seed <- function(context, method, replicate_id) {
  as.integer(context$scenario$parameters$seed) +
    10000L * as.integer(replicate_id) +
    match(method, c("bayesian_dirichlet", "stochastic_optimizer"))
}

smart31_load_completed_run <- function(context, method, replicate_id) {
  if (!resume_incomplete_run || !monitor_checkpoint_completed_runs) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  completed_file <- smart31_completed_run_file(
    context$scenario$scenario_id,
    method,
    replicate_id
  )
  if (!file.exists(completed_file)) return(NULL)
  archive <- tryCatch(readRDS(completed_file), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(archive) || is.null(archive$metadata) ||
      is.null(archive$run)) return(NULL)
  metadata <- archive$metadata
  valid <- identical(
    metadata$format_version,
    "SMART31_step24_completed_run_v1"
  ) && identical(metadata$scientific_source_md5, scientific_source_md5) && identical(
    as.character(metadata$step1_bundle_md5),
    as.character(configured_bundle_md5)
  ) && identical(
    as.character(metadata$catch_quota_file_md5),
    as.character(catch_quota_file_md5)
  ) && identical(
    as.character(metadata$effort_quota_file_md5),
    as.character(effort_quota_file_md5)
  ) && identical(metadata$scenario_contract, context$scenario) &&
    identical(as.character(metadata$method), as.character(method)) &&
    identical(as.integer(metadata$replicate), as.integer(replicate_id)) &&
    identical(
      as.integer(metadata$seed),
      as.integer(smart31_run_seed(context, method, replicate_id))
    )
  if (!valid || identical(archive$run$issue, "run_aborted_with_error")) return(NULL)

  smart31_monitor_event(
    event = "completed_run_reused",
    phase = "checkpoint",
    scenario_id = context$scenario$scenario_id,
    method = method,
    replicate = replicate_id,
    note = basename(completed_file)
  )
  archive$run
}

run_one_simulation <- function(context, method, replicate_id) {
  seed <- smart31_run_seed(context, method, replicate_id)

  workers_for_run <- smart31_start_parallel_run(context)
  on.exit(smart31_stop_parallel_run(), add = TRUE)
  set.seed(seed)

  run_finished <- FALSE
  on.exit({
    if (!run_finished) {
      smart31_monitor_event(
        event = "run_ended_abnormally",
        phase = "interrupted_or_error",
        scenario_id = context$scenario$scenario_id,
        method = method,
        replicate = replicate_id,
        note = paste0(
          "the last completed position is retained in the live event log; seed ",
          seed
        )
      )
    }
  }, add = TRUE)

  smart31_monitor_event(
    event = "run_started",
    phase = "initialisation",
    scenario_id = context$scenario$scenario_id,
    method = method,
    replicate = replicate_id,
    maximum_sweeps = as.integer(
      context$scenario$parameters$maximum_sweeps
    ),
    note = paste0(
      "seed ", seed,
      "; evaluation workers ", workers_for_run,
      if (parallel_enabled) "" else "; memory-safe sequential default"
    )
  )

  resume_payload <- smart31_load_search_checkpoint(
    context,
    method,
    replicate_id,
    seed
  )

  if (is.null(resume_payload)) {
    initial <- initialise_scenario_state(
      context,
      method,
      replicate_id
    )
    if (!isTRUE(initial$feasible)) {
      result <- list(
        feasible = FALSE,
        method = method,
        replicate = replicate_id,
        seed = seed,
        stage = "initialisation",
        issue = initial$issue,
        diagnostic = initial$diagnostic %||% NULL
      )
      run_finished <- TRUE
      smart31_monitor_event(
        event = "run_infeasible",
        phase = "initialisation",
        scenario_id = context$scenario$scenario_id,
        method = method,
        replicate = replicate_id,
        note = initial$issue
      )
      return(result)
    }

    repaired <- repair_crowding(
      initial,
      context,
      method,
      replicate_id
    )
    if (!isTRUE(repaired$feasible)) {
      result <- list(
        feasible = FALSE,
        method = method,
        replicate = replicate_id,
        seed = seed,
        stage = "feasibility_repair",
        issue = "no_jointly_feasible_state_found_within_repair_budget",
        constraint_diagnostics = repaired$constraint_diagnostics,
        diagnostic = repaired$repair_log,
        remaining_violation_score = repaired$remaining_violation_score,
        catch_quota_audit = repaired$catch_quota_audit %||% NULL
      )
      run_finished <- TRUE
      smart31_monitor_event(
        event = "run_infeasible",
        phase = "feasibility_repair",
        scenario_id = context$scenario$scenario_id,
        method = method,
        replicate = replicate_id,
        violation_score = repaired$remaining_violation_score,
        note = "no crowding- and catch-quota-feasible state found"
      )
      return(result)
    }
    feasible_state <- repaired$state
    repair_log <- repaired$repair_log
  } else {
    feasible_state <- resume_payload$state
    repair_log <- tibble::tibble()
  }

  optimised <- optimise_scenario_state(
    feasible_state,
    context,
    method,
    replicate_id,
    seed = seed,
    resume_payload = resume_payload
  )

  result <- list(
    feasible = TRUE,
    seed = seed,
    method = method,
    replicate = replicate_id,
    feasibility_repair_log = repair_log,
    outputs = assemble_final_outputs(
      optimised,
      context,
      method,
      replicate_id
    )
  )

  run_finished <- TRUE
  result
}
```

```{r step2-23-regression-tests}
smart31_initial_regression_tests <- function() {
  e <- new.env(parent = environment(smart31_initial_regression_tests))
  names_to_copy <- c("smart31_condition_working_reference", "smart31_daily_route", "smart31_working_clock", "smart31_rescale_effort_segments",

    "occupancy_relative_violation_score", "occupancy_tables_equivalent")

  ar <- tibble::tibble(CFR = c("A", "B"), MONTH = 1L, Gear = "OTB", Metier = "OTB_T",

  fl <- list(vessel_profile = tibble::tibble(CFR = c("A", "B"), harbour = "P1"))
  ds <- tibble::tibble(harbour = c("P1", "P2", "P1", "P2"), id_grid = c("1", "1", "2", "2"),
    distance_km = c(200, 20, 20, 10))
  conditioned_ref <- e$smart31_condition_working_reference(ar, tr, fl, ds,
    tibble::tibble(id_grid = c("1", "2"), GSA_code = "GSA09"), 20)
  stopifnot(identical(conditioned_ref$fleet$vessel_profile$harbour, c("P2", "P1")),
    all(conditioned_ref$time$days_reference == c(25, 10)),
    all(conditioned_ref$time$trips_reference == c(25, 10)), all(ar$harbour == "P1"),
    all(tr$trips_reference == c(1, 10)))

  r <- e$smart31_daily_route(c(20, 180), c(18, 18), 20, p)
  stopifnot(r$valid[1], !r$valid[2], r$duration[1] < 24)

  g <- tibble::tibble(CFR = "A", MONTH = 1L, Gear = c("OTB", "LLS"),
    days_scenario_gear = c(8, 2), days_scenario = 10, scenario_trips = c(8, 2),
    daily_activity_budget_h = c(18, 16), fishing_time_reference_scenario = c(96, 20),
    steaming_time_reference_scenario = c(24, 6), fishing_time_elasticity = 0.5,

    GVL_other_reference_month = c(30, 10), EC_share = 0.2, OC_share = 0.1, LC_share = 0.2,
    unit_id = "A::01")
  d <- tibble::tibble(CFR = "A", MONTH = 1L, Gear = rep(c("OTB", "LLS"), each = 2L),
    Metier = rep(c("OTB_TEST", "LLS_TEST"), each = 2L), id_grid = rep(c("1", "2"), 2L),
    GSA_code = "GSA09", harbour = "P", loa = 20, depth_m = 100,
    distance_km = rep(c(20, 40), 2L), metier_share = 1, initial_share = 0.5, peer_share = 0.5,
    allocation_units = 4L, posterior_alpha = 1, unit_id = "A::01",
```
