```{r step2-23-regression-tests}
  ctx <- list(steaming_speed_kmh = 20, working_baseline_controls = p)
  a <- e$smart31_working_clock(d, g, rep(0.5, 4), ctx)
  ghalf <- g
  for (nm in c("days_scenario_gear", "scenario_trips")) ghalf[[nm]] <- ghalf[[nm]] / 2
  ahalf <- e$smart31_working_clock(d, ghalf, rep(0.5, 4), ctx)
  stopifnot(a$valid, ahalf$valid, max(a$trip_duration) <= 23.5,
    max(a$navigation_fraction) <= 0.6,
    isTRUE(all.equal(a$row_fishing / 2, ahalf$row_fishing)),
    isTRUE(all.equal(a$trip_duration, ahalf$trip_duration)))
  scenario <- list(scenario_id = "TEST", representative_period = .smart31_case$periods$future,
    cm_status = "without_cm", scenario_year = .smart31_years$future_start, member_state = .smart31_case$domain$country,
    parameters = list(max_days_per_month = 25, landing_price_multiplier = 1), selectivity_rules = list())
  e$italian_effort_quotas <- tidyr::crossing(YEAR = .smart31_years$future,
    tibble::tibble(Gear = "OTB", length_class = c("SMALL", "MEDIUM", "LARGE"),
      min_loa_m = c(12, 18, 24), max_loa_m = c(17.99, 23.99, Inf),
      effort_quota_days = c(200, 60, 0))) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(effort_quota_days = ifelse(.data$YEAR == .smart31_years$future_end & .data$length_class == "MEDIUM", 40,
      .data$effort_quota_days), effort_quota_id = paste(.data$YEAR, .data$Gear, .data$length_class, sep = "::"))
  vessels <- tibble::tibble(CFR = c("A", "B", "C"), loa = c(15, 20, 26))
  segment_days <- tibble::tibble(CFR = c("A", "B", "C", "A"), MONTH = 1L,
    Gear = c("OTB", "OTB", "OTB", "LLS"), days_scenario_gear = c(100, 100, 50, 12))
  scaled <- e$smart31_rescale_effort_segments(segment_days, vessels, scenario)
  stopifnot(scaled$feasible,
    isTRUE(all.equal(scaled$gear$days_scenario_gear, c(100, 39.2, 0, 12))),
    all(scaled$quota_check$audit$compatible))
  day <- tibble::tibble(CFR = c("A", "A", "B", "B"), MONTH = c(1L, 2L, 1L, 2L),
    days_reference = c(15, 10, 10, 10), baseline_annual_days = c(25, 25, 20, 20), available_cm_days = c(5, 5, 3, 3))
  gd <- tibble::tibble(CFR = c("A", "A", "A"), MONTH = c(1L, 1L, 2L), Gear = c("OTB", "LLS", "OTB"),
    days_scenario_gear = c(8, 2, 5))
  refreshed <- e$smart31_refresh_working_days(day, gd, scenario)
  stopifnot(nrow(refreshed) == 4L, all(refreshed$days_scenario == c(10, 5, 0, 0)),
    abs(sum(refreshed$cm_capacity_month) - 5) < 1e-8,
    all(refreshed$conditioned_baseline_annual_days == c(15, 15, 0, 0)))

  e$lpue_reference <- tidyr::crossing(MONTH = 1L, GSA_code = "GSA09", Gear = c("OTB", "LLS"),
    id_grid = c("1", "2"), Species = c("HKE", "ARS")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(lpue_reference = ifelse(.data$Species == "HKE", 0.1, 0.05), n_positive_years = 1L)
  e$price_reference <- tibble::tibble(Species = c("HKE", "ARS"), GSA = "GSA09", price_reference = c(5, 10), n_price_years = 1L)
  e$economic_rates_reference <- g %>% dplyr::select(.data$CFR, .data$Gear, .data$EC_share, .data$OC_share, .data$LC_share)
  rates <- e$build_scenario_cell_rates(d, scenario, c("HKE", "ARS"))
  k <- e$build_unit_kernel(rates$candidates)
  k$local_key <- paste(k$data$MONTH, k$data$Gear, k$data$id_grid, sep = "::")
  ctx$scenario <- scenario; ctx$gear_time <- g; ctx$gear_search_by_unit <- list("A::01" = g)
  ctx$unit_kernels <- list("A::01" = k); ctx$cm_capacity <- c("A::01" = 5)
  ctx$revenue_rate <- rates$revenue_rate; ctx$catch_rate <- rates$catch_rate
  ctx$catch_species <- rates$catch_species; ctx$quota_species <- rates$quota_species
  ctx$fuel_price <- 0.7; ctx$retained_vessels <- tibble::tibble(CFR = "A", loa = 20)
  ctx$other_gvl_monthly <- g %>% dplyr::select(.data$CFR, .data$MONTH, .data$Gear, .data$GVL_other_reference_month)
  ctx$effort_quota_table <- e$italian_effort_quotas
  for (extra in c(0, 2.5, 5)) {
    share <- e$smart31_set_extra(rep(0.5, 4), extra)
    light <- e$evaluate_vessel_month_light(share, "A::01", ctx)
    full_data <- k$data; full_data$share <- share
    full <- e$evaluate_vessel_month_full(full_data, "A::01", ctx)
    fields <- c("days_at_sea", "trips", "fishing_time", "steaming_time",
      "steaming_distance_km", "mean_distance_km", "GVL_6sp", "GVL_other_reference",
      "GVL", "EC", "fuel_fishing_l", "fuel_steaming_l", "EC_fishing", "EC_steaming",
      "OC", "LC", "GVA", "GP")

    stopifnot(light$valid, full$valid,
      isTRUE(all.equal(unlist(light$economic[fields]), unlist(full$economic[fields]), tolerance = 1e-8)),
      isTRUE(all.equal(light$catch_kg, full$catch_kg, tolerance = 1e-8)),
      all(full$activity$trip_duration_h < 24), all(full$activity$navigation_fraction <= 0.6 + 1e-8))
    for (ev in list(light, full)) {
      ec <- ev$economic
      stopifnot(
        isTRUE(all.equal(ec$EC, ec$EC_fishing + ec$EC_steaming, tolerance = 1e-8)),
        isTRUE(all.equal(ec$EC_fishing, ctx$fuel_price * ec$fuel_fishing_l, tolerance = 1e-8)),
        isTRUE(all.equal(ec$EC_steaming, ctx$fuel_price * ec$fuel_steaming_l, tolerance = 1e-8)))
    }
  }

  ctx$feasible <- TRUE
  ctx$catch_quota_limits <- tibble::tibble(YEAR = .smart31_years$future_start, Species = c("ARS", "HKE"), quota_kg = c(100, 180))
  ctx$fixed_non_vms_quota_catch <- c(ARS = 1, HKE = 2)
  ctx$local_limits <- stats::setNames(rep(500, 4), k$local_key)
  ctx$effort_limits <- stats::setNames(ctx$effort_quota_table$effort_quota_days, ctx$effort_quota_table$effort_quota_id)
  ctx$crowding_limit <- 800
  ctx$day_allocations <- tibble::tibble(CFR = "A", MONTH = 1L, days_reference = 10,
    baseline_annual_days = 10, available_cm_days = 5)
  ctx$economic_reference <- tibble::tibble(unit_id = "A::01", CFR = "A", MONTH = 1L,
    GVL_6sp = 1500, GVL_other_reference = 40, GVL = 1540, EC = 500, OC = 154, LC = 308, GVA = 886, GP = 578)
  ctx$cessation_reference <- ctx$economic_reference[0, ]
  conditioned <- e$smart31_condition_joint_context(ctx)
  state <- e$smart31_working_state(conditioned)
  stopifnot(conditioned$feasible, e$smart31_state_feasible(state, conditioned),
    isTRUE(conditioned$working_baseline_conditioned),
    sum(conditioned$gear_time$days_scenario_gear) <= sum(g$days_scenario_gear),
    identical(e$smart31_condition_joint_context(conditioned), conditioned))
  invisible(TRUE)
}

smart31_internal_tests <- function() {
  e <- c(1, 4, 2); catches_test <- c(20, 0, 10); weight <- 0.25
  rate <- weight * catches_test / e + (1 - weight) * sum(catches_test) / sum(e)
  stopifnot(abs(sum(e * rate) - sum(catches_test)) < 1e-10)
  x <- vector("list", 2); x[1] <- list(NULL); x[2] <- list(list(feasible = FALSE))
  stopifnot(length(x) == 2, isFALSE(x[[2]]$feasible))
  share <- smart31_set_extra(c(0.3, 0.7), 2)
  stopifnot(identical(smart31_extra_days(share), 2), sum(share) == 1)
  t <- tibble::tibble(days_scenario_gear = c(8, 2), scenario_trips = c(4, 1),
    fishing_time_reference_scenario = c(60, 10), steaming_time_reference_scenario = c(20, 5))
  t2 <- smart31_scale_unit_time(t, 2)
  stopifnot(abs(sum(t2$days_scenario_gear) - 12) < 1e-10,
    abs(sum(t2$scenario_trips) - 6) < 1e-10)

  qf <- 72.8; qs <- 66; lambda <- 0.5; delta_steaming <- 20
  fuel0 <- qf * 100 + qs * 40
  fuel1 <- qf * (100 - lambda * delta_steaming) + qs * (40 + delta_steaming)
  stopifnot(abs((fuel1 - fuel0) - (qs - lambda * qf) * delta_steaming) < 1e-8)
  total <- c(a = 10, b = 4)
  stopifnot(identical(smart31_named_add(total, c(a = 3), -1), c(a = 7, b = 4)))
  stopifnot(smart31_bound_score(c(a = 0), c(a = 0)) == 0,
    smart31_bound_score(c(a = 1), c(a = 0)) > 0,
    smart31_bound_score(c(a = 100), c(a = Inf)) == 0)

  ref <- tibble::tibble(unit_id = c("A::01", "A::10", "B::01"),
    CFR = c("A", "A", "B"), MONTH = c(1L, 10L, 1L),
    GVL_6sp = c(200, 300, 150), GVL_other_reference = 0,
    GVL = c(200, 300, 150), EC = c(20, 30, 15), OC = 0, LC = 0,
    GVA = c(180, 270, 135), GP = c(180, 270, 135))
  ctx <- list(economic_reference = ref[1:2, ], cessation_reference = ref[3, ],
    removed_cfr = "B", unit_kernels = list("A::01" = list()),
    gear_search_by_unit = list("A::01" = tibble::tibble(days_scenario_gear = 10)),
    scenario = list(scenario_id = "test", scenario_year = .smart31_years$baseline,
      representative_period = .smart31_case$periods$baseline, member_state = .smart31_case$domain$country, cm_status = "with_cm"))
  ev <- list(economic = tibble::tibble(unit_id = "A::01", CFR = "A", MONTH = 1L,
    days_at_sea = 10, trips = 5, fishing_time = 70, steaming_time = 20,
    steaming_distance_km = 100, mean_distance_km = 10,
    fuel_fishing_l = 20, fuel_steaming_l = 5, EC_fishing = 20, EC_steaming = 5,
    W = 100, GVL_6sp = 210, GVL_other_reference = 0, GVL = 210,
    EC = 25, OC = 0, LC = 0, GVA = 185, GP = 185))
  accounting <- smart31_final_economics(list(ev), ctx, "test", 1L)
  stopifnot(sum(accounting$annual$reference_GVA) == 585,
    sum(accounting$annual$GVA) == 185,
    accounting$monthly$reference_GVA[accounting$monthly$CFR == "B"] == 135,
    accounting$monthly$reference_GVA[accounting$monthly$unit_id == "A::10"] == 270)
  invisible(TRUE)
}

smart31_write_preflight_failure <- function(context, unit_id, share, light, full,
                                           checks, tolerance = 1e-8) {
  root <- if (exists("simulation_output_directory", inherits = TRUE)) {
    get("simulation_output_directory", inherits = TRUE)
  } else {
    file.path("outputs", "step2_simulations")
  }
  parent <- file.path(root, "preflight_diagnostics")
  dir.create(parent, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  if (!dir.exists(parent)) stop("Cannot create preflight diagnostic directory: ", parent)
  safe_name <- function(x) gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_-]+", "_", as.character(x))
  prefix <- paste0(safe_name(context$scenario$scenario_id), "__", safe_name(unit_id),
                   "__", format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S"), "_")
  directory <- tempfile(pattern = prefix, tmpdir = parent)
  if (!dir.create(directory)) stop("Cannot create diagnostic directory: ", directory)
  put_csv <- function(x, name) {
    utils::write.csv(x, file.path(directory, paste0(name, ".csv")),
                     row.names = FALSE, na = "")
  }
  comparison_message <- function(x, y) {
    answer <- all.equal(x, y, tolerance = tolerance, check.attributes = TRUE)
    if (isTRUE(answer)) "TRUE" else paste(as.character(answer), collapse = " | ")
  }
  scalar <- function(table, field) {
    if (!is.data.frame(table) || !field %in% names(table) || nrow(table) != 1L ||
        !is.numeric(table[[field]])) return(NA_real_)
    as.numeric(table[[field]][1L])
  }
  number_text <- function(x) {
    vapply(x, function(z) format(z, digits = 17L, scientific = TRUE, trim = TRUE), character(1))
  }
  fields <- c("days_at_sea", "trips", "fishing_time", "steaming_time",
              "GVL_6sp", "GVL", "EC", "EC_fishing", "EC_steaming",
              "fuel_fishing_l", "fuel_steaming_l", "OC", "LC", "GVA", "GP")
  extra_fields <- c("GVL_other_reference", "steaming_distance_km", "mean_distance_km")
  economic <- data.frame(
    field = c(fields, extra_fields),
    included_in_original_test = c(rep(TRUE, length(fields)), rep(FALSE, length(extra_fields))),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  economic$light <- vapply(economic$field, function(nm) scalar(light$economic, nm), numeric(1))
  economic$full <- vapply(economic$field, function(nm) scalar(full$economic, nm), numeric(1))
  economic$light_minus_full <- economic$light - economic$full
  economic$light_17_digits <- number_text(economic$light)
  economic$full_17_digits <- number_text(economic$full)

  economic$scalar_all_equal <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(economic)), function(i) {
    if (anyNA(c(economic$light[i], economic$full[i]))) return("missing_or_non_numeric_field")
    comparison_message(economic$light[i], economic$full[i])
  }, character(1))
  put_csv(economic, "economic_comparison")

  vector_table <- function(x, y) {
    keys <- union(names(x), names(y))
    if (is.null(keys)) keys <- character()
    data.frame(key = keys, light = as.numeric(x[keys]), full = as.numeric(y[keys]),
               light_minus_full = as.numeric(x[keys]) - as.numeric(y[keys]),
               present_in_light = keys %in% names(x), present_in_full = keys %in% names(y),
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }
  put_csv(vector_table(light$catch_kg, full$catch_kg), "catch_comparison")
  put_csv(vector_table(light$quota_catch_kg, full$quota_catch_kg), "quota_catch_comparison")
  to_occupancy <- function(x, label) {
    if (!is.data.frame(x) || !all(c("MONTH", "id_grid", "effort") %in% names(x))) {
      out <- data.frame(MONTH = integer(), id_grid = character(), value = numeric())
    } else {
      out <- data.frame(MONTH = as.integer(x$MONTH), id_grid = as.character(x$id_grid),
                        value = as.numeric(x$effort), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    }
    names(out)[3L] <- label
    out
  }
  occ <- merge(to_occupancy(light$occupancy, "light"), to_occupancy(full$occupancy, "full"),
               by = c("MONTH", "id_grid"), all = TRUE, sort = TRUE)
  occ$present_in_light <- !is.na(occ$light)
  occ$present_in_full <- !is.na(occ$full)
  occ$light_minus_full_zero_filled <- ifelse(is.na(occ$light), 0, occ$light) -
    ifelse(is.na(occ$full), 0, occ$full)
  occ$within_original_absolute_tolerance <- abs(occ$light_minus_full_zero_filled) <= tolerance
  put_csv(occ, "occupancy_comparison")

  nms <- names(checks)
  check_table <- data.frame(check = nms, passed = as.logical(checks),
                            stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  check_table$detail <- vapply(nms, function(nm) {
    switch(nm,
      validity = paste("light valid:", isTRUE(light$valid), "; full valid:", isTRUE(full$valid)),
      economics = comparison_message(as.numeric(unlist(light$economic[fields])),
                                     as.numeric(unlist(full$economic[fields]))),
      catches = comparison_message(light$catch_kg, full$catch_kg),
      occupancy = paste("Maximum absolute difference:",
        format(max(c(0, abs(occ$light_minus_full_zero_filled))), digits = 17L)),
      "See raw evaluator outputs in failure_case.rds")
  }, character(1))
  put_csv(check_table, "comparison_checks")

  kernel <- unserialize(serialize(context$unit_kernels[[unit_id]], NULL))
  unit_cfr <- unique(as.character(kernel$data$CFR))
  unit_month <- unique(as.integer(kernel$data$MONTH))
  full_time <- context$gear_time[as.character(context$gear_time$unit_id) == unit_id, , drop = FALSE]
  light_time <- context$gear_search_by_unit[[unit_id]]
  other <- context$other_gvl_monthly[
    as.character(context$other_gvl_monthly$CFR) %in% unit_cfr &
      as.integer(context$other_gvl_monthly$MONTH) %in% unit_month, , drop = FALSE]
  put_csv(full_time, "gear_time_full")
  put_csv(light_time, "gear_time_light")
  put_csv(other, "other_gvl_monthly")
  share_table <- kernel$data
  share_table$tested_share <- as.numeric(share)
  put_csv(share_table, "candidate_state")

  kept_rates <- sort(unique(as.integer(kernel$data$cell_rate_id)))
  if (anyNA(kept_rates) || any(kept_rates < 1L) ||
      any(kept_rates > length(context$revenue_rate)) ||
      any(kept_rates > nrow(context$catch_rate))) {
    stop("Invalid cached rate indexes; CSV diagnostics saved in ", directory)
  }
  kernel$data$cell_rate_id <- match(kernel$data$cell_rate_id, kept_rates)
  context_fields <- c("scenario", "working_baseline_controls", "steaming_speed_kmh",
                      "fuel_price", "catch_species", "quota_species", "effort_quota_table")
  compact <- context[context_fields]
  compact$gear_time <- full_time
  compact$gear_search_by_unit <- stats::setNames(list(light_time), unit_id)
  compact$unit_kernels <- stats::setNames(list(kernel), unit_id)
  compact$other_gvl_monthly <- other
  compact$cm_capacity <- context$cm_capacity[unit_id]
  compact$retained_vessels <- context$retained_vessels[
    as.character(context$retained_vessels$CFR) %in% unit_cfr, , drop = FALSE]
  compact$revenue_rate <- context$revenue_rate[kept_rates]
  compact$catch_rate <- context$catch_rate[kept_rates, , drop = FALSE]
  compact$quota_rate <- smart31_context_quota_rate(context)[kept_rates,,drop=FALSE]
  cell_keys <- c("MONTH", "GSA_code", "Gear", "id_grid")
  lpue_subset <- dplyr::semi_join(lpue_reference, unique(kernel$data[cell_keys]), by = cell_keys)
  price_subset <- dplyr::semi_join(price_reference,
    unique(lpue_subset[c("Species", "GSA_code")]), by = c("Species", "GSA" = "GSA_code"))
  economic_subset <- economic_rates_reference[
    as.character(economic_rates_reference$CFR) %in% unit_cfr, , drop = FALSE]
  function_names <- c("evaluate_vessel_month_light", "evaluate_vessel_month_full",
    "smart31_working_clock", "smart31_daily_route", "smart31_extra_days", "smart31_set_extra",
    "smart31_scale_unit_time", "smart31_sum_named", "smart31_effort_quota_vector",
    "normalise_positive", "one_value", "apply_selectivity_rules", "occupancy_tables_equivalent", "smart31_stop")
  sources <- stats::setNames(lapply(function_names, function(nm) {
    fn <- get(nm, mode = "function", inherits = TRUE)
    paste0(nm, " <- ", paste(deparse(fn, width.cutoff = 120L), collapse = "\n"))
  }), function_names)
  failure_case <- list(
    format_version = "SMART31_preflight_failure_v1",
    source_revision = "mixed-gear fuel breakdown correction",
    unit_id = unit_id, extra_days = smart31_extra_days(share), share = share,
    tolerance = tolerance, original_checks = checks,
    context = compact, original_cell_rate_ids = kept_rates,
    lpue_reference = lpue_subset, price_reference = price_subset,
    economic_rates_reference = economic_subset, function_sources = sources,
    light_original = light, full_original = full,
    session_info = utils::sessionInfo())
  saveRDS(failure_case, file.path(directory, "failure_case.rds"), compress = "gzip")
  capture.output(utils::sessionInfo(), file = file.path(directory, "sessionInfo.txt"))
  writeLines(c(
    "This folder documents a failed full/light equivalence check; no check was bypassed.",
    paste0("Scenario: ", context$scenario$scenario_id, "; unit: ", unit_id,
      "; optional CM days: ", smart31_extra_days(share)),
    "economic_comparison.csv: both values, signed difference, 17-digit text and per-field comparison.",
    "comparison_checks.csv contains the ORIGINAL acceptance tests; scalar messages are diagnostic only.",
    "failure_case.rds contains ONE unit, its required references, both outputs and the evaluator sources.",
    "Original cached rate row numbers are preserved separately; compact indexes preserve exact values.",
    "Step 1, quotas, simulation formulas and the original 1e-8 tolerance are unchanged."
  ), file.path(directory, "README.txt"))
  cat("\nSMART3.1 preflight comparison checks:\n")
  print(check_table, row.names = FALSE)
  cat("\nEconomic comparison (all fields):\n")
  print(economic[c("field", "light_17_digits", "full_17_digits", "light_minus_full")], row.names = FALSE)
  cat("\nPreflight diagnostic directory: ", normalizePath(directory), "\n", sep = "")
  normalizePath(directory)
}

smart31_preflight_context <- function(context) {
  if (!isTRUE(cfg$run_internal_tests) || !isTRUE(context$feasible)) return(invisible(NULL))

  signatures <- vapply(context$gear_search_by_unit, function(z)
    paste(sort(z$Gear), collapse = "+"), character(1))
  units <- names(signatures)[!duplicated(signatures)]
  report <- list()
  for (uid in units) {
    base <- context$unit_kernels[[uid]]$initial_share
    for (extra in unique(c(0, context$cm_capacity[[uid]] / 2, context$cm_capacity[[uid]]))) {
      share <- smart31_set_extra(base, extra)
      light <- evaluate_vessel_month_light(share, uid, context)
      full_state <- context$unit_kernels[[uid]]$data
      full_state$share <- share
      full <- evaluate_vessel_month_full(full_state, uid, context)
      same_validity <- identical(isTRUE(light$valid), isTRUE(full$valid))
      if (!isTRUE(light$valid) || !isTRUE(full$valid)) stop("Conditioned baseline preflight rejected a unit: ", uid)
      if (nrow(full$activity) && any(full$activity$trip_duration_h >= 24 |
          full$activity$trip_duration_h > context$working_baseline_controls$trip_limit_hours + 1e-8 |
          full$activity$navigation_fraction > context$working_baseline_controls$max_navigation_fraction + 1e-8))
        stop("Preflight failed destination-level physical limits.")
      econ_ok <- TRUE; catch_ok <- TRUE; occupancy_ok <- TRUE
      if (isTRUE(light$valid) && isTRUE(full$valid)) {
        fields <- c("days_at_sea", "trips", "fishing_time", "steaming_time", "GVL_6sp", "GVL",
          "EC", "EC_fishing", "EC_steaming", "fuel_fishing_l", "fuel_steaming_l", "OC", "LC", "GVA", "GP")
        econ_ok <- isTRUE(all.equal(as.numeric(unlist(light$economic[fields])),
          as.numeric(unlist(full$economic[fields])), tolerance = 1e-8))
        catch_ok <- isTRUE(all.equal(light$catch_kg, full$catch_kg, tolerance = 1e-8))
        occupancy_ok <- occupancy_tables_equivalent(light$occupancy, full$occupancy)
      }
      passed <- same_validity && econ_ok && catch_ok && occupancy_ok
      report[[length(report) + 1L]] <- tibble::tibble(scenario_id = context$scenario$scenario_id,
        unit_id = uid, extra_days = extra, physical_validity = isTRUE(light$valid),
        test_status = if (isTRUE(light$valid)) "numeric_comparison" else "both_rejected_physical_state",
        light_full_equivalence = passed)
      if (!passed) {

        diagnostic_directory <- tryCatch(
          smart31_write_preflight_failure(context, uid, share, light, full,
            checks = c(validity = same_validity, economics = econ_ok,
                       catches = catch_ok, occupancy = occupancy_ok), tolerance = 1e-8),
          error = function(condition) {
            cat("\nUnable to complete the preflight diagnostic export: ",
                conditionMessage(condition), "\n", sep = "")
            NA_character_
          })
        .smart31_surface$preflight <- dplyr::bind_rows(.smart31_surface$preflight, dplyr::bind_rows(report))
        failed_checks <- names(c(economics = econ_ok, catches = catch_ok,
                                occupancy = occupancy_ok))[!c(econ_ok, catch_ok, occupancy_ok)]
        smart31_stop("v5 preflight: light/full evaluator discrepancy at ", uid,
          ", extra days ", extra, ". Failed checks: ", paste(failed_checks, collapse = ", "),
          if (!is.na(diagnostic_directory)) paste0(". Diagnostic files: ", diagnostic_directory) else "",
          ". No equivalence check was disabled.")
      }
    }
  }
  .smart31_surface$preflight <- dplyr::bind_rows(.smart31_surface$preflight, dplyr::bind_rows(report))
  invisible(TRUE)
}
if (isTRUE(cfg$run_internal_tests)) {
  smart31_internal_tests()
  smart31_initial_regression_tests()
  cat("daily-clock, quota-conditioning, full/light and legacy algebraic and historical-accounting regression tests passed.\n")
}
```

## Coupled engine

```{r step2-24-coupled-engine}

smart31_response_on <- function(context = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(context)) return(isTRUE(context$v52$enabled))
  isTRUE(.smart31_response$enabled)
}

smart31_response_multiplier <- function(effort, reference, mode = "saturating", shape = 1.5) {
  if (length(effort) != length(reference) || any(!is.finite(effort)) ||
      any(!is.finite(reference)) || any(effort < -1e-8) || any(reference < 0))
    stop("Invalid local effort/reference in the production response.")
  if (!mode %in% c("none", "saturating")) stop("Unknown LPUE response mode: ", mode)
  if (mode == "none") return(rep(1, length(effort)))
  if (length(shape) != 1L || !is.finite(shape) || shape <= 0)
    stop("lpue_response_shape must be one finite positive value.")

  result <- rep(0, length(effort))
  supported <- reference > 0
  ratio <- pmax(0, effort[supported]) / reference[supported]
  excess <- pmax(0, ratio - 1)

  above <- ratio > 1
  value <- rep(1, length(ratio))
  value[above] <- (1 + shape / (1 + shape / excess[above])) / ratio[above]
  result[supported] <- value
  if (any(!is.finite(result)) || any(result < 0 | result > 1 + 1e-12))
    stop("Invalid LPUE response multiplier.")
  pmin(1, result)
}

smart31_response_close <- function(x, y, tolerance = 1e-8, label = "invariant") {
  x <- as.numeric(x); y <- as.numeric(y)
  if (length(x) != length(y) || any(!is.finite(x)) || any(!is.finite(y)) ||
      any(abs(x - y) > tolerance * pmax(1, abs(x), abs(y)))) stop(label, " failed.")
  invisible(TRUE)
}

smart31_response_write <- function(x, name, scenario = NULL) {
  root <- file.path(simulation_output_directory, "search_diagnostics_other_gvl")
  if (!is.null(scenario)) root <- file.path(root, gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_-]", "_", scenario))
  dir.create(root, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  if (!dir.exists(root)) stop("Cannot create diagnostic directory: ", root)
  utils::write.csv(x, file.path(root, paste0(name, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE, na = "")
  invisible(x)
}

smart31_response_attach <- function(context, reference = .smart31_response$historical_pressure,
                              controls = .smart31_response$controls) {
  if (!isTRUE(context$feasible)) return(context)
  pieces <- lapply(context$unit_kernels, function(k) unique(k$data[
    c("MONTH", "Gear", "id_grid", "GSA_code", "cell_rate_id")]))
  table <- unique(dplyr::bind_rows(pieces))
  table$key <- smart31_key(table$MONTH, table$Gear, table$id_grid)
  if (anyDuplicated(table$key)) stop("A pressure cell has more than one GSA/rate identity.")
  if (!nrow(table)) stop("No pressure cells available for the engine.")
  table <- table[order(table$key), , drop = FALSE]
  ref_key <- smart31_key(reference$MONTH, reference$Gear, reference$id_grid)
  if (anyDuplicated(ref_key)) stop("Duplicated historical pressure reference keys.")
  j <- match(table$key, ref_key)
  table$reference_effort <- reference$reference_effort[j]
  table$reference_effort[is.na(j)] <- 0
  if (any(!is.finite(table$reference_effort)) || any(table$reference_effort < 0))
    stop("Invalid historical pressure reference values.")
  table$reference_source <- ifelse(table$reference_effort > 0,
    "common_active_cohort_unconditioned_historical_reference",
    "no_positive_reference_zero_productivity_when_response_enabled")
  ids <- as.integer(table$cell_rate_id)
  if (anyNA(ids) || any(ids < 1 | ids > length(context$revenue_rate)))
    stop("Invalid cell rate index in coupled context.")
  reverse <- vector("list", nrow(table))
  names(reverse) <- as.character(seq_len(nrow(table)))
  for (uid in names(context$unit_kernels)) {
    k <- context$unit_kernels[[uid]]
    k$response_index <- match(smart31_key(k$data$MONTH, k$data$Gear, k$data$id_grid), table$key)
    if (anyNA(k$response_index)) stop("Unmapped coupled candidate at ", uid)
    context$unit_kernels[[uid]] <- k
    for (ii in unique(k$response_index)) reverse[[ii]] <- c(reverse[[ii]], uid)
  }
  context$v52 <- list(enabled = TRUE, controls = controls, cells = table,
    revenue = as.numeric(context$revenue_rate[ids]),
    catch = context$catch_rate[ids, , drop = FALSE],
    quota_rate = smart31_context_quota_rate(context)[ids, , drop=FALSE],
    potential_users = reverse)
  context
}

smart31_response_payload <- function(share, uid, context, raw = NULL) {
  if (is.null(raw)) raw <- evaluate_vessel_month_light(share, uid, context)
  if (!isTRUE(raw$valid)) return(list(valid = FALSE, issue = raw$issue))
  k <- context$unit_kernels[[uid]]
  g <- smart31_scale_unit_time(context$gear_search_by_unit[[uid]], smart31_extra_days(share))
  row_effort <- raw$coupled_row_effort
  raw$coupled_row_effort <- NULL
  if (is.null(row_effort)) {

    w <- numeric(length(share))
    for (rows in k$pattern_rows) w[rows] <- normalise_positive(share[rows])
    clock <- smart31_working_clock(k$data, g, as.numeric(k$data$metier_share) * w, context)
    if (!isTRUE(clock$valid)) return(clock)
    row_effort <- as.numeric(k$data$loa) * clock$row_fishing
  }
  if (length(row_effort) != nrow(k$data) || any(!is.finite(row_effort)) || any(row_effort < 0))
    stop("Invalid candidate-local effort cache at ", uid)
  gm <- match(k$data$Gear, g$Gear)
  if (anyNA(gm) || any(!is.finite(g$OC_share)) || any(!is.finite(g$LC_share)))
    stop("Missing economic shares in coupled payload at ", uid)
  aggregated <- rowsum(cbind(E = row_effort,
    margin_E = row_effort * (1 - g$OC_share[gm]),
    labour_E = row_effort * g$LC_share[gm]),
    k$response_index, reorder = FALSE)
  keep <- aggregated[, "E"] > 0
  index <- as.integer(rownames(aggregated)[keep])
  values <- aggregated[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  constant_gva <- raw$economic$GVA[[1L]] -
    sum(context$v52$revenue[index] * values[, "margin_E"])
  list(valid = TRUE, raw = raw, index = index, E = values[, "E"],
    margin_E = values[, "margin_E"], labour_E = values[, "labour_E"],
    constant_gva = constant_gva)
}

smart31_response_at <- function(values, ids, override_ids = integer(), override_values = numeric()) {
  out <- values[ids]
  if (length(override_ids)) {
    j <- match(ids, override_ids); use <- !is.na(j)
    out[use] <- override_values[j[use]]
  }
  out
}

smart31_response_reprice <- function(payload, multiplier, context,
                               override_ids = integer(), override_values = numeric()) {
  ids <- payload$index
  m <- smart31_response_at(multiplier, ids, override_ids, override_values)
  delta_rate <- context$v52$revenue[ids] * (m - 1)
  dv <- sum(payload$E * delta_rate)
  doc <- sum((payload$E - payload$margin_E) * delta_rate)
  dlc <- sum(payload$labour_E * delta_rate)
  out <- payload$raw
  ec <- out$economic
  ec$GVL_6sp <- ec$GVL_6sp + dv
  ec$GVL <- ec$GVL + dv
  ec$OC <- ec$OC + doc
  ec$LC <- ec$LC + dlc
  ec$GVA <- ec$GVL - ec$EC - ec$OC
  ec$GP <- ec$GVA - ec$LC
  catch <- if (length(ids)) colSums(context$v52$catch[ids, , drop = FALSE] *
    as.numeric(payload$E * m)) else rep(0, length(context$catch_species))
  out$catch_kg <- stats::setNames(as.numeric(catch), context$catch_species)
  out$quota_catch_kg <- stats::setNames(
    colSums(context$v52$quota_rate[ids,,drop=FALSE] * as.numeric(payload$E*m)), context$quota_species)
  ec$W <- sum(catch)
  ec$lpue_response_revenue_loss <- payload$raw$economic$GVL_6sp[[1L]] - ec$GVL_6sp
  if (any(!is.finite(as.matrix(ec[c("GVL_6sp", "GVL", "EC", "OC", "LC", "GVA", "GP")]))))
    stop("Non-finite coupled economics.")
  out$economic <- ec
  out
}

smart31_response_build_state <- function(state, context) {
  n <- nrow(context$v52$cells)
  E <- margin <- numeric(n)
  payloads <- vector("list", length(state$share_by_unit)); names(payloads) <- names(state$share_by_unit)
  for (uid in names(payloads)) {

    raw <- if (is.null(state$v52)) state$evaluation_by_unit[[uid]] else NULL
    z <- smart31_response_payload(state$share_by_unit[[uid]], uid, context, raw)
    if (!isTRUE(z$valid)) stop("Coupled initial evaluation failed at ", uid, ": ", z$issue)
    payloads[[uid]] <- z
    E[z$index] <- E[z$index] + z$E
    margin[z$index] <- margin[z$index] + z$margin_E
  }
  p <- context$v52$controls
  m <- smart31_response_multiplier(E, context$v52$cells$reference_effort,
                              p$lpue_response_mode, p$lpue_response_shape)
  state$v52 <- list(E = E, margin_E = margin, multiplier = m, payloads = payloads)
  state$evaluation_by_unit <- lapply(payloads, smart31_response_reprice, multiplier = m, context = context)
  state$catch_index <- context$fixed_non_vms_quota_catch
  for (z in state$evaluation_by_unit) state$catch_index <-
    state$catch_index + z$quota_catch_kg[names(state$catch_index)]
  state$v52$total_gva <- sum(vapply(state$evaluation_by_unit,
    function(z) z$economic$GVA[[1L]], numeric(1)))
  state
}

smart31_response_transaction <- function(state, uid, share, context, raw = NULL) {
  proposed <- smart31_response_payload(share, uid, context, raw)
  if (!isTRUE(proposed$valid)) return(list(valid = FALSE, issue = proposed$issue))
  current <- state$v52$payloads[[uid]]
  physical <- prepare_incremental_occupancy_update(state$occupancy_index,
    state$evaluation_by_unit[[uid]]$occupancy, proposed$raw$occupancy)
  if (!incremental_occupancy_is_feasible(physical, context$crowding_limit))
    return(list(valid = FALSE, issue = "global_crowding"))
  auxiliary <- smart31_aux_replacement(state, uid, proposed$raw, context)
  if (!isTRUE(auxiliary$compatible)) return(list(valid = FALSE, issue = "local_or_effort_quota"))
  ids <- sort(unique(c(current$index, proposed$index)))
  get_sparse <- function(z, field) {
    out <- numeric(length(ids)); j <- match(z$index, ids)
    out[j] <- z[[field]]; out
  }
  old_E <- state$v52$E[ids]
  new_E <- old_E - get_sparse(current, "E") + get_sparse(proposed, "E")
  new_margin <- state$v52$margin_E[ids] - get_sparse(current, "margin_E") + get_sparse(proposed, "margin_E")
  if (any(!is.finite(new_E)) || any(new_E < -1e-7)) stop("Negative coupled exposure after replacement.")
  new_E <- pmax(0, new_E)
  p <- context$v52$controls
  new_m <- smart31_response_multiplier(new_E, context$v52$cells$reference_effort[ids],
    p$lpue_response_mode, p$lpue_response_shape)
  old_m <- state$v52$multiplier[ids]

  delta_quota <- colSums(context$v52$quota_rate[ids,,drop=FALSE] * as.numeric(new_E*new_m-old_E*old_m))
  catch_index <- state$catch_index + delta_quota[names(state$catch_index)]
  if (any(!is.finite(catch_index)) || any(catch_index < -1e-7)) stop("Invalid coupled catch total.")
  catch_index[catch_index < 0] <- 0
  if (!catch_quota_is_feasible(catch_index, context$catch_quota_limits))
    return(list(valid = FALSE, issue = "coupled_catch_quota"))
  delta_fleet <- sum(context$v52$revenue[ids] *
    (new_margin * new_m - state$v52$margin_E[ids] * old_m)) +
    proposed$constant_gva - current$constant_gva
  ev <- smart31_response_reprice(proposed, state$v52$multiplier, context, ids, new_m)
  delta_mover <- ev$economic$GVA[[1L]] - state$evaluation_by_unit[[uid]]$economic$GVA[[1L]]
  if (!is.finite(delta_fleet) || !is.finite(delta_mover)) stop("Non-finite coupled objective delta.")
  list(valid = TRUE, uid = uid, share = share, payload = proposed, ids = ids,
    E = new_E, margin_E = new_margin, multiplier = new_m, catch_index = catch_index,
    delta_fleet = delta_fleet, delta_mover = delta_mover,
    physical = physical, auxiliary = auxiliary, mover = ev)
}

smart31_response_commit <- function(state, transaction, context) {
  if (!isTRUE(transaction$valid)) stop("Cannot commit an invalid candidate.")
  t <- transaction; uid <- t$uid
  affected <- unique(c(uid, unlist(context$v52$potential_users[t$ids], use.names = FALSE)))
  affected <- intersect(names(state$evaluation_by_unit), affected)

  repriced <- if (identical(context$v52$controls$lpue_response_mode, "none")) uid else affected
  old_total <- sum(vapply(state$evaluation_by_unit[repriced], function(z) z$economic$GVA[[1L]], numeric(1)))
  state <- apply_incremental_occupancy_update(state, t$physical)
  state$local_index[t$auxiliary$keys] <- t$auxiliary$replacement
  state$effort_index <- t$auxiliary$effort
  state$catch_index <- t$catch_index
  state$share_by_unit[uid] <- list(t$share)
  state$v52$payloads[uid] <- list(t$payload)
  state$v52$E[t$ids] <- t$E
  state$v52$margin_E[t$ids] <- t$margin_E
  state$v52$multiplier[t$ids] <- t$multiplier
  for (other_uid in repriced) state$evaluation_by_unit[other_uid] <- list(
    smart31_response_reprice(state$v52$payloads[[other_uid]], state$v52$multiplier, context))
  new_total <- sum(vapply(state$evaluation_by_unit[repriced], function(z) z$economic$GVA[[1L]], numeric(1)))
  smart31_response_close(new_total - old_total, t$delta_fleet, label = "Affected-fleet GVA delta")
  state$v52$total_gva <- state$v52$total_gva + t$delta_fleet
  state$v52$last_affected <- affected
  state
}

smart31_response_full <- function(share, uid, context, multiplier) {
  d <- context$unit_kernels[[uid]]$data; d$share <- share
  full <- evaluate_vessel_month_full(d, uid, context)
  if (!isTRUE(full$valid)) return(full)
  if (!nrow(full$activity)) return(full)
  keys <- context$v52$cells$key
  for (nm in c("activity", "catches")) {
    z <- full[[nm]]
    if (nrow(z)) {
      j <- match(smart31_key(z$MONTH, z$Gear, z$id_grid), keys)
      if (anyNA(j)) stop("Full reconstruction has an unmapped pressure key.")
      z$lpue_effort_multiplier <- multiplier[j]
      z$reference_pressure_effort <- context$v52$cells$reference_effort[j]
    }
    full[[nm]] <- z
  }
  z <- full$catches
  if (nrow(z)) {
    z$lpue_before_effort_response <- z$lpue_scenario
    z$W_before_effort_response <- z$W
    z$GVL_before_effort_response <- z$GVL
    z$lpue_scenario <- z$lpue_scenario * z$lpue_effort_multiplier
    z$W <- z$W * z$lpue_effort_multiplier
    z$GVL <- z$GVL * z$lpue_effort_multiplier
  }
  full$catches <- z
  ge <- full$gear_economic
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(ge))) {
    ix <- which(z$Gear == ge$Gear[i])
    ge$W[i] <- sum(z$W[ix]); ge$GVL_6sp[i] <- sum(z$GVL[ix])
  }
  ge$GVL <- ge$GVL_6sp + ge$GVL_other_reference
  ge$OC <- ge$GVL * ge$OC_share
  ge$LC <- ge$GVL * ge$LC_share
  ge$GVA <- ge$GVL - ge$EC - ge$OC
  ge$GP <- ge$GVA - ge$LC
  old_six <- full$economic$GVL_6sp[[1L]]
  for (nm in c("W", "GVL_6sp", "GVL", "OC", "LC", "GVA", "GP"))
    full$economic[[nm]] <- sum(ge[[nm]])
  full$economic$lpue_response_revenue_loss <- old_six - full$economic$GVL_6sp
  full$gear_economic <- ge
  full$catch_kg[] <- 0
  for (sp in names(full$catch_kg)) full$catch_kg[sp] <- sum(z$W[z$Species == sp])
  full$quota_catch_kg <- smart31_quota_catches(z, context$quota_species)
  full
}

smart31_response_validate_state <- function(state, context, full_units = character()) {

  rebuilt <- smart31_response_rebuild_from_shares(state, context)
  if (!occupancy_tables_equivalent(rebuilt$occupancy, state$occupancy))
    stop("Independent physical occupancy rebuild differs.")
  smart31_response_close(rebuilt$local_index, state$local_index, label = "Rebuilt local effort")
  smart31_response_close(rebuilt$effort_index, state$effort_index, label = "Rebuilt effort-quota days")
  smart31_response_close(rebuilt$v52$E, state$v52$E, label = "Rebuilt cell effort")
  smart31_response_close(rebuilt$v52$margin_E, state$v52$margin_E, label = "Rebuilt net-revenue exposure")
  smart31_response_close(rebuilt$catch_index, state$catch_index, label = "Rebuilt quota catches")
  smart31_response_close(rebuilt$v52$total_gva, state$v52$total_gva, label = "Rebuilt fleet GVA")
  fields <- c("days_at_sea", "trips", "fishing_time", "steaming_time", "GVL_6sp", "GVL_other_reference",
    "GVL", "EC", "EC_fishing", "EC_steaming", "fuel_fishing_l", "fuel_steaming_l", "OC", "LC", "GVA", "GP")
  for (uid in names(state$evaluation_by_unit)) {
    smart31_response_close(unlist(rebuilt$evaluation_by_unit[[uid]]$economic[fields]),
      unlist(state$evaluation_by_unit[[uid]]$economic[fields]), label = paste("Peer cache", uid))
  }
  for (uid in full_units) {
    full <- smart31_response_full(state$share_by_unit[[uid]], uid, context, state$v52$multiplier)
    light <- state$evaluation_by_unit[[uid]]
    if (!isTRUE(full$valid)) stop("Coupled full evaluator rejected ", uid)
    smart31_response_close(unlist(full$economic[fields]), unlist(light$economic[fields]),
      label = paste("Coupled full/light economics", uid))
    smart31_response_close(full$catch_kg, light$catch_kg, label = paste("Coupled full/light catch", uid))
    if (!occupancy_tables_equivalent(full$occupancy, light$occupancy)) stop("Coupled occupancy mismatch.")
    if (nrow(full$activity) && any(full$activity$trip_duration_h >= 24 |
      full$activity$trip_duration_h > context$working_baseline_controls$trip_limit_hours + 1e-8))
      stop("Coupled full reconstruction violates the trip clock.")
  }
  if (!smart31_state_feasible(state, context)) stop("Coupled state fails a hard constraint.")
  invisible(TRUE)
}

smart31_response_pressure_audit <- function(state, context) {
  z <- context$v52$cells
  z$scenario_effort <- state$v52$E
  z$effort_ratio <- ifelse(z$reference_effort > 0, z$scenario_effort / z$reference_effort, NA_real_)
  z$lpue_multiplier <- state$v52$multiplier
  z$lpue_response_mode <- context$v52$controls$lpue_response_mode
  z$lpue_response_shape <- context$v52$controls$lpue_response_shape
  z$parameters_empirically_estimated <- FALSE
  z
}

smart31_response_anneal_accept <- function(delta, temperature, candidate_gva, floor_gva) {
  if (!is.finite(delta) || !is.finite(candidate_gva) || candidate_gva < floor_gva) return(FALSE)
  if (delta >= 0) return(TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(temperature) || temperature <= 0) return(FALSE)
  log(stats::runif(1L)) < delta / temperature
}

smart31_response_same_share <- function(a, b) {
  identical(as.numeric(a), as.numeric(b)) && identical(smart31_extra_days(a), smart31_extra_days(b))
}

smart31_base_condition_joint_context <- smart31_condition_joint_context
smart31_base_optimise_scenario_state <- optimise_scenario_state
smart31_base_rehydrate_final_evaluations <- rehydrate_final_evaluations
smart31_base_preflight_context <- smart31_preflight_context

smart31_condition_joint_context <- function(context) {
  context <- smart31_base_condition_joint_context(context)
  if (!smart31_response_on() || !isTRUE(context$feasible)) return(context)
  if (isTRUE(context$v52$enabled)) return(context)

  context <- smart31_response_attach(context)
  initial <- smart31_response_build_state(smart31_working_state(context), context)
  if (!smart31_state_feasible(initial, context))
    stop("Response-adjusted initial state violates a constraint.")
  monthly <- context$initial_economic_monthly
  fields <- c("GVL_6sp", "GVL", "OC", "LC", "GVA", "GP")
  for (field in fields) monthly[[paste0("unpenalised_", field)]] <- monthly[[field]]
  calculated <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(initial$evaluation_by_unit, function(z) z$economic))
  j <- match(monthly$unit_id, calculated$unit_id); use <- !is.na(j)
  for (field in fields) monthly[[field]][use] <- calculated[[field]][j[use]]
  monthly$initial_W <- ifelse(use, calculated$W[j], 0)
  monthly$lpue_response_mode <- context$v52$controls$lpue_response_mode
  monthly$initial_baseline_type <- "Step2_conditioned_daily_trip_with_common_pressure_response"
  context$initial_economic_monthly <- monthly
  .smart31_initial$initial_economics[[context$scenario$scenario_id]] <- monthly
  smart31_response_write(monthly, "initial_economic_monthly", context$scenario$scenario_id)
  smart31_response_write(smart31_response_pressure_audit(initial, context), "initial_cell_pressure", context$scenario$scenario_id)
  smart31_monitor_event(event = "coupled_baseline_ready", phase = "scenario_preparation",
    scenario_id = context$scenario$scenario_id, total_GVA = initial$v52$total_gva,
    note = paste0("response=", context$v52$controls$lpue_response_mode,
      "; shared cell-month-gear pressure; conservative initial quotas rechecked"))
  context
}

smart31_preflight_context <- function(context) {

  smart31_base_preflight_context(context)
  if (!isTRUE(cfg$run_internal_tests) || !smart31_response_on(context)) return(invisible(TRUE))
  state <- smart31_response_build_state(smart31_working_state(context), context)
  signatures <- vapply(context$gear_search_by_unit, function(g) paste(sort(g$Gear), collapse = "+"), character(1))
  units <- names(signatures)[!duplicated(signatures)]

  if (any(state$v52$multiplier < 1 & state$v52$E > 0)) {
    ii <- which.min(ifelse(state$v52$E > 0, state$v52$multiplier, 2))
    units <- unique(c(units, head(context$v52$potential_users[[ii]], 1L)))
  }
  smart31_response_validate_state(state, context, units)
  checks <- list()
  for (uid in units) {
    capacity <- context$cm_capacity[[uid]]
    variants <- list(state$share_by_unit[[uid]])
    if (capacity > 0) variants <- c(variants, lapply(c(capacity/2, capacity), function(x)
      smart31_set_extra(as.numeric(state$share_by_unit[[uid]]), x)))

    k <- context$unit_kernels[[uid]]
    perturbed <- as.numeric(state$share_by_unit[[uid]])
    for (rows in k$pattern_rows) if (length(rows) > 1L)
      perturbed[rows] <- normalise_positive(0.8 * perturbed[rows] + 0.2 * rev(perturbed[rows]))
    variants[[length(variants) + 1L]] <- smart31_set_extra(perturbed, 0)
    for (i in seq_along(variants)) {
      tr <- smart31_response_transaction(state, uid, variants[[i]], context)
      if (isTRUE(tr$valid)) {
        changed <- smart31_response_commit(state, tr, context)
        peers <- unique(c(uid, head(changed$v52$last_affected, 2L)))
        smart31_response_validate_state(changed, context, peers)
      }
      checks[[length(checks) + 1L]] <- data.frame(unit_id = uid, variant = i,
        extra_days = smart31_extra_days(variants[[i]]), candidate_feasible = isTRUE(tr$valid),
        status = if (isTRUE(tr$valid)) "incremental_and_rebuilt_and_full_passed" else tr$issue,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    }
  }
  smart31_response_write(dplyr::bind_rows(checks), "coupled_preflight", context$scenario$scenario_id)
  cat("shared-pressure full/light and candidate peer-accounting preflight passed.\n")
  invisible(TRUE)
}

optimise_scenario_state <- function(feasible_state, context, method,
                                   replicate_id = NA_integer_, seed, resume_payload = NULL) {
  if (!smart31_response_on(context)) return(smart31_base_optimise_scenario_state(
    feasible_state, context, method, replicate_id, seed, resume_payload))
  p <- context$v52$controls; parameter <- context$scenario$parameters
  nsweep <- as.integer(parameter$maximum_sweeps)
  warm <- min(as.integer(p$exploration_sweeps), max(0L, nsweep - 1L))
  if (is.null(resume_payload)) {
    state <- smart31_response_build_state(feasible_state, context)
    stability <- stats::setNames(integer(nrow(state$units)), state$units$unit_id)
    reference <- smart31_state_diagnostics(state, context)
    initial_gva <- reference$total_GVA[[1L]]
    initial_revenue <- reference$total_GVL[[1L]]
    meta <- list(best_gva = initial_gva, best_shares = state$share_by_unit, best_sweep = 0L,
      initial_gva = initial_gva, reference = reference, stable_growth_sweeps = 0L,
      floor_gva = initial_gva - p$exploration_max_drawdown_fraction *
        max(abs(initial_gva), 0.01 * abs(initial_revenue), 1),
      unit_scales = vapply(state$evaluation_by_unit, function(z)
        max(abs(z$economic$GVA[[1L]]), 0.01 * abs(z$economic$GVL[[1L]]), 1), numeric(1)))
    state$response_meta <- meta
    accepted <- 0L; first <- 1L
    logs <- list(smart31_sweep_diagnostic_row(state, context, 0L, 0L, stability, reference))
    logs[[1]]$search_phase <- "initial_after_measures"
    logs[[1]]$record_type <- "search_state"
    logs[[1]]$best_feasible_GVA <- initial_gva
    logs[[1]]$accepted_worsening <- 0L
    logs[[1]]$accepted_improving <- 0L
    logs[[1]]$temperature_fraction <- 0
  } else {
    state <- resume_payload$state
    if (is.null(state$v52) || is.null(state$response_meta)) stop("Checkpoint lacks coupled state or best-state history.")
    stability <- resume_payload$stability
    logs <- resume_payload$convergence_log
    accepted <- as.integer(resume_payload$accepted_updates)
    first <- as.integer(resume_payload$metadata$completed_sweep) + 1L
    reference <- state$response_meta$reference
    if (!is.null(resume_payload$random_seed)) assign(".Random.seed", resume_payload$random_seed, envir = .GlobalEnv)
    smart31_response_validate_state(state, context)
  }
  meta <- state$response_meta
  initial_gva <- meta$initial_gva
  phase <- function(s) if (s <= warm) "exploration" else "improvement"
  smart31_monitor_detail_capture(state, context, method, replicate_id, first - 1L,
    trajectory = dplyr::bind_rows(logs))
  smart31_monitor_event(event = "optimisation_started", phase = "optimisation",
    scenario_id = context$scenario$scenario_id, method = method, replicate = replicate_id,
    sweep = first - 1L, maximum_sweeps = nsweep,
    total_GVA = state$v52$total_gva, reference_GVA = initial_gva,
    note = paste0("; ", p$search_objective, " objective; ", warm,
                  " exploratory sweeps; all hard constraints remain active"))
  sequence <- if (first <= nsweep) seq.int(first, nsweep) else integer()
  for (sweep in sequence) {
    exploring <- sweep <= warm
    if (sweep == warm + 1L) { stability[] <- 0L; meta$stable_growth_sweeps <- 0L }
    unit_order <- sample(state$units$unit_id)
    improving <- worsening <- accepted_sweep <- 0L
    temperature_fraction <- if (exploring) p$exploration_temperature_fraction *
      p$exploration_cooling^(sweep - 1L) else 0

    for (position in seq_along(unit_order)) {
      uid <- unit_order[[position]]
      proposals <- smart31_search_proposals(state$share_by_unit[[uid]], uid, context, method)

      evaluate_ids <- which(!vapply(proposals, smart31_response_same_share, logical(1),
        b = state$share_by_unit[[uid]]))
      raw_evaluations <- vector("list", length(proposals))
      if (length(evaluate_ids)) raw_evaluations[evaluate_ids] <-
        evaluate_candidate_states(proposals[evaluate_ids], uid, context, method, replicate_id)
      transactions <- vector("list", length(proposals))
      for (i in seq_along(proposals)) {
        if (smart31_response_same_share(proposals[[i]], state$share_by_unit[[uid]])) next
        if (!isTRUE(raw_evaluations[[i]]$valid)) next
        tr <- smart31_response_transaction(state, uid, proposals[[i]], context, raw_evaluations[[i]])
        if (isTRUE(tr$valid)) transactions[i] <- list(tr)
      }
      valid <- which(vapply(transactions, function(z) isTRUE(z$valid), logical(1)))
      chosen <- NULL; accept <- FALSE
      if (length(valid)) {
        gain <- vapply(transactions[valid], function(z)
          if (p$search_objective == "fleet") z$delta_fleet else z$delta_mover, numeric(1))
        index <- if (exploring) valid[sample.int(length(valid), 1L)] else valid[which.max(gain)]
        chosen <- transactions[[index]]
        delta <- if (p$search_objective == "fleet") chosen$delta_fleet else chosen$delta_mover
        if (exploring) {
          temperature <- temperature_fraction * meta$unit_scales[[uid]]
          accept <- smart31_response_anneal_accept(delta, temperature,
            state$v52$total_gva + chosen$delta_fleet, meta$floor_gva)
        } else {

          current_gva <- state$evaluation_by_unit[[uid]]$economic$GVA[[1L]]
          hurdle <- gva_improvement_threshold(current_gva, parameter$min_GVA_improve_fact,
                                             parameter$min_GVA_improve_abs_eur) - current_gva
          accept <- is.finite(delta) && delta > hurdle
        }
      }
      if (accept) {
        before <- state$v52$total_gva
        state <- smart31_response_commit(state, chosen, context)
        stability[state$v52$last_affected] <- 0L
        accepted <- accepted + 1L; accepted_sweep <- accepted_sweep + 1L
        if (chosen$delta_fleet < -1e-8) worsening <- worsening + 1L else improving <- improving + 1L
        if (!exploring && p$search_objective == "fleet" && state$v52$total_gva < before - 1e-7)
          stop("Fleet GVA declined during the improvement-only phase.")
        if (state$v52$total_gva > meta$best_gva + 1e-8) {
          meta$best_gva <- state$v52$total_gva
          meta$best_shares <- state$share_by_unit
          meta$best_sweep <- sweep
        }
      } else stability[[uid]] <- stability[[uid]] + 1L
      if (position %% monitor_update_every_units == 0L || position == length(unit_order) || smart31_monitor_heartbeat_due()) {
        smart31_monitor_event(event = "optimisation_unit_progress", phase = "optimisation",
          scenario_id = context$scenario$scenario_id, method = method, replicate = replicate_id,
          sweep = sweep, maximum_sweeps = nsweep, unit_index = position, units_in_stage = length(unit_order),
          total_GVA = state$v52$total_gva, reference_GVA = initial_gva, accepted_updates = accepted_sweep,
          note = paste0(phase(sweep), "; best feasible GVA ", signif(meta$best_gva, 8),
                        "; accepted fleet declines ", worsening))
      }
    }
    if (!smart31_state_feasible(state, context)) stop("Accepted coupled sweep violates hard constraints.")

    smart31_response_validate_state(state, context)
    if (!exploring) meta$stable_growth_sweeps <- if (accepted_sweep == 0L)
      meta$stable_growth_sweeps + 1L else 0L
    state$response_meta <- meta
    memory <- if (sweep %% memory_cleanup_every_sweeps == 0L) sum(gc(verbose = FALSE)[,2]) else NA_real_
    row <- smart31_sweep_diagnostic_row(state, context, sweep, accepted_sweep, stability, reference, memory)
    row$search_phase <- phase(sweep); row$record_type <- "search_state"
    row$best_feasible_GVA <- meta$best_gva
    row$accepted_worsening <- worsening; row$accepted_improving <- improving
    row$temperature_fraction <- temperature_fraction
    row$penalised_pressure_cells <- sum(state$v52$E > 0 & state$v52$multiplier < 1 - 1e-12)
    row$effort_weighted_lpue_multiplier <- if (sum(state$v52$E) > 0)
      sum(state$v52$E * state$v52$multiplier) / sum(state$v52$E) else 1
    logs[[length(logs) + 1L]] <- row
    smart31_monitor_detail_capture(state, context, method, replicate_id, sweep, row)
    smart31_write_live_sweep_diagnostics(logs, context, method, replicate_id)
    converged <- !exploring && meta$stable_growth_sweeps >= parameter$max_consecutive_non_improvements
    smart31_monitor_event(event = "optimisation_sweep", phase = "optimisation",
      scenario_id = context$scenario$scenario_id, method = method, replicate = replicate_id,
      sweep = sweep, maximum_sweeps = nsweep, total_GVA = state$v52$total_gva,
      reference_GVA = initial_gva, accepted_updates = accepted_sweep,
      maximum_crowding_ratio = row$maximum_crowding_ratio[[1L]],
      note = paste0(phase(sweep), "; best=", signif(meta$best_gva, 8),
                    "; improving=", improving, "; worsening=", worsening,
                    "; stable growth sweeps=", meta$stable_growth_sweeps))
    if (sweep %% checkpoint_every_sweeps == 0L || converged || sweep == nsweep)
      smart31_save_search_checkpoint(state, stability, logs, accepted, sweep, context,
                                    method, replicate_id, seed, initial_gva)
    if (converged) break
  }
  current_log <- dplyr::bind_rows(logs)
  last_gva <- state$v52$total_gva
  last_sweep <- tail(current_log$sweep, 1L)
  converged <- meta$stable_growth_sweeps >= parameter$max_consecutive_non_improvements
  restored <- isTRUE(p$return_best_feasible) && meta$best_gva > last_gva + 1e-8
  smart31_response_write(current_log, paste0("search_trajectory_", method, "_rep", replicate_id), context$scenario$scenario_id)
  if (restored) {
    state$share_by_unit <- meta$best_shares

    state <- smart31_response_rebuild_from_shares(state, context)
    smart31_response_close(state$v52$total_gva, meta$best_gva, label = "Restored best-state GVA")
    if (!smart31_state_feasible(state, context)) stop("Stored best state is infeasible.")
    output_row <- smart31_sweep_diagnostic_row(state, context, last_sweep, 0L, stability, reference)
    output_row$search_phase <- "selected_best_feasible"
    output_row$record_type <- "output_selection_not_an_additional_sweep"
    output_row$best_feasible_GVA <- meta$best_gva
    logs[[length(logs) + 1L]] <- output_row
    converged <- FALSE
  }
  selection <- data.frame(scenario_id = context$scenario$scenario_id, method = method, replicate = replicate_id,
    last_visited_GVA = last_gva, best_feasible_GVA = meta$best_gva,
    selected_GVA = state$v52$total_gva, best_sweep = meta$best_sweep,
    returned_best_instead_of_last = restored, objective = p$search_objective,
    exploration_sweeps = warm, optimiser_sweeps_are_not_time_periods = TRUE)
  smart31_response_write(selection, paste0("output_selection_", method, "_rep", replicate_id), context$scenario$scenario_id)
  smart31_response_write(smart31_response_pressure_audit(state, context),
    paste0("final_cell_pressure_", method, "_rep", replicate_id), context$scenario$scenario_id)
  list(state = state, stability = stability, convergence_log = dplyr::bind_rows(logs),
       accepted_updates = accepted, converged = converged,
       search_trajectory = current_log, output_selection = selection)
}

smart31_response_rebuild_from_shares <- function(state, context) {
  ids <- names(state$share_by_unit)
  ev <- lapply(ids, function(uid) evaluate_vessel_month_light(state$share_by_unit[[uid]], uid, context))
  names(ev) <- ids
  if (!all(vapply(ev, function(z) isTRUE(z$valid), logical(1)))) stop("Invalid physical state during rebuild.")
  state$evaluation_by_unit <- ev
  state$occupancy <- combine_occupancy(ev)
  state$occupancy_index <- build_occupancy_index(state$occupancy)
  state <- smart31_auxiliary_state(state, context)
  state$v52 <- NULL
  smart31_response_build_state(state, context)
}

rehydrate_final_evaluations <- function(optimised, context, method, replicate_id) {
  if (!smart31_response_on(context)) return(smart31_base_rehydrate_final_evaluations(optimised, context, method, replicate_id))
  state <- optimised$state
  ids <- names(state$share_by_unit)
  out <- vector("list", length(ids)); names(out) <- ids
  fields <- c("GVL_6sp", "GVL_other_reference", "GVL", "EC", "OC", "LC", "GVA", "GP",
    "fuel_fishing_l", "fuel_steaming_l", "EC_fishing", "EC_steaming")
  smart31_monitor_event(event = "final_output_reconstruction_started", phase = "final_output_reconstruction",
    scenario_id = context$scenario$scenario_id, method = method, replicate = replicate_id,
    unit_index = 0L, units_in_stage = length(ids), note = "independent full reconstruction with final common LPUE multipliers")
  for (i in seq_along(ids)) {
    uid <- ids[[i]]
    full <- smart31_response_full(state$share_by_unit[[uid]], uid, context, state$v52$multiplier)
    if (!isTRUE(full$valid)) stop("Coupled final reconstruction rejected ", uid)
    light <- state$evaluation_by_unit[[uid]]
    smart31_response_close(unlist(full$economic[fields]), unlist(light$economic[fields]),
                     label = paste("Final coupled economics", uid))
    smart31_response_close(full$catch_kg, light$catch_kg, label = paste("Final coupled catches", uid))
    out[[i]] <- full
    if (i %% monitor_update_every_units == 0L || i == length(ids))
      smart31_monitor_event(event = "final_output_reconstruction_progress", phase = "final_output_reconstruction",
        scenario_id = context$scenario$scenario_id, method = method, replicate = replicate_id,
        unit_index = i, units_in_stage = length(ids), note = paste("last reconstructed", uid))
  }
  out
}

smart31_response_collect <- function(field) {
  purrr::map_dfr(simulation_results, function(result) {
    if (is.null(result$runs)) return(tibble::tibble())
    purrr::map_dfr(result$runs, function(run) {
      if (!isTRUE(run$feasible)) return(tibble::tibble())
      z <- run$outputs[[field]]
      if (is.null(z) || !is.data.frame(z) || !nrow(z)) return(tibble::tibble())
      z$scenario_id <- result$scenario_id; z$method <- run$method; z$replicate <- run$replicate
      z
    })
  })
}

smart31_response_common_reference <- function(scenario) {
  if (!is.null(.smart31_response$common_reference)) return(.smart31_response$common_reference)
  sandbox <- new.env(parent = environment(smart31_response_common_reference))
  names_to_copy <- c("prepare_scenario_context", "smart31_prepare_working_allocation",
    "smart31_rescale_effort_segments", "evaluate_effort_quota_compatibility",
    "build_catch_quota_limits", "smart31_complete_context")
  for (nm in names_to_copy) {
    f <- get(nm, envir = parent.env(sandbox), inherits = TRUE)
    environment(f) <- sandbox; assign(nm, f, envir = sandbox)
  }
  sandbox$italian_effort_quotas <- italian_effort_quotas[0, , drop = FALSE]
  sandbox$italian_catch_quotas <- italian_catch_quotas[0, , drop = FALSE]

  sandbox$.smart31_initial <- list2env(as.list(.smart31_initial), parent = emptyenv())
  sandbox$smart31_working_write <- function(x, ...) invisible(x)
  sandbox$smart31_monitor_event <- function(...) invisible(NULL)
  reference_scenario <- scenario
  reference_scenario$scenario_id <- "COMMON_OPERATIONAL_REFERENCE"
  reference_scenario$scenario_year <- .smart31_years$baseline
  reference_scenario$representative_period <- .smart31_case$periods$baseline
  reference_scenario$cm_status <- "without_cm"
  reference_scenario$permanent_cessation_cfr <- character()
  reference_scenario$closures <- list()
  reference_scenario$compensation_mechanisms <- list()
  reference_scenario$selectivity_rules <- list()
  reference_scenario$parameters$fuel_price_multiplier <- 1
  reference_scenario$parameters$landing_price_multiplier <- 1
  ctx <- sandbox$smart31_complete_context(sandbox$prepare_scenario_context(reference_scenario))
  if (!isTRUE(ctx$feasible)) stop("Common physical reference preparation failed: ", ctx$issue)
  ctx <- smart31_response_attach(ctx)
  state <- smart31_response_build_state(smart31_working_state(ctx), ctx)
  out <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(state$evaluation_by_unit, function(z) z$economic))
  out$reference_kind <- "synthetic_common_daily_operational_reference_before_management_quotas"
  out$no_scenario_closures_or_cessations <- TRUE
  out$not_a_causally_identified_policy_counterfactual <- TRUE
  .smart31_response$common_reference <- out
  smart31_response_write(out, "common_operational_reference")
  out
}

smart31_base_assemble_final_outputs <- assemble_final_outputs
assemble_final_outputs <- function(optimised, context, method, replicate_id) {
  out <- smart31_base_assemble_final_outputs(optimised, context, method, replicate_id)
  controls <- if (smart31_response_on(context)) context$v52$controls else .smart31_response$controls
  out$lpue_response_controls <- controls
  out$cell_pressure <- if (smart31_response_on(context))
    smart31_response_pressure_audit(optimised$state, context) else tibble::tibble()
  out$search_trajectory <- optimised$search_trajectory
  if (is.null(out$search_trajectory)) {
    out$search_trajectory <- optimised$convergence_log
    out$search_trajectory$search_phase <- ifelse(out$search_trajectory$sweep == 0L,
      "initial_after_measures", "legacy_improvement")
    out$search_trajectory$record_type <- "search_state"
    out$search_trajectory$best_feasible_GVA <- cummax(out$search_trajectory$total_GVA)
    out$search_trajectory$accepted_worsening <- 0L
  }
  out$output_selection <- optimised$output_selection
  out$preserve_days_audit <- context$baseline_initialisation_audit
  common <- .smart31_response$common_reference
  stages <- data.frame(
    stage = c("imported_Step1_history", "common_daily_operational_reference",
              "conditioned_initial_after_measures", "selected_optimised_pattern"),
    GVA = c(sum(context$economic_reference$GVA) + sum(context$cessation_reference$GVA),
            if (is.null(common)) NA_real_ else sum(common$GVA),
            sum(context$initial_economic_monthly$GVA), sum(out$economic_monthly$GVA)),
    days = c(sum(.smart31_initial$original_time$days_reference),
             if (is.null(common)) NA_real_ else sum(common$days_at_sea),
             sum(context$initial_economic_monthly$days_at_sea), sum(out$economic_monthly$days_at_sea)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  stages$scenario_id <- context$scenario$scenario_id
  stages$method <- method; stages$replicate <- replicate_id
  stages$lpue_response_mode <- controls$lpue_response_mode
  stages$not_a_calendar_time_series <- TRUE
  out$economic_stages <- stages
  smart31_response_write(stages, paste0("economic_stages_", method, "_rep", replicate_id), context$scenario$scenario_id)
  out
}
```

```{r step2-25-regression-tests}
smart31_response_regression_tests <- function() {
  parent <- environment(smart31_response_regression_tests)
  e <- new.env(parent = parent)

  for (nm in ls(parent, all.names = TRUE)) {
    obj <- get(nm, envir = parent, inherits = FALSE)
    if (is.function(obj) && identical(environment(obj), parent)) {
      environment(obj) <- e; assign(nm, obj, envir = e)
    }
  }
  seed_present <- exists(".Random.seed", envir = .GlobalEnv, inherits = FALSE)
  old_seed <- if (seed_present) get(".Random.seed", envir = .GlobalEnv) else NULL
  on.exit({
    if (seed_present) assign(".Random.seed", old_seed, envir = .GlobalEnv)
    else if (exists(".Random.seed", envir = .GlobalEnv, inherits = FALSE)) rm(".Random.seed", envir = .GlobalEnv)
  }, add = TRUE)
  set.seed(521003L)
  e$smart31_response_write <- function(x, ...) invisible(x)
  e$smart31_monitor_event <- function(...) invisible(NULL)
  e$smart31_monitor_heartbeat_due <- function(...) FALSE
  e$smart31_write_live_sweep_diagnostics <- function(...) invisible(NULL)
  e$validate_incremental_occupancy_once <- function(...) invisible(TRUE)
  e$monitor_update_every_units <- 10000L
  e$memory_cleanup_every_sweeps <- Inf
  e$checkpoint_every_sweeps <- 1L
  e$validate_acceleration_first_batch <- FALSE
  e$cfg <- list(enforce_local_effort_envelope = TRUE, cm_step_days = 1,
                   run_internal_tests = TRUE)
  e$quota_tolerance_fraction <- 1e-8
  e$smart31_save_search_checkpoint <- function(state, stability, convergence_log,
      accepted_updates, completed_sweep, context, method, replicate_id, seed, reference_GVA) {
    payload <- list(state = state, stability = stability, convergence_log = convergence_log,
      accepted_updates = accepted_updates, metadata = list(completed_sweep = completed_sweep),
      random_seed = get(".Random.seed", envir = .GlobalEnv))

    e$test_checkpoint <- unserialize(serialize(payload, NULL, version = 3))
    invisible(NULL)
  }
  e$evaluate_candidate_states <- function(proposed_shares, unit_id, context, method, replicate_id) {
    lapply(proposed_shares, e$evaluate_vessel_month_light, unit_id = unit_id, context = context)
  }
  cfg <- list(lpue_response_mode = "saturating", lpue_response_shape = 1.5,
    exploration_sweeps = 2L, exploration_temperature_fraction = 0.05,
    exploration_cooling = 0.5, exploration_max_drawdown_fraction = 0.10,
    return_best_feasible = TRUE, search_objective = "fleet")
  physical <- list(trip_limit_hours = 23.5, trip_reserved_hours = 0.5,
    min_fishing_hours_per_trip = 4, max_fishing_hours_per_trip = 16,
    max_navigation_fraction = 0.6, initial_quota_utilisation = 0.98)

  rr <- c(0, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8, 1e8)
  mm <- e$smart31_response_multiplier(rr, rep(1, length(rr)), "saturating", 1.5)
  stopifnot(abs(mm[4] - .8) < 1e-12, abs(mm[5] - .5) < 1e-12,
    all(diff(mm) <= 1e-12), all(diff(rr * mm) >= -1e-12), rr[7] * mm[7] < 2.5)
  stopifnot(identical(e$smart31_response_multiplier(c(0, 4), c(0, 0), "saturating"), c(0, 0)),
    identical(e$smart31_response_multiplier(c(0, 4), c(0, 0), "none"), c(1, 1)))
  scenario <- list(scenario_id = "SYNTHETIC_V52", scenario_year = .smart31_years$baseline,
    representative_period = .smart31_case$periods$baseline, member_state = .smart31_case$domain$country, cm_status = "with_cm",
    selectivity_rules = list(), parameters = list(max_days_per_month = 25,
      landing_price_multiplier = 1, maximum_sweeps = 4L, candidates_per_update = 5L,
      max_consecutive_non_improvements = 3L, min_GVA_improve_fact = 1.01,
      min_GVA_improve_abs_eur = 0.01, stochastic_exploration = 0.15,
      stochastic_concentration = 80, minimum_dirichlet_alpha = 1e-8))
  g <- tibble::tibble(CFR = c("A", "A", "B", "C"), MONTH = 1L,
    Gear = c("OTB", "LLS", "OTB", "LLS"), days_scenario_gear = c(3, 2, 4, 3),
    days_scenario = c(5, 5, 4, 3), scenario_trips = c(3, 2, 4, 3),
    daily_activity_budget_h = c(18, 16, 18, 16), fishing_time_reference_scenario = c(36, 20, 48, 30),
    steaming_time_reference_scenario = c(9, 6, 12, 9), fishing_time_elasticity = .5,
    fishing_fuel_l_per_h = c(10, 5, 12, 6), steaming_fuel_l_per_h = c(15, 7, 16, 8),
    GVL_other_reference_month = c(30, 10, 35, 12), EC_share = .2,
    OC_share = c(.1, .15, .25, .12), LC_share = c(.2, .1, .3, .15),
    unit_id = c("A::01", "A::01", "B::01", "C::01"))
  d <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(g)), function(i) tibble::tibble(
    CFR = g$CFR[i], MONTH = 1L, Gear = g$Gear[i], Metier = paste0(g$Gear[i], "_TEST"),
    id_grid = as.character(1:3), GSA_code = "GSA09", harbour = "P", loa = 20,
    depth_m = 100, distance_km = c(20, 40, 60), metier_share = 1,
    initial_share = c(.6, .3, .1), peer_share = c(.3, .3, .4),
    allocation_units = 4L, posterior_alpha = c(2, 1, 1), unit_id = g$unit_id[i],
    pattern_id = paste(g$unit_id[i], g$Gear[i], sep = "::"))))
  e$lpue_reference <- tidyr::crossing(MONTH = 1L, GSA_code = "GSA09",
    Gear = c("LLS", "OTB"), id_grid = as.character(1:3), Species = c("HKE", "ARS"))
  e$lpue_reference$lpue_reference <- with(e$lpue_reference,
    ifelse(Species == "HKE", .10, .03) * ifelse(id_grid == "1", 2, ifelse(id_grid == "2", 1, .6)))
  e$price_reference <- tibble::tibble(Species = c("ARS", "HKE"), GSA = "GSA09", price_reference = c(10, 5))
  e$economic_rates_reference <- g[c("CFR", "Gear", "EC_share", "OC_share", "LC_share")]
  rates <- e$build_scenario_cell_rates(d, scenario, c("ARS", "HKE"))
  kernels <- lapply(split(rates$candidates, rates$candidates$unit_id), e$build_unit_kernel)
  for (uid in names(kernels)) kernels[[uid]]$local_key <- e$smart31_key(
    kernels[[uid]]$data$MONTH, kernels[[uid]]$data$Gear, kernels[[uid]]$data$id_grid)
  quota <- tibble::tibble(YEAR = .smart31_years$baseline, Gear = c("LLS", "OTB"), length_class = "ALL",
    min_loa_m = 0, max_loa_m = Inf, effort_quota_days = 1000,
    effort_quota_id = c("LLS_LIMIT", "OTB_LIMIT"))
  e$italian_effort_quotas <- quota
  ctx <- list(feasible = TRUE, scenario = scenario, working_baseline_controls = physical,
    steaming_speed_kmh = 20, fuel_price = .7, gear_time = g,
    gear_search_by_unit = split(g, g$unit_id), unit_kernels = kernels,
    revenue_rate = rates$revenue_rate, catch_rate = rates$catch_rate,
    catch_species = rates$catch_species, quota_species = rates$quota_species,
    diagnostic_species = rates$catch_species,
    cm_capacity = c("A::01" = 2, "B::01" = 2, "C::01" = 2),
    retained_vessels = tibble::tibble(CFR = c("A", "B", "C"), loa = 20),
    other_gvl_monthly = g[c("CFR", "MONTH", "Gear", "GVL_other_reference_month")],
    effort_quota_table = quota,
    effort_limits = c(LLS_LIMIT = 1000, OTB_LIMIT = 1000),
    catch_quota_limits = tibble::tibble(YEAR = .smart31_years$baseline, Species = c("ARS", "HKE"), quota_kg = 1e6),
    fixed_non_vms_quota_catch = c(ARS = 5, HKE = 7),
    fixed_non_vms_species_catch = c(ARS = 5, HKE = 7), crowding_limit = 1e6)
  ref <- unique(rates$candidates[c("MONTH", "Gear", "id_grid")]); ref$reference_effort <- 300
  ctx$local_limits <- stats::setNames(rep(1e6, nrow(ref)), e$smart31_key(ref$MONTH, ref$Gear, ref$id_grid))
  ctx <- e$smart31_response_attach(ctx, ref, cfg)
  state <- e$smart31_working_state(ctx)
  state$units <- tibble::tibble(unit_id = names(ctx$unit_kernels))
  state <- e$smart31_response_build_state(state, ctx)

  e$smart31_response_validate_state(state, ctx, names(ctx$unit_kernels))

  proposal <- e$smart31_set_extra(c(.1, .2, .7), 0)
  tx <- e$smart31_response_transaction(state, "B::01", proposal, ctx)
  stopifnot(tx$valid)
  changed <- e$smart31_response_commit(state, tx, ctx)
  e$smart31_response_validate_state(changed, ctx, names(ctx$unit_kernels))
  stopifnot(!isTRUE(all.equal(state$evaluation_by_unit[["A::01"]]$catch_kg,
                             changed$evaluation_by_unit[["A::01"]]$catch_kg)),
    identical(state$share_by_unit[["A::01"]], changed$share_by_unit[["A::01"]]),
    identical(state$evaluation_by_unit[["A::01"]]$economic$EC, changed$evaluation_by_unit[["A::01"]]$economic$EC),
    isTRUE(all.equal(state$evaluation_by_unit[["C::01"]]$economic,
                     changed$evaluation_by_unit[["C::01"]]$economic)))

  for (sp in names(ctx$fixed_non_vms_quota_catch)) {
    catches <- sum(vapply(changed$evaluation_by_unit, function(z) z$quota_catch_kg[[sp]], numeric(1)))
    e$smart31_response_close(changed$catch_index[[sp]] - catches, ctx$fixed_non_vms_quota_catch[[sp]])
  }
  impossible <- ctx; impossible$crowding_limit <- 1
  before <- serialize(state, NULL)
  rejected <- e$smart31_response_transaction(state, "B::01", proposal, impossible)
  stopifnot(!rejected$valid, identical(before, serialize(state, NULL)))

  none <- ctx; none$v52$controls$lpue_response_mode <- "none"
  none_state <- e$smart31_response_build_state(state, none)
  for (uid in names(none_state$share_by_unit)) {
    raw <- e$evaluate_vessel_month_light(none_state$share_by_unit[[uid]], uid, none)
    actual <- none_state$evaluation_by_unit[[uid]]
    fields <- c("GVL_6sp", "GVL_other_reference", "GVL", "EC", "OC", "LC", "GVA", "GP")
    e$smart31_response_close(unlist(raw$economic[fields]), unlist(actual$economic[fields]))
  }

  none_raw <- e$evaluate_vessel_month_light(proposal, "B::01", none)
  cached_payload <- e$smart31_response_payload(proposal, "B::01", none, none_raw)
  none_raw$coupled_row_effort <- NULL
  uncached_payload <- e$smart31_response_payload(proposal, "B::01", none, none_raw)
  stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(cached_payload, uncached_payload, tolerance = 1e-12)))
  none_tx <- e$smart31_response_transaction(none_state, "B::01", proposal, none)
  stopifnot(none_tx$valid)
  none_changed <- e$smart31_response_commit(none_state, none_tx, none)
  for (peer in setdiff(names(none_state$evaluation_by_unit), "B::01"))
    stopifnot(identical(none_changed$evaluation_by_unit[[peer]], none_state$evaluation_by_unit[[peer]]))
  e$smart31_response_validate_state(none_changed, none, names(none$unit_kernels))

  moving <- state
  for (i in seq_len(24L)) {
    uid <- names(ctx$unit_kernels)[1L + (i %% length(ctx$unit_kernels))]
    k <- ctx$unit_kernels[[uid]]; share <- numeric(nrow(k$data))
    for (rows in k$pattern_rows) share[rows] <- e$normalise_positive(stats::runif(length(rows)))
    share <- e$smart31_set_extra(share, c(0, 1, 2)[1L + i %% 3L])
    tr <- e$smart31_response_transaction(moving, uid, share, ctx)
    if (tr$valid) moving <- e$smart31_response_commit(moving, tr, ctx)
    e$smart31_response_validate_state(moving, ctx)
  }

  stopifnot(!e$smart31_response_anneal_accept(-1, 0, 99, 80),
            !e$smart31_response_anneal_accept(1, 10, 70, 80),
            e$smart31_response_anneal_accept(1, 10, 101, 80))

  legacy_ctx <- ctx; legacy_ctx$v52 <- NULL
  set.seed(714L)
  a <- e$smart31_base_optimise_scenario_state(none_state, legacy_ctx, "stochastic_optimizer", 1L, seed = 714L)
  seed_a <- get(".Random.seed", envir = .GlobalEnv)
  set.seed(714L)
  b <- e$optimise_scenario_state(none_state, legacy_ctx, "stochastic_optimizer", 1L, seed = 714L)
  stopifnot(identical(a$state$share_by_unit, b$state$share_by_unit),
    identical(seed_a, get(".Random.seed", envir = .GlobalEnv)),
    isTRUE(all.equal(a$convergence_log, b$convergence_log)))

  ctx$v52$controls$return_best_feasible <- FALSE
  set.seed(522L)
  initial_raw <- e$smart31_working_state(ctx); initial_raw$units <- state$units
  result <- e$optimise_scenario_state(initial_raw, ctx, "stochastic_optimizer", 1L, seed = 522L)
  e$smart31_response_validate_state(result$state, ctx, names(ctx$unit_kernels))

  cp <- e$test_checkpoint
  resumed <- e$optimise_scenario_state(cp$state, ctx, "stochastic_optimizer", 1L, seed = 522L, resume_payload = cp)
  stopifnot(identical(result$state$share_by_unit, resumed$state$share_by_unit))
  e$smart31_response_close(result$state$v52$total_gva, resumed$state$v52$total_gva)
  trajectory <- result$search_trajectory
  growth <- trajectory[trajectory$search_phase == "improvement", , drop = FALSE]
  stopifnot(all(diff(growth$total_GVA) >= -1e-7), all(growth$accepted_worsening == 0L),
            all(diff(trajectory$best_feasible_GVA) >= -1e-7))
  invisible(list(status = "PASS", categories = 9L, stochastic_transactions = 24L,
                 fleet_fixture = "3 vessels; one mixed gear; two species; 3 cells"))
}

if (isTRUE(cfg$run_internal_tests)) {
  .smart31_response$test_results <- smart31_response_regression_tests()
  cat("synthetic coupled-accounting, peer-effects and exploration tests passed.\n")
} else .smart31_response$test_results <- list(status = "not_run")
```
