## Output and cartography helpers

```{r step2-26-output-and-cartography-helpers}

smart31_archive_tag <- function(x, scenario, method, replicate_id) {
  if (!is.data.frame(x) || !nrow(x)) return(tibble::tibble())
  for (nm in c("scenario_id", "scenario_year", "representative_period", "member_state", "cm_status"))
    x[[nm]] <- rep(scenario[[nm]], nrow(x))
  x$method <- rep(method, nrow(x)); x$replicate <- rep(as.integer(replicate_id), nrow(x))
  x
}

smart31_archive_sum_table <- function(x, keys, values) {
  if (!is.data.frame(x) || !nrow(x)) return(tibble::tibble())
  keys <- intersect(keys, names(x)); values <- intersect(values, names(x))
  if (!length(keys) || !length(values)) stop("Cannot summarise a table without keys and values.")
  if (inherits(x,"sf")) x <- sf::st_drop_geometry(x)
  if (any(!vapply(x[values], is.numeric, logical(1)))) stop("Non-numeric output measure.")
  if (any(!is.finite(as.matrix(x[values])))) stop("Non-finite output measure; no silent NA removal.")
  x %>% dplyr::group_by(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(keys))) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(values), sum), .groups="drop")
}

smart31_archive_compact_run <- function(run, scenario) {
  file <- smart31_completed_run_file(scenario$scenario_id, run$method, run$replicate)
  if (!file.exists(file) || file.info(file)$size <= 0) stop("Full run archive missing before compaction: ",file)
  run$archive_file <- normalizePath(file, winslash="/", mustWork=TRUE)
  run$archive_bytes <- as.numeric(file.info(file)$size)
  if (!isTRUE(run$feasible)) return(run)

  o <- run[["outputs", exact = TRUE]]
  detail_fields <- c("spatial_pattern", "catches", "occupancy")
  if (!is.list(o) || anyDuplicated(names(o)) ||
      !all(detail_fields %in% names(o)))
    stop("Compaction requires exact full-output fields: spatial_pattern, catches, occupancy. ",
         "Do not pass a compact summary as a complete run.")
  if (!all(vapply(o[detail_fields], is.data.frame, logical(1))))
    stop("Full-output detail fields must be data frames, including empty tables.")
  dims <- c("scenario_id","scenario_year","representative_period","member_state","cm_status","method","replicate")
  sp <- smart31_archive_sum_table(o[["spatial_pattern", exact = TRUE]], c(dims,"Gear","MONTH","id_grid"),
    c("effort","fishing_hours","steaming_hours","fishing_time","days_at_sea","trips","steaming_time"))

  ca <- smart31_archive_sum_table(o[["catches", exact = TRUE]],
    c(dims,"CFR","MONTH","Gear","Species","GSA_code","simulation_treatment"), "W")
  if (nrow(sp)) {
    err <- abs(sum(sp$effort)-sum(o[["spatial_pattern", exact = TRUE]]$effort))
    if (err > 1e-8 * max(1,abs(sum(o[["spatial_pattern", exact = TRUE]]$effort)))) stop("Spatial report aggregation loses effort.")
  }
  if (nrow(ca) && abs(sum(ca$W)-sum(o[["catches", exact = TRUE]]$W)) > 1e-8*max(1,abs(sum(o[["catches", exact = TRUE]]$W))))
    stop("Catch report aggregation loses catch.")
  run$detail_manifest <- data.frame(
    field=c("spatial_pattern","catches","occupancy"),
    rows=vapply(c("spatial_pattern","catches","occupancy"), function(nm) {
      z<-o[[nm, exact = TRUE]]; if(is.data.frame(z)) nrow(z) else 0L
    }, integer(1)),
    full_archive=basename(file), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

  o[["spatial_pattern"]] <- NULL; o[["catches"]] <- NULL; o[["occupancy"]] <- NULL
  o$spatial_report <- smart31_archive_tag(sp, scenario, run$method, run$replicate)
  o$catches_report <- smart31_archive_tag(ca, scenario, run$method, run$replicate)
  run$outputs <- o; run$storage_mode <- "compact_in_memory_full_per_run_archive"
  compact_name <- sub("_completed_","_summary_",basename(file),fixed=TRUE)
  if(identical(compact_name,basename(file))) compact_name <- paste0("summary_",basename(file))
  compact_file <- file.path(dirname(file),compact_name)
  atomic_save_rds(run, compact_file)
  run
}

smart31_archive_relative_path <- function(path, from) {
  split_path <- function(x) strsplit(normalizePath(x,winslash="/",mustWork=FALSE),"/",fixed=TRUE)[[1L]]
  a <- split_path(path); b <- split_path(from); n <- 0L
  while(n < min(length(a),length(b)) && identical(a[n+1L],b[n+1L])) n <- n+1L
  out <- c(rep("..",length(b)-n), if(n < length(a)) a[seq.int(n+1L,length(a))] else character())
  if(length(out)) paste(out,collapse="/") else "."
}

smart31_archive_read_results <- function(file, tables=character(), run_ids=NULL, max_overview_mib=128) {

  if(!file.exists(file)) stop("Overview file not found: ",file)
  if(!is.finite(max_overview_mib) || max_overview_mib <= 0) stop("Invalid overview size guard.")
  if(file.info(file)$size > max_overview_mib * 1024^2)
    stop("Selected overview exceeds the read guard. Do not select the old 500-MB master. ",
         "Use the compact overview, or deliberately raise max_overview_mib.")
  bundle <- readRDS(file)
  if (!identical(bundle$metadata$storage_format,"SMART31.partitioned.results.1"))
    stop("Not a partitioned overview: ",file)
  if (!length(tables)) return(bundle)
  allowed <- c("spatial_patterns","catches","occupancy")
  if (any(!tables %in% allowed)) stop("Unknown detail tables: ",paste(setdiff(tables,allowed),collapse=", "))
  manifest <- bundle$run_archives
  manifest <- manifest[manifest$feasible,,drop=FALSE]
  if (!is.null(run_ids)) {
    if(any(!run_ids %in% manifest$run_id)) stop("Unknown run_id requested.")
    manifest <- manifest[manifest$run_id %in% run_ids,,drop=FALSE]
  }
  chunks <- stats::setNames(lapply(tables,function(x) list()),tables)
  for(i in seq_len(nrow(manifest))) {
    path <- file.path(dirname(file),manifest$archive_relative[i])
    if(!file.exists(path)) stop("Missing complete archive: ",path,". Keep the result directory together.")
    archive <- readRDS(path)
    if(!identical(as.character(archive$metadata$scientific_source_md5),
                  as.character(bundle$metadata$scientific_source_md5))) stop("Archive source mismatch: ",path)
    r <- archive$run
    if(!isTRUE(r$feasible)) stop("Archive status does not match overview: ",path)
    for(nm in tables) {
      field <- if(nm=="spatial_patterns") "spatial_pattern" else nm
      full_outputs <- r[["outputs", exact = TRUE]]
      if (!is.list(full_outputs) || anyDuplicated(names(full_outputs)) ||
          !field %in% names(full_outputs) ||
          !is.data.frame(full_outputs[[field, exact = TRUE]]))
        stop("Complete archive is missing the exact detail table '", field,
             "': ", path, ". A report summary is not a detail table.")
      chunks[[nm]][[length(chunks[[nm]])+1L]] <- full_outputs[[field, exact = TRUE]]
      rm(full_outputs)
    }
    rm(archive,r); invisible(gc(verbose=FALSE))
  }
  for(nm in tables) bundle[[nm]] <- dplyr::bind_rows(chunks[[nm]])
  bundle$metadata$materialised_detail_tables <- tables

  bundle
}

smart31_archive_cartography <- function(grid, land_file=NULL, gsa_file=NULL) {
  if(!inherits(grid,"sf") || !"id_grid" %in% names(grid)) stop("A georeferenced map grid is required.")
  if(is.na(sf::st_crs(grid))) stop("Map grid CRS is undefined.")
  grid <- grid[,"id_grid",drop=FALSE]; grid$id_grid <- as.character(grid$id_grid)
  if(anyNA(grid$id_grid) || anyDuplicated(grid$id_grid)) stop("Invalid map-grid identifiers.")
  grid <- sf::st_transform(grid,4326)
  box <- sf::st_bbox(grid); pad <- .025 * max(box["xmax"]-box["xmin"],box["ymax"]-box["ymin"])
  box <- sf::st_bbox(c(xmin=unname(box["xmin"]-pad),ymin=unname(box["ymin"]-pad),
    xmax=unname(box["xmax"]+pad),ymax=unname(box["ymax"]+pad)),crs=sf::st_crs(4326))
  if(!is.null(land_file) && nzchar(land_file)) {
    if(!file.exists(land_file)) stop("Configured land layer is missing: ",land_file)
    land <- if(grepl("\\.rds$",land_file,ignore.case=TRUE)) readRDS(land_file) else sf::st_read(land_file,quiet=TRUE)
    if(!inherits(land,"sf") || is.na(sf::st_crs(land))) stop("Land layer must be sf with a defined CRS.")
    source <- normalizePath(land_file,winslash="/")
  } else {
    if(!requireNamespace("maps",quietly=TRUE)) stop("Install 'maps' (also used by Step 1) before drawing coastlines.")

    land <- sf::st_as_sf(maps::map("world",plot=FALSE,fill=TRUE))
    if(is.na(sf::st_crs(land))) sf::st_crs(land) <- 4326
    source <- paste0("maps::world; installed maps ",utils::packageVersion("maps"))
  }
  land <- sf::st_make_valid(sf::st_transform(land,4326))
  keep <- lengths(sf::st_intersects(sf::st_geometry(land),sf::st_as_sfc(box))) > 0L
  land <- land[keep,,drop=FALSE]
  land <- suppressWarnings(sf::st_crop(sf::st_make_valid(land),box))

  land <- sf::st_sf(geometry=sf::st_geometry(land))
  gsa <- NULL; gsa_status <- "not_requested_or_not_present"
  if(!is.null(gsa_file) && nzchar(gsa_file) && file.exists(gsa_file)) {
    gsa <- tryCatch({
      z <- sf::st_read(gsa_file,quiet=TRUE)
      if(is.na(sf::st_crs(z))) stop("Undefined GSA CRS")
      z <- sf::st_transform(z,4326)
      z <- suppressWarnings(sf::st_crop(sf::st_make_valid(z),box))
      sf::st_sf(geometry=sf::st_geometry(z))
    },error=function(e){gsa_status <<- paste("unavailable:",conditionMessage(e));NULL})
    if(!is.null(gsa)) gsa_status <- "read_local_Step1_GSA_layer"
  }
  list(grid=grid,land=land,gsa=gsa,bbox=box,
    provenance=data.frame(land_source=source,land_features=nrow(land),gsa_status=gsa_status,
      grid_geometry_modified_for_simulation=FALSE,coastline_source="Same world dataset family as Step 1",
      stringsAsFactors=FALSE))
}

smart31_archive_map_plot <- function(table, cartography, value, title, subtitle="", kind="absolute",
    limits=NULL, facet=NULL, ncol=2L, caption="") {
  if(!value %in% names(table)) stop("Map field missing: ",value)
  table$id_grid <- as.character(table$id_grid)
  j <- match(table$id_grid,cartography$grid$id_grid)
  if(anyNA(j)) stop("Effort cells missing from map geometry.")

  layer <- sf::st_sf(table,geometry=sf::st_geometry(cartography$grid)[j])
  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(layer) + ggplot2::geom_sf(ggplot2::aes(fill=.data[[value]]),colour=NA)
  if(!is.null(cartography$gsa) && nrow(cartography$gsa)) p <- p +
    ggplot2::geom_sf(data=cartography$gsa,inherit.aes=FALSE,fill=NA,colour="#172B4D",linewidth=.3,show.legend=FALSE)
  p <- p + ggplot2::geom_sf(data=cartography$land,inherit.aes=FALSE,
    fill="grey92",colour="grey55",linewidth=.25,show.legend=FALSE)
  if(kind=="absolute") { p <- p + ggplot2::scale_fill_viridis_c(option="mako",direction=-1,
    limits=limits,trans="sqrt",na.value="transparent",labels=scales::label_number(big.mark=","),
    name="LOA (m) × fishing hours",guide=ggplot2::guide_colourbar(title.position="top",
      barwidth=grid::unit(55,"mm"),barheight=grid::unit(4,"mm")))
  } else if(kind=="footprint") { p <- p + ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
    values=c("Used in both"="#168A9B","No longer used"="#B35806","New to reference cohort"="#7462A8","Unused in both"="#F7FBFD"),
    drop=FALSE,na.value="transparent",name="Spatial use")
  } else { p <- p + ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient2(low="#B35806",mid="#F7FBFD",high="#2166AC",
    midpoint=0,limits=limits,na.value="transparent",labels=scales::label_number(big.mark=","),
    name=if(kind=="percent") "Change (%)" else "Scenario − historical\nLOA (m) × hours",
    guide=ggplot2::guide_colourbar(title.position="top",barwidth=grid::unit(55,"mm"),barheight=grid::unit(4,"mm")))
  }
  if(!is.null(facet)) p <- p + ggplot2::facet_wrap(stats::reformulate(facet),ncol=ncol,drop=FALSE)
  b <- cartography$bbox
  p + ggplot2::coord_sf(crs=sf::st_crs(4326),datum=sf::st_crs(4326),
    xlim=as.numeric(b[c("xmin","xmax")]),ylim=as.numeric(b[c("ymin","ymax")]),expand=FALSE) +
    smart31_archive_map_theme() + ggplot2::labs(title=title,subtitle=subtitle,
      x="Longitude",y="Latitude",caption=caption)
}

smart31_archive_comparison <- function(historical, scenario, gear, monthly=FALSE) {
  h <- historical[historical$Gear==gear,,drop=FALSE]
  s <- scenario[scenario$Gear==gear,,drop=FALSE]
  key <- if(monthly) c("MONTH","id_grid") else "id_grid"
  h <- smart31_archive_sum_table(h,key,"effort_historical")
  s <- smart31_archive_sum_table(s,key,"effort_scenario")

  if(!nrow(h)) {h<-scenario[0,key,drop=FALSE];h$effort_historical<-numeric()}
  if(!nrow(s)) {s<-historical[0,key,drop=FALSE];s$effort_scenario<-numeric()}
  z <- dplyr::full_join(h,s,by=key,relationship="one-to-one")
  z$historical <- dplyr::coalesce(z$effort_historical,0)
  z$scenario <- dplyr::coalesce(z$effort_scenario,0)
  z$difference <- z$scenario-z$historical
  z$change_percent <- NA_real_; k <- z$historical > 1e-12
  z$change_percent[k] <- 100*z$difference[k]/z$historical[k]
  z$spatial_status <- ifelse(!k & z$scenario>1e-12,"New to reference cohort",
    ifelse(k & z$scenario<=1e-12,"No longer used",ifelse(k,"Used in both","Unused in both")))
  z$Gear <- rep(gear,nrow(z)); z
}

smart31_archive_render_report <- function(bundle, output_root, reuse_existing=TRUE) {
  required <- c("ggplot2","dplyr","tidyr","sf","scales")
  for(pkg in required) if(!requireNamespace(pkg,quietly=TRUE)) stop("Missing reporting package: ",pkg)
  if(!identical(bundle$metadata$storage_format,"SMART31.partitioned.results.1")) stop("A overview is required.")
  pset <- bundle$report_options
  report_dir <- file.path(output_root,"reports",bundle$metadata$run_timestamp)
  figure_dir <- file.path(report_dir,"figures")
  dir.create(figure_dir,recursive=TRUE,showWarnings=FALSE)
  manifest_file <- file.path(report_dir,"figure_manifest.csv")
  index_file <- file.path(report_dir,"SMART31_Step2_Report.html")
  manifest <- data.frame(figure=character(),file=character(),status=character(),error=character(),
    bytes=numeric(),seconds=numeric(),stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  if(isTRUE(reuse_existing) && file.exists(manifest_file)) {
    old_manifest <- tryCatch(utils::read.csv(manifest_file,stringsAsFactors=FALSE),error=function(e) NULL)
  } else old_manifest <- NULL
  escape <- function(x) {
    x <- as.character(x); x[is.na(x)] <- "—"
    x <- gsub("&","&amp;",x,fixed=TRUE); x <- gsub("<","&lt;",x,fixed=TRUE)
    x <- gsub(">","&gt;",x,fixed=TRUE); x <- gsub('"',"&quot;",x,fixed=TRUE);x
  }
  table_html <- function(x) {
    if(!is.data.frame(x) || !nrow(x)) return("<p>No rows available.</p>")
    y <- x
    for(nm in names(y)) if(is.numeric(y[[nm]])) y[[nm]] <- format(signif(y[[nm]],5),trim=TRUE,scientific=FALSE)
    paste0("<div class='scroll'><table><thead><tr><th>",paste(escape(names(y)),collapse="</th><th>"),
      "</th></tr></thead><tbody>",paste(vapply(seq_len(nrow(y)),function(i) paste0("<tr><td>",
      paste(escape(unlist(y[i,],use.names=FALSE)),collapse="</td><td>"),"</td></tr>"),character(1)),collapse=""),
      "</tbody></table></div>")
  }
  publish <- function() {
    utils::write.csv(manifest,manifest_file,row.names=FALSE,na="")
    small <- bundle$scenario_economic_summary
    cols <- intersect(c("scenario_id","method","GVA","reference_GVA","initial_GVA","days_at_sea","EC"),names(small))
    if(length(cols)) small <- small[,cols,drop=FALSE]
    cards <- if(nrow(manifest)) paste(vapply(seq_len(nrow(manifest)),function(i) {
      m <- manifest[i,]
      if(m$status %in% c("written","reused")) paste0("<article><h3>",escape(gsub("_"," ",m$figure)),
        "</h3><a href='figures/",escape(m$file),"'><img loading='lazy' decoding='async' src='figures/",
        escape(m$file),"' alt='",escape(m$figure),"'></a></article>")
      else paste0("<article class='error'><h3>",escape(m$figure),"</h3><p>",escape(m$error),"</p></article>")
    },character(1)),collapse="\n") else "<p>Numerical results saved. Figures are pending.</p>"
    h <- paste0("<!doctype html><html lang='en'><head><meta charset='utf-8'>",
      "<meta name='viewport' content='width=device-width,initial-scale=1'><title>SMART3.1 Step 2 · results</title>",
      "<style>body{margin:0;background:#F3F6F8;color:#17324D;font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif}",
      "main{max-width:1180px;margin:auto;padding:28px}h1{font-size:29px}h2{font-size:22px;margin-top:35px}",
      "p{line-height:1.6}.note{border-left:4px solid #168A9B;background:#fff;padding:16px}.scroll{overflow-x:auto}",
      "table{background:#fff;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:12px;width:100%}td,th{border-bottom:1px solid #dce5eb;padding:10px;text-align:left}",
      "article{background:white;border:1px solid #dce5eb;border-radius:9px;padding:16px;margin:22px 0}",
      "article h3{font-size:14px;color:#526979}img{width:100%;height:auto}a{color:#176b8f}.error{border-left:4px solid #B35806}",
      "code{font-size:12px}</style></head><body><main><h1>SMART3.1 · Step 2 results</h1><p>",
      "· ",escape(bundle$metadata$run_timestamp)," · maximum sweeps ",bundle$metadata$maximum_sweeps,
      " · LPUE response: ",escape(bundle$metadata$lpue_response_mode)," · crowding: ",escape(bundle$metadata$crowding_definition),"</p>",
      "<div class='note'>Historical GVA is the unchanged Step 1 model reference, not the conditioned run start. ",
      "The latter includes the Step 2 resets and management constraints. Sweeps are optimisation iterations, not calendar periods. ",
      "Full vessel–cell details remain in the per-run RDS archives. This gallery uses only compact summaries and external PNGs.</div>",
      "<h2>Run status</h2>",table_html(bundle$run_status),"<h2>Economic comparisons (EUR)</h2>",table_html(small),
      "<h2>Figures</h2><p>Historical effort is captured before the Step 2 operational resets. ",
      "Annual and monthly comparisons share the same spatial domain. Absolute colours use a square-root transformation; ",
      "signed changes are centred on zero, without quantile clipping. Coastlines are display layers, not changes to the simulation grid.</p>",
      cards,"<p><a href='figure_manifest.csv'>Figure status and error log</a></p></main></body></html>")
    temp <- paste0(index_file,".tmp")
    writeLines(h,temp,useBytes=TRUE)
    if(!file.rename(temp,index_file)) {
      if(!file.copy(temp,index_file,overwrite=TRUE)) stop("Cannot publish report HTML.")
      unlink(temp)
    }
  }
  publish()
  if(!isTRUE(pset$render_figures)) return(list(report_file=index_file,manifest=manifest,
    status=data.frame(numerical_outputs_saved=TRUE,graphical_outputs="not_requested")))
  job <- function(stem,builder,width=11,height=7) {
    safe <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_-]","_",stem); filename <- paste0(safe,".png"); path <- file.path(figure_dir,filename)
    valid_png <- function(path) {
      if(!file.exists(path) || file.info(path)$size < 12) return(FALSE)
      con<-file(path,"rb");on.exit(close(con));identical(readBin(con,"raw",n=8),as.raw(c(137,80,78,71,13,10,26,10)))
    }
    known <- !is.null(old_manifest) && all(c("file","status") %in% names(old_manifest)) &&
      any(old_manifest$file==filename & old_manifest$status %in% c("written","reused"))
    started <- proc.time()[[3]]; error <- ""; status <- "written"
    if(isTRUE(reuse_existing) && known && valid_png(path)) status <- "reused" else {
      temp <- file.path(figure_dir,paste0(safe,".writing.png"))
      status <- tryCatch({
        plot <- builder()

        args <- list(filename=temp,plot=plot,width=width,height=height,units="in",
          dpi=pset$figure_dpi,limitsize=TRUE,bg="white")
        if(requireNamespace("ragg",quietly=TRUE)) args$device <- ragg::agg_png
        do.call(ggplot2::ggsave,args)
        rm(plot)
        if(!valid_png(temp)) stop("Incomplete PNG output")
        if(!file.rename(temp,path)) {
          if(!file.copy(temp,path,overwrite=TRUE)) stop("Cannot publish PNG")
          unlink(temp)
        }
        "written"
      },error=function(e){error <<- conditionMessage(e);"failed"})
      if(status=="failed" && file.exists(temp)) unlink(temp)
    }
    manifest <<- rbind(manifest,data.frame(figure=safe,file=filename,status=status,error=error,
      bytes=if(file.exists(path)) as.numeric(file.info(path)$size) else 0,
      seconds=proc.time()[[3]]-started,stringsAsFactors=FALSE))
    publish(); invisible(gc(verbose=FALSE))
    message("Report figure ",nrow(manifest),": ",safe," [",status,"]")
    invisible(status)
  }
  conv <- bundle$sweep_diagnostics; econ <- bundle$scenario_economic_summary
  if("record_type" %in% names(conv)) conv <- conv[is.na(conv$record_type) |
    conv$record_type != "output_selection_not_an_additional_sweep",,drop=FALSE]
  if(nrow(conv) && nrow(econ)) {
    reference <- econ[,c("scenario_id","method","replicate","reference_GVA","initial_GVA"),drop=FALSE]
    z <- dplyr::left_join(conv,reference,by=c("scenario_id","method","replicate"),suffix=c("","_summary"))

    z$historical_GVA <- reference$reference_GVA[match(paste(z$scenario_id,z$method,z$replicate),
      paste(reference$scenario_id,reference$method,reference$replicate))]
    z$starting_GVA <- reference$initial_GVA[match(paste(z$scenario_id,z$method,z$replicate),
      paste(reference$scenario_id,reference$method,reference$replicate))]
    job("GVA_sweeps_with_history",function() {
      long <- tidyr::pivot_longer(z,c("total_GVA","historical_GVA","starting_GVA"),names_to="reference",values_to="eur")
      ggplot2::ggplot(long,ggplot2::aes(.data$sweep,.data$eur/1e6,colour=.data$reference,
        linetype=.data$reference,group=interaction(.data$reference,.data$replicate))) +
        ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth=.7) + ggplot2::facet_grid(scenario_id~method) +
        ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values=c(total_GVA="#F28E2B",historical_GVA="#17324D",starting_GVA="#168A9B"),
          labels=c(total_GVA="Current GVA",historical_GVA="Step 1 history",starting_GVA="Conditioned start")) +
        ggplot2::scale_linetype_manual(values=c(total_GVA="solid",historical_GVA="dashed",starting_GVA="dotted"),
          labels=c(total_GVA="Current GVA",historical_GVA="Step 1 history",starting_GVA="Conditioned start")) +
        ggplot2::labs(title="GVA during the search, with the historical reference",x="Sweep",y="Million EUR",colour=NULL,linetype=NULL) +
        ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size=11)+ggplot2::theme(legend.position="bottom")
    },height=8)
    z$vs_history_percent <- smart31_archive_percent_change(z$total_GVA,z$historical_GVA)
    z$vs_start_percent <- smart31_archive_percent_change(z$total_GVA,z$starting_GVA)
    job("GVA_two_denominators",function() {
      long <- tidyr::pivot_longer(z,c("vs_history_percent","vs_start_percent"),names_to="comparison",values_to="change")
      ggplot2::ggplot(long,ggplot2::aes(.data$sweep,.data$change,colour=.data$comparison,
        group=interaction(.data$comparison,.data$replicate))) + ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept=0,colour="grey60") +
        ggplot2::geom_line()+ggplot2::facet_grid(scenario_id~method)+ggplot2::theme_minimal()+
        ggplot2::theme(legend.position="bottom")+ggplot2::labs(title="Recovery from start versus change from history",x="Sweep",y="Change (%)",colour=NULL)
    },height=8)
    energy_fields <- intersect(c("total_EC_fishing","total_EC_steaming"),names(conv))
    if(length(energy_fields)==2L) job("energy_fishing_steaming",function() {
      long<-tidyr::pivot_longer(conv,dplyr::all_of(energy_fields),names_to="component",values_to="eur")
      ggplot2::ggplot(long,ggplot2::aes(.data$sweep,.data$eur/1e6,colour=.data$component,
        group=interaction(.data$component,.data$replicate)))+ggplot2::geom_line()+
        ggplot2::facet_grid(scenario_id~method,scales="free_y")+ggplot2::theme_minimal()+
        ggplot2::labs(title="Energy cost components",x="Sweep",y="Million EUR",colour=NULL)
    },height=8)
    if("total_used_cm_days" %in% names(conv)) job("CM_days_used",function() {
      ggplot2::ggplot(conv,ggplot2::aes(.data$sweep,.data$total_used_cm_days,colour=.data$method,
        group=interaction(.data$method,.data$replicate)))+ggplot2::geom_line()+
        ggplot2::facet_wrap(~scenario_id)+ggplot2::theme_minimal()+ggplot2::labs(title="Optional CM days actually used",x="Sweep",y="Additional days")
    })
  }
  boxes<-bundle$surface_diagnostics$catch_boxplot_data
  if(is.data.frame(boxes) && nrow(boxes)) for(method in setdiff(unique(boxes$method),"Historical")) {
    d <- boxes[boxes$method %in% c("Historical",method),,drop=FALSE]
    d$comparison <- factor(d$comparison,levels=unique(c("Historical",as.character(d$comparison))))
    for(logarithmic in c(FALSE,TRUE)) job(paste0("catch_boxplot_",method,if(logarithmic) "_pseudolog" else ""),function() {
      q <- ggplot2::ggplot(d,ggplot2::aes(.data$comparison,.data$catch_t,fill=.data$comparison))+
        ggplot2::geom_boxplot(outlier.size=.5)+ggplot2::facet_wrap(~Species,scales="free_y",ncol=3)+
        ggplot2::theme_minimal()+ggplot2::theme(legend.position="none",axis.text.x=ggplot2::element_text(angle=30,hjust=1,size=8))+
        ggplot2::labs(title="Annual representative catch per vessel",subtitle=method,x=NULL,y="Tonnes per vessel",
          caption="Same original active cohort. Ceased vessels are zero; failed runs are not zero. Spread is among vessels, not simulation uncertainty.")
      if(logarithmic) q <- q+ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(trans=scales::pseudo_log_trans(base=10))
      q
    },height=8)
  }

  if(nrow(conv) && all(c("total_GVL","total_EC","total_OC","total_GVA") %in% names(conv))) {
    decomposition<-conv %>% dplyr::group_by(.data$scenario_id,.data$method,.data$replicate) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(.data$sweep,.by_group=TRUE) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(revenue=dplyr::last(.data$total_GVL)-dplyr::first(.data$total_GVL),
        energy=dplyr::first(.data$total_EC)-dplyr::last(.data$total_EC),
        other_costs=dplyr::first(.data$total_OC)-dplyr::last(.data$total_OC),
        delta_GVA=dplyr::last(.data$total_GVA)-dplyr::first(.data$total_GVA),.groups="drop")
    decomposition$residual<-with(decomposition,delta_GVA-revenue-energy-other_costs)
    utils::write.csv(decomposition,file.path(report_dir,"GVA_decomposition.csv"),row.names=FALSE)
    job("GVA_decomposition",function() {
      d<-tidyr::pivot_longer(decomposition,c("revenue","energy","other_costs"),names_to="component",values_to="eur")
      ggplot2::ggplot(d,ggplot2::aes(.data$component,.data$eur/1e6,fill=.data$component))+
        ggplot2::geom_col()+ggplot2::facet_grid(scenario_id~method,scales="free_y")+ggplot2::theme_minimal()+
        ggplot2::theme(legend.position="none")+ggplot2::labs(title="GVA change: revenue and costs",x=NULL,y="Million EUR",
          caption="Start to last visited search state. Output selection, if different, is shown in the economic stages.")
    },height=8)
  }
  if(nrow(conv) && "EC_change_percent" %in% names(conv)) job("energy_percent_own_scale",function() {
    ggplot2::ggplot(conv,ggplot2::aes(.data$sweep,.data$EC_change_percent,colour=.data$method,
      group=interaction(.data$method,.data$replicate)))+ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept=0,colour="grey70")+
      ggplot2::geom_line()+ggplot2::facet_wrap(~scenario_id,scales="free_y")+ggplot2::theme_minimal()+
      ggplot2::labs(title="Energy-cost response on its own scale",x="Sweep",y="Change from run start (%)")
  })
  stages<-bundle$response_diagnostics$economic_stages
  if(is.data.frame(stages) && nrow(stages)) job("GVA_economic_stages",function() {
    s<-stages;s$stage<-factor(s$stage,levels=c("imported_Step1_history","common_daily_operational_reference",
      "conditioned_initial_after_measures","selected_optimised_pattern"),
      labels=c("Step 1 history","Common operative","Conditioned start","Selected result"))
    ggplot2::ggplot(s,ggplot2::aes(.data$stage,.data$GVA/1e6,fill=.data$stage))+ggplot2::geom_col()+
      ggplot2::facet_grid(scenario_id~method)+ggplot2::theme_minimal()+
      ggplot2::theme(legend.position="none",axis.text.x=ggplot2::element_text(angle=25,hjust=1))+
      ggplot2::labs(title="Historical, operative, initial and final economic references",x=NULL,y="Million EUR",
        caption="Distinct model stages, not a calendar-time economic trajectory. Missing references are not zero.")
  },width=12,height=8)
  traj<-bundle$response_diagnostics$search_trajectory
  if(is.data.frame(traj) && nrow(traj) && "accepted_worsening" %in% names(traj)) job("accepted_initial_declines",function() {
    ggplot2::ggplot(traj,ggplot2::aes(.data$sweep,.data$accepted_worsening))+
      ggplot2::geom_col(fill="#168A9B")+ggplot2::facet_grid(scenario_id~method)+ggplot2::theme_minimal()+
      ggplot2::labs(title="Accepted GVA declines during exploration",x="Optimiser sweep",y="Accepted moves")
  },height=8)
  if(nrow(conv) && all(c("mean_distance_km","effective_occupied_cells") %in% names(conv))) job("distance_and_concentration",function() {
    d<-tidyr::pivot_longer(conv,c("mean_distance_km","effective_occupied_cells"),names_to="indicator",values_to="value")
    ggplot2::ggplot(d,ggplot2::aes(.data$sweep,.data$value,colour=.data$method,
      group=interaction(.data$method,.data$replicate)))+ggplot2::geom_line()+
      ggplot2::facet_grid(indicator~scenario_id,scales="free_y")+ggplot2::theme_minimal()+
      ggplot2::labs(title="Spatial response: mean distance and effective occupied cells",x="Sweep",y=NULL)
  },height=7)

  cartography <- tryCatch(readRDS(file.path(output_root,bundle$cartography_file)),error=function(e) NULL)
  if(is.null(cartography)) {
    manifest <- rbind(manifest,data.frame(figure="cartography",file="",status="failed",error="Cartography sidecar unavailable; numerical outputs remain intact.",bytes=0,seconds=0))
    publish()
  } else if(nrow(bundle$run_status[bundle$run_status$feasible,,drop=FALSE])) {
    historical <- bundle$surface_diagnostics$historical_effort
    all_scenario <- bundle$spatial_patterns_summary
    runs <- unique(bundle$run_status[bundle$run_status$feasible,c("scenario_id","method","replicate","converged"),drop=FALSE])
    gears <- sort(unique(c(historical$Gear,all_scenario$Gear)))
    scales_log <- list()
    for(gear in gears) {

      tabs<-lapply(seq_len(nrow(runs)),function(i) {
        r<-runs[i,]; s<-all_scenario[all_scenario$scenario_id==r$scenario_id & all_scenario$method==r$method & all_scenario$replicate==r$replicate,,drop=FALSE]
        smart31_archive_comparison(historical,s,gear,FALSE)
      })
      scale_abs <- max(c(1,unlist(lapply(tabs,function(t)c(t$historical,t$scenario)))))
      scale_delta <- max(c(1,abs(unlist(lapply(tabs,function(t)t$difference)))))
      pp<-unlist(lapply(tabs,function(t)t$change_percent));scale_percent<-max(c(1,abs(pp[is.finite(pp)])))
      monthly_tabs<-if(isTRUE(pset$comparison_monthly_maps)) lapply(seq_len(nrow(runs)),function(i) {
        r<-runs[i,];s<-all_scenario[all_scenario$scenario_id==r$scenario_id & all_scenario$method==r$method & all_scenario$replicate==r$replicate,,drop=FALSE]
        smart31_archive_comparison(historical,s,gear,TRUE)
      }) else list()
      monthly_abs<-max(c(1,unlist(lapply(monthly_tabs,function(t)c(t$historical,t$scenario)))))
      monthly_delta<-max(c(1,abs(unlist(lapply(monthly_tabs,function(t)t$difference)))))
      scales_log[[gear]]<-data.frame(Gear=gear,absolute_max=scale_abs,difference_max=scale_delta,percent_max=scale_percent,
        monthly_absolute_max=monthly_abs,monthly_difference_max=monthly_delta)
      for(i in seq_len(nrow(runs))) {
        r<-runs[i,];tab<-tabs[[i]];if(!nrow(tab))next
        stem<-paste(r$scenario_id,r$method,paste0("rep",r$replicate),gear,sep="_")
        subtitle<-paste(gear,r$scenario_id,r$method,if(r$converged)"converged" else "feasible / not converged",sep=" | ")
        job(paste0("effort_absolute_",stem),function() {
          a<-tidyr::pivot_longer(tab,c("historical","scenario"),names_to="representation",values_to="value")
          a$representation<-factor(a$representation,levels=c("historical","scenario"),labels=c("Historical annual reference","Scenario annual pattern"))
          smart31_archive_map_plot(a,cartography,"value","Annual effort: historical and scenario",subtitle,"absolute",
            c(0,scale_abs),"representation",2L,"Common cohort, annualisation, extent and scale. Square-root colour transform; no clipping.")
        },width=12,height=7)
        job(paste0("effort_difference_",stem),function() smart31_archive_map_plot(tab,cartography,"difference",
          "Change in annual fishing effort",subtitle,"difference",c(-scale_delta,scale_delta),caption="Positive = increase; negative = reduction. Same absolute scale across runs of this gear."))
        job(paste0("effort_footprint_",stem),function() smart31_archive_map_plot(tab,cartography,"spatial_status",
          "Change in the fishing footprint",subtitle,"footprint",caption="New to the reference cohort does not mean never fished by any vessel."))
        job(paste0("effort_percent_",stem),function() smart31_archive_map_plot(tab,cartography,"change_percent",
          "Relative change in annual effort",subtitle,"percent",c(-scale_percent,scale_percent),
          caption="Percent change is undefined where historical effort is zero; see the footprint map for new uses."))
        if(length(monthly_tabs)) {
          mtab<-monthly_tabs[[i]]; pages<-split(1:12,ceiling((1:12)/as.integer(pset$map_months_per_page)))
          for(page in seq_along(pages)) {
            months<-pages[[page]];m<-mtab[mtab$MONTH %in% months,,drop=FALSE]
            if(!nrow(m))next
            m$month_label<-factor(m$MONTH,levels=months,labels=month.abb[months])
            job(paste0("effort_monthly_difference_",stem,"_page",page),function()
              smart31_archive_map_plot(m,cartography,"difference","Monthly effort redistribution",subtitle,"difference",
                c(-monthly_delta,monthly_delta),"month_label",2L,"Same scale across months and runs. Effort is not pooled over repeated future years."),width=11,height=9)
            if(isTRUE(pset$monthly_absolute_atlases)) for(representation in c("historical","scenario"))
              job(paste0("effort_monthly_",representation,"_",stem,"_page",page),function()
                smart31_archive_map_plot(m,cartography,representation,paste("Monthly effort:",representation),subtitle,
                  "absolute",c(0,monthly_abs),"month_label",2L),width=11,height=9)
          }
        }
      }
      rm(tabs,monthly_tabs);invisible(gc(verbose=FALSE))
    }
    utils::write.csv(dplyr::bind_rows(scales_log),file.path(report_dir,"map_scale_limits.csv"),row.names=FALSE)
  }
  publish()
  status<-data.frame(numerical_outputs_saved=TRUE,figures_written=sum(manifest$status=="written"),
    figures_reused=sum(manifest$status=="reused"),figures_failed=sum(manifest$status=="failed"),
    native_knit_HTML_completion_verified=FALSE,report_file=normalizePath(index_file,winslash="/"))
  utils::write.csv(status,file.path(report_dir,"report_status.csv"),row.names=FALSE)
  list(report_file=index_file,manifest=manifest,status=status)
}

smart31_archive_regression_tests <- function(draw_map=TRUE) {
  env <- new.env(parent=environment(smart31_archive_regression_tests))
  for(nm in ls(parent.env(env),all.names=TRUE)) {
    obj<-get(nm,envir=parent.env(env),inherits=FALSE)
    if(is.function(obj) && identical(environment(obj),parent.env(env))) {
      environment(obj)<-env;assign(nm,obj,envir=env)
    }
  }
  wd <- tempfile("smart31_archive_test_");dir.create(wd)
  on.exit(unlink(wd,recursive=TRUE),add=TRUE)
  env$smart31_completed_run_file <- function(...) file.path(wd,"run.rds")
  p<-env$smart31_archive_percent_change(c(12,12,0,2),c(10,30,0,-2))
  stopifnot(identical(p,c(20,-60,NA_real_,200)))

  events<-data.frame(event=c("optimisation_started","optimisation_sweep","run_output_selected"),
    scenario_id="TEST",method="test",replicate=1L,sweep=c(0,1,NA),maximum_sweeps=50L,
    total_GVA=c(10e6,12e6,12e6),reference_GVA=10e6,historical_GVA=30e6)
  curve<-env$smart31_monitor_curve_data(events)
  stopifnot(nrow(curve)==2L,identical(curve$sweep,c(0,1)))
  svg<-env$smart31_monitor_convergence_svg(events)
  stopifnot(grepl("Step 1 historical reference",svg,fixed=TRUE),grepl("Change vs history",svg,fixed=TRUE),
    grepl("Change vs run start",svg,fixed=TRUE),!grepl("NaN",svg,fixed=TRUE))
  scenario<-list(scenario_id="SYNTHETIC",scenario_year=.smart31_years$baseline,representative_period=.smart31_case$periods$baseline,member_state="ITA",cm_status="with_cm")
  spatial<-data.frame(CFR=c("A","A","B"),MONTH=1L,Gear="OTB",id_grid=c("1","2","1"),
    effort=c(100,20,80),fishing_hours=c(10,2,8),days_at_sea=c(1,.2,.8),trips=c(1,.2,.8),steaming_hours=c(2,.4,1.6))
  catch<-data.frame(CFR=c("A","A","B",NA),MONTH=1L,Gear="OTB",Species=c("HKE","HKE","ARS","HKE"),
    id_grid=c("1","2","1","1"),GSA_code="GSA09",simulation_treatment=c(rep("simulated",3),"fixed_non_vms_catch_no_synthetic_effort_or_economics"),
    W=c(20,4,10,5),GVL=c(100,20,80,NA_real_))
  run<-list(feasible=TRUE,method="test",replicate=1L,seed=1L,outputs=list(spatial_pattern=spatial,catches=catch,
    occupancy=data.frame(MONTH=1L,id_grid=c("1","2"),effort=c(180,20)),converged=FALSE,
    economic_monthly=data.frame(CFR=c("A","B"),MONTH=1L,GVL=c(120,80),
      EC=c(30,20),OC=c(12,8),LC=c(24,16),GVA=c(78,52),GP=c(54,36))))
  saveRDS(list(metadata=list(scientific_source_md5="fixture"),run=run),file.path(wd,"run.rds"))
  archive_md5 <- unname(tools::md5sum(file.path(wd,"run.rds")))
  small<-env$smart31_archive_compact_run(run,scenario)

  detail_fields <- c("spatial_pattern", "catches", "occupancy")
  small_outputs <- small[["outputs", exact = TRUE]]
  stopifnot(!any(detail_fields %in% names(small_outputs)),
    all(vapply(detail_fields, function(nm)
      is.null(small_outputs[[nm, exact = TRUE]]), logical(1))),
    all(c("spatial_report", "catches_report") %in% names(small_outputs)),
    identical(small_outputs[["economic_monthly", exact = TRUE]],
      run[["outputs", exact = TRUE]][["economic_monthly", exact = TRUE]]),
    identical(archive_md5, unname(tools::md5sum(file.path(wd,"run.rds")))) ,
    sum(small$outputs$spatial_report$effort)==200,sum(small$outputs$catches_report$W)==39,
    identical(readRDS(file.path(wd,"run.rds"))$run,run),nrow(small$outputs$spatial_report)==2L,
    sum(small$outputs$spatial_report$fishing_hours)==20,
    sum(small$outputs$spatial_report$steaming_hours)==4,
    !"GVL" %in% names(small$outputs$catches_report))

  residual <- small_outputs
  residual[["catches"]] <- catch
  stopifnot("catches" %in% names(residual),
    !is.null(residual[["catches", exact = TRUE]]))

  summary_md5 <- unname(tools::md5sum(file.path(wd,"summary_run.rds")))
  compact_error <- tryCatch({
    env$smart31_archive_compact_run(small,scenario); NA_character_
  }, error=function(e) conditionMessage(e))
  stopifnot(is.character(compact_error),length(compact_error)==1L,
    !is.na(compact_error),grepl("exact full-output fields",compact_error,fixed=TRUE),
    identical(summary_md5,unname(tools::md5sum(file.path(wd,"summary_run.rds")))) )
  overview<-list(metadata=list(storage_format="SMART31.partitioned.results.1",scientific_source_md5="fixture"),
    run_archives=data.frame(feasible=TRUE,run_id="test",archive_relative="run.rds"))
  saveRDS(overview,file.path(wd,"overview.rds"))
  materialised<-env$smart31_archive_read_results(file.path(wd,"overview.rds"),c("spatial_patterns","catches","occupancy"))
  stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(as.data.frame(materialised$spatial_patterns),spatial,check.attributes=FALSE)),
    isTRUE(all.equal(as.data.frame(materialised$catches),catch,check.attributes=FALSE)),
    isTRUE(all.equal(as.data.frame(materialised[["occupancy", exact = TRUE]]),
      run[["outputs", exact = TRUE]][["occupancy", exact = TRUE]],check.attributes=FALSE)))

  saveRDS(list(metadata=list(scientific_source_md5="fixture"),run=small),
    file.path(wd,"summary_as_archive.rds"))
  bad_overview <- overview
  bad_overview$run_archives$archive_relative <- "summary_as_archive.rds"
  saveRDS(bad_overview,file.path(wd,"bad_overview.rds"))
  read_error <- tryCatch({
    env$smart31_archive_read_results(file.path(wd,"bad_overview.rds"),"catches"); NA_character_
  },error=function(e) conditionMessage(e))
  stopifnot(is.character(read_error),length(read_error)==1L,!is.na(read_error),
    grepl("exact detail table 'catches'",read_error,fixed=TRUE))
  h<-data.frame(Gear="OTB",MONTH=1L,id_grid=c("1","2"),effort_historical=c(10,20))
  s<-data.frame(Gear="OTB",MONTH=1L,id_grid=c("1","3"),effort_scenario=c(15,5))
  comparison<-env$smart31_archive_comparison(h,s,"OTB")
  stopifnot(sum(comparison$historical)==30,sum(comparison$scenario)==20,sum(comparison$difference)==-10,
    comparison$spatial_status[comparison$id_grid=="2"]=="No longer used",
    is.na(comparison$change_percent[comparison$id_grid=="3"]))
  empty<-env$smart31_archive_comparison(h,s[0,],"OTB")
  stopifnot(all(empty$scenario==0),all(empty$spatial_status=="No longer used"))
  if(isTRUE(draw_map)) {
    box<-sf::st_bbox(c(xmin=10.8,ymin=41.1,xmax=13,ymax=43),crs=sf::st_crs(4326))
    grid<-sf::st_sf(id_grid=as.character(1:4),geometry=sf::st_make_grid(sf::st_as_sfc(box),n=c(2,2)))
    unchanged<-serialize(grid,NULL)
    cart<-env$smart31_archive_cartography(grid,gsa_file=NULL)
    stopifnot(nrow(cart$land)>0L,identical(unchanged,serialize(grid,NULL)))
    tab<-data.frame(id_grid=as.character(1:4),effort=c(1,2,3,4))
    plot<-env$smart31_archive_map_plot(tab,cart,"effort","Synthetic map fixture — not simulation results",limits=c(0,4))
    ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(wd,"map.png"),plot=plot,width=5,height=5,dpi=80,bg="white")
    stopifnot(file.info(file.path(wd,"map.png"))$size > 1000)
  }
  invisible(list(status="PASS",scope="synthetic monitor, compaction, detail read, map joins and optional coast render",map_rendered=isTRUE(draw_map)))
}

if (isTRUE(cfg$run_internal_tests)) smart31_archive_regression_tests(draw_map = FALSE)
```

## Preserve days and mass calibration helpers

```{r step2-27-preserve-days-and-mass-calibration-helpers}

smart31_repair_control <- function(name, default) {
  value <- cfg[[name]]
  if (is.null(value)) default else value
}
smart31_repair_write <- function(x, name, scenario = NULL) {
  root <- file.path(simulation_output_directory, "diagnostics_other_gvl")
  if (!is.null(scenario)) root <- file.path(root, gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_-]", "_", scenario))
  dir.create(root, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  utils::write.csv(x, file.path(root, paste0(name, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE, na = "")
  invisible(x)
}

smart31_repair_calibration <- function(surface, exposure) {
  keys <- c("MONTH", "GSA_code", "Gear", "Species")
  ekeys <- setdiff(keys, "Species")
  ekeys <- c(ekeys, "id_grid")
  if (anyDuplicated(exposure[ekeys])) stop("Duplicated operational exposure keys.")
  target <- surface %>% dplyr::group_by(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(keys))) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(historical_target_kg = sum(.data$catch_reference), .groups = "drop")
  evaluated <- surface %>% dplyr::left_join(exposure, by = ekeys, relationship = "many-to-one") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(operational_effort = dplyr::coalesce(.data$operational_effort, 0),
      unanchored_catch_kg = .data$operational_effort * .data$lpue_reference) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(keys))) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(unanchored_catch_kg = sum(.data$unanchored_catch_kg), .groups = "drop")
  a <- dplyr::left_join(target, evaluated, by = keys, relationship = "one-to-one")
  if (any(!is.finite(a$historical_target_kg)) || any(a$historical_target_kg < 0) ||
      any(!is.finite(a$unanchored_catch_kg)) || any(a$unanchored_catch_kg < 0))
    stop("Invalid calibration mass.")
  a$supported <- a$historical_target_kg == 0 | a$unanchored_catch_kg > 0

  a$operational_scale <- ifelse(a$unanchored_catch_kg > 0,
    a$historical_target_kg / a$unanchored_catch_kg,
    ifelse(a$historical_target_kg == 0, 0, NA_real_))
  a$large_adjustment_flag <- is.finite(a$operational_scale) &
    (a$operational_scale < .5 | a$operational_scale > 2)
  a$anchored_catch_kg <- a$unanchored_catch_kg * a$operational_scale
  a$residual_kg <- a$anchored_catch_kg - a$historical_target_kg
  a$compatible <- a$supported & is.finite(a$residual_kg) &
    abs(a$residual_kg) <= 1e-8 * pmax(1, a$historical_target_kg)
  list(audit = a, keys = keys)
}

smart31_repair_anchor_reference <- function(scenario) {
  if (isTRUE(.smart31_repair$anchored)) return(invisible(.smart31_repair$calibration))

  e <- new.env(parent = environment(smart31_repair_anchor_reference))
  for (nm in c("prepare_scenario_context", "smart31_prepare_working_allocation",
      "smart31_rescale_effort_segments", "evaluate_effort_quota_compatibility",
      "build_catch_quota_limits", "smart31_complete_context")) {
    f <- get(nm, envir = parent.env(e), inherits = TRUE)
    environment(f) <- e; assign(nm, f, envir = e)
  }
  e$italian_effort_quotas <- italian_effort_quotas[0, , drop = FALSE]
  e$italian_catch_quotas <- italian_catch_quotas[0, , drop = FALSE]
  e$.smart31_initial <- list2env(as.list(.smart31_initial), parent = emptyenv())
  e$smart31_working_write <- function(x, ...) invisible(x)
  ref <- scenario
  ref$scenario_id <- "COMMON_OPERATIONAL_REFERENCE"
  ref$scenario_year <- .smart31_years$baseline; ref$representative_period <- .smart31_case$periods$baseline; ref$cm_status <- "without_cm"
  ref$closures <- list(); ref$compensation_mechanisms <- list(); ref$selectivity_rules <- list()
  ref$permanent_cessation_cfr <- character()
  ref$parameters$landing_price_multiplier <- 1; ref$parameters$fuel_price_multiplier <- 1
  smart31_monitor_event(event = "operational_calibration_started", phase = "baseline",
    note = "one common, no-measures exposure; original Step 1 catch targets")
  ctx <- e$smart31_complete_context(e$prepare_scenario_context(ref))
  if (!isTRUE(ctx$feasible)) stop("Operational calibration preparation failed: ", ctx$issue)
  exposures <- vector("list", length(ctx$unit_kernels))
  unanchored_economics <- vector("list", length(ctx$unit_kernels)); j <- 0L
  for (uid in names(ctx$unit_kernels)) {
    j <- j + 1L; k <- ctx$unit_kernels[[uid]]; g <- ctx$gear_search_by_unit[[uid]]
    s <- k$initial_share
    for (rr in k$pattern_rows) s[rr] <- normalise_positive(s[rr])
    clock <- smart31_working_clock(k$data, g, k$data$metier_share * s, ctx)
    if (!isTRUE(clock$valid)) stop("Invalid calibration clock at ", uid, ": ", clock$issue)
    ev <- evaluate_vessel_month_light(s, uid, ctx)
    if (!isTRUE(ev$valid)) stop("Invalid unanchored reference economics at ", uid)
    unanchored_economics[[j]] <- ev$economic
    unanchored_economics[[j]]$W <- sum(ev$catch_kg)
    z <- k$data[c("MONTH", "GSA_code", "Gear", "id_grid")]
    z$operational_effort <- k$data$loa * clock$row_fishing
    exposures[[j]] <- z %>% dplyr::group_by(.data$MONTH, .data$GSA_code, .data$Gear, .data$id_grid) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(operational_effort = sum(.data$operational_effort), .groups = "drop")
  }
  exposure <- dplyr::bind_rows(exposures) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$MONTH, .data$GSA_code, .data$Gear, .data$id_grid) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(operational_effort = sum(.data$operational_effort), .groups = "drop")
  unanchored_economics <- dplyr::bind_rows(unanchored_economics)
  smart31_repair_write(unanchored_economics, "common_economics_before_mass_anchor")
  rm(exposures); invisible(gc(FALSE))

  surface <- .smart31_surface$surface
  if (!is.data.frame(surface) || !nrow(surface)) stop("Missing original mass-conserving surface.")
  cal <- smart31_repair_calibration(surface, exposure)
  smart31_repair_write(cal$audit, "operational_mass_calibration")
  if (!all(cal$audit$compatible)) stop(
    "Positive historical mass has no operational support. See operational_mass_calibration.csv; ",
    "no target, habitat or quota was changed.")
  .smart31_repair$unanchored_lpue <- lpue_reference
  anchored <- lpue_reference %>% dplyr::left_join(cal$audit %>%
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(cal$keys), .data$operational_scale),
    by = cal$keys, relationship = "many-to-one")
  if (any(!is.finite(anchored$operational_scale))) stop("A simulation rate has no calibration stratum.")
  anchored$lpue_reference <- anchored$lpue_reference * anchored$operational_scale
  anchored$operational_scale <- NULL

  assign("lpue_reference", anchored, envir = environment(smart31_repair_anchor_reference))
  .smart31_repair$calibration <- cal$audit
  .smart31_repair$anchored <- TRUE
  rm(ctx, e, surface, anchored, exposure); invisible(gc(FALSE))

  .smart31_response$common_reference <- NULL
  common <- smart31_response_common_reference(scenario)
  .smart31_response$common_reference_status <- "mass_anchored_common_daily_reference"
  expected <- sum(cal$audit$historical_target_kg)
  smart31_response_close(sum(common$W), expected, label = "Independent anchored common catch")
  economic_fields <- c("GVL_6sp", "GVL_other_reference", "GVL", "EC", "OC", "LC", "GVA", "GP")
  aggregate_stage <- function(z, label) {
    out <- as.data.frame(as.list(vapply(economic_fields, function(nm) sum(z[[nm]]), numeric(1))))
    out$stage <- label
    out$days <- if ("days_at_sea" %in% names(z)) sum(z$days_at_sea) else NA_real_
    out$catch_kg <- if ("W" %in% names(z)) sum(z$W) else NA_real_
    out
  }
  .smart31_repair$reference_bridge <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    aggregate_stage(economic_reference, "imported_Step1_history"),
    aggregate_stage(unanchored_economics, "common_before_mass_anchor"),
    aggregate_stage(common, "common_after_mass_anchor"))
  smart31_repair_write(.smart31_repair$reference_bridge, "common_reference_economic_bridge")
  rm(unanchored_economics)
  smart31_monitor_event(event = "operational_calibration_completed", phase = "baseline",
    total_GVA = sum(common$GVA), note = paste(nrow(cal$audit), "strata reconciled; no scenario-specific calibration"))
  invisible(cal$audit)
}

smart31_repair_build_lp <- function(context) {
  uids <- names(context$unit_kernels); nu <- length(uids)
  count <- vapply(context$unit_kernels, function(k) nrow(k$data), integer(1))
  nc <- sum(count); offsets <- c(0L, cumsum(count)); nv <- nc + nu
  if (nv > smart31_repair_control("repair_max_variables", 2000000L))
    stop("Sparse repair exceeds repair_max_variables; no cells were sampled and no days were cut.")
  pids <- unlist(lapply(context$unit_kernels, function(k) names(k$pattern_rows)), use.names = FALSE)
  if (anyDuplicated(pids)) stop("LP pattern ids are not globally unique.")
  np <- length(pids)
  global_keys <- unique(unlist(lapply(context$unit_kernels, function(k)
    paste(k$data$MONTH, k$data$id_grid, sep = "::")), use.names = FALSE))
  local_keys <- if (isTRUE(cfg$enforce_local_effort_envelope))
    unique(unlist(lapply(context$unit_kernels, function(k) k$local_key), use.names = FALSE)) else character()
  loclim <- unname(context$local_limits[local_keys])
  if (any(!is.finite(loclim)) || any(loclim < 0)) stop("Missing/invalid local effort limit in sparse repair.")
  sp <- context$quota_species
  qlim <- vapply(sp, function(s) min(context$catch_quota_limits$quota_kg[
    context$catch_quota_limits$Species == s]), numeric(1))
  fixed <- context$fixed_non_vms_quota_catch[sp]
  if (any(!is.finite(qlim)) || any(!is.finite(fixed)) || any(fixed < 0) || any(fixed > qlim + 1e-8))
    stop("Fixed non-VMS removals exceed a quota or are incomplete; no activity repair can resolve this.")
  ec_keys <- names(context$effort_limits)
  limits <- c(rep(context$crowding_limit, length(global_keys)), loclim,
    unname(qlim - fixed), unname(context$effort_limits))
  if (any(!is.finite(limits)) || any(limits < 0)) stop("Non-finite/negative LP constraint limit.")
  row_scale <- c(rep(1, np), pmax(1, limits))
  nr <- np + length(limits)
  base_global <- np; base_local <- base_global + length(global_keys)
  base_catch <- base_local + length(local_keys); base_effort <- base_catch + length(sp)
  II <- JJ <- VV <- vector("list", nu)
  expected_days <- numeric(nu); names(expected_days) <- uids
  objective_gva <- objective_prior <- numeric(nv)
  initial_y <- numeric(nc)

  for (u in seq_along(uids)) {
    uid <- uids[u]; k <- context$unit_kernels[[uid]]; d <- k$data
    g <- context$gear_search_by_unit[[uid]]; gi <- match(d$Gear, g$Gear)
    route <- smart31_daily_route(d$distance_km, g$daily_activity_budget_h[gi],
      context$steaming_speed_kmh, context$working_baseline_controls)
    if (anyNA(gi) || any(!route$valid)) stop("LP kernel contains an unsupported daily route: ", uid)
    pp <- match(d$pattern_id, pids); col <- offsets[u] + seq_len(nrow(d))
    trip <- g$days_scenario_gear[gi] * d$metier_share
    ef <- trip * route$fishing * d$loa
    if (any(abs(g$scenario_trips - g$days_scenario_gear) > 1e-8))
      stop("LP expects one daily-trip equivalent per authorised day: ", uid)
    expected_days[u] <- sum(g$days_scenario_gear)
    if (expected_days[u] <= 0 || any(!is.finite(ef))) stop("Invalid LP effort coefficients.")
    first <- !duplicated(d$pattern_id)

    pattern_trips <- tapply(trip[first], d$Gear[first], sum)
    if (any(abs(pattern_trips[g$Gear] - g$days_scenario_gear) > 1e-8)) stop("LP metier/day mix mismatch.")
    ii <- c(pp, pp[first]); jj <- c(col, rep(nc + u, sum(first)))
    vv <- c(rep(1, length(col)), rep(-1, sum(first)))
    append_entries <- function(row, column, value) {
      keep <- is.finite(value) & value != 0
      if (any(!is.finite(value))) stop("Non-finite sparse LP coefficient.")
      ii <<- c(ii, row[keep]); jj <<- c(jj, column[keep]); vv <<- c(vv, value[keep])
    }
    append_entries(base_global + match(paste(d$MONTH, d$id_grid, sep = "::"), global_keys), col, ef)
    if (length(local_keys)) append_entries(base_local + match(k$local_key, local_keys), col, ef)
    for (s in seq_along(sp)) {
      rate <- smart31_context_quota_rate(context)[d$cell_rate_id, sp[s]]
      append_entries(rep(base_catch + s, nrow(d)), col, ef * rate)
    }
    qday <- smart31_effort_quota_vector(g, context)
    if (length(ec_keys)) append_entries(base_effort + seq_along(ec_keys),
      rep(nc + u, length(ec_keys)), unname(qday[ec_keys]))
    objective_gva[col] <- ef * context$revenue_rate[d$cell_rate_id] * (1 - g$OC_share[gi]) -
      trip * context$fuel_price * (route$fishing * g$fishing_fuel_l_per_h[gi] +
        route$navigation * g$steaming_fuel_l_per_h[gi])
    objective_gva[nc + u] <- if (identical(cfg$other_gvl_mode, "per_day_reference"))
      sum(g$GVL_other_reference_month * (1 - g$OC_share)) else 0
    initial <- k$initial_share
    for (rr in k$pattern_rows) initial[rr] <- normalise_positive(initial[rr])
    initial_y[col] <- initial

    objective_prior[col] <- -trip * log(pmax(initial, 1e-12))
    II[[u]] <- as.integer(ii); JJ[[u]] <- as.integer(jj); VV[[u]] <- vv
    if (u %% 100L == 0L || u == nu) smart31_monitor_event(
      event = "preserve_days_matrix_progress", phase = "scenario_preparation",
      scenario_id = context$scenario$scenario_id, unit_index = u, units_in_stage = nu,
      note = paste("sparse repair coefficients;", nv, "variables"))
  }
  i <- unlist(II, use.names = FALSE); j <- unlist(JJ, use.names = FALSE); v <- unlist(VV, use.names = FALSE)
  rm(II, JJ, VV)
  if (length(v) > smart31_repair_control("repair_max_nonzeros", 20000000L))
    stop("Sparse repair exceeds repair_max_nonzeros; no cells were sampled or days cut.")
  A <- slam::simple_triplet_matrix(i, j, v / row_scale[i], nrow = nr, ncol = nv)
  rm(i, j, v); invisible(gc(FALSE))
  rows <- data.frame(type = c(rep("pattern_conservation", np), rep("global_crowding", length(global_keys)),
      rep("local_effort", length(local_keys)), rep("catch_quota_active", length(sp)), rep("effort_quota", length(ec_keys))),
    key = c(pids, global_keys, local_keys, sp, ec_keys),
    limit = c(rep(0, np), limits), scale = row_scale)
  list(A = A, rhs = c(rep(0, np), limits / pmax(1, limits)),
    dir = c(rep("==", np), rep("<=", length(limits))), rows = rows,
    uids = uids, nc = nc, nu = nu, offsets = offsets, days = expected_days,
    gva = objective_gva, prior = objective_prior, initial_y = initial_y,
    day_objective = c(rep(0, nc), expected_days),
    scope = "all_supported_candidate_cells; fixed vessel-month gear/metier proportions; continuous days")
}

smart31_repair_lp_valid <- function(lp, solution, fixed_days = FALSE, tolerance = 2e-7) {
  if (length(solution) != ncol(lp$A) || any(!is.finite(solution))) return(FALSE)
  r <- solution[lp$nc + seq_len(lp$nu)]
  if (any(solution < -1e-9) || any(r > 1 + 1e-9) || (fixed_days && any(abs(r - 1) > 1e-9))) return(FALSE)
  lhs <- as.numeric(slam::matprod_simple_triplet_matrix(lp$A, matrix(solution, ncol = 1L)))
  eq <- lp$dir == "=="
  le <- lp$dir == "<="; ge <- lp$dir == ">="
  all(abs(lhs[eq] - lp$rhs[eq]) <= tolerance) &&
    all(lhs[le] - lp$rhs[le] <= tolerance) && all(lp$rhs[ge] - lhs[ge] <= tolerance)
}

smart31_solver_status_glpk_status <- function(status) {
  labels <- c("GLP_UNDEF", "GLP_FEAS", "GLP_INFEAS", "GLP_NOFEAS", "GLP_OPT", "GLP_UNBND")
  code <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(status))
  if (length(code) != 1L || is.na(code) || !code %in% seq_along(labels)) return("UNKNOWN_STATUS")
  labels[[code]]
}
smart31_solver_status_lp_diagnostics <- function(lp, solution, fixed_days = FALSE, tolerance = 2e-7) {
  out <- list(validation_reason = "not_evaluated", min_variable = NA_real_,
    max_retained_bound_error = NA_real_, max_fixed_day_error = NA_real_,
    max_row_violation_scaled = NA_real_, failed_rows = NA_integer_)
  if (length(solution) != ncol(lp$A)) {
    out$validation_reason <- "solution_length_mismatch"; return(out)
  }
  if (any(!is.finite(solution))) {
    out$validation_reason <- "nonfinite_solution"; return(out)
  }
  r <- solution[lp$nc + seq_len(lp$nu)]
  lhs <- as.numeric(slam::matprod_simple_triplet_matrix(lp$A, matrix(solution, ncol = 1L)))
  violation <- rep(0, length(lhs))
  eq <- lp$dir == "=="; le <- lp$dir == "<="; ge <- lp$dir == ">="
  violation[eq] <- abs(lhs[eq] - lp$rhs[eq])
  violation[le] <- pmax(0, lhs[le] - lp$rhs[le])
  violation[ge] <- pmax(0, lp$rhs[ge] - lhs[ge])
  out$min_variable <- min(c(0, solution))
  out$max_retained_bound_error <- max(c(0, r - 1, -r))
  out$max_fixed_day_error <- if (fixed_days) max(c(0, abs(r - 1))) else 0
  out$max_row_violation_scaled <- max(c(0, violation))
  out$failed_rows <- sum(violation > tolerance)
  reasons <- c(if (any(solution < -1e-9)) "negative_variable",
    if (any(r > 1 + 1e-9)) "retained_fraction_above_one",
    if (fixed_days && any(abs(r - 1) > 1e-9)) "fixed_day_fraction_not_one",
    if (out$failed_rows > 0L) "row_constraint_violation")
  out$validation_reason <- if (length(reasons)) paste(reasons, collapse = ";") else "passed"
  out
}

smart31_repair_solve <- function(lp, objective, fixed_days, maximise = FALSE) {
  rc <- lp$nc + seq_len(lp$nu)
  bounds <- list(upper = list(ind = rc, val = rep(1, lp$nu)))
  if (fixed_days) bounds$lower <- list(ind = rc, val = rep(1, lp$nu))
  started <- proc.time()[[3L]]
  budget <- smart31_repair_control("repair_time_limit_seconds", 900)
  solve_once <- function(presolve, seconds) Rglpk::Rglpk_solve_LP(
    obj = objective, mat = lp$A, dir = lp$dir, rhs = lp$rhs,
    bounds = bounds, max = maximise,
    control = list(presolve = presolve, canonicalize_status = FALSE,
      tm_limit = as.integer(max(1, floor(1000 * seconds)))))
  answer <- solve_once(TRUE, budget)
  presolve_status <- answer$status
  validated <- smart31_repair_lp_valid(lp, answer$solution, fixed_days)
  retried <- FALSE
  remaining <- budget - (proc.time()[[3L]] - started)

  if (!validated && !identical(as.integer(answer$status), 4L) && remaining > .01) {
    answer <- solve_once(FALSE, remaining)
    retried <- TRUE
  }
  answer$presolve_status <- presolve_status
  answer$retried_without_presolve <- retried
  answer$elapsed_seconds <- proc.time()[[3L]] - started
  answer$validated <- smart31_repair_lp_valid(lp, answer$solution, fixed_days)
  answer$status_label <- smart31_solver_status_glpk_status(answer$status)
  answer$validation_diagnostics <- smart31_solver_status_lp_diagnostics(lp, answer$solution, fixed_days)
  answer
}
smart31_repair_lp_row <- function(lp, name, coefficients, direction, rhs) {
  use <- which(coefficients != 0); nr <- nrow(lp$A) + 1L
  scale <- max(1, abs(rhs), max(abs(coefficients)))
  lp$A <- slam::simple_triplet_matrix(c(lp$A$i, rep(nr, length(use))), c(lp$A$j, use),
    c(lp$A$v, coefficients[use] / scale), nrow = nr, ncol = ncol(lp$A))
  lp$dir <- c(lp$dir, direction); lp$rhs <- c(lp$rhs, rhs / scale)
  lp$rows <- rbind(lp$rows, data.frame(type = name, key = name, limit = rhs, scale = scale))
  lp
}

smart31_reduced_lp_reduce_gva_lp <- function(lp, seed_solution, context) {
  tol <- smart31_repair_control("repair_gva_positive_tolerance", 1e-10)
  extra_n <- as.integer(smart31_repair_control("repair_gva_extra_cells_per_pattern", 6L))
  if (length(seed_solution) != ncol(lp$A)) stop("Invalid seed solution for reduced GVA LP.")
  keep_y <- which(seed_solution[seq_len(lp$nc)] > tol)
  if (extra_n > 0L) {
    for (u in seq_along(lp$uids)) {
      k <- context$unit_kernels[[lp$uids[[u]]]]
      cols <- lp$offsets[[u]] + seq_len(nrow(k$data))
      for (rr in k$pattern_rows) {
        cc <- cols[rr]
        score <- lp$gva[cc]
        ord <- order(score, decreasing = TRUE, na.last = NA)
        if (length(ord)) keep_y <- c(keep_y, cc[head(ord, extra_n)])
      }
    }
  }
  keep_y <- sort(unique(keep_y))
  r_old <- lp$nc + seq_len(lp$nu)
  keep <- c(keep_y, r_old)
  remap <- integer(ncol(lp$A)); remap[keep] <- seq_along(keep)
  nz <- lp$A$j %in% keep
  A <- slam::simple_triplet_matrix(
    i = lp$A$i[nz], j = remap[lp$A$j[nz]], v = lp$A$v[nz],
    nrow = nrow(lp$A), ncol = length(keep))
  reduced <- lp
  reduced$A <- A
  reduced$nc <- length(keep_y)
  reduced$offsets <- NULL
  reduced$gva <- lp$gva[keep]
  reduced$prior <- lp$prior[keep]
  reduced$initial_y <- lp$initial_y[keep_y]
  reduced$day_objective <- c(rep(0, reduced$nc), lp$days)
  reduced$scope <- paste0(lp$scope, "; reduced economic support retaining certified seed + up to ",
    extra_n, " GVA-ranked cells per pattern")
  list(lp = reduced, keep = keep, full_ncol = ncol(lp$A), kept_y = length(keep_y))
}
smart31_reduced_lp_expand_solution <- function(reduced_result, reduction, full_lp) {
  out <- reduced_result
  full <- numeric(reduction$full_ncol)
  if (length(reduced_result$solution) == length(reduction$keep))
    full[reduction$keep] <- reduced_result$solution
  out$solution <- full
  out$validated <- smart31_repair_lp_valid(full_lp, full, fixed_days = FALSE)
  out$validation_diagnostics <- smart31_solver_status_lp_diagnostics(full_lp, full, fixed_days = FALSE)
  out$reduced_support_y <- reduction$kept_y
  out
}

smart31_repair_repair <- function(context) {
  lp <- smart31_repair_build_lp(context); sid <- context$scenario$scenario_id
  diagnostics <- list(); log_answer <- function(a, phase, fixed) {
    row <- data.frame(phase = phase, glpk_status = a$status, independently_validated = a$validated,
      retained_days = if (a$validated) sum(a$solution * lp$day_objective) else NA_real_,
      authorised_days = sum(lp$days), elapsed_seconds = a$elapsed_seconds,
      variables = ncol(lp$A), constraints = nrow(lp$A), nonzeros = length(lp$A$v),
      fixed_days_requested = fixed, model_scope = lp$scope,
      initial_presolve_status = if (is.null(a$presolve_status)) NA_integer_ else a$presolve_status,
      retried_without_presolve = isTRUE(a$retried_without_presolve))
    detail <- a$validation_diagnostics
    if (is.null(detail)) detail <- smart31_solver_status_lp_diagnostics(lp, a$solution, fixed)
    row$glpk_status_label <- smart31_solver_status_glpk_status(a$status)
    row$solver_package <- "Rglpk"
    row$solver_package_version <- as.character(utils::packageVersion("Rglpk"))
    for (nm in names(detail)) row[[nm]] <- detail[[nm]]
    diagnostics[[length(diagnostics) + 1L]] <<- row
    smart31_repair_write(dplyr::bind_rows(diagnostics), "preserve_days_solver", sid)
    smart31_monitor_event(event = "preserve_days_solver_phase", phase = "scenario_preparation",
      scenario_id = sid, note = paste(phase, "GLPK status", a$status,
        smart31_solver_status_glpk_status(a$status), "validated", a$validated,
        "check", detail$validation_reason))
  }

  reserve <- smart31_repair_control("repair_numerical_reserve", 0.000001)
  upper <- lp$dir == "<="
  lp$rhs[upper] <- lp$rhs[upper] * (1 - reserve)
  fixed <- smart31_repair_solve(lp, lp$prior, TRUE, FALSE); log_answer(fixed, "fixed_days_spatial_repair", TRUE)
  fixed_infeasible <- FALSE; maxdays_optimal <- FALSE; selected <- fixed
  if (!isTRUE(fixed$validated)) {

    lp$rhs[upper] <- lp$rows$limit[upper] / lp$rows$scale[upper]
    exact <- smart31_repair_solve(lp, lp$prior, TRUE, FALSE); log_answer(exact, "fixed_days_exact_bounds", TRUE)
    if (isTRUE(exact$validated)) selected <- exact else {
      if (!isTRUE(as.integer(exact$status) == 4L)) stop(
        "Exact-bound fixed-day repair unresolved (GLPK status ", exact$status,
        " / ", smart31_solver_status_glpk_status(exact$status), "; interior status ", fixed$status,
        "). Independent validation failed. This is not an infeasibility certificate; ",
        "no fallback day cut was applied. Inspect preserve_days_solver.csv for residuals.")
      fixed_infeasible <- TRUE

      dayfit <- smart31_repair_solve(lp, lp$day_objective, FALSE, TRUE)
      log_answer(dayfit, "maximum_retained_days", FALSE)
      if (!dayfit$validated || dayfit$status != 5L)
        stop("Day-retention optimum not certified within solver budget; no scenario search was started.")
      selected <- dayfit; maxdays_optimal <- TRUE
      best_days <- sum(dayfit$solution * lp$day_objective)

      lp <- smart31_repair_lp_row(lp, "retained_day_floor", lp$day_objective, ">=",
        best_days - smart31_repair_control("repair_day_tolerance", 0.000001))
      reduced <- smart31_reduced_lp_reduce_gva_lp(lp, dayfit$solution, context)
      second_reduced <- smart31_repair_solve(reduced$lp, reduced$lp$gva, FALSE, TRUE)
      second <- smart31_reduced_lp_expand_solution(second_reduced, reduced, lp)
      log_answer(second, "GVA_tiebreak_reduced_support_at_maximum_days", FALSE)
      if (second$validated) selected <- second
    }
  }
  x <- selected$solution; r <- pmax(0, pmin(1, x[lp$nc + seq_len(lp$nu)])); names(r) <- lp$uids
  shares <- vector("list", lp$nu); names(shares) <- lp$uids
  for (u in seq_along(lp$uids)) {
    k <- context$unit_kernels[[lp$uids[u]]]
    y <- pmax(0, x[lp$offsets[u] + seq_len(nrow(k$data))])
    if (r[u] > 1e-10) for (rr in k$pattern_rows) {
      if (sum(y[rr]) <= 0) stop("Positive retained unit has an empty LP pattern.")
      y[rr] <- y[rr] / sum(y[rr])
    } else y <- k$initial_share
    shares[[u]] <- y
  }
  lhs <- as.numeric(slam::matprod_simple_triplet_matrix(lp$A, matrix(x, ncol = 1L)))
  ledger <- lp$rows; ledger$lhs <- lhs * ledger$scale
  ledger$solver_rhs <- lp$rhs * ledger$scale
  ledger$solver_slack <- ifelse(lp$dir == ">=", ledger$lhs - ledger$solver_rhs, ledger$solver_rhs - ledger$lhs)
  ledger$direction <- lp$dir
  ledger$dual_scaled <- if (length(selected$auxiliary$dual) == nrow(ledger)) selected$auxiliary$dual else NA_real_
  smart31_repair_write(ledger, "preserve_days_constraint_ledger", sid)
  audit <- data.frame(unit_id = lp$uids, authorised_days = unname(lp$days),
    retained_fraction = unname(r), retained_days = unname(lp$days * r),
    removed_days = unname(lp$days * (1 - r)),
    fixed_day_infeasibility_certified_within_support = fixed_infeasible,
    maximum_retention_optimal_within_support = maxdays_optimal,
    model_scope = lp$scope)
  out <- list(shares = shares, fractions = r, audit = audit,
    solver = dplyr::bind_rows(diagnostics), predicted_GVA = sum(lp$gva * x),
    selected_days = sum(lp$day_objective * x))
  rm(lp, fixed, selected, x); invisible(gc(FALSE))
  out
}

smart31_other_gvl_refresh_other_gvl <- function(context) {

  if (identical(cfg$other_gvl_mode, "per_day_reference")) return(context)
  if (!nrow(context$gear_time)) return(context)
  active <- context$gear_time %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$CFR, .data$Gear) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(active_days = sum(.data$days_scenario_gear), .groups = "drop")
  original <- .smart31_initial$original_time %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$CFR, .data$Gear) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(original_annual_days = sum(.data$days_reference), .groups = "drop")
  z <- context$gear_time %>%
    dplyr::select(.data$CFR, .data$MONTH, .data$Gear, .data$days_scenario_gear) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(vessel_other_gvl_reference, by = c("CFR", "Gear"), relationship = "many-to-one") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(original, by = c("CFR", "Gear"), relationship = "many-to-one") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(active, by = c("CFR", "Gear"), relationship = "many-to-one")
  missing_reference <- z %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.na(.data$GVL_other_reference_annual) |
      is.na(.data$original_annual_days) | is.na(.data$active_days)) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(.data$CFR, .data$Gear)
  if (nrow(missing_reference)) {
    stop("Non-modelled-species GVL reference/day basis is missing for ",
      nrow(missing_reference), " active vessel-gear combination(s).")
  }
  z <- z %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      other_gvl_activity_ratio = dplyr::if_else(.data$original_annual_days > 0,
        .data$active_days / .data$original_annual_days, 0),
      GVL_other_target_annual = smart31_other_gvl_other_gvl_target(
        .data$GVL_other_reference_annual, .data$active_days, .data$original_annual_days),
      other_GVL_eur_per_day = dplyr::if_else(.data$active_days > 0,
        .data$GVL_other_target_annual / .data$active_days, 0),
      GVL_other_reference_month = .data$other_GVL_eur_per_day * .data$days_scenario_gear,
      other_gvl_mode = cfg$other_gvl_mode,
      other_gvl_beta = cfg$other_gvl_beta)
  check <- z %>% dplyr::group_by(.data$CFR, .data$Gear) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(realised = sum(.data$GVL_other_reference_month),
      target = dplyr::first(.data$GVL_other_target_annual),
      reference = dplyr::first(.data$GVL_other_reference_annual),
      active_days = dplyr::first(.data$active_days),
      historical_days = dplyr::first(.data$original_annual_days),
      activity_ratio = dplyr::first(.data$other_gvl_activity_ratio), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(mode = cfg$other_gvl_mode, beta = cfg$other_gvl_beta,
      cap_at_reference = isTRUE(cfg$other_gvl_cap_at_reference),
      realised_fraction_of_reference = dplyr::if_else(.data$reference > 0,
        .data$realised / .data$reference, NA_real_))
  if (any(!is.finite(check$realised)) || any(!is.finite(check$target)) ||
      any(!is.finite(check$reference)))
    stop("Non-modelled-species GVL reconciliation produced non-finite values.")
  if (any(abs(check$realised - check$target) > 1e-8 * pmax(1, abs(check$target))))
    stop("Non-modelled-species GVL failed vessel-gear target reconciliation.")
  if (isTRUE(cfg$other_gvl_cap_at_reference) &&
      any(check$realised > check$reference + 1e-8 * pmax(1, abs(check$reference))))
    stop("Non-modelled-species GVL exceeded its Step 1 annual cap.")
  smart31_repair_write(check, "other_gvl_activity_audit", context$scenario$scenario_id)
  context$other_gvl_activity_audit <- check

  context$other_gvl_monthly <- z
  propagated <- z %>% dplyr::select(.data$CFR, .data$MONTH, .data$Gear,
    .data$GVL_other_reference_month)
  context$gear_time <- context$gear_time %>%
    dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of("GVL_other_reference_month")) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(propagated, by = c("CFR", "MONTH", "Gear"), relationship = "one-to-one")
  if (any(!is.finite(context$gear_time$GVL_other_reference_month)))
    stop("Non-modelled-species GVL could not be propagated to gear_time.")
  for (uid in names(context$gear_search_by_unit)) {
    g <- context$gear_search_by_unit[[uid]] %>%
      dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of("GVL_other_reference_month")) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(propagated,
        by = c("CFR", "MONTH", "Gear"), relationship = "one-to-one")
    if (any(!is.finite(g$GVL_other_reference_month)))
      stop("Non-modelled-species GVL could not be propagated to search units.")
    context$gear_search_by_unit[[uid]] <- g
  }
  context
}

smart31_repair_condition_context <- function(context) {
  if (!isTRUE(context$feasible) || isTRUE(context$working_baseline_conditioned)) return(context)
  before <- smart31_working_state(context)
  scores <- smart31_constraint_scores(before, context)
  initial_ev <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(before$evaluation_by_unit, function(z) z$economic))

  if (smart31_state_feasible(before, context)) {
    ids <- names(context$unit_kernels)
    audit <- data.frame(unit_id = ids, authorised_days = initial_ev$days_at_sea,
      retained_fraction = 1, retained_days = initial_ev$days_at_sea, removed_days = 0,
      fixed_day_infeasibility_certified_within_support = FALSE,
      maximum_retention_optimal_within_support = FALSE,
      model_scope = "unchanged feasible reference")
    repair <- list(shares = before$share_by_unit, fractions = stats::setNames(rep(1, length(ids)), ids),
      audit = audit, solver = data.frame(phase = "already_feasible_no_repair", glpk_status = NA_integer_,
        independently_validated = TRUE), predicted_GVA = sum(initial_ev$GVA), selected_days = sum(initial_ev$days_at_sea))
  } else repair <- smart31_repair_repair(context)
  factors <- repair$fractions
  scale_table <- function(z) {
    f <- unname(factors[make_unit_id(z$CFR, z$MONTH)])
    if (anyNA(f)) stop("Missing retained-day fraction.")
    fields <- c("days_scenario_gear", "scenario_trips", "fishing_time_reference_scenario",
      "steaming_time_reference_scenario")
    if (identical(cfg$other_gvl_mode, "per_day_reference"))
      fields <- c(fields, "GVL_other_reference_month")
    for (nm in intersect(fields, names(z))) z[[nm]] <- z[[nm]] * f
    z
  }
  context$gear_time <- scale_table(context$gear_time)
  context$other_gvl_monthly <- scale_table(context$other_gvl_monthly)
  context$gear_search_by_unit <- lapply(context$gear_search_by_unit, scale_table)
  inactive <- names(factors)[factors <= 1e-10]
  if (length(inactive)) {
    context$unit_kernels[inactive] <- NULL; context$gear_search_by_unit[inactive] <- NULL
    context$gear_time <- context$gear_time[!context$gear_time$unit_id %in% inactive, , drop = FALSE]
    context$other_gvl_monthly <- context$other_gvl_monthly[!make_unit_id(
      context$other_gvl_monthly$CFR, context$other_gvl_monthly$MONTH) %in% inactive, , drop = FALSE]
  }
  context <- smart31_other_gvl_refresh_other_gvl(context)
  if (!length(context$unit_kernels)) {
    context$feasible <- FALSE; context$issue <- "no_positive_day_retention_within_declared_support"
    context$diagnostic <- repair$audit; return(context)
  }
  context$gear_time <- context$gear_time %>% dplyr::group_by(.data$CFR, .data$MONTH) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(days_scenario = sum(.data$days_scenario_gear),
      gear_day_share = .data$days_scenario_gear / .data$days_scenario) %>% dplyr::ungroup()
  for (uid in names(context$unit_kernels)) {
    g <- context$gear_search_by_unit[[uid]]; k <- context$unit_kernels[[uid]]
    g$days_scenario <- sum(g$days_scenario_gear); g$gear_day_share <- g$days_scenario_gear / g$days_scenario
    context$gear_search_by_unit[[uid]] <- g
    k$initial_share <- repair$shares[[uid]]; k$data$initial_share <- repair$shares[[uid]]
    k$baseline_combined_share <- k$data$metier_share * k$initial_share
    k$data$allocation_units <- pmax(1L, as.integer(round(g$scenario_trips[match(k$data$Gear, g$Gear)] * k$data$metier_share)))
    context$unit_kernels[[uid]] <- k
  }
  context$day_allocations <- smart31_refresh_working_days(context$day_allocations, context$gear_time, context$scenario)
  context$cm_capacity <- stats::setNames(context$day_allocations$cm_capacity_month,
    make_unit_id(context$day_allocations$CFR, context$day_allocations$MONTH))
  final <- smart31_working_state(context)
  if (!smart31_state_feasible(final, context)) stop(
    "Sparse repair did not pass ORIGINAL independent physical/catch/effort constraints; no run was started.")
  economic <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(final$evaluation_by_unit, function(z) z$economic))
  close <- function(x, y) abs(x-y) <= 1e-7 * max(1, abs(x), abs(y))
  gva_prediction_required <- identical(cfg$other_gvl_mode, "per_day_reference")
  if ((gva_prediction_required && !close(sum(economic$GVA), repair$predicted_GVA)) ||
      !close(sum(economic$days_at_sea), repair$selected_days))
    stop("Sparse-LP coefficients disagree with the independent daily-clock evaluator.")
  sid <- context$scenario$scenario_id
  audit <- repair$audit
  audit$CFR <- initial_ev$CFR[match(audit$unit_id, initial_ev$unit_id)]
  audit$MONTH <- initial_ev$MONTH[match(audit$unit_id, initial_ev$unit_id)]
  audit$GVA_before_joint <- initial_ev$GVA[match(audit$unit_id, initial_ev$unit_id)]
  audit$actual_initial_GVA <- economic$GVA[match(audit$unit_id, economic$unit_id)]
  audit$actual_initial_GVA[is.na(audit$actual_initial_GVA)] <- 0
  audit$days_before_joint <- audit$authorised_days; audit$days_after_joint <- audit$retained_days
  audit$joint_factor <- audit$retained_fraction
  audit$all_authorised_days_preserved <- sum(audit$removed_days) <= 1e-6
  audit$reason <- ifelse(audit$removed_days <= 1e-8, "days_preserved",
    "joint_LP_frontier_not_unique_single_constraint_attribution")
  audit <- smart31_working_tag(audit, context$scenario, "preserve_days_first")
  .smart31_initial$joint_audits[[sid]] <- audit
  .smart31_repair$repairs[[sid]] <- list(days = audit, solver = repair$solver)
  smart31_repair_write(audit, "preserve_days_audit", sid)
  smart31_working_write(audit, "joint_initialisation_audit", sid)
  smart31_working_write(smart31_working_tag(context$day_allocations, context$scenario, "ready_for_search"),
    "conditioned_day_allocation", sid)
  smart31_working_write(smart31_working_tag(data.frame(constraint = names(scores), before = as.numeric(scores),
    after = as.numeric(smart31_constraint_scores(final, context))), context$scenario, "ready_for_search"),
    "initial_constraint_scores", sid)
  eq <- evaluate_effort_quota_compatibility(context$gear_time, context$retained_vessels, context$scenario)
  context$effort_quota_audit <- smart31_working_tag(eq$audit, context$scenario, "conditioned_initial")
  context$effort_quota_assignments <- eq$assignments
  economic$initial_W <- vapply(final$evaluation_by_unit, function(z) sum(z$catch_kg), numeric(1))
  fields <- c("GVL_6sp", "GVL_other_reference", "GVL", "EC", "OC", "LC", "GVA", "GP")
  refs <- dplyr::bind_rows(context$economic_reference, context$cessation_reference)
  init <- refs %>% dplyr::select(.data$unit_id, .data$CFR, .data$MONTH, dplyr::all_of(fields)) %>%
    dplyr::rename_with(~paste0("historical_", .x), dplyr::all_of(fields)) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(economic %>% dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of(c("CFR", "MONTH"))),
      by = "unit_id", relationship = "one-to-one") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(c(fields, "days_at_sea", "trips", "fishing_time", "steaming_time")),
      ~dplyr::coalesce(.x, 0)), initial_baseline_type = paste0("other_gvl_anchored_preserve_days_first_", cfg$other_gvl_mode))
  context$initial_economic_monthly <- smart31_working_tag(init, context$scenario, "ready_for_search")
  .smart31_initial$initial_economics[[sid]] <- context$initial_economic_monthly
  context$working_baseline_conditioned <- TRUE; context$baseline_initialisation_audit <- audit
  smart31_working_write(context$initial_economic_monthly, "initial_economic_monthly", sid)
  smart31_monitor_event(event = "working_baseline_ready", phase = "scenario_preparation", scenario_id = sid,
    total_GVA = sum(economic$GVA), total_units = length(context$unit_kernels),
    note = paste("preserve-days-first; authorised", round(sum(audit$authorised_days), 3),
      "retained", round(sum(audit$retained_days), 3), "; CM starts at zero"))
  context
}
```
