```{r step2-28-regression-tests}

smart31_repair_regression_tests <- function() {
  parent <- environment(smart31_repair_regression_tests)
  e <- new.env(parent = parent)
  for (nm in ls(parent, all.names = TRUE)) {
    obj <- get(nm, envir = parent, inherits = FALSE)
    if (is.function(obj) && identical(environment(obj), parent)) {
      environment(obj) <- e; assign(nm, obj, envir = e)
    }
  }
  e$smart31_repair_write <- e$smart31_working_write <- e$smart31_response_write <- function(x, ...) invisible(x)
  e$smart31_monitor_event <- function(...) invisible(NULL)
  e$monitor_update_every_units <- 10000L
  e$quota_tolerance_fraction <- 1e-8
  e$cfg <- list(enforce_local_effort_envelope = TRUE, repair_time_limit_seconds = 30L,
    repair_numerical_reserve = 1e-6, repair_day_tolerance = 1e-6,
    repair_gva_extra_cells_per_pattern = 2L, repair_gva_positive_tolerance = 1e-10,
    repair_max_variables = 10000L, repair_max_nonzeros = 100000L,
    other_gvl_mode = "activity_elastic", other_gvl_beta = 0.5,
    other_gvl_cap_at_reference = TRUE)
  e$.smart31_repair <- new.env(parent = emptyenv()); e$.smart31_repair$repairs <- list()
  e$.smart31_initial <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
  e$.smart31_initial$joint_audits <- list(); e$.smart31_initial$initial_economics <- list()
  checks <- character()
  pass <- function(name) checks <<- c(checks, name)
  expect_error <- function(expr, pattern) {
    msg <- tryCatch({force(expr); "NO_ERROR"}, error = function(c) conditionMessage(c))
    if (!grepl(pattern, msg, fixed = TRUE)) stop("Unexpected test error: ", msg)
  }
  physical <- list(trip_limit_hours = 23.5, trip_reserved_hours = .5,
    min_fishing_hours_per_trip = 4, max_fishing_hours_per_trip = 16,
    max_navigation_fraction = .6, initial_quota_utilisation = .98)

    representative_period = .smart31_case$periods$baseline, member_state = .smart31_case$domain$country, cm_status = "with_cm",
    selectivity_rules = list(), parameters = list(max_days_per_month = 25, landing_price_multiplier = 1))

    days_scenario_gear = c(6, 2, 5), days_scenario = c(8, 8, 5), scenario_trips = c(6, 2, 5),

    steaming_time_reference_scenario = c(12,4,10), fishing_time_elasticity = .5,
    fishing_fuel_l_per_h = c(2,1,3), steaming_fuel_l_per_h = c(3,2,4),
    GVL_other_reference_month = c(60,20,40), EC_share = .2,
    OC_share = c(.15,.2,.12), LC_share = .2)

  e$vessel_other_gvl_reference <- tibble::tibble(
    CFR = c("A", "A", "B"), Gear = c("OTB", "LLS", "OTB"),
    GVL_other_reference_annual = c(60, 20, 40))
  e$.smart31_initial$original_time <- g %>%
    dplyr::transmute(CFR = .data$CFR, Gear = .data$Gear, days_reference = .data$days_scenario_gear)

  stopifnot(abs(e$smart31_other_gvl_other_gvl_target(100, 70, 100) - 100 * sqrt(.7)) < 1e-10)
  stopifnot(abs(e$smart31_other_gvl_other_gvl_target(100, 120, 100) - 100) < 1e-10)
  old_mode <- e$cfg$other_gvl_mode
  e$cfg$other_gvl_mode <- "per_day_reference"
  stopifnot(abs(e$smart31_other_gvl_other_gvl_target(100, 70, 100) - 70) < 1e-10)
  e$cfg$other_gvl_mode <- "fixed_annual_reference"
  stopifnot(abs(e$smart31_other_gvl_other_gvl_target(100, 70, 100) - 100) < 1e-10)
  e$cfg$other_gvl_mode <- old_mode
  pass("activity_elastic_other_gvl_interpolates_between_day_proportional_and_fixed_caps_at_reference")
  d <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(g)), function(i) tibble::tibble(

  e$italian_effort_quotas <- q
  localkeys <- unique(unlist(lapply(kernels,function(k) k$local_key),use.names=FALSE))
  ctx <- list(feasible=TRUE, scenario=scenario, working_baseline_controls=physical,

    revenue_rate=rates$revenue_rate, catch_rate=rates$catch_rate, catch_species=rates$catch_species,
    quota_species="HKE", diagnostic_species=rates$catch_species,
    fixed_non_vms_quota_catch=c(HKE=2), fixed_non_vms_species_catch=c(DPS=0,HKE=2),
    catch_quota_limits=tibble::tibble(YEAR=.smart31_years$baseline,Species="HKE",quota_kg=1000),

    effort_limits=c(OTB_LIMIT=1000,LLS_LIMIT=1000),effort_quota_table=q,
    retained_vessels=tibble::tibble(CFR=c("A","B"),loa=20),

  base <- e$smart31_working_state(ctx)
  ctx$economic_reference <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(base$evaluation_by_unit,function(z)z$economic))
  ctx$cessation_reference <- ctx$economic_reference[0,]
```

## Run scenarios

```{r step2-30-run-scenarios}

run_smart31_scenario <- function(scenario) {
  scenario_finished <- FALSE
  on.exit({
    if (!scenario_finished) {
      smart31_monitor_event(
        event = "scenario_ended_abnormally",
        phase = "interrupted_or_error",
        scenario_id = scenario$scenario_id,
        note = "inspect the final live-monitor row for the last completed position"
      )
    }
  }, add = TRUE)

  smart31_monitor_event(
    event = "scenario_started",
    phase = "scenario_preparation",
    scenario_id = scenario$scenario_id,
    maximum_sweeps = as.integer(scenario$parameters$maximum_sweeps),
    note = paste0(
      scenario$representative_period,
      "; ", scenario$cm_status
    )
  )

  context <- tryCatch(
    smart31_condition_joint_context(smart31_complete_context(prepare_scenario_context(scenario))),
    error = function(condition) {
      if (!isTRUE(cfg$continue_after_run_error)) stop(condition)
      issue <- paste0("preparation_unresolved: ", conditionMessage(condition))
      smart31_repair_write(data.frame(scenario_id = scenario$scenario_id,
        status = "preparation_unresolved", issue = issue,
        proof_of_management_infeasibility = FALSE), "preparation_failure", scenario$scenario_id)
      list(feasible = FALSE, issue = issue, preparation_error = TRUE,
        diagnostic = data.frame(issue = issue, proof_of_management_infeasibility = FALSE))
    })

  if (!isTRUE(context$feasible)) {
    result <- list(
      scenario_id = scenario$scenario_id,
      scenario_year = scenario$scenario_year,
      representative_period = scenario$representative_period,
      member_state = scenario$member_state,
      cm_status = scenario$cm_status,
      feasible = FALSE,
      stage = if (isTRUE(context$preparation_error)) "scenario_preparation_unresolved" else "scenario_preparation",
      issue = context$issue,
      diagnostic = context$diagnostic %||% NULL,
      day_allocations = context$day_allocations %||% NULL,
      cm_allocation_audit = context$cm_allocation_audit %||% NULL,
      effort_quota_audit = context$effort_quota_audit %||% NULL,
      catch_quota_audit = context$catch_quota_audit %||% NULL
    )
    scenario_finished <- TRUE
    smart31_monitor_event(
      event = if (isTRUE(context$preparation_error)) "scenario_preparation_failed" else "scenario_infeasible",
      phase = "scenario_preparation",
      scenario_id = scenario$scenario_id,
      note = context$issue
    )
    return(result)
  }

  .smart31_monitor$historical_gva_by_scenario[[scenario$scenario_id]] <-
    sum(context$economic_reference$GVA) + sum(context$cessation_reference$GVA)
  smart31_monitor_detail_guard(smart31_monitor_detail_reference(context))
  smart31_preflight_context(context)

  methods <- if (scenario$method == "both") {
    c("bayesian_dirichlet", "stochastic_optimizer")
  } else {
    scenario$method
  }

  run_grid <- tidyr::crossing(
    method = methods,
    replicate = seq_len(as.integer(
      scenario$parameters$n_replicates
    ))
  )

  smart31_monitor_event(
    event = "scenario_preparation_completed",
    phase = "scenario_preparation",
    scenario_id = scenario$scenario_id,
    total_units = dplyr::n_distinct(context$gear_time$unit_id),
    note = paste0(nrow(run_grid), " method-replicate runs scheduled")
  )

  n_runs <- nrow(run_grid)
  runs <- vector("list", n_runs)
  for (run_position in seq_len(n_runs)) {
    run_method <- run_grid$method[[run_position]]
    run_replicate <- run_grid$replicate[[run_position]]

    run_result <- tryCatch({
      result <- smart31_load_completed_run(context, run_method, run_replicate)
      if (is.null(result)) result <- run_one_simulation(context, run_method, run_replicate)
      result
    }, error = function(e) {
      if (!isTRUE(cfg$continue_after_run_error)) stop(e)
      smart31_monitor_event(event = "run_aborted", phase = "run_execution",
        scenario_id = scenario$scenario_id, method = run_method, replicate = run_replicate,
        note = conditionMessage(e))
      list(feasible = FALSE, method = run_method, replicate = run_replicate,
        seed = smart31_run_seed(context, run_method, run_replicate), stage = "run_execution",
        issue = "run_aborted_with_error", diagnostic = tibble::tibble(message = conditionMessage(e)))
    })

    if (!is.list(run_result) ||
        !is.logical(run_result$feasible) ||
        length(run_result$feasible) != 1L ||
        is.na(run_result$feasible)) {
      smart31_stop(
        "Invalid simulation result for scenario ", scenario$scenario_id,
        "; method ", run_method, "; replicate ", run_replicate,
        ". Expected a list with one non-missing logical 'feasible' field."
      )
    }
    if (!identical(as.character(run_result$method), as.character(run_method)) ||
        !identical(as.integer(run_result$replicate), as.integer(run_replicate))) {
      smart31_stop(
        "Simulation result identity mismatch for scenario ",
        scenario$scenario_id, "; method ", run_method,
        "; replicate ", run_replicate, "."
      )
    }

    smart31_monitor_detail_selected(run_result, context)

    smart31_monitor_checkpoint_run(scenario, run_result)
    if (isTRUE(run_result$feasible)) smart31_monitor_event(
      event = "run_output_selected", phase = "checkpoint", scenario_id = scenario$scenario_id,
      method = run_method, replicate = run_replicate,
      total_GVA = sum(run_result$outputs$economic_monthly$GVA),
      reference_GVA = sum(run_result$outputs$initial_economic_monthly$GVA),
      note = "Selected final output archived; not an additional optimisation sweep")
    runs[run_position] <- list(smart31_archive_compact_run(run_result, scenario))

    if (exists("result", inherits = FALSE)) rm(result)
    rm(run_result)
    invisible(gc(verbose = FALSE))
  }

  if (length(runs) != n_runs || any(vapply(runs, is.null, logical(1)))) {
    smart31_stop(
      "Internal run-collection error for scenario ", scenario$scenario_id,
      ": the result list does not match the method-replicate grid."
    )
  }

  names(runs) <- paste(
    run_grid$method,
    sprintf("rep%03d", run_grid$replicate),
    sep = "__"
  )

  result <- list(
    scenario_id = scenario$scenario_id,
    scenario_year = scenario$scenario_year,
    representative_period = scenario$representative_period,
    member_state = scenario$member_state,
    cm_status = scenario$cm_status,
    feasible = all(vapply(runs, function(x) isTRUE(x$feasible), logical(1))),
    context = list(
      crowding_limit = context$crowding_limit,
      day_allocations = context$day_allocations,
      cm_allocation_audit = context$cm_allocation_audit,
      effort_quota_audit = context$effort_quota_audit,
      catch_quota_fixed_audit = context$catch_quota_fixed_audit,
      catch_quota_species_coverage =
        context$catch_quota_species_coverage
    ),
    run_grid = run_grid,
    runs = runs
  )

  scenario_finished <- TRUE
  smart31_monitor_event(
    event = "scenario_completed",
    phase = "scenario_complete",
    scenario_id = scenario$scenario_id,
    note = paste0(
      sum(vapply(runs, function(x) isTRUE(x$feasible), logical(1))),
      "/", length(runs), " feasible runs"
    )
  )

  result
}
```

```{r step2-31-collect-simulation-outputs}
run_status <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  simulation_results,
  function(result, scenario_id) {
    if (!isTRUE(result$feasible) && is.null(result$runs)) {
      return(tibble::tibble(
        scenario_id = scenario_id,
        scenario_year = result$scenario_year,
        representative_period = result$representative_period,
        member_state = result$member_state,
        cm_status = result$cm_status,
        method = NA_character_,
        replicate = NA_integer_,
        feasible = FALSE,
        converged = FALSE,
        stage = result$stage,
        issue = result$issue,
        accepted_updates = NA_integer_
      ))
    }

    purrr::imap_dfr(
      result$runs,
      function(run, run_id) {
        tibble::tibble(
          scenario_id = scenario_id,
          scenario_year = result$scenario_year,
          representative_period = result$representative_period,
          member_state = result$member_state,
          cm_status = result$cm_status,
          method = run$method %||% sub("__.*$", "", run_id),
          replicate = run$replicate %||% NA_integer_,
          feasible = isTRUE(run$feasible),
          converged = if (isTRUE(run$feasible)) {
            isTRUE(run$outputs$converged)
          } else {
            FALSE
          },
          stage = run$stage %||% "completed",
          issue = run$issue %||% NA_character_,
          accepted_updates = if (isTRUE(run$feasible)) {
            run$outputs$accepted_updates
          } else {
            NA_integer_
          }
        )
      }
    )
  }
)

smart31_final_reference_audit <- function(catches, runs, limits) {
  if(!nrow(limits)) return(tibble::tibble())
  ids <- c("scenario_id","method","replicate")
  runs <- unique(runs[runs$representative_period==.smart31_case$periods$future & runs$feasible,ids,drop=FALSE])
  lim <- limits[limits$YEAR==.smart31_years$future_start,,drop=FALSE]
  result <- list()
  for(i in seq_len(nrow(runs))) {
    keep <- catches$representative_period==.smart31_case$periods$future
    for(nm in ids) keep <- keep & catches[[nm]]==runs[[nm]][i]
    kg <- smart31_quota_catches(catches[keep,,drop=FALSE],paste0("STOCK::",lim$assessment_stock))
    z <- data.frame(runs[rep(i,nrow(lim)),,drop=FALSE],assessment_stock=lim$assessment_stock,
      Species=lim$Species,scenario_catch_kg=unname(kg),fmsy_catch_limit_kg=lim$quota_kg)
    z$F_calibrated <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(lim)),function(j)smart31_monitor_f_at_catch(kg[j],lim[j,,drop=FALSE]),numeric(1))
    z$Fmsy <- lim$Fmsy;z$F_over_Fmsy<-z$F_calibrated/z$Fmsy
    z$bound_respected <- z$scenario_catch_kg<=z$fmsy_catch_limit_kg*(1+quota_tolerance_fraction)+1e-6
    z$F_bound_respected <- is.finite(z$F_calibrated) & z$F_calibrated<=z$Fmsy+1e-8
    result[[i]] <- z
  }
  out <- dplyr::bind_rows(result)
  out$enforced_in_Step2 <- out$assessment_stock %in% .smart31_case$management$fmsy_stocks
  if(nrow(out) && anyNA(out$enforced_in_Step2)) stop("Missing FMSY enforcement status.")
  if(nrow(out)!=nrow(runs)*nrow(lim) || !nrow(out) || !all((out$bound_respected & out$F_bound_respected)[out$enforced_in_Step2])) {
    print(out);stop("Independent final stock/F audit failed.")
  }
  out
}
```

```{r step2-32-collect-sweep-diagnostics}
            replicate = run$replicate,
```

```{r step2-34-save-partitioned-overview}
    f_monitor_all$replicate, sep = "__"))) {
    z <- f_monitor_all[paste(f_monitor_all$scenario_id, f_monitor_all$method,
      f_monitor_all$replicate, sep = "__") == key, , drop = FALSE]
    if (!nrow(z)) next
    z <- z[order(z$sweep), , drop = FALSE]
    fig <- ggplot2::ggplot(z, ggplot2::aes(x = .data$sweep,
      y = .data$F_over_Fmsy, colour = .data$assessment_stock)) +
      ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) + ggplot2::geom_point(size = 0.7) +
      ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "#A94343") +
      ggplot2::labs(title = paste("Calibrated F / FMSY", key), x = "Optimiser sweep",
        y = "F / FMSY", colour = "Assessment stock",
        caption = "Selected FMSY constraints; representative annual state. Dashed line = FMSY.") +
      ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
    ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(f_figure_dir, paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_-]", "_", key), ".png")),
      plot = fig, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 180, bg = "white")
  }
}

rm(reference_payload)

},error=function(e) paste("unavailable:",conditionMessage(e)))
if(!identical(unname(tools::md5sum(configured_bundle_file)),unname(configured_bundle_md5)))
  stop("Step 1 bundle checksum changed during Step 2.")
simulation_export <- list(
  metadata=list(workflow="SMART3.1 Step 2",source_document="workflows/step2.Rmd",
    storage_format="SMART31.partitioned.results.1",run_timestamp=simulation_timestamp,

    stock_constraint_scope_md5=unname(tools::md5sum(cfg$fmsy_assessment_crosswalk_file)),

    fmsy_limits_file_md5=if (isTRUE(cfg$enforce_fmsy)) unname(tools::md5sum(path.expand(cfg$fmsy_limits_file))) else NA_character_,
    maximum_sweeps=as.integer(cfg$maximum_sweeps),lpue_response_mode=cfg$lpue_response_mode,
    exploration_sweeps=cfg$exploration_sweeps,crowding_definition=paste0(cfg$crowding_scale," x historical maximum; no Q95"),
    other_gvl_mode=cfg$other_gvl_mode,other_gvl_beta=as.numeric(cfg$other_gvl_beta),
    other_gvl_cap_at_reference=isTRUE(cfg$other_gvl_cap_at_reference),
    repair_gva_extra_cells_per_pattern=as.integer(cfg$repair_gva_extra_cells_per_pattern),
    full_detail_tables_in_overview=FALSE,numerical_outputs_complete=TRUE,native_HTML_completion_verified=FALSE,
    cartography_status=cartography_status,created_utc=format(Sys.time(),tz="UTC",usetz=TRUE),session_info=utils::sessionInfo()),
  fmsy_catch_limits=fmsy_catch_limits, fmsy_reference_limits=fmsy_reference_limits,
  fmsy_reference_audit=fmsy_reference_audit, stock_constraint_scope=stock_constraint_scope,
  fmsy_constraint_audit=fmsy_constraint_audit,
  scenarios=scenarios,configuration=cfg,run_status=run_status,run_archives=run_archives,
  reference_file=basename(reference_file),cartography_file=basename(cartography_file),

  catches_summary=catches_all,spatial_patterns_summary=scenario_effort_map,
  cm_allocation_audit=cm_allocation_audit_all,day_allocations=day_allocations_all,

  catch_quota_audit=catch_quota_audit_all,effort_quota_audit=effort_quota_audit_all,
  sweep_diagnostics=convergence_all,sweep_catch_diagnostics=sweep_catch_diagnostics_all,

  surface_diagnostics=list(historical_effort=historical_effort_map,historical_catches=historical_catch_vessel,

    warnings=.smart31_monitor$rich_warnings),
  report_options=cfg[c("figure_dpi","comparison_monthly_maps","map_months_per_page","monthly_absolute_atlases","render_figures")])
simulation_export_file <- file.path(simulation_output_directory,paste0("SMART31_step2_simulation_results_",simulation_timestamp,".rds"))
```

## Render external graphical report

```{r step2-35-render-external-graphical-report, results='asis'}

report_result <- tryCatch({
  smart31_archive_render_report(simulation_export,simulation_output_directory,reuse_existing=TRUE)
},error=function(e) {
  path<-file.path(simulation_output_directory,paste0("report_failure_",simulation_timestamp,".txt"))
  writeLines(c("Numerical results remain saved.",conditionMessage(e),
    "Rebuild using scripts/rebuild_gallery.R and the compact overview."),path)
  list(error=conditionMessage(e),report_file=NA_character_)
})
if(!is.null(report_result$report_file) && !is.na(report_result$report_file)) {
  link<-smart31_archive_relative_path(report_result$report_file,getwd())
  cat("\n\n**[Open the complete graphical gallery](",link,
    ")** — external PNGs, numerical summaries and individual figure status.\n\n",sep="")
  smart31_monitor_event(event="report_assets_completed",phase="report_assets_complete",
    note=paste0("External gallery saved; ",sum(report_result$manifest$status=="failed"),
      " figure(s) failed. Native knit HTML conversion is a separate final stage."))
} else {
  cat("\n\nGraphical reporting stopped: ",smart31_html_escape(report_result$error),
      ". Numerical results are saved and may be inspected independently.\n\n",sep="")
  smart31_monitor_event(event="report_assets_failed",phase="report_assets_failed",note=report_result$error)
}
```
